description.zh: FA是兽迷文化中最大的网络社群，拥有庞大的艺术家社群。因网站本身因技术过老、搜索功能太弱而被诟病。
description.en: As one of the largest and oldest furry art communities, Fur Affinity is a hub for artists and art enthusiasts. Here, you can explore an extensive gallery of furry artwork, connect with artists, and even commission custom pieces.

description.zh: e621 是全球最大的 Furry 兽人插画图库，是一个拥有论坛等高级功能的艺术社群，也是 Furry 文化爱好者必备网站。
description.en: For those with an interest in adult furry art, e621 is a popular imageboard-style site. It hosts an extensive collection of furry art, providing a platform for artists to share their work and for users to explore a wide range of content.

description.zh: e926 是 e621 的镜像站点，仅展示 e621 中对公众友好的 SFW 作品。
description.en: e926 is a mirror site of e621, displaying only the public-friendly SFW (Safe For Work) works from e621.

description.zh: e6ai 是 e621 旗下的非盈利兽人 AI 艺术社区，收录的作品均为 AIGC 生成。
description.en: e6ai is a non-profit Furry AI art community under e621, where all collected works are generated by AIGC.

description.zh: WildDream 是中国最知名的 Furry 艺术网站，拥有专业技术团队，主要为大陆及港台地区用户提供服务。
description.en: WildDream is the most well-known Furry art website in China, with a professional technical team, mainly providing services for users in mainland China and the Hong Kong and Taiwan regions.

description.zh: 最全的兽人控游戏索引，收集了各种兽人控游戏，从传统角色扮演兽游到恋爱模拟，或是战略类兽人游戏，甚至更小众的选择，你都能在这里找到。
description.en: The most comprehensive and thorough index of furry and kemono games can be found here, featuring a wide range of titles from RPGs to unique simulation and strategy games.

description.zh: FGI (FurryGamesIndex 的缩写) 是一个致力于收集、组织、分类、标签“兽人游戏”或包含 furry、kemono 内容的游戏的项目。同时也收集这些游戏的第三方本地化资源链接。
description.en: FGI (short for FurryGamesIndex) is a project to collect, organize, classify, tag games which are "furry games" or include furry and/or kemono contents. Also collect third-party localized resource links for these games.

description.zh: FurryBar 是一款 Furry 向 AI + 社交产品，主要提供文字类 AIGC 服务。
description.en: FurryBar is a Furry-oriented AI + social product, mainly providing text-based AIGC services.

description.zh: CyberFurry 是一款基于开源大语言模型自研的 Furry 聊天应用，永久免费，你可以在这里创建角色并与赛博福瑞聊天。
description.en: CyberFurry is a Furry-themed chat application independently developed based on open-source large language models. It is permanently free, allowing you to create characters and chat with cyber furries here.

description.zh: 兽聚汇是专为 Furry 群体打造的平台，核心提供委托、定制等服务，满足用户相关交易需求。
description.en: Shou juhui is a platform designed specifically for the Furry community, focusing on providing services such as commission and customization to meet users' relevant trading needs.

description.zh: Furry Writers’ Guild 是服务兽人文学创作者的组织，核心功能为支持、指导、提升并推广优质拟人化小说及创作者。
description.en: The Furry Writers’ Guild is a resource for furry writers, offering support, advice, and a platform for showcasing furry literature within the fandom.

description.zh: FUR-PAW绒爪™实验室是小动物主题的周边设计品牌
description.en: FUR-PAW-Lab is a design brand for animal-themed products

description.zh: 翎迹网络推出的 Furry 云赋能计划，是面向 Furry 相关项目线上业务的专属定制化云计算解决方案，提供低价甚至免费服务，兼具安全性。
description.en: WingMark Network has launched the Furry Cloud Empowerment Program, a customized cloud computing solution for the online business of Furry-related projects, offering low-cost or even free services with security.

description.zh: UTAU 中华兽人组以科普中 U 兽相关角色形象信息为核心，帮助用户更清晰地了解中 U 兽相关内容。
description.en: UTAU Chinese Furry Group focuses on popularizing character image information related to Chinese UTAU Furries, helping users understand Chinese UTAU Furries more clearly.

description.zh: 福瑞之家是翎迹网络旗下的 Furry 相关导航站点。
description.en: Furry Home is a Furry-related navigation site under WingMark Matrix.

description.zh: WikiFur是专门收集兽人爱好者相关、感兴趣及实用内容的百科类站点，为用户提供兽圈相关知识查询服务。
description.en: Furry Encyclopedia is an encyclopedia site specifically collecting content related to, of interest to, and useful for Furry enthusiasts, providing Furry fandom-related knowledge query services for users.

description.zh: 高校兽迷联盟是公益类网站，旨在为各校兽友群体搭建联系桥梁，帮助用户寻找同校兽友。
description.en: University Association of Furries is a public welfare website, aiming to build a connection bridge for furry groups in various universities and help users find fellow furries in the same school.

description.zh: 绒兽志专注为兽装爱好者提供创作空间与分享渠道，助力爱好者交流兽装相关内容、展现创作成果。
description.en: Rongshouzhi focuses on providing creation spaces and sharing channels for fursuit enthusiasts, helping them exchange fursuit-related content and showcase their creative achievements.

description.zh: 以茶会毛是一场位于中国台湾地区的兽圈专属展会，为当地 Furry 爱好者提供线下交流、互动的平台。
description.en: Furry Tea Party is an exclusive Furry exhibition held in Taiwan Region of China, providing an offline communication and interaction platform for local Furry enthusiasts.

description.zh: 绒毛墙是面向兽人控的专属交流平台，核心功能为供用户分享日常生活相关内容，促进同好间的互动与交流。
description.en: FurWall is an exclusive communication platform for Furry fans, with the core function of allowing users to share content related to daily life and promoting interaction among like-minded people.

description.zh: GameMale是面向同性恋群体的专业论坛平台，平台内包含大量同性向兽人相关内容，供目标用户交流与浏览。
description.en: GameMale is a professional forum platform for the gay community, which contains a large amount of gay-oriented Furry-related content for target users to communicate and browse.

description.zh: 幻龙之域是专为龙爱好者打造的平台，聚焦龙相关艺术内容的展示与交流，满足龙文化爱好者的兴趣需求。
description.en: Furagon is a platform designed specifically for dragon enthusiasts, focusing on the display and exchange of dragon-related art content to meet the interests of dragon culture lovers.

description.zh: 狼之乐园是面向动物、Furry 及奇幻生物爱好者的交流与创作分享平台，涵盖多元兴趣方向，为同好提供互动交流、作品展示的综合空间。
description.en: Wolf Paradise is a communication and creation-sharing platform for animal, Furry, and fantasy creature enthusiasts, covering diverse interest areas and providing a comprehensive space for like-minded people to interact and showcase their works.

description.zh: 鳞目界域是以龙为核心主题的专属站点，其创立初衷是为龙文化爱好者搭建交流想法、分享相关见闻的专属平台，聚焦龙类相关内容的互动与传播。
description.en: Draconian zone is an exclusive site centered on the dragon theme. Its founding purpose is to build a dedicated platform for dragon culture enthusiasts to exchange ideas and share relevant experiences, focusing on the interaction and dissemination of dragon-related content.

description.zh: 野性城邦是一个中文兽迷网络论坛，致力于营造一个中文兽迷得以畅所欲言的空间。
description.en: Wildpolis is a Chinese furry online forum dedicated to creating a space where Chinese furries can speak freely.

description.zh: 龙幻世界是以龙为核心主题的平台，主要围绕幻想故事的创作与讨论展开，为龙文化及幻想文学爱好者提供交流想法、分享创作的专属空间。
description.en: Dragicland is a platform centered on the dragon theme, focusing on the creation and discussion of fantasy stories, and providing an exclusive space for dragon culture and fantasy literature enthusiasts to exchange ideas and share creations.

description.zh: 兽人控小说站是聚焦兽人题材文学的内容平台，核心收录大量中文及多语言兽人向小说，涵盖奇幻、剧情、同人等多元类型，同时包含创作委托、作品分享等相关功能，为兽人文学爱好者提供阅读与交流的专属空间。
description.en: FurryNovel is a content platform focusing on Furry-themed literature. It mainly collects a large number of Chinese and multilingual Furry novels, covering diverse genres such as fantasy, plot-driven, and fan fiction. It also includes functions like creation commissions and work sharing, providing an exclusive space for Furry literature enthusiasts to read and communicate.

description.zh: Linpx 是专注于兽人题材文学的手机端专属阅读平台，界面仅适配移动设备，为兽人文学爱好者提供便捷的移动端阅读体验，可浏览、阅读各类兽人相关小说内容。
description.en: Linpx is a mobile-exclusive reading platform focusing on Furry-themed literature. Its interface is only adapted to mobile devices, providing a convenient mobile reading experience for Furry literature enthusiasts to browse and read various Furry-related novels .

description.zh: GoFurry 是专注于兽圈基础建设的公益性质平台，为兽圈用户提供支持，助力兽圈生态的规范与良性发展。
description.en: GoFurry is a public welfare platform dedicated to the infrastructure development of the Furry fandom. It mainly provides targeted support for Furry fandom users, contributing to the standardized development and positive cycle of the Furry fandom ecosystem.

description.zh: 兽展日历整合并更新全球各大兽人专属展会举办时间，附展会地点等辅助信息，供兽圈爱好者查询、规划参与行程。
description.en: Furry Exhibition Calendar integrates and updates the holding time of major global Furry Furry exhibition, with auxiliary info like venues, for fans to query and plan participation.

description.zh: 兽聚汇总整合各类兽展举办时间信息，供兽圈爱好者快速查询，助力规划参与行程。
description.en: FurryFusion integrates time info of various Furry conventions for fans to query quickly and plan participation.

description.zh: Furscience 专注开展兽人群体相关的社会学、心理学等领域学术研究，推动该群体相关学术内容的探索与传播。
description.en: Focuses on conducting academic research in sociology, psychology and other fields related to the furry community, promoting the exploration and dissemination of relevant academic content.

description.zh: 万物通行(ww-pass)是一个日系兽装工作室。成立于2019年，拥有国内庞大的忠实爱好群体。还拥有角色汤（Char-Shop）商店系统，帮助兽迷找到属于自己的角色。
description.en: Wanwu Tongxing (ww-pass) is a Japanese-style fursuit studio. Founded in 2019, it has a large group of loyal fans in China. It also has the Char-Shop (Juese Tang) store system, which helps furries find their own characters.

description.zh: 象山工作室（XiangShanStudio）是一个2021年在浙江省杭州市成立的兽装工作室。
description.en: XiangShan Studio (founded in 2021 in Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province) is a fursuit studio.

description.zh: 文禽武兽工作室（Gentlefur），是一间位于中国福建的兽装制作商。除了制作兽装部件，也从事保冷背心、香水等兽装辅具及周边商品制作。
description.en: Gentlefur (Wenqin Wushou Studio) is a fursuit manufacturer located in Fujian, China. In addition to making fursuit parts, it also produces fursuit accessories such as cooling vests and perfumes, as well as peripheral products.

description.zh: 飞兽爪屋（FlyPaws），原名为海伦实验（Helen Workshop），是一家位于广州市的全职兽装制作工作室，擅长制作混系单头。早期风格以萌系kemomo为主，随着制作工艺的成熟，转变为美系混合。
description.en: FlyPaws (originally named Helen Workshop, formerly known as Feishou Zhuawu) is a full-time fursuit-making studio located in Guangzhou City. It specializes in creating mixed-style single-head fursuits. Its early style was mainly cute kemomo, and as its production techniques matured, it shifted to a mix of American styles.

description.zh: mofumofu手作，是2019年成立的中国兽装工作室。
description.en: Mofumofu Handmade is a Chinese fursuit studio founded in 2019.

description.zh: 鸿萌造物（Furmony）创建于2022年年底，位于广东省广州市，致力于在保持兽装定制的精致度的同时缩短委托等待的周期。
description.en: Furmony (Hongmeng Zao wu) was founded at the end of 2022 and is located in Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province. It is committed to maintaining the exquisiteness of custom fursuits while shortening the waiting period for commissions.

description.zh: 爻光星（ALKAID）兽装工作室，成立于2022年，位于广东省。
description.en: ALKAID (Yaoguangxing) Fursuit Studio was founded in 2022 and is located in Guangdong Province.

description.zh: 苍牌毛化（CANGPAIFUR）是一家创立于2023年7月的兽装制作工作室。位于四川省成都市。
description.en: CANGPAIFUR (Cangpai Maohua) is a fursuit-making studio founded in July 2023. It is located in Chengdu City, Sichuan Province.

description.zh: 十方百兽（Sfursuit）创立于2021年初，位于江西，是早期的兽装工作室之一。
description.en: Sfursuit (Shifang Baishou) was founded in early 2021, located in Jiangxi Province, and is one of the early fursuit studios.

description.zh: 奇幻工坊（StarFire）是一家创办于2024年初的兽装制作团队，致力于打造一个融合个性与创意的奇幻世界，让每一个想象都能在这里找到属于自己的舞台。
description.en: StarFire (Qihuan Gongfang) is a fursuit-making team founded in early 2024. It is committed to building a fantasy world that integrates personality and creativity, allowing every imagination to find its own stage here.

description.zh: NF兽装工作室，英文商标全名 Nagi Fursuit，是间位于台湾的兽装工作室。制作风格力求拟真写实，擅长制作龙、狼、犬科、猫科物种。
description.en: NF Fursuit Studio, whose full English trademark name is Nagi Fursuit, is a fursuit studio located in Taiwan, China. Its production style strives for realism, and it specializes in creating fursuits of species such as dragons, wolves, canines and felines.

description.zh: 天邪鬼工作室（Atelier Amanojaku）是位于日本名古屋的一家专注于制作兽装的团队，也是目前日本国内每年生产兽装数量最多的工作室。
description.en: Atelier Amanojaku is a team focusing on fursuit making located in Nagoya, Japan, and it is also the studio that produces the largest number of fursuits annually in Japan currently.

description.zh: 犬工房（Inu-Koubou），英文名 Doggy Studio，是一个位于日本千叶县千叶市创建的兽装制作商，创立于2017年10月，制作风格介于卡通及半写实风格之间。
description.en: Inu-Koubou (Quangongfang), also known by its English name Doggy Studio, is a fursuit manufacturer founded in Chiba City, Chiba Prefecture, Japan in October 2017. Its production style falls between cartoon and semi-realistic styles.

description.zh: K-LINE，全名为 Kemono-LINE，简称K家。命名意义为“拉起与けもの（兽）的连线”，缩写恰好音似英语的 Canine（犬科）一字。知名日本兽装制作商，制作风格以动漫风格为主，但也从事半写实风格与写实风格兽装制作。
description.en: K-LINE, whose full name is Kemono-LINE and often referred to as "K Jia" (K Family) for short, derives its name from the meaning "connecting with kemono (beasts)". Coincidentally, its abbreviation sounds similar to the English word "Canine" (canines). As a well-known Japanese fursuit manufacturer, it mainly adopts an anime-style production approach, but also engages in creating fursuits in semi-realistic and realistic styles.

description.zh: きぐるみ花月是位于日本大阪市的兽装工作室。制作风格偏向美式卡通风格，轮廓方正鲜明，鼻头膨大。然而即便外型粗犷，斑纹设计及整体做工仍可见精致之处。
description.en: Kigurumi Kagetuki is a fursuit studio located in Osaka City, Japan. Its production style leans towards American cartoon style, featuring sharp and distinct square outlines and enlarged noses. Nevertheless, despite the rugged appearance, the delicacy of its pattern designs and overall craftsmanship is still evident.

description.zh: Clockwork Creature，是一间位于美国马里兰州巴尔的摩市的艺术装扮工作室，创立于2005年。擅长制作极为拟真、戏剧化且可怕的装扮，且其写实风格不仅限套用于现实生物，虚拟的奇幻生物也能做的栩栩如生。
description.en: Clockwork Creature is an artistic costume studio located in Baltimore, Maryland, USA, founded in 2005. It specializes in creating highly realistic, dramatic, and terrifying costumes. Its realistic style is not limited to real-world creatures—it can also bring fictional fantasy creatures to life with vivid detail.

description.zh: Drakonicknight，是一间位于美国威斯康辛州的兽装制作商；而除了贩售兽装，该工作室也贩售育种箭毒蛙。
description.en: Drakonicknight is a fursuit manufacturer located in Wisconsin, USA; in addition to selling fursuits, this studio also sells captive-bred poison dart frogs.

description.zh: Made Fur You是一间位于美国佛罗里达州的兽装制作商。命名由来为“Made for you”的谐音。专精卡通风格兽装制作，制作物种广泛多元。2010创立至今已出产近千套兽装。
description.en: Made Fur You is a fursuit manufacturer located in Florida, USA. Its name comes from a homophone of "Made for you". It specializes in creating cartoon-style fursuits, with a wide and diverse range of species. Founded in 2010, it has produced nearly 1,000 fursuits to date.

description.zh: 坏龙是全球最早从事兽人元素相关情趣玩具销售的厂商，至今已发展为规模最大、知名度最高的兽人情趣玩具品牌商。
description.en: Bad Dragon is the world's earliest manufacturer engaged in the sale of adult toys with furry elements, and has now developed into the largest and most well-known brand of furry-themed adult toys.

description.zh: Weredog 是世界知名的兽人元素情趣玩具厂商，同时也是英国规模最大的该类厂商，拥有全球工艺最精细的爪模造型情趣玩具。
description.en: Weredog is a world-renowned manufacturer of furry-themed adult toys, and also the largest manufacturer of its kind in the UK, with the most exquisitely crafted paw mold-shaped adult toys globally.

description.zh: Naughty Fox 是德国最知名的兽人元素情趣玩具厂商，旗下玩具造型多样，可满足你的兽人幻想。
description.en: Naughty Fox is the most well-known Furry-themed adult toy manufacturer in Germany, with a variety of toy designs to satisfy users' Furry fantasies.

description.zh: 幻龙是中国最知名的兽人元素情趣玩具厂商，主营兽人风格高端情趣产品，同时提供兽人情趣玩具私人订制服务。
description.en: Nothosaur is the most well-known Furry-themed adult toy manufacturer in China, mainly selling high-end Furry-style adult products and providing custom-made services for Furry-themed adult toys.

description.zh: u18chan 是一个老式的毛茸茸社区论坛，你可以在这里分享你感兴趣的图片、漫画以及游戏等资源。
description.en: u18chan is an old-fashioned furry community forum where you can share resources you are interested in, such as images, comics, and games.

description.zh: Inkbunny 是一个兽人控艺术社区，欢迎各种技能水平的艺术家。
description.en: Inkbunny is another furry art community that welcomes artists of all skill levels. The site supports a variety of content types, including visual art, stories, music, and even 3D artwork.

description.zh: Furbooru 是一个专门针对福瑞控群体的图像分享/评论/投票系统。
description.en: Furbooru is an image booru (sharing/commenting/voting system) specifically aimed at the furry fandom.

description.zh: 兽时社区是一个兽人控社交平台，亮点功能为兽展地图。
description.en: Shoutime Community is a furry social platform, whose standout feature is the furry convention map.

description.zh: 兽人星球是一个中国大陆大型兽人主题论坛，基于 Discuz 论坛系统搭建。该网站涵盖的主要兽人内容包括动画、音乐、游戏、文学等。
description.en: Furry Star is a large-scale furry-themed forum in Chinese Mainland, built on the Discuz forum system. The main furry-related content covered on this website includes animations, music, games, literature, and more.

description.zh: 你好兽聚(Hi Furry) 创办于2023年初，致力于传播优秀的Furry文化，秉承着"为毛毛们带来便捷，愉悦且舒适的聚会体验"这一愿景，以真诚，亲切的态度努力让大家的每一次聚会都能留下一段愉快的记忆！
description.en: Hi Furry was founded in early 2023. Committed to promoting excellent Furry culture, adhering to the vision of "bringing convenient, pleasant and comfortable gathering experiences to furries", and striving to make every gathering leave a pleasant memory for everyone with a sincere and friendly attitude!

description.zh: 为兽人控社区创建最全面、最用户友好的搜索平台。
description.en: FurryBox aims to create the most comprehensive and user-friendly search platform for the furry fan community.

description.zh: furrykong 是一个付费资源网站，但旗下资源均未有官方授权。
description.en: Furrykong is a paid resource website, but none of the resources under its umbrella have official authorization.

description.zh: 趣绮梦是一个集成云存储、云打标、模板集市、稿件集市、网站反诈和PSD文件查看器六大核心功能，为Furry兽圈用户提供安全便捷的文件管理与交易平台。
description.en: Quqimeng is a platform that integrates six core functions—cloud storage, cloud tagging, template marketplace, submission marketplace, website anti-fraud, and PSD file viewer—and provides a secure and convenient file management and transaction service for users in the Furry community.

description.zh: 一个与众不同的艺术、创意为主的兽人控社区。
description.en: An artistic, creative furry community unlike any other

description.zh: 兽化科技是一家以兽文化产品为主的小微互联网企业，为多个兽聚提供技术支持。
description.en: Shouhua Technology is a small and micro internet enterprise focusing on furry culture products, and it provides technical support for multiple furry conventions.

description.zh: VRFurry 是一个举办VRC线上聚会的中国社团，在这里你可以找到志同道合的伙伴。
description.en: VRFurry is a Chinese community that hosts VRC online gatherings, where you can meet like-minded friends.

description.zh: 云兽聚是一个由热爱福瑞文化的广大爱好者组成的线下展会，秉承开放、平等和包容的理念。
description.en: Yun Furry Gathering is an offline exhibition composed of a large number of enthusiasts who love furry culture, adhering to the concepts of openness, equality and inclusiveness.

description.zh: FurryRaiders 创立于 2007 年，2016 年进军线下，主营兽人元素商品、组织线下活动，秉持开放无偏见理念，致力于在全球兽圈构建包容社区，现成员遍布多国且社交平台影响力扩大。
description.en: Founded in 2007, FurryRaiders entered the offline world in 2016. It mainly sells furry-themed products, organizes offline events, upholds open and unbiased values, and aims to build an inclusive global furry community. Now it has members in many countries and growing influence on social platforms.

description.zh: 毛绒绒图书馆是一个已经完成开发的兽圈论坛，但内部由于桌面端转移动端、维护成本等问题发生矛盾，现已进入复活赛阶段。
description.en: FurLibrary is a fully developed furry forum. However, internal conflicts arose due to issues such as the transition from desktop to mobile version and maintenance costs, and it has now entered the revival phase.

description.zh: 极兽聚所属上海端萌文化传播有限公司，是位于上海的一系列兽聚。
description.en: Super Furry Fusion is affiliated with Shanghai Duanmeng Culture Communication Co., Ltd. and consists of a series of furry conventions based in Shanghai.

description.zh: RE621 是一套功能全面的工具组件，旨在为普通用户和高级用户提升网站的使用功能。它不仅全面优化了用户界面、简化了上传与打标签流程，还支持用户下载完整的资源合集、收藏内容，或直接下载任意选定的帖子集合。
description.en: RE621 is a comprehensive set of tools and utilities, designed to enhance the website's functionality for both casual and power users. It overhauls the UI, simplifies uploading and tagging, and allows you to download entire pools, favorites, or simply arbitrary collections of posts.

description.zh: 上海翎迹网络科技有限公司旗下的一个我的世界社团。
description.en: Minecraft Club under WingMark Network.

description.zh: FurCraft 是一个独立的社区服务器
description.en: FurCraft is an independent Minecraft community server

description.zh: SoFurry是一个多功能平台，适合艺术家、作家和角色扮演者。它为视觉艺术家提供了一个画廊，为作家提供了一个图书馆，并为用户提供了创建和分享自己毛茸茸内容的工具。
description.en: SoFurry is a versatile platform that caters to artists, writers, and role-players. It features a gallery for visual artists, a library for writers, and offers tools for users to create and share their own furry content.

description.zh: F-list 是一个专为兽人向角色扮演的论坛。用户可以创建详细的角色档案，找到兼容的合作伙伴，并参与基于文本的角色扮演场景。
description.en: F-list is a platform designed for furries interested in role-playing. Users can create detailed character profiles, find compatible partners, and engage in text-based role-playing scenarios.

description.zh: Weasyl 是一个拥有画廊的毛茸茸平台。
description.en: Weasyl is an art-centric furry platform that emphasizes user-friendly features and a clean design. Artists can showcase their work, and users can discover new content through a personalized recommendation system.

description.zh: Furvilla 是一个非常古早的兽设模板创建网站
description.en: Furvilla combines elements of socializing and gaming in a virtual furry world. Users can create characters, engage in activities, and explore a community-driven world filled with anthropomorphic creatures.

description.zh: FurryMate 是一个兽人控约会网站，兽人控的可以在这里与具有相似兴趣和关系目标的其他人聊天。
description.en: FurryMate is a furry dating site where furries can connect with others who share similar interests and relationship goals.

description.zh: Furcadia 是一款以兽人元素为主题的多人在线游戏，为兽人控提供了一个探索、社交和参与角色扮演的虚拟世界。
description.en: Furcadia is a multiplayer online game with a furry theme, offering a virtual world for furries to explore, socialize, and engage in role-playing.

description.zh: FurryFiesta 是在德克萨斯州达拉斯举行的年度兽聚。
description.en: Furry Fiesta is an annual furry convention held in Dallas, Texas. The website provides information about the event, including schedules, guests, and registration details.

description.zh: InFurNation 是一个兽人控的新闻和资源网站，涵盖兽人社区内的活动、大会和一般新闻。
description.en: InFurNation is a furry news and resource website that covers events, conventions, and general news within the furry community.

description.zh: Fursona Pins 是一家在线商店，专门制作带有各种毛茸茸角色的珐琅别针。
description.en: Fursona Pins is an online store that specializes in creating enamel pins featuring various furry characters, allowing enthusiasts to showcase their favorite designs.

description.zh: FurryRefuge 是一个充满活力的多元化社区
description.en: FurryRefuge is a vibrant and diverse community

description.zh: FurryVTuberPark 是一个兽人元素 VTuber 开播信息的汇总平台。
description.en: FurryVTuberPark is a platform that compiles information on the live broadcasts of VTubers with furry elements.

description.zh: Infurnity 是一个始于2015年的台湾兽聚，超过三分之一的人来自全球各地。
description.en: Infurnity is a Taiwanese furry convention founded in 2015, with over one-third of its attendees coming from all around the world.

description.zh: 毛毛大百科是由台湾兽迷创建的面向兽装穿着者，及兽迷展览会的Wiki。相比WikiFur，词条和活跃编辑以台湾地区居多。
description.en: Fursuiters' Wiki is a Wiki founded by Taiwanese furries, targeting fursuit wearers and furry conventions. Compared with WikiFur, most of its entries and active editors are from Taiwan, China.

description.zh: GFTV（Global Furry Television）是新加坡的兽迷新闻媒体。有兽闻60秒、兽圈周报、兽际兽闻、数据兽圈等多个新闻播报项目，且提供中文版本。
description.en: GFTV (Global Furry Television) is a furry news media outlet based in Singapore. It features multiple news programs such as 60-Second Furry News, Furry Community Weekly Report, International Furry News, and Data Insights into the Furry Fandom, and also provides a Chinese version.

description.zh: 兽化科技专注于打造最具表现力的FURRY名片平台，通过模板快速创建专属的兽设名片。
description.en: Shouhua Technology focuses on building the most expressive FURRY business card platform, enabling users to quickly create exclusive fursona business cards through templates.

description.zh: 野兽大都汇（Wild Metropolis）是一个位于上海的兽展。
description.en: Wild Metropolis (Yeshou Daduhui) is a furry convention located in Shanghai, China.

description.zh: 远吠书签（Tohboe）汉化本的在线阅读版。
description.en: The online reading version of the Chinese - translated edition of "Tohboe Bookmark".

description.zh: 日本作者飞弹丸（KAIJYU-09）的个人网站，内含《黑礁的秘密（Lagoon Lounge）》、《骑士学院（Knights College）》等作品的资讯以及周边商品。
description.en: This is the personal website of Japanese creator Kaijyu-09, which contains information about works such as Lagoon Lounge and Knights College, as well as related merchandise.

description.zh: Sungazer Software 是位于美国南卡罗来纳州斯帕坦堡的独立单人游戏开发工作室及网页设计服务公司，2014 年末注册成立。已推出多款品质优良的商业游戏，游戏平均开发周期约 2 年。
description.en: Sungazer Software is an independent one-person game development studio and web design service company located in Spartanburg, South Carolina, USA. It was incorporated in late 2014 and has released a number of high-quality commercial games, with an average game development cycle of approximately 2 years.

description.zh: Klondike工作室是来自台湾的独游工作室，代表作有《家有大猫（Nekojishi）》、《BEEK》、《Astatos》、《家有大猫2》等。
description.en: Klondike Studio is an indie game studio from Taiwan, China. Its representative works include Nekojishi (Home with Big Cats), BEEK, Astatos, and Nekojishi 2.

description.zh: 爪印文化（PawPrintPress）是 Klondike 工作室旗下的周边商店，大量销售兽人元素相关的周边产品。
description.en: PawPrintPress is a merchandise store under Klondike Studio, selling a large number of peripheral products related to furry elements.

description.zh: tailsup4tyranno的个人网站，tailsup4tyranno是一位3D模型师，你可以在这里买到这位作者的独游、小说或更多作品。
description.en: This is the personal website of tailsup4tyranno, a 3D modeler. Here you can purchase this creator's indie games, novels, and other works.

description.zh: Furarchiver 是一款针对 FurAffinity 的辅助工具类网站，核心提供两大功能：一是聚合 FurAffinity 平台内容的精准搜索服务，解决原站搜索功能较弱的问题；二是支持平台内图片的下载，为用户获取兽迷艺术作品提供便利。
description.en: Furarchiver is an auxiliary tool website designed for FurAffinity. It mainly offers two core functions: first, it provides a precise aggregated search service for content on FurAffinity, addressing the weak search function of the original site; second, it supports the download of images from the platform, facilitating users in obtaining furry artworks.

description.zh: What Are Furries 是一个专注于介绍兽迷（furry）文化的静态网站，核心功能是向新手或好奇者科普兽迷文化的定义、核心概念、社群特点等基础信息，适合作为了解兽迷文化的入门参考工具。
description.en: This is a static website dedicated to introducing furry culture. Its core function is to popularize basic information about furry culture—including definitions, core concepts, and community characteristics—to newcomers or the curious. It has a clear content structure and serves as a useful introductory reference for understanding furry culture.

description.zh: 这是一个来自中国台湾地区、以繁体中文呈现的 furry 文化静态科普网站。核心功能是向中文用户（尤其台湾地区用户）介绍兽迷文化的基础概念、社群动态与相关知识，内容风格贴合繁体中文用户阅读习惯，是区域内了解 furry 文化的入门参考。
description.en: This is a static furry culture popularization website from Taiwan Region of China, presented in Traditional Chinese. Its core function is to introduce basic concepts, community trends and related knowledge of furry culture to Chinese users (especially users in Taiwan Region). With a content style that fits the reading habits of Traditional Chinese users, it serves as an introductory reference for understanding furry culture in the region.

description.zh: FurTrack 是一款专注于兽装领域的分享类平台，核心功能包括兽装照片与视频的上传分享、标签分类管理，以及基于标签的内容发现。平台专门服务于兽装穿戴者、兽装摄影师、兽装创作者及兽迷文化爱好者，为兽装相关内容的流通与互动提供专属空间。
description.en: FurTrack is a sharing platform dedicated to the fursuit field. Its core functions include uploading and sharing fursuit photos and videos, tag classification management, and content discovery based on tags. The platform specifically serves fursuiters, fursuit photographers, fursuit creators, and furry fandom enthusiasts, providing an exclusive space for the circulation and interaction of fursuit-related content.

description.zh: Ferzu 是一款面向所有类型兽迷的社交网络与社群平台。无论你的兽设是行走、飞行还是水生形态，无论你想寻找兽迷朋友、发展约会关系或是享受趣味互动，也无论年龄、体型或兽设外观如何，都能在此找到归属感，是兽迷群体专属的社交空间。
description.en: Ferzu is a social network and community tailored for all types of furries. No matter if your fursona walks, flies, or swims, whether you're seeking furry friends, dates, or fun, and regardless of your age, body type, or fursona's appearance—you're welcome home here. It serves as an exclusive social space for the furry community.

description.zh: Flayrah 是一款运营 25 年以上的综合性 furry 新闻网站，内容覆盖兽迷展会、兽装、媒体、电影、特稿评论、科幻、艺术、电视、动物、漫画、科学、动画、网站、小说等多个领域，同时提供最新资讯、索引、存档、链接、标签分类等功能，支持用户注册登录，是兽迷领域内容全面、历史悠久的权威新闻聚合平台。
description.en: Flayrah is a comprehensive furry news website with over 25 years of operation. Its content covers various fields including furry conventions, fursuits, media, movies, eccentric opinions, sci-fi, art, television, animals, comics, science, animation, websites, and novels. It also provides functions such as recent news, indexes, archives, links, tag classifications, and supports user login/registration, serving as an authoritative and comprehensive news aggregation platform in the furry field with a long history.

description.zh: Darkcrow 是一款专注于聚合各类 furry 漫画资源的网站，核心功能为提供丰富的 furry 题材漫画资源，支持用户在线阅读漫画内容，同时具备漫画下载功能，满足兽迷群体对 furry 漫画的浏览与收藏需求。
description.en: Darkcrow is a website dedicated to aggregating various furry comic resources. Its core functions include providing a wealth of furry-themed comic resources, supporting users to read comics online, and featuring a comic download function. It caters to the needs of the furry community for browsing and collecting furry comics.

description.zh: Midwest FurFest（中西部兽迷嘉年华）是一个专注于展会宣传的官方网站，推广每年在伊利诺伊州芝加哥西郊举办的同名年度兽迷展会。该展会由非营利组织 Midwest Furry Fandom, Inc.（501 (c) 3 认证）主办，核心是庆祝以拟人化动物为核心的兽迷文化，涵盖艺术、文学与表演等领域。自 2000 年创办以来，展会规模从 388 名参与者增长至 16000 余人，成为全球最大规模的兽迷展会之一；同时累计为社会、野生动物及动物相关慈善项目筹集超 90 万美元，其艺术展单去年便通过拍卖、捐赠等形式为兽迷创作者创造了超 10 万美元收入。
description.en: Midwest FurFest is an official promotional website for the eponymous annual furry convention, held in the west suburbs of Chicago, Illinois. Organized by Midwest Furry Fandom, Inc., a 501(c)3 non-profit corporation, the convention celebrates the furry fandom—encompassing art, literature, and performances centered on anthropomorphic animals. Since its founding in 2000, the event has grown from 388 attendees to over 16,000, ranking among the world’s largest conventions of its kind. It has proudly raised more than $900,000 for various social, wildlife, and animal-related charities. Additionally, the Midwest FurFest Art Show generated over $100,000 last year alone through auctions, donations, and benefits, supporting the talented artists and makers of the furry fandom.

description.zh: Slightly Furry 是一家 LGBT 友好的兽迷主题商业平台，核心业务包含线上酒水商店与线下主题酒馆两部分：线上商店专注出售各类 furry 主题酒水饮品，线下酒馆则为兽迷群体及 LGBT 群体提供兼具主题氛围与包容环境的社交空间，既满足兽迷对主题周边的消费需求，也助力多元群体的线下互动。
description.en: Slightly Furry is an LGBT-friendly furry-themed commercial platform, consisting of two core businesses: an online liquor store and an offline themed pub. The online store specializes in selling various furry-themed alcoholic beverages, while the offline pub provides an inclusive social space with a themed atmosphere for the furry community and LGBT community. It not only meets furries’ demand for themed merchandise but also facilitates offline interaction among diverse groups.

description.zh: Anthrocon 是专注于同名兽迷展会宣传的官方网站，推广每年夏季在匹兹堡举办的年度兽迷展会，被誉为 “匹兹堡顶级兽迷展会”。展会核心是庆祝拟人化动物角色 —— 这类角色自人类想象力诞生之初便吸引着世人，参与者涵盖艺术家、动画师、作家、服装制作者、木偶表演者及各类喜爱卡通动物的普通爱好者，是兽迷群体交流互动的重要平台。
description.en: Anthrocon is the official promotional website for the eponymous furry convention, hailed as "Pittsburgh's Premier Furry Convention". Held annually every summer in Pittsburgh, the convention celebrates anthropomorphic animal characters—creatures that have fascinated mankind since the dawn of human imagination. It brings together artists, animators, writers, costumers, puppeteers, and everyday fans who enjoy cartoon animals and their kin, serving as a key platform for interaction within the furry community.

description.zh: FurDU 是澳大利亚本土兽迷展会的官方宣传网站，展会意为Furry Down Under。官网明确致敬澳大利亚各地的传统土地守护者，认可他们与土地、水域及社区的持续联结，并向这些守护者、他们的文化以及过去、现在和未来的长者表达敬意，同时作为展会核心信息发布与推广的官方平台。
description.en: FurDU is the official promotional website for Australia's local furry convention, known as "Furry Down Under". The website acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of Country throughout Australia and their continuing connection to land, waters and community. It pays respect to these Custodians, their cultures, and Elders—past, present and emerging—while serving as the official platform for releasing and promoting core information about the convention.

description.zh: Furality 是美国佛罗里达州非营利组织 Furality, Inc.运营的虚拟兽迷展会官方网站，核心推广 “Furality Online Xperience”（Furality 线上体验）这一 VR 兽迷展会。展会全程在虚拟现实环境中举办，既聚焦 VR 兽迷文化的庆祝与传播，也为参与者提供体验、学习、分享拟人化艺术的平台，涵盖即兴表演、音乐等表演艺术，以及卡通、素描、摄影、3D 建模、数字设计等视觉艺术。平台还会募集捐款支持选定的慈善机构，以动物福利与保护相关组织为主。展会源于 2020 年全球动荡隔离时期，初衷是为兽迷群体打造能贴近兽设、与各地同好互动的虚拟空间。
description.en: Furality is the official website for a virtual reality furry convention operated by Furality, Inc.—a Florida-based nonprofit organization. It focuses on promoting "Furality Online Xperience", a VR furry convention that not only takes place entirely in virtual reality but also celebrates the VR furry fandom. Its mission is to provide a forum for attendees to experience, learn, share, and celebrate anthropomorphic arts, including performing arts like improv and musical performances, as well as visual arts such as cartoons, sketches, photography, 3D modeling, and digital design. The platform also collects donations to benefit selected charitable organizations, typically (but not exclusively) those related to animal welfare and/or preservation. Founded in 2020 amid global turmoil and isolation, the convention was created to let furries feel close to their fursonas and connect with fellow fans worldwide in a virtual space.

description.zh: Furry Weekend Atlanta（简称 FWA）是美国亚特兰大兽迷展会的官方宣传网站，由社区驱动、志愿者主导的非营利组织（依据乔治亚州非营利公司法设立）运营。展会核心使命是为兽迷群体提供难忘、具教育意义、包容且安全的体验，鼓励大家探索并表达真实自我，同时在东南部及全美推广对拟人化兽迷文化的接纳与认可。展会自 2004 年创办以来逐年发展：初期 2 月举办，2009 年调整至 3 月末或 4 月初，2019 年起固定在母亲节周末，场地扩展至亚特兰大市中心多家酒店；规模从首届 270 人增长至 2024 年的 15000 余人，累计为慈善机构筹款，其中 2024 年为合作慈善组织 Lost and Found Youth 募集 10 万美元，现已成为全球最大规模的兽迷展会之一。
description.en: Furry Weekend Atlanta (FWA) is the official promotional website for the eponymous furry convention in Atlanta, operated by a community-driven, volunteer-led nonprofit corporation organized under the Georgia Non-Profit Corporation Code. Its core mission is to provide memorable, educational, inclusive, and safe experiences for the furry community, encouraging individuals to explore and express their true selves while promoting the acceptance and appreciation of the anthropomorphic fandom in the Southeast and across the United States. Since its inauguration in 2004, the convention has grown steadily: initially held in February, it shifted to late March or early April in 2009, and has been hosted over Mother’s Day weekend since 2019, expanding to multiple hotels in downtown Atlanta. Attendance has grown from 270 attendees in 2004 to over 15,000 in 2024 (across 4 hotels and convention spaces), and it has raised substantial funds for charities—including $100,000 for its 2024 partner Lost and Found Youth—solidifying its status as one of the world’s largest furry conventions.

description.zh: NordicFuzzCon 是举办于瑞典的国际兽迷展会官方宣传网站，面向全球兽迷群体，同时欢迎所有人士参与。展会提供丰富多元的活动，包括现场 DJ 舞会、艺术与兽装相关座谈会、有组织的桌游与电子游戏体验等，致力于打造北欧地区丰富多样的娱乐体验。自 2013 年首次举办以来，展会规模持续扩大：首届吸引来自 10 多个国家的 170 余名参与者，2025 年已迎来 62 个国家的 5335 余名参与者，成为欧洲最大的国际兽迷展会；同时为 Dýrahjálp 慈善机构募集了超 46.2 万瑞典克朗。
description.en: NordicFuzzCon is the official promotional website for an international furry convention held in Sweden. It is aimed at the global furry community—people interested in anthropomorphic animal characters like Bugs Bunny or Donald Duck—and welcomes all attendees. The convention offers a variety of activities, including dances with live DJ sets, panels on art and costume-wearing, organized tabletop and video gaming, and more, striving to provide a diverse smorgasbord of entertainment in Northern Europe. Since its debut in 2013, the convention has grown significantly: starting with over 170 attendees from more than 10 countries, it welcomed over 5,335 participants from 62 countries in 2025, becoming Europe’s largest international furry convention. It has also raised over 462,000 Swedish kronor for the Dýrahjálp charity.

description.zh: FurUp 是一项非商业纯公益的社区项目，专注记录 Furry 创作者的成长轨迹，所有数据均来源于 B 站公开可查信息。
description.en: FurUp is a non-commercial and purely public welfare community project dedicated to recording the growth of Furry creators, with all data sourced from public information on Bilibili.

description.zh: FurryChatWorld 是面向 Furry 爱好者的社区平台，核心功能涵盖毛毛图鉴、各地群聊、兽聚日历及身份认证，为兽圈同好提供多元的交流与信息服务。
description.en: FurryChatWorld is a community platform for Furry enthusiasts, with core functions including Furry Illustrated Handbook, local group chats, Furry gathering calendar and identity authentication, offering diverse communication and information services for the Furry community.

description.zh: FurryChat是一个基于AI的兽人角色文本对话平台。
description.en: FurryChat is an AI-based platform for text-based conversations featuring furry characters.

description.zh: Furry Fandom Club（简称 FFC，亦称“拟人动物爱好者俱乐部”）是由 Furry 爱好者自发组织、非营利运营的线上社群，致力于提供一个 包容、尊重、自由表达 的交流平台。
description.en: The Furry Fandom Club (abbreviated as FFC, also known as "Club of Furry Animal Enthusiasts") is an online community organized by Furry enthusiasts themselves and operated for non-profit purposes. It aims to provide a platform that is inclusive, respectful, and allows for free expression of ideas.

description.zh: mem.pics 是 e621 的meme站点，仅展示对公众友好的 SFW 迷因图。
description.en: mem.pics is a meme image site of e621, displaying only the public-friendly SFW meme images.

description.zh: E621 的三方搜索工具
description.en: Tripartite search tool for e621.

description.zh: E621 的三方搜索工具
description.en: Tripartite search tool for e621.

description.zh: E621 的三方搜索工具
description.en: Tripartite search tool for e621.

description.zh: 一款独特的科幻视觉小说，融合日常与恋爱模拟元素，登陆 PC、PS4/PS5、Xbox 及任天堂 Switch 平台，故事设定在一个由龙栖息的世界。
description.en: A unique sci-fi visual novel with slice-of-life and dating sim elements, available on PC, PS4/PS5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch, set in a world inhabited by dragons.

description.zh: 一款开放世界动作游戏，将狼的魅力与动态战斗相融合，背景设定在充满奇幻色彩的雪地世界。玩家将探索这片冬日景致，邂逅各色角色并发掘他们的独特特质。
description.en: An open-world action game that blends the charm of wolves with dynamic combat, set in a snowy, fantasy-inspired world. Players will explore this winter landscape, meet various characters, and uncover their unique traits.

description.zh: 展示游戏《Super Taco Crew》相关设定集与插画的专属站点。
description.en: A dedicated site featuring settings and illustrations related to the game "Super Taco Crew".

description.zh: 成人向雄兽 ADV 冒险游戏《夏多內羅曼史》的官方情报站，提供游戏设定集、世界观及插画等相关内容。
description.en: An official information site for "Chardonnay Romancia", an adult-oriented beast ADV adventure game, offering game settings, worldview, illustrations, and related content.

description.zh: 由武装猫工作室研发、虚幻 5 引擎打造的第三人称射击游戏。玩家将化身动物英雄，运用多样武器与战术技能，与队友紧密协作奔赴战场，体验激烈战斗与爽快射击，演绎独特的毛绒战争传奇。
description.en: A third-person shooter developed by Armed Cat Studio using Unreal Engine 5. Players will take on the role of animal valiants, wield various weapons and tactical skills, cooperate closely with teammates, and charge into battle to experience intense combat and exciting shooting, interpreting a unique furry war legend.

description.zh: 总部位于底特律的游戏工作室，专注打造叙事向游戏体验，通过创意视觉艺术、原创故事与对游戏的热爱，带玩家脱离现实时空与形态，探索全新世界。
description.en: A Detroit-based video game studio specializing in crafting narrative experiences. Through creative visual art, truly original stories, and a passion for games, it takes players out of their current time, place, and form to explore new worlds.

description.zh: 开放世界游戏《Hunt and Snare》的官方站点，提供社群链接与开发日志更新。
description.en: The official site for the open-world game "Hunt and Snare", featuring community links and development log updates.

description.zh: 成人向 VR 游戏《HEAT》的官方官网，为玩家带来逼真的成人 VR 体验。
description.en: The official website for HEAT, a realistic adult VR experience game.

description.zh: 尾巴帧短片工作室，专注为兽装爱好者打造高质量兽设短片，用专业设备呈现电影级画面，结合专属故事脚本与全流程专业制作，让兽设在现实中鲜活起来。
description.en: TailingFrames Studio specializes in creating high-quality fursona short films for furry fans, presenting cinematic visuals with professional equipment, and making fursonas come alive in reality with exclusive story scripts and full-process professional production.

description.zh: KR 兽化实验是厦门双人兽装工作室，秉持「以心赋形，缝纫幻想」理念，主打日系风格并探索混系、美系创作，从兽设绘制到兽装制作全流程打造专属灵魂载体。
description.en: Furgence is a two-person fursuit studio in Xiamen, adhering to the concept of "Shaping with Heart, Sewing Fantasies". Specializing in Japanese style and exploring mixed & American style creation, it creates exclusive soul carriers from fursona design to fursuit making.

description.zh: 国际兽装制作工作室，专注个性化兽装定制服务，以精湛的制作工艺打造贴合兽设的专属作品，为全球兽装爱好者提供优质的定制体验。
description.en: An international fursuit studio, focusing on personalized fursuit customization services, creating exclusive works that fit fursonas with exquisite craftsmanship, and providing high-quality customization experience for furry fans worldwide.

description.zh: 美国知名兽装工作室 MFL，打造舒适耐穿、吸睛度拉满的独家定制兽装，制作周期高效，能满足漫展等各类场景的快速定制需求。
description.en: MFL, a renowned American fursuit studio, creates exclusive custom fursuits that are comfortable, durable and eye-catching, with an efficient production cycle to meet the rapid customization needs of conventions and other scenarios.

description.zh: 美国顶级手工兽装工作室 DHC，拥有 18 年 + 制作经验，累计打造超 800 件作品，全球漫展可见，纯手工定制高视觉质感、舒适易穿的各类体型兽装与吉祥物服饰。
description.en: DHC, a premier handcrafted fursuit studio in the USA, with over 18 years of production experience and more than 800 works created to date, visible at conventions worldwide. It handcrafts custom fursuits and mascot costumes of all shapes with high visual appeal, comfort and wearability.

description.zh: 云幽岛是国内优质兽聚活动，首届 2023 年落地成都，由专业策划团队打造，以丰富的互动体验和精美礼品，为兽圈爱好者打造专属的 Furry 文化盛宴。
description.en: Yunyou Island is a high-quality furry convention in China, first held in Chengdu in 2023. Created by a professional planning team, it offers exclusive Furry cultural feasts for furry fans with rich interactive experiences and exquisite gifts.

description.zh: FurryGooo 专属展会服务小程序平台，为兽聚相关活动提供配套服务支持，需完成账号登录后即可使用相关功能。
description.en: The exclusive exhibition service mini-program platform for FurryGooo, providing supporting services for furry convention-related activities, and relevant functions are available after account login.

description.zh: 毛绒城兽聚官方网站，集中发布该兽聚的活动安排、报名信息、现场指引等全方面官方内容。
description.en: The official website of FurCity furry convention, centrally releasing all-round official content such as event arrangements, registration information and on-site guidelines for the convention.

description.zh: 苏格兰首个且唯一的兽聚活动，2011 年首次举办，每年持续升级，2026 年主题为 “正午嚎叫”，以西部冒险为核心打造丰富趣味的线下交流体验。
description.en: Scotland's first and only furry convention, first held in 2011 and continuously upgraded every year. The 2026 theme is "Howl at High Noon", creating a rich and interesting offline exchange experience with Western adventure as the core.

description.zh: 美国兽圈公益向活动平台，融合兽聚与公益兽装互动形式，联动公众力量为当地慈善机构提供视觉曝光与资金支持，传递快乐与社会责任。
description.en: A US-based public welfare platform for the furry community, integrating furry conventions and charitable fursuit interactions, linking public forces to provide visual exposure and financial support for local charities, and conveying joy and social responsibility.

description.zh: 美国密歇根州专属 18 + 兽聚，为兽圈爱好者打造多元线下体验，涵盖主题座谈、桌游、电玩等丰富活动，以用心的筹备打造沉浸式的狂欢派对。
description.en: An exclusive 18+ furry convention in Michigan, USA, creating a diverse offline experience for furry fans, covering rich activities such as panels, board games and video games, and building an immersive carnival with careful preparation.

description.zh: 巴西知名年度兽聚，2019 年首次试点举办并大获成功，固定于每年二月中旬狂欢节期间举办，是巴西兽圈核心线下交流活动。
description.en: A well-known annual furry convention in Brazil, which was first piloted and a great success in 2019. It is held fixed in mid-February every year during Carnival and is a core offline exchange event for the Brazilian furry community.

description.zh: 黔兽聚以 “开放、共创” 为核心理念，活动场地、内容、规模均由参与者投票决定，重视每一条反馈建议，打造属于全体兽圈爱好者的共创型兽聚。
description.en: Qian Furry Convention takes "Openness and Co-creation" as its core concept. The event venue, content and scale are all decided by participants' votes, and every feedback and suggestion is valued to build a co-creation furry convention for all furry fans.

description.zh: 绒兽汇汇聚华北地区精英策划与执行团队，聚焦打造全方位覆盖、深度沉浸的高品质兽聚，为华北兽圈爱好者带来专属线下体验。
description.en: Fluffy Flow gathers elite planning and execution teams in North China, focusing on creating a high-quality furry convention with all-round coverage and in-depth immersion, bringing exclusive offline experiences for furry fans in North China.

description.zh: 加拿大西海岸最大规模兽聚，落地不列颠哥伦比亚省列治文市，为四天全流程线下活动，2026 年以 “仙境” 为主题，打造兽圈风格的文学经典沉浸式体验。
description.en: The largest furry convention on Canada's west coast, held in Richmond, British Columbia, is a four-day full-process offline event. The 2026 theme is "WONDERLAND", creating an immersive literary classic experience with furry style.

description.zh: 波兰格但斯克年度幻想艺术与创意表达盛会，2010 年首次举办，每年二月底开展，涵盖创意工坊、主题座谈等丰富活动，是东欧地区同类核心活动之一。
description.en: An annual fantasy art and creative expression event in Gdansk, Poland, first held in 2010 and held at the end of February every year. It covers rich activities such as creative workshops and panels, and is one of the core events of its kind in Eastern Europe.

description.zh: 三江兽汇官方网站，权威发布该兽聚的活动最新动态、参与方式、现场服务等相关信息，为宜宾及周边兽圈爱好者提供线下交流指引。
description.en: The official website of Sanjiang Furry Gathering, authoritatively releasing the latest event trends, participation methods and on-site services of the convention, and providing offline exchange guidance for furry fans in Yibin and surrounding areas.

description.zh: 泰国 ThaiTails 兽聚 2026 年官方站点，打造星光舞台才艺秀、主题座谈、摊主集市、互动任务、DJ 派对等多元特色活动，为兽圈爱好者打造沉浸式线下狂欢。
description.en: The 2026 official site of ThaiTails furry convention in Thailand, creating diverse characteristic activities such as Starlight Stage talent show, panels, dealers den, interactive quests and DJ parties, building an immersive offline carnival for furry fans.

description.zh: 法国 Fauntastic 兽聚官方网站，为该欧洲兽圈线下活动提供官方资讯、活动详情与参与指引等服务。
description.en: The official website of Fauntastic furry convention in France, providing official news, event details and participation guidelines for this European furry offline event.

description.zh: 德国 SpringFurCon 兽聚官方站点，发布该兽聚的活动安排、报名信息等核心内容，服务德国及欧洲兽圈爱好者。
description.en: The official site of SpringFurCon furry convention in Germany, releasing core content such as event arrangements and registration information, serving furry fans in Germany and Europe.

description.zh: 美国 Furgeddaboutit 兽聚官方网站，权威发布该兽聚的最新动态、现场规则与各类活动详情，为本土兽圈爱好者提供参与参考。
description.en: The official website of Furgeddaboutit furry convention in the USA, authoritatively releasing the latest news, on-site rules and various event details, providing participation references for local furry fans.

description.zh: 美国俄克拉荷马州 18 + 露营式兽聚，为期五天四夜落地强盗洞州立公园，是北美四大露营类兽聚之一，为兽圈打造非传统酒店式的户外交流体验。
description.en: An 18+ camp-style furry convention in Oklahoma, USA, held for five days and four nights at Robber's Cave State Park. It is one of the four major camp-style furry conventions in North America, creating a non-traditional hotel-style outdoor exchange experience for the furry community.

description.zh: 兽行迹兽聚官方网站，发布该兽聚的官方活动资讯、报名通道与现场指引，为国内兽圈爱好者提供线下交流的权威信息。
description.en: The official website of Furward furry convention, releasing official event news, registration channels and on-site guidelines, providing authoritative information for offline communication of domestic furry fans.

description.zh: 美国亚特兰大知名非盈利兽聚，2004 年创办，现为全球大型兽聚之一，2024 年吸引超 1.5 万人参与并筹得 10 万美元慈善款，兼具娱乐性与公益属性，鼓励自我表达与社群包容。
description.en: A well-known non-profit furry convention in Atlanta, USA, founded in 2004 and now one of the world's largest furry conventions. It attracted over 15,000 participants and raised $100,000 in charity funds in 2024, with both entertainment and public welfare attributes, encouraging self-expression and community inclusion.

description.zh: 比利时 AnthroTales 兽聚官方网站，为比利时及欧洲周边的兽圈爱好者，提供该线下兽聚的活动资讯与参与方式等内容。
description.en: The official website of AnthroTales furry convention in Belgium, providing event news and participation methods of this offline furry convention for furry fans in Belgium and surrounding Europe.

description.zh: 美国俄亥俄州哥伦布市年度兽聚，氛围轻松且活动丰富，含夜间舞会等特色环节，2026 年主题为 “像兽风一样摇滚”，将于 5 月 22-24 日在市中心希尔顿酒店举办。
description.en: An annual furry convention in Columbus, Ohio, USA, with a relaxed atmosphere and rich activities including night dances. The 2026 theme is "Rock You Like A Furricane", to be held at the Hilton Columbus Downtown from May 22-24.

description.zh: 英国最大规模兽聚，2008 年首办于曼彻斯特，现落地伯明翰梅特罗波尔希尔顿酒店，2025 年吸引超 3000 名全球参与者，还筹得超 4 万英镑慈善资金。
description.en: The largest furry convention in the UK, first held in Manchester in 2008 and now hosted at the Hilton Birmingham Metropole. It welcomed over 3000 global attendees and raised over £40,000 for charity in 2025.

description.zh: 中国台湾地区 Furrymosa 兽聚官方网站，发布该兽聚的活动最新动态、报名信息与现场服务指引，服务当地兽圈爱好者。
description.en: The official website of Furrymosa furry convention in Taiwan, China, releasing the latest event trends, registration information and on-site service guidelines, serving local furry fans.

description.zh: 美国俄勒冈州年度户外露营式兽聚，每年 8 月首个周末举办于高沙漠地区，提供餐饮、卫浴等基础保障，在松林、火山环绕的自然环境中打造轻松的社群交流体验。
description.en: An annual outdoor camp-style furry convention in Oregon, USA, held every first weekend of August in the High Desert area. It provides basic guarantees such as catering and sanitation, creating a relaxed community exchange experience in a natural environment surrounded by pine forests and volcanoes.

description.zh: 德国 Furvaria 兽聚官方网站，发布该兽聚的活动资讯、参与指南等核心内容，服务德国及欧洲地区的兽圈爱好者。
description.en: The official website of Furvaria furry convention in Germany, releasing core content such as event news and participation guidelines for furry fans in Germany and Europe.

description.zh: 新加坡 Little Island 兽聚官方站点，当地轻松休闲的兽圈线下活动，每年举办两场，含年初线上活动 LIFCO 与年中线下实体兽聚。
description.en: The official site of Little Island Furcon (LIFC) in Singapore, a casual local furry convention with two events annually, including the online LIFCO at the start and an in-person convention in the middle of the year.

description.zh: 阿根廷 FurFiesta 兽聚官方网站，为阿根廷本土及南美地区的兽圈爱好者，提供该兽聚的官方活动信息与参与指引。
description.en: The official website of FurFiesta furry convention in Argentina, providing official event information and participation guidelines for furry fans in Argentina and South America.

description.zh: 马来西亚 Borneo Anthro Hub 兽聚官方网站，发布该兽聚的活动动态、报名信息等内容，服务婆罗洲及马来西亚各地的兽圈爱好者。
description.en: The official website of Borneo Anthro Hub furry convention in Malaysia, releasing event trends and registration information for furry fans in Borneo and all over Malaysia.

description.zh: 中国台湾地区 UTFG 兽聚官方站点，由兽圈爱好者发起，寓意打造难忘的聚会体验，隶属于台湾兽文化交流推广协会，2025 年举办首届线下活动，同时致力保育动物宣传与兽文化交流。
description.en: The official site of UTFG furry convention in Taiwan, China, initiated by furry fans and meant to create unforgettable gathering experiences. Affiliated to Taiwan Furry Culture Exchange and Promotion Association, it held its first offline event in 2025, and is committed to wildlife conservation publicity and furry culture exchange.

description.zh: 奥地利 Lakeside Furs 兽聚官方网站，权威发布该兽聚的活动安排、现场规则等信息，为奥地利及欧洲周边的兽圈爱好者提供参与参考。
description.en: The official website of Lakeside Furs furry convention in Austria, authoritatively releasing event arrangements and on-site rules for furry fans in Austria and surrounding Europe.

description.zh: 加拿大阿尔伯塔省首个兽聚，埃德蒙顿年度经典兽圈活动，2026 年以 “翼之领主” 为主题，打造充满奇幻、魔法与中世纪趣味的沉浸式线下体验。
description.en: Alberta’s first and Canada’s favorite furry convention, an annual classic furry event in Edmonton. The 2026 theme is Lord of the Wings, creating an immersive offline experience full of fantasy, magic and medieval fun.

description.zh: 巴西圣保罗年度兽聚 BFF，于当地冬季举办，兼具兽圈交流与公益属性，常年为当地流浪动物救助项目筹款，2024 年筹得约 5900 美元善款。
description.en: Brasil FurFest (BFF), an annual furry convention in São Paulo, Brazil, held in local winter. It combines furry community exchange with public welfare, and raises funds for local street animal rescue projects all year round, raising about USD 5,900 in 2024.

description.zh: 美国纽约州奥尔巴尼市专属 18 + 兽聚 Eufuria 官方网站，为成年兽圈爱好者打造专属的线下交流与互动平台。
description.en: The official website of Eufuria, an exclusive 18+ furry convention in Albany, New York, USA, creating a dedicated offline exchange and interaction platform for adult furry fans.

description.zh: 澳大利亚新南威尔士州悉尼地区兽聚 Aurawra 官方站点，2022 年举办首届线下活动，参会人数逐年增长，现接近一千人，是澳洲本土颇具规模的兽圈活动。
description.en: The official site of Aurawra furry convention in the Sydney region of New South Wales, Australia. It held its first offline event in 2022, with attendance growing year by year to nearly 1,000 now, making it a large-scale local furry event in Australia.

description.zh: 德国 Sachsen Furs 兽聚官方网站，发布该兽聚的活动资讯、参与指南等内容，服务德国萨克森地区及周边的兽圈爱好者。
description.en: The official website of Sachsen Furs furry convention in Germany, releasing event news and participation guidelines for furry fans in Saxony and surrounding areas of Germany.

description.zh: 德国汉堡年度国际兽聚，是欧洲极具影响力的大型 Furry 线下盛会，汇聚了全球各地的兽圈爱好者参与交流。
description.en: An annual international furry convention held in Hamburg, Germany, it is a highly influential large-scale furry offline event in Europe, gathering furry fans from all over the world for communication.

description.zh: 美国佛罗里达州经典兽聚，2002 年创办，聚焦拟人化与幻想主题的互动艺术和表演，活动丰富且设专属兽装配套设施，每年为动物相关慈善机构筹款。
description.en: A classic furry convention in Florida, USA, founded in 2002, focusing on interactive arts and performances with anthropomorphic and fantasy themes. It has rich events and exclusive fursuit facilities, and raises funds for animal-related charities every year.

description.zh: 美国 FursonaCon 兽聚官方网站，权威发布该兽聚的最新动态、活动安排与现场规则，为本土兽圈爱好者提供参与参考。
description.en: The official website of FursonaCon furry convention in the USA, authoritatively releasing the latest news, event arrangements and on-site rules for local furry fans.

description.zh: 美国明尼苏达州年度全年龄段兽聚，2014 年创办，隶属于非盈利组织 MNFurs，以艺术、兽装等形式打造友好交流氛围，同时为合作慈善机构筹募资金。
description.en: An annual all-ages furry convention in Minnesota, USA, founded in 2014 and affiliated to the non-profit organization MNFurs. It creates a friendly communication atmosphere through art and fursuiting, and raises funds for partner charities.

description.zh: 墨西哥 Confuror 兽聚，由兽圈爱好者共创的志愿性项目，全程由社群协作运营，是墨西哥本土极具代表性的 Furry 线下交流活动。
description.en: Confuror furry convention in Mexico is a voluntary project co-created by furry fans, operated by community collaboration throughout, and is a representative furry offline exchange event in Mexico.

description.zh: 斯洛文尼亚年度兽聚，由 SloFurs 主办，2023 年首办即吸引多国爱好者参与，参会人数逐年翻倍，是斯洛文尼亚及东欧地区新兴的兽圈盛会。
description.en: An annual furry convention in Slovenia, hosted by SloFurs. It attracted fans from many countries since its first holding in 2023, with attendance doubling year by year, and it is an emerging furry event in Slovenia and Eastern Europe.

description.zh: 美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥西郊年度兽聚，全球规模最大的兽聚之一，2024 年参会超 1.6 万人，累计为慈善筹超 90 万美元，艺术展单年成交额破 10 万美元。
description.en: An annual furry convention in the western suburbs of Chicago, Illinois, USA, one of the largest furry conventions in the world. It had over 16,000 attendees in 2024, raised over $900,000 for charity in total, and its art show had over $100,000 in turnover in a single year.

description.zh: 国内 Furry 综合共建平台，提供兽聚资讯、地区聚合、主办发布、百科共建与社区交流等一站式服务。
description.en: A comprehensive co-built platform for furry fandom in China, providing one-stop services including convention info, regional aggregation, host publishing, encyclopedia co-creation and community communication.

description.zh: 国内 Furry 社群聚合导航站，支持地方、高校、展会类兽圈群组检索，提供群组主页与反馈纠错功能。
description.en: A furry community aggregation navigation site in China, supporting search for local, university and convention-related furry groups, with group pages and feedback functions.

description.zh: 万兽会是专业兽圈社交名片平台，通过一个链接即可整合并展示所有社交平台，便捷连接同好，打造一站式兽圈个人主页。
description.en: Wanshouhui is a professional furry social 名片 platform. It integrates all your social accounts into one link for easy connection with fellow furry fans, creating an all-in-one personal homepage.

description.zh: 兽频道 fursuit.tv 是面向兽圈的交友平台，支持按地区等多维度搜索发现同好，并提供个性化个人名片与专属主页。
description.en: Fursuit.tv is a social platform for the furry community. It allows you to find like-minded friends through multi-dimensional searches such as region, and provides personalized business cards and homepages.

description.zh: Furry Latino 是创立于 2014 年的西班牙语兽圈社群，致力于传承与弘扬兽圈原生文化，营造尊重包容的交流环境，联结全球西语系兽迷，促进创作者交流与社群正向发展。
description.en: Founded in 2014, Furry Latino is a Spanish-speaking furry community dedicated to preserving the original fandom culture, building a respectful environment, connecting Spanish-speaking furries worldwide, and supporting artist collaboration.

description.zh: FurrTrax 是面向兽圈的社交平台与移动端应用，支持创建个人主页、公私密聊、同城定位交友、发布线下活动等功能，旨在整合分散的兽迷社群，方便同好结识、面基与活动组织。
description.en: FurrTrax is a furry-focused social network and mobile app for making friends, organizing events, locating local furries via GPS, and connecting users with shared interests. It offers profiles, public/private chats, event planning, and is available on web and Android.

description.zh: FurryChat 是面向兽迷与拟人文化爱好者的活跃线上社区，提供论坛、图片分享、角色扮演等多元功能，致力于打造尊重包容的交流空间，守护用户隐私安全，让同好分享创作、交流互动、缔结友谊。
description.en: FurryChat is a vibrant online community for furries and anthropomorphic culture fans. It offers forums, image sharing, roleplay and more, providing a respectful, inclusive space to share creativity, discuss interests and make friends, with strong focus on privacy and safety.

description.zh: Furmeet 是面向兽圈打造的线上交流广场，支持浏览、分享与结识同好，专注搭建轻松舒适的现代社交平台，基于 SolidJS 构建，带来流畅便捷的交友体验。
description.en: Furmeet is a modern online town square for the furry community, letting you browse, share and meet new friends in one unified platform. Built with SolidJS for a smooth, comfortable social experience focused on genuine connections.

description.zh: 绒兽社区是一款专注隐私与纯净体验的兽圈社交平台，摒弃多余营销，聚焦私密沟通、稳定可靠、简洁易用的核心需求，解决兽迷交流分散、隐私难保障的痛点。
description.en: Rongshou Community is a furry social platform focusing on privacy and a clean experience. Without redundant marketing, it focuses on core needs such as private communication, stability and ease of use, solving the pain points of scattered communication and poor privacy protection for furries.

description.zh: Welqum 是一个面向成年用户的兽人漫画浏览网站，主要展示 NSFW / 成人向的拟人动物漫画内容，适合对成人向 furry 漫画感兴趣的用户访问。
description.en: Welqum is an adult-only furry comic browsing site featuring NSFW anthropomorphic comic content for mature audiences interested in adult-oriented furry comics.

description.zh: YiffHaven 是一个面向成年用户的 furry 成人内容社区网站，提供高清兽人插画、图片与相关 NSFW 内容浏览，同时支持用户上传与分享作品。
description.en: YiffHaven is an adult furry content community featuring HD furry artwork, images, and other NSFW content, with support for user uploads and sharing.

description.zh: Yiff Hub 是 FP Company 旗下的 furry 成人内容导航站，聚合图片、漫画、AI 生成与相关 NSFW 社区资源。
description.en: Yiff Hub is a furry adult content portal by FP Company, aggregating NSFW images, comics, AI generation tools, and related community resources.

description.zh: Yiff Party 是一个面向成年用户的 furry 图片站点，主要收录和展示 NSFW 兽人插画、GIF 与相关成人向内容。
description.en: Yiff Party is an adult furry image platform featuring NSFW artwork, GIFs, and other adult-oriented furry content.

description.zh: Yiff AI 是一个面向 furry 社区的 AI 图像生成平台，支持创建 SFW 与 NSFW 的拟人动物角色、原创 fursona 与兽人风格作品。
description.en: Yiff AI is a furry-focused AI image generation platform that supports creating both SFW and NSFW anthropomorphic characters, fursonas, and furry-themed artwork.

description.zh: Yiff Comics 是一个成人向 furry 漫画站点，提供拟人动物题材的 NSFW 漫画与视觉故事内容。
description.en: Yiff Comics is an adult furry comics platform featuring NSFW anthropomorphic stories and visual comic content.

description.zh: Yiff Girlfriend 是一个面向 furry 社区的成人 AI Companion 平台，提供具有不同设定与个性的兽人 AI 角色互动体验。
description.en: Yiff Girlfriend is an adult AI companion platform for the furry fandom, offering interactive furry AI characters with unique personalities and customizable experiences.

description.zh: Yiffer.xyz 是一个面向成年用户的 furry 漫画聚合与浏览平台，主要收录拟人动物题材的漫画作品，并提供标签、评分、收藏与社区贡献功能。
description.en: Yiffer.xyz is an adult furry comics aggregation and browsing platform featuring anthropomorphic comic content with tagging, rating, bookmarking, and community contribution features.

description.zh: Nyiff.net 是一个面向成年用户的 furry 图片浏览网站，主要提供 NSFW 拟人动物插画与相关成人向内容。
description.en: Nyiff.net is an adult furry image site featuring NSFW anthropomorphic artwork and related adult-oriented furry content.

description.zh: FuzzySearch 是一个面向 furry 社区的反向图片搜索工具，支持对 FurAffinity、Weasyl、e621 与 Twitter/X 等平台进行相似图片检索。
description.en: FuzzySearch is a reverse image search tool for the furry community, supporting similarity searches across FurAffinity, Weasyl, e621, and Twitter/X.

description.zh: Dokidoki Fursuit 是一家提供定制兽装制作服务的工作室，专注于将原创角色与 Fursona 形象转化为高品质可穿戴兽装作品。
description.en: Dokidoki Fursuit is a custom fursuit studio specializing in transforming original characters and fursonas into high-quality wearable fursuit creations.

description.zh: 兽模工坊是一个面向 furry 3D 角色建模委托的展示与排单平台，支持 VRM 模型预览、动作与表情切换、场景导入及创意工坊功能，并提供定制化角色建模服务。
description.en: Furry Shopping is a furry 3D character commission platform featuring VRM model preview, pose and expression controls, scene importing, creative workshop features, and custom 3D character modeling services.

description.zh: ChatFurry 是一个专为 furry 社区打造的实时聊天平台，提供公共聊天室、私信交流与多主题讨论空间，致力于为全球兽迷建立友好、安全的交流社区。
description.en: ChatFurry is a real-time chat platform built for the furry community, offering public chat rooms, private messaging, and topic-based discussions in a safe and welcoming environment.

description.zh: The Furry Forums 是一个历史悠久的 furry 社区论坛，成立于 2006 年，提供讨论交流、角色扮演、兴趣分享与社区互动等多种板块内容。
description.en: The Furry Forums is a long-running furry community forum founded in 2006, featuring discussions, roleplay, community activities, and interest-based conversations.

description.zh: FurryGuides 是一个面向 furry 社区的资料与指南网站，提供兽聚信息、兽装护理教程、社区工具以及创作者目录等实用内容。
description.en: FurryGuides is a furry community reference site featuring convention information, fursuit care guides, community tools, and creator directories.

description.zh: FurryCons 是一个全球 furry 兽聚活动目录网站，收录世界各地的兽聚、展会与相关活动信息，帮助用户发现和了解不同地区的 furry 社区活动。
description.en: FurryCons is a global directory of furry conventions and events, helping users discover furry community gatherings and convention information worldwide.

description.zh: PlayFurryGames 是一个 furry 成人游戏资源平台，收录并整理大量由独立开发者创作的兽人题材视觉小说、RPG 与互动剧情游戏，支持分类浏览与下载。
description.en: PlayFurryGames is a furry adult game platform featuring a large collection of furry-themed visual novels, RPGs, and interactive story-driven games created by independent developers.

description.zh: MyFurryRefSheet 提供专业的 furry 角色参考图与动作姿势表定制服务，为每个 fursona 创作多视角、高分辨率的视觉参考，适合动画、角色设计与收藏。
description.en: MyFurryRefSheet offers professional furry reference sheets and pose sheets, creating multi-angle, high-resolution visual guides for each fursona, suitable for animation, character design, and personal collections.

description.zh: Fursonafy 是一家提供定制兽装制作服务的工作室，专注于根据客户角色设定打造个性化兽装作品，支持从头套、爪套到全套兽装的定制与国际配送。
description.en: Fursonafy is a custom fursuit studio specializing in personalized fursuit creations, offering everything from heads and paws to full-body suits with worldwide shipping.

description.zh: Anthro New England（ANE）是美国新英格兰地区的大型 furry 兽聚活动，自 2015 年起举办，汇聚艺术、表演、音乐与社区交流内容，并长期支持本地公益慈善事业。
description.en: Anthro New England (ANE) is a major furry convention in the New England region of the United States, featuring art, performances, music, community activities, and charitable fundraising initiatives.

description.zh: Barq 是面向 furry 社区的移动端应用与服务平台，提供账户管理、用户互动、消息通知及位置相关功能，帮助社区成员更方便地互相联系和参与活动。
description.en: Barq is a mobile app and service platform for the furry community, offering account management, user interaction, notifications, and location-based features to help community members connect and engage.

description.zh: The Dealers Den 是一个面向 furry 社区的在线交易平台，提供兽装、艺术委托、角色设定、周边商品、毛绒玩偶与制作材料等内容的买卖与拍卖服务。
description.en: The Dealers Den is an online marketplace for the furry community, offering buying, selling, and auction listings for fursuits, art commissions, adoptables, merchandise, plushies, and maker supplies.

description.zh: FursuitCommissions.com 是一家提供定制兽装、Cosplay 服装与手工毛绒玩偶制作服务的工作室，专注于根据角色设定打造个性化、可穿戴或可收藏的角色作品。
description.en: FursuitCommissions.com is a custom maker studio offering fursuits, cosplay suits, and handcrafted plushies, focused on bringing character designs to life as wearable or collectible creations.

description.zh: furry.ai 是一个面向 furry 主题创作的 AI 图像生成应用，支持用户通过文本提示生成拟人动物、fursona 与相关风格的图像内容，适合个人创作与灵感探索。
description.en: furry.ai is an AI-powered image generation app for furry-themed creation, allowing users to generate anthropomorphic characters, fursonas, and related artwork from text prompts for personal creative use.

description.zh: Dimvra 是一个面向成年用户的幻想生物与 furry 主题情趣玩具品牌，主打龙、神话生物与兽形元素设计，产品风格精致，兼具收藏感与幻想艺术表现力。
description.en: Dimvra is an adult fantasy creature and furry-themed toy brand featuring dragon, mythical beast, and animal-inspired designs, with a focus on detailed craftsmanship and fantasy art aesthetics.

description.zh: BoldKobold 是一个面向 furry 与奇幻爱好者的主题商品商店，主打 Kobold、小龙人、龙类与高幻想风格周边，提供服饰、配件、骰袋等特色商品。
description.en: BoldKobold is a themed merchandise shop for furry and fantasy fans, featuring kobold, dragon, and high-fantasy inspired goods such as apparel, accessories, dice bags, and collectibles.

description.zh: Wolvden 是一款免费的浏览器狼群模拟游戏，玩家可以创建并自定义自己的狼群首领，在不同生态环境中探索、狩猎、繁育后代，并经营属于自己的狼群家族。
description.en: Wolvden is a free browser-based wolf pack simulation game where players create and customize their own wolf leader, explore diverse biomes, hunt, breed new generations, and manage a growing wolf dynasty.

description.zh: 福瑞百科是一个基于 Wiki 技术的中文 furry 亚文化百科社区，由志愿者共同编纂，致力于建设开放、协作、内容丰富的兽迷文化知识库。
description.en: Furry Wiki is a Chinese wiki-based encyclopedia community for the furry subculture, collaboratively edited by volunteers and dedicated to building an open, collaborative, and comprehensive knowledge base for the furry fandom.

description.zh: DeepFurry（深度兽研）是一个正在公开建设中的 furry 相关开源组织首页，作为项目、文章与联系入口的聚合页面，后续将逐步展示更多仓库、演示与说明内容。
description.en: DeepFurry is a publicly evolving furry-related open-source organization homepage, serving as a central entry point for projects, articles, and contact information, with more repositories, demos, and documentation planned to be released over time.

description.zh: Furbox 是一个面向 furry 社区的社交平台，提供社区动态、艺术与兽装照片分享、活动日历、实时地图以及创作者市场等功能，帮助兽迷发现内容、联系同好并参与线下活动。
description.en: Furbox is a social platform for the furry community, featuring community feeds, art and fursuit photo sharing, event calendars, live maps, and a creator marketplace to help furries discover content, connect with others, and join community events.

description.zh: Tas兽化工作室是一家提供定制兽装制作服务的工作室，专注于以精良做工、完善售后与相对亲民的价格，为兽装爱好者打造个性化的角色作品。
description.en: TAS Furry is a custom fursuit studio focused on creating personalized fursuit works with solid craftsmanship, thoughtful after-sales support, and accessible pricing for fursuit enthusiasts.

description.zh: 福瑞饭是一个面向 furry 社区的兽装返图与 AI 工具平台，提供兽装照片展示、AI 兽装识别、相关接口服务及商业化功能，服务兽装爱好者、摄影师与社区项目。
description.en: FurryFans is a furry community platform focused on fursuit photo sharing and AI-powered tools, offering fursuit photo showcases, AI fursuit recognition, API services, and commercial features for fursuiters, photographers, and community projects.

description.zh: Furstar 是一个日本 furry 角色设定购买平台，展示由不同设计师创作的兽人角色与原创设定，用户可以购买心仪的角色形象，并在此基础上延展角色性格、故事与 Fursona 设定。
description.en: Furstar is a Japanese furry character adoptable platform featuring original anthropomorphic character designs by various designers, allowing users to purchase characters and develop their personalities, stories, and fursona settings.

description.zh: 福瑞八奇物志是位于四川成都的沉浸式 furry 兽聚活动官网，围绕主题舞台剧、线下交流、市集摊位与活动企划，为兽圈爱好者提供具有叙事氛围的线下聚会体验。
description.en: Furry8, also known as Furry8 Chronicles, is the official website for an immersive furry convention in Chengdu, China, featuring themed stage storytelling, community gatherings, artist markets, and event programs for furry fans.

description.zh: api.furry.ist 是一个专注于 furry 相关内容的开放 API 平台，提供稳定、快速、免费的接口服务，支持随机图片、IP 多数据库查询与在线计算工具等功能。
description.en: api.furry.ist is an open API platform focused on furry-related content, offering stable, fast, and free API services such as random images, multi-database IP lookup, and online calculation tools.

description.zh: FurryFursuitDesign 是一家专注于定制兽装制作的工作室，团队擅长制作 Kemono、Toony、写实与半写实风格兽装，为客户打造个性化角色作品。
description.en: FurryFursuitDesign is a custom fursuit studio specializing in Kemono, Toony, realistic, and semi-realistic fursuit designs, creating personalized character suits for clients.

description.zh: Pawer 是一款以 furry 角色设定为核心的个人 AI Agent 助手，将角色人格、长期记忆与任务执行能力结合，让用户可以通过自定义角色完成文件处理、资料整理、内容生成等多步骤任务。
description.en: Pawer is a furry-focused personal AI Agent assistant that combines character-based personalities, long-term memory, and task execution capabilities, allowing users to complete multi-step tasks such as file processing, data organization, and content creation through customized AI characters.

description.zh: Further Confusion（简称 FurCon）是美国加州圣何塞举办的年度大型 furry 兽聚活动，由非营利组织 Anthropomorphic Arts and Education 主办，包含主题活动、教育讲座、艺术展示、舞会与社区交流，并长期支持公益慈善事业。
description.en: Further Confusion (FurCon) is an annual furry convention held in San Jose, California, organized by the nonprofit Anthropomorphic Arts and Education. The event features panels, educational programs, art showcases, dance parties, and community activities while supporting charitable causes.

description.zh: dotfurry.org 是推动 .furry 顶级域名申请的社区项目，由非营利组织 Pawprint Prototyping 发起，旨在为 furry 社区建立专属互联网基础设施。项目通过社区支持参与 ICANN gTLD 申请流程，未来计划提供开放注册的 .furry 域名服务。
description.en: dotfurry.org is a community-driven project working toward the creation of the .furry top-level domain, led by the nonprofit Pawprint Prototyping. The project aims to establish dedicated internet infrastructure for the furry community through the ICANN gTLD application process and future open .furry domain registration.

description.zh: FurryVNE（Furry Visual Novel Editor）是一款面向 furry 社区的 3D 角色与故事创作工具，支持创建拟人化角色、制作动画以及构建视觉小说内容，旨在降低 3D furry 内容创作门槛。
description.en: FurryVNE (Furry Visual Novel Editor) is a 3D creation toolkit for the furry community, enabling users to create anthropomorphic characters, animations, and visual novel experiences while making furry content creation more accessible.

description.zh: 毛窝是一个面向 furry 社区的独立站点收录与发现平台，专门整理兽迷创作者自己搭建的博客、个人主页与独立网站，帮助用户发现散落在互联网各处的个人小站。
description.en: Maowo is a furry-focused independent website directory that collects and showcases personal blogs, homepages, and self-hosted sites created by furry community members, helping users discover small corners of the furry web.

description.zh: Furpic 是一个面向 furry 社区的图片分享与角色档案平台，支持兽装摄影、绘画作品展示，并将图片与对应的兽设角色和创作者关联，同时提供兽聚活动与兽装制作商等社区信息。
description.en: Furpic is a furry community platform for photo sharing and character profiles, featuring fursuit photography, artwork galleries, and links between images, fursonas, and creators, alongside convention and fursuit maker directories.

description.zh: Pawprint Prototyping 是一家位于美国的非营利性 furry 技术与创客社区，提供电子制作、3D 打印、机械加工及计算机技术相关的共享设备与工作空间，通过技术课程、项目协作和知识分享促进社区创新与交流。
description.en: Pawprint Prototyping is a nonprofit furry hackerspace in the United States, offering shared tools and workspaces for electronics, 3D printing, machining, and computing, while fostering creativity and technical collaboration through workshops, community projects, and knowledge sharing.

title.zh: 狮子和律律子的奇妙网站

description.zh: 由狮子和律律子创建的男同/兽人本资源站，大多为E-hentai上的漫画
description.en: A manga library built by Lion & Melody. Most of manga come from E-Hentai.

description.zh: 专注于兽人主题艺术创作、作品分享与交流的社区平台，涵盖插画、设计、文学等多种艺术形式，供兽人控群体展示创意、互动沟通。
description.en: A community platform focused on the creation, sharing, and exchange of furry-themed art, covering various art forms such as illustrations, designs, and literature, for the furry community to showcase creativity and interact.

description.zh: 收录以兽人为核心元素的小说作品，涵盖冒险、日常、奇幻等多种题材，为 Furry 爱好者提供相关文学阅读与内容探索的平台。
description.en: A collection of novel works with Furry as the core element, covering various themes such as adventure, daily life and fantasy, providing a platform for Furry enthusiasts to read related literature and explore content.

description.zh: 聚焦兽人主题游戏的交流社区，提供游戏推荐、攻略分享、资源分享等功能，供兽人控群体交流游戏体验、探索兽人游戏。
description.en: A communication community focusing on furry-themed games, providing functions such as game recommendations, strategy sharing, and resource sharing, for the furry fan community to exchange gaming experiences and explore furry games.

description.zh: 专注兽人文化的 AI 服务平台，提供兽人形象生成、主题创作辅助、剧情对话等功能，满足兽人群体设计、创意及信息需求。
description.en: An AI service platform for furry culture, offering furry character generation, themed creation assistance, and plot dialogue to meet the furry community’s design, creativity and information needs.

description.zh: 整理兽人文化相关知识、资源及社群信息的名录索引，便于兽人群体快速查询文化科普、优质资源及关联社群等内容。
description.en: A directory index organizing knowledge, resources and community information related to furry culture, facilitating the furry community to quickly search for cultural popularization, high-quality resources and related communities.

description.zh: 为兽圈提供便利的工具类网站集合，涵盖兽展日历、兽人形象设计辅助、社群活动查询等工具，满足 Furry 爱好者日常需求与活动参与的便捷性。
description.en: A collection of tool websites for the Furry fandom, including furry convention calendars, furry character design aids, community event searches and other tools, meeting the convenience needs of Furry enthusiasts for daily use and event participation.

description.zh: 提供兽人相关资源下载的站点集合，涵盖图片、视频、设计素材等，满足用户资源获取需求。
description.en: A collection of sites offering Furry-related resource downloads, including images, videos, design materials, to meet users' resource acquisition needs.

description.zh: 面向兽人群体的综合交流平台，涵盖文化讨论、兴趣分享、生活互动及社群组织等内容，为 Furry 爱好者提供沟通交流、互助联结的空间。
description.en: A comprehensive communication platform for the Furry community, covering culture discussions, interest sharing, daily interactions and community organization, providing a space for Furry enthusiasts to communicate and connect with each other.

description.zh: 集合各类兽人主题产品的商店分组，涵盖周边、服饰、文创等非成人向商品，为兽人文化爱好者提供集中选购渠道。
description.en: A group of stores gathering various Furry-themed products, covering non-adult items like peripherals, clothing, and cultural and creative goods, providing a centralized purchasing channel for Furry culture enthusiasts.

description.zh: 聚焦兽人群体与文化的宣传类网站，用于推广兽人相关活动、文化内容及社群动态，助力兽人文化传播。
description.en: Promotional websites focusing on the furry community and culture, used to promote furry-related events, cultural content and community updates, supporting the spread of furry culture.

description.zh: 收纳全球各地不同兽圈展会各自的官方网站，便于用户快速查找特定兽展的官方信息。
description.en: A collection of the respective official websites of different Furry conventions around the world, making it easy for users to quickly find official information about specific Furry conventions.

description.zh: 收录兽人文化相关的兽装定制、设计及制作、拍片等委托内容的工作室，提供工作室信息查询、作品展示等内容，为兽装爱好者对接定制需求提供参考。
description.en: A collection of fursuit customization, design and production studios related to Furry culture, providing studio information search and work displays, offering references for fursuit enthusiasts to connect with customization needs.

description.zh: 这是一个关于某个普通大学生突然看到了三位猫科动物神灵的故事。
description.en: Nekojishi is a visual novel about feline beast-men, Taiwanese folklore, and the pressures and consequences that come with navigating the world of gods and spirits.

body.zh:
有没有幻想过毛茸茸的兽人出现在身边？如果他们是自幼就听过大名的神明怎么办？在家有大猫的故事中，你会很快发现美梦成真需要付出的代价。

神像里真的住着守护神，祭祀的表演台下也有神明观看？家里世代是乩童，但如今只是个普通大学生的林天辽，从没想过身边会突然多出三个猫科兽人神灵。

得到了封印已久的灵力，看到了原本隐形的神明。对此一点都不兴奋的林天辽，作为普通人的生活还要继续。穿梭在日常与非日常间，他与三只大猫一起的故事匆匆开始了。

还没有来得及让他庆幸自己有了阴阳眼，几个突然出现的神灵就开始给阿辽规划起了人生。林家的守护神林虎希望阿辽能在毕业后回老家从事神职，原住民部落的云豹神灵李克劳则相信阿辽是部落新祭司的最佳人选。就连学校舞蹈社的学长颜书齐，也被不知道从哪里来的石虎精给附了身，一直拖着阿辽想让他陪自己为一个乡下小庙复兴香火。还没搞清楚到底发生了什么的阿辽，就这样被推进了不一样的世界线。

令阿辽意外的是，这些神灵并非如他想象的那般迂腐，这也让这个不关心鬼神之事的孩子重新思考起民间信仰在现代的意义。不过，他的课程表可不允许他来做个传统文化大巡礼，所以现在要由你来为他做决定了。

家有大猫的故事含有同性恋爱的剧情。
body.en:
A romance torn between school life and mysterious spirits!

Born into a religious family, Lin Tian-Liao left his hometown and moved to Taipei to study and follow his dreams, trying to escape the pressures of returning to his family’s temple in the process. His ordinary college life seemed to be going well until suddenly one day his third eye was opened. Liao, now able to see the various spirits and gods in the world, has to deal with his new found powers, his school life, and three particular cats who all want to have a say in his life and his future.

Nekojishi is a visual novel about the pressures and consequences of deciding your future in a world of gods and spirits, the position that religion and folklore take in modern society, and three feline beast-men that Liao can’t seem to get out of his room or out of his head!

Note: Nekojishi features same-sex romances and cute cat dudes.

description.zh: 你被困于一个研究所，要想尽办法使你还仍然是“你自己”，坚持下去，活下去。
description.en: You are trapped in an experiment, trying to find ways to make you still "yourself" , persevere, and survive.

body.zh:
游戏梗概：

Changed是一款颇有难度、拥有大量追逐战与初见杀的动作解谜游戏。

你在一个陌生的房间中苏醒，发觉自己被绑架到了一个神秘的研究所。

冒险中，你会遇到形形色色的未知生物，每一种都可以轻易“掠夺”你的躯体。

那些由粘液组成的生物不会伤害你，但它们会同化你、改变你的思想，使你成为它们的一员。

为了生存，你只能进行不断的探索，试图走出这个危机四伏的建筑。

在这个草木皆兵的新世界里，任何大意都可能会让你结束你的冒险。

外面的世界究竟发生了什么？暗自引导着你前进的究竟是谁？一切究竟是怎么回事？

种种谜团错综复杂，真相将在一步步交互与探索中慢慢浮出水面。

当然，要小心，不要迷失在这个建筑里…

特点介绍：

* 主角仅有简单的移动与奔跑的能力，他是所有生物的抓捕目标，希望你跑的够快。

* 没有道具，没有技能，你所遇到的一切难题都要用智慧与行动力来解决。

* RPGMAKER日式解密与I WANNA类游戏的融合，准备好面对初见杀。

* 数十首精心原创的8-bit风格音乐，让你在艰苦的探索中不再孤单。

* 游戏颇有难度，适合擅长细心观察、敢于尝试的玩家，不要放过任何一丝线索。

* 在一次次失败中了解生物的特性来逃离它们，或加入它们，在这里，失败并不是那么可怕。

* 交互陷阱、文字彩蛋、CG剧情、和一位“可爱”的家伙交朋友，大量的可探索内容。

* 精彩的剧情与多线结局，根据交互和调查情况可触发不同的结局。

* 大约六小时的可游戏长度（如果可能的话）。
body.en:
Game Synopsis:

"Changed" is a difficult, action puzzle game with a lot of chase.

The protagonist of the game awakened in a strange room and came to an unfamiliar laboratory building.

In the adventure, he will encounter all kinds of unknown creatures, each of which can easily “plunder” his body.

He can only make constant explorations and try to walk out of this dangerous building.

In this deserted world, who is secretly guiding him to go out? Why is he trapped here? What happened to the outside world?

All kinds of mysteries are intricate and the truth will slowly emerge from the interaction and exploration.

Of course, be careful not to get lost in this building...

Features Introduction:

* The protagonist can only use simple movements and sprints because he is the prey of all creatures.

* No props, even tools, all problems must be solved with wisdom and action.

* High game difficulty, Japanese fusion RPG and I WANNA games.

* 8-bit style music evokes childhood memories in a retro style.

* Difficult, suitable for players who are good at watching and daring to try.

* Understand the characteristics of creatures in one failure to escape them.

* Interactive traps, text eggs, CG plots, many investigable items for exploration.

* Multi-line outcomes, triggering different outcome lines based on interactions and investigations.

* Approximately six hours of playable length (if possible).

description.zh: 《三相奇谈》的故事发生在一个幻想中的东方世界。数千年的繁荣时代早已落幕，人、妖怪、龙族混居的青龙城逐渐步入了道术、机关术以及失落的古代科技并存的混沌年代。黑暗在城邦角落悄然滋生，一次前所未有的危机即将爆发……
