description.zh: 一部喜剧探案视觉小说，讲述了狐警长与浣警探如何同菠萝披萨斗智斗勇的故事。
description.en: A comedy-mystery visual novel about Captain Fox, Detective Raccoon and the danger of pineapple pizza.

body.zh:
故事梗概

椰城警署人才辈出：比如资深警官狐警长，它德高望重，每周最喜欢星期一；又比如新来的实习生浣警探，它年轻、傻乎乎、满腔热血，嗜披萨如命，最爱不走寻常路。

今夏，这两位性格迥异的警官将会组成搭档，携爪共同探索椰子城洒满霓虹的街道，认识各色的市民，解决奇怪的案件。危机四伏中，爱的火花悄然绽放。

尽情探索、细心选择，每个决定都会让故事踏上截然不同的走向。狐警长与浣警探最终会共结连理，还是分道扬镳？

未来就在你的爪中。

游戏特色

•

画风质朴但依然可爱的像素小动物

•

多个独特的场景可供探索

•

轻松的解谜元素

•

5个沙雕惊险刺激的案件！

•

6个结局！

操作方法

•

鼠标左键/空格键 - 推进对话

•

CTRL - 快进

•

F - 切换全屏模式

灵感来源

角色灵感源自《赛博朋克2077》、《黑暗侦探》、《X档案》和90年代搭档警匪片。
body.en:
STORY

Nut City Police Department is full of eccentric characters. Captain Fox, for example, is a venerated veteran police officer whose favourite day of the week is Monday. And the new intern, Detective Raccoon, is a young, dumb and hot-headed pizza lover who is always sniffing for ways to bend the rules.

The unlikely pair have to team up this summer to explore Nut City’s neon-washed streets, meet its strange citizens, and tackle bizarre cases. Danger looms around the corner, but love also blossoms.

Be careful of where to look and which path to choose, because all actions have consequences. Will Captain Fox and Detective Raccoon form a deeper bond, or part ways in bitterness?

The future is in your paws.

FEATURES

•

Crudely drawn but still lovable pixel animals

•

Various unique locations with secrets to uncover

•

Casual puzzles

•

5 comical thrilling cases!

•

6 endings!

CONTROLS

•

Mouse Left Click/Space Bar - Advances dialogue

•

CTRL - Fast forward

•

F - Toggles full-screen mode

INSPIRATIONS

The character dynamics are loosely inspired by Cyberpunk 2077, The Darkside Detective, The X-Files, and 90s buddy cop movies.

description.zh: 灵龙岛，一直以来都是旭城名流的度假胜地。亨利·海姆利克，一个平平无奇的救生员，居然收到了一张前往灵龙岛的船票。跟他一道，与另外六只龙共同登上灵龙岛，与你心仪的雄龙度过难忘的海岛假日吧！
description.en: Henry Heimlich, a shark dragon lifesaver suddenly received a ticket to Dragon Island, the famous resort. Follow Henry to the island, and create some unique memory on the long shore with 6 other dragons!

body.en:
Dragon Island is a relaxing ADV in which you will follow Henry Heimlich as he creates unforgettable memories with six other dragons on Dragon Island.

The game has over 15k words in total, you can make a lot of choices and reach 12 different endings!

Henry Heimlich, an ordinary lifeguard, suddenly received a letter of employment from Dragon Island. Together with six other dragons, he got on a cruise ship to the island. But until they boarded the island, they had no idea what they were about to face...

In the game, use different maps to move freely throughout the island, hanging out with everyone and chat with them.

Don't forget to check your phone, it will be updated as you explore the island!

Every evening, everyone will gather together for some intense and exciting activities, such as debating, do remember to attend!

During free exploration, you will also encounter some unexpected small tasks. Completing them will help you earn more friendships from the dragons!

title.zh: 潟湖茶座 2: 阁楼上的室友

description.zh: 兽人们登场的视觉小说。在湖畔村，主人公捡到了一只神秘的狮子兽人，并展开了一段神秘的生活。
description.en: This is a visual novel featuring beastmen. In a lakeside village, the protagonist picks up a mysterious lion beastman and begins to lead a secret life.

body.zh:
更新历史[h2/]

2024.02.06 ver1.0.1→1.0.2 更新

・添加了简体中文

・修复了无法切换到英语的错误

・修复了 UI 和其他部分缺少文本的错误

・在第三集、第五集和最后一集中增加了一些场景的对话

・更改和调整了一些 BGM 和 SE 的音量

・更改和修正了一些角色立绘和表情图标

故事主人公是一位因过劳倒下，辞去工作的兽人。他目前正在顺州湖畔村的一位朋友家中逗留。

有一天，主人公发现了一位狮子兽人躲在阴影中小便。仔细检查后，似乎他是露营中。感到对他抱歉，认为他因为缺钱无法住在旅馆，主人公决定让他在朋友家中住下。

当狮子兽人精疲力尽地睡着时，主人公对他的随身箱感到好奇，发现了一大笔前所未有的钞票。

"…我应该怎么办呢...?"

就在那一刻，主人公意识到他捡到了一个非凡的个体。

游戏玩法一部以兽人为特色的视觉小说。这是前作《Lagoon Lounge: The Poisonous Fountain》的续集。

该系统注重简单性和可玩性，允许您重新访问剧集列表中的任何剧集并轻松进行不同的选择。

语言截至2024年1月，支持日语、英语、繁体中文、韩语、泰语、西班牙语-西班牙、和拉丁西班牙语。
body.en:
Update2024.02.06 Updated [ver1.0.1]→[ver1.0.2]

・Added Simplified Chinese

・Fixed a bug preventing switching to English

・Fixed bugs causing some text to be missing in the UI and other parts

・Added conversations for some scenes in episodes three, five, and the final episode

・Changed and adjusted the volume of some BGM and SE

・Changed and corrected some character illustrations and expression icons

StoryThe protagonist is a beastman who collapsed from overwork and quit his job. He is currently staying at a friend's house in the lakeside village of Shunzhou.

One day, the protagonist discovers a lion beastman hiding in the shade, urinating. Upon closer inspection, it seems he was camping out. Feeling sorry for him, thinking he couldn't afford to stay at an inn due to lack of money, the protagonist takes it upon himself to let him stay at his friend's house.

While the lion beastman sleeps in exhaustion, the protagonist, curious about the contents of his carry-on case, discovers an unprecedented amount of banknotes.

"…What should I do...?"

At that moment, the protagonist realizes that he has picked up an extraordinary individual.

GameplayA visual novel featuring beastmen. It is a sequel to the previous work, "Lagoon Lounge: The Poisonous Fountain."

The system focuses on simplicity and replayability, allowing you to revisit any episode from the episode list and easily make different choices.

LanguagesAs of January 2024, it supports Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Thai, Spanish-Spanish, and Latin-Spanish.

description.zh: 《兽猎突袭》是一款用虚幻5引擎打造的国产射击网游，采用动物题材，以大战场英雄技能射击为主要玩法，玩家将扮演各类动物英雄，运用武器和战术技能，与队友紧密配合，奔赴战场，赢得胜利。 这里的英雄使用自己的动物本能作为技能，战场将充满想象，丰富多彩。集合你的动物战友们，一起战斗吧。
description.en: Wild Assault is an anthro-themed tactical shooter built with Unreal Engine 5, featuring large-scale battlefield gameplay centered around Valiant abilities. Work closely with your team, harness your instincts, and charge into battle to secure victory.

body.zh:
欢迎来到《兽猎突袭》

1991年，历史的铡刀斩断铁幕，我们曾以为文明的页码将就此翻向和平。

两年后，新加州腹地发现大量兽骨核心资源，再度引发多国军事力量角逐，雇佣兵抑或正规军都对这一宝贵资源虎视眈眈，期望在此留下爪痕。 战火焚尽短暂和平最终夜，午夜号角在铁幕余韵下声声响起。

你将扮演各类动物英雄，受雇于斯瑞宁秘密国际组织，成为无畏者的一员，参与战争，走上攻防兼具的战场，与珍重或果敢的同伴相识，书写你的战争史诗。

动物英雄们奔跑，攀爬，跳跃，抢占据点，布置陷阱，一切由你掌握。

他们风格迥异，来自世界各地，怀揣不同目的，不约而同至此，一决胜负。

全新技能系统，动物英雄习性鲜明，拥有各自独特能力。

精妙技能操控配合致命枪械射击，创造出千变万化的战术可能。

战场生存，好枪法必然重要。

得心应手的枪械手感，酣畅淋漓的射击体验，多种枪械随意选择，因时制宜。

战火燎原，弹雨枪林，从小规模据点争夺到超多人战线攻防。

20V20战场对抗体验，一场实力较量在所难免。

与小队成员并肩作战，将最大化您的战果。

是想全员专家拒敌于千里之外，还是各司其职全面突击，所有人在这里都能拥有自己的兽猎时刻！
body.en:
Welcome to "Wild Assault".

This third-person PvP shooting game was developed using Unreal Engine 5, where you are about to embark on a unique furry warfare experience that integrates intense battles, teamwork, and ingenious animal hero abilities.

Anthro heroes & heroines with unique abilities based on animal instincts. Unleash their primal power with your wisdom and achieve victory together!

Different styles, different origins, different goals, same battleground!

Wild Assault provides a free-choice experience based on weapon classes.

Whether you're a cool-headed marksman or a brave assault player, in Wild Assault you can always enjoy the most exhilarating shooting experience.

All characters in Wild Assault have their unique abilities based on animal instincts.

It's more than just shooting combat - help the characters unleash their primal powers to achieve victory!

Wild Assault offers a 20 vs 20 team-based battleground gaming experience.

From capturing strongholds to frontline assaults and defenses, utilize characters' high mobility on all fours and unique abilities to secure victory. It's a test of skill and strategy!

Assault, expert, medic, marksman, and much more!

Unleash your wisdom and creativity to match different classes for the squad. Maximize the team's strength!

description.zh: 《巧|合》为Renpy制作的兽人向文字游戏。
description.en: "co|incidence" is a FVN produced for Renpy.

body.zh:
游戏简介：

“3059电子瘟疫”事件后，为防电子瘟疫的影响扩大，兽人与智人协作将意识科技的发展限制封锁，世界格局随之发生巨变。

百年过去，世间有一言流传：存在称“蒙荫”之身份者，可捕获并拘禁寄宿于特定意识科技产品中的特殊人工智能，藉以满足任何需求。而“蒙荫者”身份亦可被给予或掠夺。

作为一名普通的兽人大学生，刘巧从不轻信这些流言怪谈，殊不知自己正卷入一场涉及“蒙荫者”身份的纷争，《巧|合》的故事由此开始······

游戏特色：

·《巧|合》为Renpy制作的兽人向文字游戏。

·将阈限空间（包括怪核、梦核、伤核、池核、后室等）相关艺术形式与科幻世界观结合。

·游戏只有一条剧情线且CP固定。

警告：

·本游戏含有恐怖、跳出惊吓、诡异、同性关系、性侵/非自愿性行为、BDSM、自残等内容。

·基于Renpy的存档机制，试玩版的存档会直接迁移到该steam版本，但请不要读取那些档位，否则因为内容删减可能会出现bug。

·基于Renpy的对话机制，在对话框有角色头像时存档再读档会有头像延迟消失和提前出现的bug，暂时无法解决，如果可以请避免在有头像出现的对话中存档。
body.en:
Game Introduction:

After the "3059 Electronic Plague" incident, in order to prevent the expansion of the impact of electronic plague, Animo sapiens and Homo sapiens collaborated to restrict and block the development of consciousness technology, resulting in a huge change in the world landscape.

Century passed, there is a legend in the world that there exists an identity called "shade" that can capture and detain special artificial intelligence residing in specific consciousness technology products to meet any needs. And the identity of the "shaded" can also be given or plundered.

As an ordinary Animo sapiens college student, Liu Qiao never believed in these strange rumors, but did not realize that he was embroiled embroiled in a dispute about the identity of "shaded ". From this, the story of "Co|incidence" began...

Game features:

·"Co|Incidence" is a FVN produced for Renpy.

·Combine art forms related to liminal space (includingweirdcore,dreamcore, traumacore, poolcore, back room, etc.) with science fiction worldview.

·The game has only one storyline and a fixed couple.

Warning:

·This game contains thrilling, jump scare, weird and Same-Sex Relationships，sexual assault/non-consensual sex, BDSM, self-harm, etc.

·Based on Renpy's save mechanism, the trial version and save will be directly migrated to that Steam version, but please do not read those files, otherwise there may be bugs due to content deletion.

·Based on Renpy's dialogue mechanism, saving and reading files when there is a character head in the dialog box will cause a bug where the head will disappear and appear earlier, which cannot be solved temporarily. If possible, please avoid saving in conversations when any character head appears.

description.zh: 《Tails Noir Preludes》是一款分支剧情的后黑色叙事冒险游戏。它由一系列交织的短篇故事组成，聚焦于改变、境遇与因果。你将引导四个角色，在一座由拟人化动物居住的反乌托邦温哥华，经历人生的关键转折时刻。
description.en: Tails Noir Preludes is a post-noir narrative adventure with branching choices. It is an intertwined series of vignettes about change, circumstance, and consequence. Guide four characters through formative moments in their lives in a dystopian Vancouver inhabited by anthropomorphic animals.

body.zh:
What are the moments in life that make us who we are today?

How much impact do our choices have those around us?

Your destination may be set, but your journey isn’t. It’s time to make your choice, friend, on what kind of baggage you want to carry.

Taking place years before the events of Tails Noir, Tails Noir Preludes is a narrative game following four characters through formative moments of change, circumstance, and consequences in life and told through a series of interactive vignettes.

Your choices are what’s most important – what traits are you bringing with you in your story, and what is the impact you make on the characters around you?

Immerse yourself in a deep and meaningful narrative again and again. Character traits, branching dialogues, and randomized events open up new paths every time the stories are relived.

Keep track of all of your choices in the new branching tree, and explore all the different scenarios. With twice the wordcount as Tails Noir, Tails Noir Preludes dives deep into the different ways conversations play out.

While the world may be strange and the circumstances different, the stories in Tails are ones that everyone can relate to. Step into the shoes of four characters whose stories will reflect on different formative moments in life:

Howard, a photography major experiencing college alongside his roommate, Larry.

Clarissa, an heiress who will never be good enough for her father.

Renee, who's confronting the lack of agency in her life.

And Eli, a scientist beginning to question if what he is doing is really for the greater good.

Welcome – or welcome back – to a very different Vancouver. Set in a dystopian world and inhabited by anthropomorphic animals, you’ll find that this city both alien and familiar as you visit a world with a rich history inspired by art deco and post-Soviet architecture.

The same beautiful high-resolution pixel art, atmosphere, and locations of Tails Noir are revisited and set against another banger of a soundtrack by Danshin, whose melancholic and noir doom jazz perfectly accompanies the themes and characters of each story.

description.zh: 《Creatures of Aether》是一款免费游玩的卡牌对战游戏，背景设定在《Rivals of Aether》的宇宙中。构建包含强力元素技能的牌组，参与 PVP 天梯赛或 PVE 副本挑战。
description.en: Creatures of Aether is a free-to-play card battler set in the Rivals of Aether universe. Play PvP ladder matches or PvE dungeons as you construct a deck with powerful elemental abilities.

body.zh:
Creatures of Aether is a free to play card game created by Tako Boy Studios in collaboration with Dan Fornace and the Rivals of Aether team. Collect elemental creatures from around the world of Aether including powerful Rival cards from the indie fighting game, Rivals of Aether!

Inspired by the card game, Triple Triad, Creatures of Aether blows the doors off the formula with its elemental gameplay. Once you learn the basics of flipping cards, you'll need to account for the four elements and powerful abilities to turn the board to your favor.

Creatures of Aether features a ranked ladder with online cross-platform PvP matches. Matches are around 3 minutes long and matchmaking pits you against players with similar skills.

Earn Medals to climb the ladder and reach the Master tier to earn yourself a free Rival card! Once you hit Master, the race is on to the top of the leaderboard, but be careful because you can also lose medals in the Master tier!

Creatures of Aether features over 150 unique elemental cards each with their own set of numbers. The four numbers on the cards determine it's power in that direction. Place a card with a higher number facing a card on the board to flip it to be under your control!

But where Creatures of Aether really shines is the card abilities! After you master the 15 unique card abilities, you'll be able to build a deck that can counter any strategy. Multiple deck types are viable at the top level and its up to you to decide what kind of deck you want to build!

Creatures of Aether features a fun single player experience to obtain more cards known as Dungeons. These miniature roguelite experiences require Abyss Orbs to enter in exchange for fantastic rewards. Players are given a new dungeon deck and must improve their deck by defeating computer opponents in 3x3 and 4x4 board battles.

Throughout the Dungeon, you'll encounter some awesome rewards including chests, boosters and even a safe that allows you to add a card from your Dungeon deck to your loot. At the end of the Dungeon, is the Dungeon Boss who has powerful cards from a single element. Beating the boss allows you to take a large stack of one of their cards!

One of the most exciting features in Creatures of Aether are the Rival cards! These cards act like classes or heroes in other card games and give your deck its flair. You need to have a Rival card and can only have one in your deck. Your opponent can also see which Rival you are using.

There are 16 Rivals in the game and each of them mix up your strategy. The cards are pulling from characters across the Aether Universe featuring favorites from both Rivals of Aether and the upcoming Dungeons of Aether.

Creatures of Aether is the perfect card game if you are looking for deep and strategic gameplay with a short match time. There are always improvements you can make to your deck and strategies you can adjust in order to make sure the board ends in your favor!

description.zh: 《Rivals of Aether II》是备受欢迎的独立格斗游戏《Rivals of Aether》的续作。在这一全新世代的平台格斗游戏中，您可操作全新的元素战士或熟悉的经典角色来展开激烈对决！
description.en: Rivals of Aether II is the sequel to the hit indie fighting game, Rivals of Aether. Play as both new and returning elemental fighters in the next generation of platform fighters.

body.zh:
《Rivals of Aether II》是新一代的平台格斗游戏与多人乱斗游戏。这款备受欢迎的独立格斗游戏续作在《Rivals of Aether》上多方面进行了扩展和提升。我们加入了3D视觉效果、全新的游戏机制、优化的在线支持等有趣内容！

以太宇宙是个充满纷争的世界，各个文明召唤火、水、风、土的元素之力，而强大的战士们利用这些力量展开无法遗忘的激烈战斗。《Rivals of Aether II》延续了系列作品对竞技深度、易上手的玩法和难忘的角色设计。无论您是格斗游戏的竞技高手，还是希望轻松享受乐趣的新手，《Rivals of Aether II》都能为您带来高速且华丽的乱斗体验！

《Rivals of Aether II》包含令人兴奋的初始角色阵容，既有全新角色，也有经典回归角色。游戏推出后，我们还计划新增更多免费的可玩角色！每位战士都拥有丰富的技能组合，引入了新的机制与特殊技能，不仅对原作进行了全面升级，还为平台格斗游戏类型带来了全新突破。游戏新增的防御盾、边缘系统、抓取与投掷动作，为紧张激烈的战斗增加了很多的层次玩法。此外，独特的连击技能（Pummel Special）、边缘技能（Ledge Special） 和起身技能（Getup Special） 提供了全新的战斗选项，为玩家带来前所未有的畅快体验，推动了平台格斗游戏的有趣而难忘的提升。
body.en:
Rivals of Aether II is the next generation of platform fighters and multiplayer brawlers. This sequel to the hit indie fighting game Rivals of Aether is expanded and upgraded with 3D visuals, new mechanics, improved online support, and more!

The Aether Universe is a world where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth - and powerful Rivals harness those powers to clobber each other! Rivals of Aether II continues the franchise’s iconic focus on competitive depth, accessible gameplay, and unforgettable characters. Whether you’re a competitive master of the genre or a newcomer looking to have fun, Rivals of Aether II delivers a fast-paced and flashy brawler experience that you won’t forget.

Rivals of Aether II features an exciting base roster of new and returning characters - with post-launch plans to add additional playable characters to the game for free! Each of these playable Rivals have an expansive moveset featuring new mechanics and special moves that are not only an upgrade over the original game, but new to the platform fighter genre as a whole. Shields, ledges, grabs and throws add new layers to the frenetic flow of combat in Rivals of Aether II. On top of that, the Pummel Special, Ledge Special, and Getup Special provide unique combat options that push the genre forward in exciting new ways.

description.zh: 这款复古风格点击冒险游戏，灵感源自 90 年代经典动画电影与冒险游戏，你将拯救一个和平世界，使其免遭机器的毁灭。
description.en: Save a peaceful world from being annihilated by machines in this oldschool point&click tale, inspired by classic animated movies and adventure games of the 90s.

body.zh:
Beyond The Edge Of Owlsgard is an old-school point & click adventure game that is reminiscent of the animated movies and Saturday morning cartoons of decades gone by. While it is obviously inspired by the LucasArts and Sierra classics, it also strives to create its own style and identity by returning to the original “adventure” aspect of the genre. Aside from solving the obligatory inventory-based puzzles, this means a heavy focus on exploring mysterious lands, uncovering secrets and dealing with all kinds of dangers.

Strange things are happening in the animal kingdom of Velehill. Unknown shadows of large appearance are seen roaming through the forests and making the ground shake with every step of their steel feet. Houses and trees are destroyed and one animal after the other seems to disappear mysteriously.

Finn, a young roebuck, soon finds out about the disappearance of his family as well. Without hesitation, he goes on a journey to find them, not knowing he and his new friend Gwen the owl will soon uncover a dark secret that should have been kept hidden for all eternity...

• An immersive story told through hand-drawn landscapes and countless animations!

• A return to the “adventure” aspect of the genre – a big focus on exploring whimsical places, uncovering secrets, and dealing with tense and dangerous situations

• Cinematic cutscenes, reminiscent of hand-drawn animated movies, mixed with a pixel art aesthetic

• Atmospheric soundtrack, inspired by the old midi classics everyone knows and loves

• 6-8 hours of gameplay

body.zh:
【故事介绍】在和平的葡葡果蜜花园小镇，有一个热心的勇者叫做莱特。他十分喜欢帮助别人，在小镇中过着快乐而自在的生活。

直到某天，他的朋友向他道出一个秘密……

“莱特，你一定要……”

【玩法介绍】这是一个轻松可爱的剧情向rpg游戏，玩家将与勇者莱特一起在温馨小镇进行愉快生活！

• 你可以与小镇的朋友聊天，探索发现新风景~

• 帮助居民们完成他们的请求，这是勇者该做的事！

• 在粉红沙滩钓鱼享受悠闲时光。

• 烹饪美味食物来送给居民吧。

• 不过在那之前得先种植作物哦。

• 对了，再帮镇长做一件新衣服吧！

【游戏特色】

• 独特的世界观与可爱剧情，内含furry与GB元素，调查发现更多惊喜！

• 丰富的小游戏和轻松互动，你可以在这里自由探索，完成各种有趣的任务！

• 清新优美的美术风格，游戏中涵盖大量动画，CG与美丽地图场景哦！

【关于游玩】

「游戏时长」

2小时

「结局数量」

2个结局

解锁特殊回忆剧情且在游戏内达成2个结局将自动进入附赠房间

「操作方式」

方向键/鼠标：移动

Shift+方向键： 跑步

空格/鼠标：对话/调查物品（长按空格跳过对话）

ESC/鼠标右键：取消/打开菜单

美术：lidogegg、伊柚

发行：梦结界工作室

特别感谢：

音乐感谢Alexander Nakarada，更多引用素材来源详见游戏内ED

description.zh: 你是一个被迫继承了酒馆的新手老板。布置酒馆，购买装备，完成任务，酿造美酒，做出上百种风格各异的料理和饮品，平衡客人的数量，升级酒馆的等级。招募性格各异且身怀绝技的员工，在他们的帮助下振兴酒馆，同时了解他们的故事，又或者，了解你自己？
description.en: You are a rookie tavern owner who has been forced to inherit a tavern. Set up the tavern, buy equipment, complete quests, make hundreds of different dishes and drinks. Recruit skilled staffs and revitalize the tavern with their help while learning their stories, or maybe, learning about yourself?

body.zh:
一个剑与魔法的世界，一个包罗万象的城市，你是一个被迫继承了酒馆的新手老板，前方有艰难的路等着你。

28天的期限，你需要利用好手中的一切来赚钱，每次游戏你都会遇到不同的人，买到不同的装备，获得不同的特权。运用好他们的特性并合理搭配组合，能让你从沉重的债务中找到生机，甚至突破所有人的期望成为一代酒馆大亨也说不定。

无需手动布置位置，你可以直接装点好酒馆的装饰，增添酒馆的人气，让顾客络绎不绝。

——————————————————————————————————————————————

不同职业和品级的员工，各自都掌握着与众不同的技能，他们是让酒馆繁荣起来的关键。员工们也有着丰富多彩的身世和故事，每个人都值得深交。

——————————————————————————————————————————————

上百种食材、料理和饮品，你需要精心安排酒馆的菜单，有时菜谱也不是越多越好哦。

——————————————————————————————————————————————

商店和公会系统帮助你获得各式各样的装备道具，还能举办活动获得增益，完成任务来获得额外的奖励，还有更多机制隐藏在员工身上。

——————————————————————————————————————————————

白影酒馆既是生意，也是生活。无论你想寻找什么，都可以来这里坐一坐。

获取更多资讯，反馈游戏问题，欢迎加入官方QQ群：976944204

小红书：tavernrevisited

微博、b站：流浪狗工作室
body.en:
A world of swords and magic, a city of many races, and you're a rookie owner who has inherited a tavern. There are tough roads ahead waiting for you.

With a 28-day deadline, you need to utilize everything at hand to make money. Each time you play you will meet different people, buy different equipment and experience different events. Utilizing their characteristics and matching them in the right combinations can help you find life from heavy debts, and even break through everyone's expectations to become a generation of tavern tycoons.

No need to manually set up the location, you can just load up the decorations and add to the popularity of the tavern to keep the customers coming back.

——————————————————————————————————————————————

Employees of different professions and ranks, each with distinctive skills, are the key to making the tavern thrive. The employees also have colorful lives and stories, and everyone deserves a deeper friendship.

——————————————————————————————————————————————

With hundreds of ingredients, dishes and drinks, you'll need to carefully organize your tavern's menu, and sometimes more recipes aren't better.

——————————————————————————————————————————————

The store and guild system help you to get all kinds of equipments and props, and you can also organize activities to gain benefits.

Complete tasks to earn extra rewards, and there are more mechanics hidden in the staff.

——————————————————————————————————————————————

Tavern is as much about business as it is about life. Whatever you're looking for, it's worth a revisit.

X：

description.zh: 《安尼姆的无尽旅途》是一款高难度动物拟人RPG。你将组建一支4人军团，以第三人称视角，参与这场持续千年的中世纪王座之乱。敌人或来自于权斗，或源自于黑瘴。请牢记生命只有一次，堕落或是超越就在一念之间，一切为了生存的抉择都需要你的策略、运气和勇气。
description.en: DONG WU: ODYSSEY is a challenging RPG about legendary beasts. You will form a 4-person party and fight a battle of succession to claim the throne. In this thousand-year war, your enemy could be the noble or Miasma. Your fate depends on your strategy, luck and courage. Good luck!

body.zh:
《安尼姆的无尽旅途》是一款高难度动物拟人RPG，游戏中有角色会永久死亡（死亡角色可以免费重新招募，已获得角色不会消失不用重新抽），会因为积累瘴气值到达临界点而出现“堕落”或者“超越”的精神状态，会在冒险的过程中遇到各种有趣的随机事件....没错，我们工作室里有一群心智经受了无数次考验的高承压《暗黑地牢》玩家。

故事背景

这是漂浮在大洋之上的四大板块之一，也是九国聚合分裂循环往复的史诗中的一环。

在这片有着龙崇拜的土地上，打着匡扶龙脉旗号的战争再次响起，苍之大陆再一次进入动荡的乱世。与此同时，曾经肆虐百年终于消隐的黑瘴也悄然蔓延，成为权力斗争之外的更大的危机。

九国形成三方势力，角逐这片土地的王座之位。不同的国家，不同的身份，兽人们都在战争与黑瘴的夹缝中寻求生存，兽人群像在这里影映成为历史的惊鸿一瞥——百兽时代。

周游九国土地，危险与奇遇并存。

随机的敌人增加了旅途未知的危险，随机事件触发后你是否有勇气接受诱惑与挑战，而一些安尼姆将在路途中与你偶遇，为你带来财富、好运或不幸。

如同生命只有一次，安尼姆脆弱的肉体总会在时间中消亡。

瘴气的蔓延将会加快生命的流逝，当安尼姆生命将尽，再战还是逃离，超越还是堕落？一线生机就在此刻。

旅途中你将面对40+不同机制的敌人，20+高难BOSS战。每个敌人都有自己独特的机制，而在洞悉了敌人的弱点后，我们将不再有不可逾越的高山。

目前一共有120多件装备可在游戏中获得，但它们并不会在你的仓库中成为一个落满灰尘的收藏品。不断地前进，不断地战斗，每一件装备都有自己的特点，每一件装备也都有自己的归宿。大开大合地使用吧，无惧未知的危险！

在这里，故事剧情将以手绘形式融入游戏的直线体验中。无声的、简洁的、拟喻的，去除繁重文字之后，我们将每只安尼姆的故事，散落在旅途的诸多细微之处。而游戏一开始出现的红狐皇子，仅作为四大主角之一。我们将以POV的叙事形式，一窥这混乱中世纪的绘卷。

欢迎关注《安尼姆的无尽旅途》社区，获取一手开发进度，预订一场惊险独特的冒险之旅！

官方QQ群：548949208
body.en:
This is one of the four continents and one of the Nine Kingdoms where a web of political conficts go on.

On this land of Dragon, the war to awaken the power of Dragon bloodline is back. Once again, the Land of Azure falls into chaos. Miasma that once shrouded the continent for hundreds of years is coming back, posing another threat besides the fights orchestrated around the throne.

The Nine Kingdoms join into three forces, vying for the throne of the land. Every one is just the epitome of the Beast Era, no matter your nationalities or identies.

Travel across the land of Nine Kingdoms where danger and adventures await.

Your journey becomes more danger as you don't know who your enemies are. It's up to you whether to accept the challenges. Some of the Dong Wu will company you along the journey. They will bring you fortune, good luck or bad luck.

You only live once. So as Dong Wu.

As Miasma builds up, you will fade away. Fight or flee? Transcend or corrupt? It's all on a whim.

You'll fight against 40+ enemies of different mechanism and 20+ challenging bosses. Each enemy has their own mechanism. You will conquer the land once you know your enemies.

You can unlock 120+ items in the game. Keep moving. Keep fighting. Each item has their own use. Each item has their own fate. Use them wisely and face the unknown!

Each Dong Wu has their own history. Their secrets are unveiled throughout your trip.

You'll experience the chaos of this world in the POV of four main characters, starting with Crown of Fusia.

Follow Dong Wu on our social media and get ready for your adventure!

title.zh: 逃出从此以后：入职培训

description.zh: 这款游戏受《纸片马力欧》系列经典作品启发，颠覆角色扮演品类！现实世界贪婪的巨型集团闯入童话世界，剥削童话角色的廉价劳动力，新进的故事书主人公必须在公司内部不断晋升，团结其他不满的员工，与大家携手一同努力抗争！
description.en: A genre-bending RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games! Ever After Inc, a greedy megacorp from the real world, is taking over fairytales for their cheap labor and it’s up to you to fight back! Experience Escape from Ever After’s first chapter in this prologue version of the full game.

body.zh:
《逃出从此以后：入职培训》是一款冒险角色扮演游戏的序章版本，受《纸片马力欧》系列经典作品启发，将向大家讲述童话故事书角色如何与资本主义抗争！

原来，现实世界的商业巨头“从此以后集团”发现故事书世界宝贵资源丰富，劳动力成本低廉，盈利空间可观，然而完全没有开发，自然便想了个办法，企图将这里变成他们的下一个市场！某个童话的主人公霍什·全顿为了扳倒从今以后集团，被迫求职，只能与昔日的宿敌火龙联手，期望从内部击溃这家集团！不断晋升，号召其他不满的员工，大家一同反抗资本主义！

纵身跃入一个又一个童话世界，邂逅形形色色的角色，到达迷人的地方，揭晓令人惊叹的秘密！《逃出从此以后：入职培训》的故事里，霍什甚至必须进入《三只小猪》的黑化世界，阻挠三只猪推平树林的计划，阻止他们使用稻草、木头和砖头建造住宅。

一群又一群搞笑的敌人，简洁干脆的回合制玩法！精准把握时机，下达行动指令，让霍什潇洒结果对手，各种物品、徽章以及伙伴保证他每次都能有一张王牌。

• 战斗有趣，对战系统紧张刺激，鼓励创新尝试和运用策略

• 组建自己的队伍，每个角色都有特有技能，冒险途中可以选择和升级

• 跟公司的其他角色调侃打趣，帮助故事书里的同事，努力晋升，装点你的办公室

• 探索广阔的故事书世界——支线任务、宝藏和秘密随处可见

• 故事套故事，体验迷人而又鲜活的叙事，这里的规则不断变化

• 游戏音乐由爵士乐团演奏，令玩家全程精力满满
body.en:
Escape from Ever After: Onboarding is a free, standalone version of Escape from Ever After, featuring the game’s first chapter. It’s fairytales vs. capitalism in this adventure RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games!

It turns out that storybooks are an untapped market ripe with valuable resources, cheap labor, and profit to be had—so naturally, real-world conglomerate Ever After Inc.™ found a way to intervene! With no choice but to get a job, a newly-hired fairytale hero named Flynt Buckler must team up with his former dragon nemesis in order to take down Ever After Inc. from the inside. Climb the corporate ladder, rally together other disgruntled employees, and fight back against capitalism!

Dive into storybook worlds packed to the brim with colorful characters, captivating locales, and electrifying secrets! In Escape from Ever After: Onboarding, Flynt must enter a twisted version of The Three Little Pigs, in which the pigs have been contracted by Ever After Inc. to bulldoze the forest and build condos made from straw, sticks, and brick.

Face off against hordes of wacky enemies in snappy turn-based gameplay! Perfectly-timed action commands allow Flynt to finish off his foes with style, and an assortment of items, badges, and partners ensure there’s always a trick up his sleeve.

•

Fight in a fun, fast-paced battle system that rewards experimentation and strategy

•

Build and customize your party—every character has unique skills that can be equipped and upgraded throughout your journey

•

Engage in office banter, help your storybook coworkers, and decorate your office as you climb the corporate ladder

•

Explore vast storybook worlds brimming with sidequests, treasures, and secrets

•

Stories within stories: experience a charming and lively narrative where the rules are constantly changing

•

A jazzy, big-band soundtrack that keeps the energy pumping throughout

title.zh: Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah
title.en: Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah

description.zh: 一款奇幻互动叙事游戏，讲述兽人希杜（Hidu）在一座港口城市调查连环谋杀案的故事。
description.en: A fantasy interactive tale about the beast-man Hidu investigating murders in a port city.

body.zh:
A Game from the "Legends of Savvarah" series.

"Time of Pariah" is an interactive story. The game is primarily text-based, but with lots of illustrations (essentially a visual novel in a non-standardised setting).

On the continent of Erteon, the endless war rages between Kradzhan – an alliance of three beastly kingdoms – and Dominion of the Horned Ones.

Seihal is a port city of Kradzhan, steeped in corruption and crime. Wealthy aristocrats, commanding squads of well-armed mercenaries, wield the ultimate power here.

Hidu is a mercenary. He once deserted the army, escaping death. He managed to blend into this colorful cauldron of the criminal world, where a precarious balance between different factions has somehow been maintained in recent years.

But now, this delicate balance is under threat: one by one, the enforcers of the Black Horn – a criminal authority for whom Hidu works – are disappearing.

Hidu must get to the bottom of these events. And perhaps even play a pivotal role in them, for a great storm is brewing...

Extra: it is recommended to select the second launch option if the DLC is downloaded.

FEATURES:

•

A complex and truly nonlinear plot: 25unique endings, numerous unexpected twists, and challenging decisions;

•

14 detailed non-playable characters, each can become either your friend or foe;

•

5 romantic interests (2 male and 3 female): 4 main and 1 additional;

•

Vibrant and unique visual style, original soundtrack;

•

A detailed, original fantasy world that goes beyond the game storyline;

•

Space for role-play and your unique story: play as a ruthless rogue, a patriot of your country, or someone who just wants to survive. Everything is in your hands.

description.zh: 这是一款深度的开放世界生活模拟与城镇建设游戏，背景设定在一个舒适的末世后乐园。在这里，你可以复兴古老的小镇、航行穿越神秘的群岛、搜寻文物、种植农作物、捕鱼以及制作你所需要的物资。你能帮助动物海湾重获新生，再次成为一个繁荣的旅游胜地吗？
description.en: A deep, open world life sim and town building game set in a cozy post-apocalyptic paradise. Restore your town, sail across a mysterious archipelago, rescue animal pals. Hunt for relics and farm, fish & craft everything you need. Can you help turn Critter Cove into a thriving tourist town once again?

body.zh:
动物海湾曾经是一个吸引了全球游客的旅游胜地，可如今，这里的街头脏乱不堪、海滩布满垃圾。你能帮助我们改变这一切，让动物海湾重新充满活力吗？

《动物海湾》是一款结合了生活模拟和城镇建设的游戏，这里有精美绝伦、能够随心打造的开放世界，等待着你来探索！

花费金币来升级建筑，通过探索世界发现新的蓝图，收集资源发展你的小镇。动物海湾的游客满意度将随着小镇的升级而提高。满意度越高，吸引的新游客就越多，这将带给你源源不断的收入，可以用于小镇的升级。相信聪明的你，应该都明白了吧！

勇闯神秘的热带群岛，那里遍布着被毁灭已久的文明遗迹；潜入海底，打捞旧世界的宝藏；解救遇难的小动物们；发掘异国风味食材。这是一个充满神秘废墟、沉船和古老技术的奇妙世界，等待着你去发现。

在探索的过程中，你会找到制作数百种不同物品的资源，发现新的建筑蓝图，并带回独特的植物在你的农场里种植。变废为宝，通过向游客提供新鲜食物来提高游客满意度。

利用游客的消费所得和你淘来的宝贝，修复那些年久失修的建筑。为游客和镇上的居民开设全新的商店和设施。打造各种装饰和有趣的互动小道具，让整个小镇焕然一新，成为你独特的天地。你甚至可以用手工制作（或者抢夺）家具，来装点自己的小窝

想要复兴小镇，你需要一些帮助。幸好在动物海湾的世界里，你可以结识各种各样的小伙伴。他们有的随和友好，但有一些可能需要你耐心地去说服。营救世界各地的小动物，帮助他们在小镇上建立自己的家园并找到理想的工作。不要忘记，他们的幸福是你成功的关键

踏上寻宝之旅，去发现遍布世界各地的隐秘宝藏和古代文物吧！将这些文物捐赠给神秘博物馆，揭开古老的秘密，同时可以让游客领略到当地的文化并收取一些费用，真是一举两得！

利用强大的自定义功能，打造专属你自己的完美小岛角色。无论是人类还是动物，哺乳动物还是爬行动物，亦或是鹦鹉的头和猴子的尾，全凭你喜欢！尽情混搭你的外貌特征，发现数百种服装组合，打造完美的热带风格。

• 发现废弃景点的魅力，重现于你的城镇

• 探索神秘奇幻之境，如沉没之城、野趣植物园等绝美胜地。

• 寻觅世界各地独一无二的渔场，捕捞末世后的鱼类。发现最佳钓鱼点，畅享独特钓鱼之旅

• 解构开放世界中的物品，探索全新的制作配方

• 欣赏游客们尽情被弹射器投入海洋，享受一场绝佳的娱乐体验

• 根据居民个性，精准匹配职业。让他们在喜爱（或讨厌）的工作中找到满足感

• 亲眼见证小动物们喜欢上你制作的礼物，或是穿上你为他们精心设计的服装

• 追寻在暴风雨过后因海难而来的新居民

• 烹制强效食物，增强你的体力和探险能力

• 展开宣传营销，吸引更多游客来到你的岛屿。享受无尽的旅游盛宴！

将我们添加到你的愿望单，以获取最新资讯。同时也可以加入我们的Discord社区，第一时间了解我们的送礼活动，以及最新的《动物海湾》新闻和消息！"
body.en:
The town of Critter Cove used to attract visitors from all over the world. Now it’s mostly known for dirty streets and trash-strewn beaches. Can you help us turn things around?

Critter Cove is a life sim and town builder game with a beautiful, handcrafted open world to explore.

Spend your doubloons to upgrade buildings and explore the world to discover new blueprints and gather resources to grow your town. More upgrades will improve Critter Cove’s tourist rating.

The greater your tourist rating, the more new tourists will visit. The more new tourists, the more money in your pockets to upgrade the town!

Venture out into the mysterious tropical archipelago peppered with the ruins of a long-destroyed civilization. Dive beneath the waves to salvage the treasures of the old world. Rescue shipwrecked critters. Unearth exotic ingredients. It’s a wondrous world of mysterious ruins, shipwrecks and ancient technology waiting to be discovered.

As you explore, you’ll find resources to craft hundreds of different items, discover new construction blueprints and bring home unique plants to grow on your farm. Turn mundane salvage into something new and unique, and improve your tourism rating by offering your freshly grown food to visitors.

Use tourist money and salvaged items to restore rundown buildings and open up entirely new stores and venues for tourists and townsfolk. Craft decorations and interactive objects that will improve the town and make it uniquely yours. You can even decorate your very own home with hand-crafted (or hand-looted) furniture!

You’ll need help to restore the town, and luckily the world of Critter Cove is filled with many colorful characters. Some are easy-going and friendly… others might need some convincing! Rescue Critters across the world, assist them in building a home and help them find the perfect job in your community. Their happiness is the key to your success.

Embark on quests to find hidden treasures or ancient relics scattered throughout the world. Donate these artifacts to the Museum of Mystery to uncover the secrets of the long, long ago - and then charge tourists a small fee to the museum so they can absorb some local culture!

Create your perfect island persona with our robust customization system. Human or animal? Mammal or reptile? The head of a parrot and the tail of a monkey? It’s entirely up to you! Mix and match your physical attributes to your heart's content and discover that perfect tropical drip with hundreds of outfit combinations to craft and discover.

•

Discover abandoned attractions and rebuild them in your town

•

Explore weird and wonderful locations such as a sunken city, and a wild botanical garden

•

Catch some post-apocalyptic fish and discover the best and most unique fishing spots around the world

•

Dismantle items in the open-world to discover new crafting recipes

•

Watch tourists launch themselves into the ocean for entertainment

•

Assign townsfolk careers they’ll love (or hate) depending on their personalities

•

Watch Critters use gifts or wear clothes you make for them

•

Hunt for new residents shipwrecked after storms

•

Cook powerful food items that affect your stamina and exploration prowess

•

Run advertising campaigns to attract more tourists to your island

Wishlist us to stay up-to-date, and head over to our Discord to be the first to hear about giveaways, and the latest Critter Cove news and gossip!

description.zh: 人类已经破灭 - 一切全凭哥里（Gori）、他致命而诙谐的智能悬浮滑板 F.R.A.N.K，以及阴郁的人工智能伙伴 CH1-P，撕扯开邪恶“可爱军”的封锁，将它们统统斩杀。
description.en: Humanity has been destroyed - and it's up to Gori, along with his deadly but wise-cracking sentient hoverboard, F.R.A.N.K, and morose AI companion, CH1-P, to shred and slay the evil Adorable Army!

body.zh:
人类已经破灭 - 一切全凭哥里（Gori）、他致命而诙谐的智能悬浮滑板 F.R.A.N.K，以及阴郁的人工智能伙伴 CH1-P，撕扯开邪恶“可爱军”的封锁，将它们统统斩杀。

受到无法满足的需求的推动，“Cool-Toyz inc.”打造出了“终极宠物”。这是不会饥饿、不需要上厕所，也不会受到时间的摧残的终极伙伴。几乎没人能够预料到这些完美的宠物会变异成噩梦般可怕的扭曲玩具，让人类遭遇破灭。

在史诗般的大战中，掌握轰隆爆炸的武器，学会摧枯拉朽的连击，阻止“可爱军”征服星系，同时还要救出自己的创造者和唯一对 Gori 一众表达爱意之人 – Y 教授。将你的战斗和平台跳跃技能臻至极限，这里有充满环境危险的奇特地形，有尖锐的成人幽默，还有令人热血沸腾的音乐，让你勇往直前，突破难关。

这些为时势所迫的英雄必须在一些不那么可靠的盟友的帮助下追踪并消灭“可爱军”的各位将领，发现“Cool-Toyz inc.”潜藏的真相，揭开这趟惊险动作满载的砍杀之旅背后的秘密。做好准备，去展开可爱大灭绝吧！

在毁灭之前从“Cool-Toyz inc.”偷运出来的最新合成宠物原型之一；Gori 超级可爱，同时又极度致命。

和一群最不像样的英雄一道拯救星系 – F.R.A.N.K 和 CH1-P，还有一大堆充满意外的盟友，言辞中满是真心，还有和 F.R.A.N.K 的刀刃一样锋利的成人幽默！

用悬浮滑板作为武器，在快节奏的战斗中与成群的嗜血“可爱军”战斗！施展强力的滑行、跐板和旋转，最大限度进行屠戮，累积连击高分。

从满是霓虹灯的城市街道到流淌着致命毒药的玩具工厂，再到扭曲的狂欢节和街机台的内部 – 每个关卡都充满了致命的危险环境，遍地变异玩具，让你将战斗与平台跳跃的能力推向极限。

这只猫咪不仅有爪子... 更还有摧枯拉朽的爆炸武库、锋利无比的武器和各种可供解锁的招式，用最粗暴最型的方式向“可爱军”倾泻火力。

运用你的终极悬浮滑板跑酷技能，探索关卡每个角落，寻找可解锁全新滤镜、Gori 服装和毛皮样式的收集品！

运用 F.R.A.N.K 的利刃大肆切割，令敌人血肉横飞，让城镇满是血红 – 这里有你前所未见的肉体恐惧和最最扭曲的玩具设计！

使用悬浮滑板去大肆斩杀，还能听取多种风格的动力满载原创劲爆曲目。

做好准备：

• 快节奏的第三人称滑板砍杀恐怖游戏。

• 遭受可爱军团侵袭的未来风格世界。

• 沉浸式（而且非常萌）的环境。

• 可对玩家操作和游戏风格做出响应的自适应音乐。

• 猛烈破坏，野蛮战斗，整个世界都可以砸得稀巴烂。
body.en:
Humanity has been destroyed - and it's up to Gori, along with his deadly but wise-cracking sentient hoverboard, F.R.A.N.K, and morose A.I companion, CH1-P, to slay the evil Adorable Army with lethal combos.

Fuelled by insatiable demand, 'Cool-Toyz Inc.' created 'Ultra Pets'. The ultimate companions that never hunger, never require bathroom breaks and are impervious to the ravages of time. Little did anyone expect the mutation that transformed these perfect pets into twisted toys straight from your nightmares, hell-bent on wiping out mankind.

Master explosive weaponry and devastating combos in an epic battle to prevent the Adorable Army from conquering the galaxy, and rescue Professor Y, their missing creator and only human who showed Gori and his friends love. Push your combat and platforming skills to the limits as you fight your way through twisted landscapes filled with environmental hazards, razor-sharp adult humour and a bone-crunching, pulse-pounding soundtrack.

One of the last prototype synthetic pets, smuggled out of Cool-Toyz Inc before destruction, Gori is cute, cuddly, yet extremely deadly.

Save the galaxy with a team of the unlikeliest heroes, from F.R.A.N.K and CH1-P to a host of unexpected allies, with a script packed with heart and adult humour that’s as razor-sharp as F.R.A.N.K’s blades!

Battle the blood-thirsty hordes of the Adorable Army in fast-paced combat where your hoverboard is your weapon! Power slide, grind and spin to cause MAXIMUM carnage and high combo scores. Paint the town red with F.R.A.N.K’s blades as you slice and dice with gratuitous amounts of dismemberment - body horror and the most twisted toy designs you’ve ever seen!

This cat has claws… and a devastating arsenal of explosives, razor-sharp weaponry and unlockable moves to lay waste to the Adorable Army in the most brutal and stylish way possible! From neon-drenched city streets and toy factories awash with deadly toxins, to twisted carnivals and the insides of arcade machines - each level is filled with lethal environmental hazards and mutated toys to push your combat and platforming skills to their limits.

Use your extreme hoverboard parkour skills to explore every corner of the level for collectables that unlock radical new filters, outfits and fur-styles for Gori!

Skate and slay out to an original bone-crunching soundtrack, with 48 songs bursting with energy across multiple genres.

• Play as a badass cat with a team of unlikely heroes

• Battle blood-thirsty hordes of mutated toys

• Explore multiple levels filled with lethal environmental hazards

• Master a devastating arsenal of explosives, razor-sharp weaponry and unlockable moves

• Use your extreme hoverboard parkour skills to explore every corner of the level for collectables

• Turn the town red with F.R.A.N.K’s blades as you slice and dice

• Skate and slay out to an original bone-crunching soundtrack

The game contains foul language, excessive gore, and other adult content! Enjoy!

description.zh: 惩罚这个小混蛋恶魔，同时也会被反制！——恶魔召唤冒险游戏
description.en: Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Cemo-Summoning Adventure Game

body.zh:
关于语言切换

・在Steam库中右键点击本作，在【属性】>【通用】设定下，将语言设定为您想要游玩的语言即可。

・读取不同语言版本创建的存档时，周目数和结局收集等信息可以正确继承，但出于引擎功能限制，文本显示方面可能会有极小概率出现轻微问题。因此，当您切换语言进行游玩时，我们推荐不要「继续连结」，而是选择「新的开始」来进行新一轮游戏。

✦剧情✦

这里是魔法世界——玛吉利西亚。

身为召唤师的你召唤出了一只恶魔。

为了缔结契约，你对他说出了自己的名字，但恶魔却始终不肯报上名号。

无奈之下你只能随口以“德比伦”来称呼他。

为了帮他实现他的野心——恢复真正的姿态，你需要召唤玛吉利西亚各地的民众，让他们深陷恐惧的漩涡从而收集魔力！

✦游戏玩法✦

你需要和恶魔“德比伦”一起召唤个性鲜明的角色们。让对方的情绪高涨，将其“感情灵气”转化为魔力进行吸收。

在游戏里，会让你从两个选项中选择其一来刺激对方的情绪。不过这并不是随便乱选就行，你需要活用德比伦的特殊能力——“邪眼洞察”来窥视对方的内心，准确解读对方的想法，从而找出通往正确答案的道路。或许有时候，还能发现对方令人意想不到的一面哦……？

本游戏最大的特点便是海量的结局。甚至于一旦选错了选项，可能就会当场进入结局……灵活运用存档与读档的“魔法”，探索所有可能性，找出这个故事的真结局吧！

明知这是错误选项，却又忍不住想看看会有什么反应——为了收集结局……做出这种事也是可以的吧？

——嗯，就是这样与恶魔一起做“背德之事”的故事哦。

↑个性丰富的角色示例

✦拍照＆装饰照片✦

本作还搭载了可以与登场角色一起拍摄趣味照片的相机功能，以及可以用各种贴纸来装饰照片的装饰功能。

与各个角色一起，用不同姿势和滤镜拍照！并且随着剧情推进，还将解锁更多贴纸，随心所欲地用它们来装饰你的照片吧！

✦游戏特色✦

・可召唤的角色总数超过30名。

・所有表情差分均由动画呈现，让角色生动活跃在你的眼前。

・点击角色身体可触发各种有趣反应。

・颇具魔法世界氛围的，可爱又略带黑暗的哥特幻想风格音乐。

・仅在独立游戏中才有，充斥作者个人趣味、带有强烈背德感的剧情。

※使用本游戏素材制作视频或发布截图时，无论个人或企业、无论是否盈利均可自由使用。投稿时欢迎附带【#恶魔连结】的标签。详细条款请参阅官方网站。

※游玩过程中若发生问题，请通过Steam社区中的贴子向我们反馈。

✦操作方法✦

基本上是以鼠标操作，但也提供了一些键盘快捷键。部分环节需键盘输入。

•

鼠标右键：隐藏对话框

•

鼠标滚轮下滑：推进对话

•

Enter：推进对话／邪眼洞察、魔力收集操作

•

Esc：打开菜单（标题画面以外）／退出游戏（标题画面）

•

Space：隐藏对话框

•

Tab：快进

•

B：显示对话记录

•

L：打开读取界面

•

S：打开存档界面

•

F10、F12：截图
body.en:
Switching Languages

・To change the game language, select your preferred language in the Steam game's properties menu.

・When loading save data from a different language, data such as playthrough count and unlocked endings will carry over, but text display issues may occur. This is due to limitations with the game engine. When playing in a different language, we recommend that you do not use your existing save data and instead start a new game.

✦Story✦

In the magical world, "Magirisia"...

You, the summoner, have summoned a demon. You give him your own name to make a contract, but the demon does not give his name.

He, named "Debirun",summon the people throughout Magirisia to gather magical power and terrorize them to regain his true form!

✦Game System✦

Summon unique characters to collect magical power by converting their "emotional aura" into magical power.

There is a phase in which you have to choose one of two options to heighten the emotions of the person you summoned in any way. However, you do not choose blindly. Use Debirun's special ability, “Evil Eye Search,” to look into your opponent's mind. By reading their thoughts, you will naturally find the correct answer, or you may even catch a glimpse of an unexpected side of them...?

The most important feature of this game is the large number of endings. The wrong choice can result in an immediate ending... Use the magic of save and load to explore all possibilities and find the true ending to this story!

You know it's a bad choice, but you can't help but want to see how they react in order to collect the ending... Is it OK to do this? This is a story about doing “immoral things” with the devil.

↑An example of unique characters

✦Camera & Deco✦

The game features a camera function that allows you to take unique photos with the characters and a decorating function that allows you to decorate the photos you take with stamps. Take pictures with various characters in various poses and with various filters, and decorate them with various stamps that are unlocked as you progress through the story!

✦Features✦

•

More than 30 characters can be summoned.

•

All facial expressions are fully animated. The characters are fully animated, making you feel as if they are right in front of you.

•

Tap the character's body to enjoy various reactions.

•

Cute and dark gothic and fantasy music that fits the magical world.

•

The scenario is filled with the indie author's favorite, and you can feel a sense of immorality.

* This game has some mature expressions.

* Please feel free to post videos and still images using captured game works, regardless of whether you are an individual or a company, and whether or not you are monetizing your work. Please use the hashtag #deviconnect. Please refer to the official website for detailed guidelines.

•

If you encounter any issues while playing, please report them on the bug report forum.

✦Contorl✦

The game primarily uses mouse controls and some keyboard input for text entry, but shortcuts are provided.

•

Right-click: Clear message window

•

Mouse wheel down: Next message

•

Enter: Send message, control for Evil Eye Search/Magic Recovery

•

Display menu (except title screen), quit game (on title screen)

•

Space: Clear message window

•

B: Display backlog

•

L: Display load screen

•

S: Display save screen

•

F10: Take screenshot

title.zh: Cheetahs Are Meant To Be Fast
title.en: Cheetahs Are Meant To Be Fast

description.zh: 一本互动故事书，揭示 “一个贪吃的胖子在道德上是何等错误，且一点也不酷炫、毫无吸引力” 的主题。
description.en: An interactive storybook about how being a fat guy who eats a lot is very morally wrong and not at all awesome or attractive.

body.en:
In this interactive storybook that feels straight out of the CD-Rom era, use both pointing AND clicking to guide Chet the Cheetah through his weight loss journey! Then guide him out of it in a thrilling escape from a body-shaming digital dystopia!

CONTAINS KINKY SITUATIONS, (MILDLY) SPOOKY CONTENT AND RADICAL THEMES OF BODY POSITIVITY SOME PLAYERS MAY FIND MORALLY FRIGHTENING AND CRINGE. NOT FOR CONSUMPTION BY CHILDREN NO MATTER HOW MUCH THEY LOVE 90s STORYBOOK CD-ROMS!

FEATURES

•

A short and sweet linear narrative you can play in one sitting.

•

Innovative point 'n' click linguistic puzzle solving that lets you literally rewrite Chet's story!

•

Beautiful cartoon animation in crisp 'n' cutting-edge (for 1996) 640x480px.

•

Full voice acting, with narration by Kingmaker Histories' Meg Molloy Tuten.

•

Twists!

•

Turns!

•

Tummies!

•

Tummies that get BIGGER!

•

Yay!!

title.zh: 毛茸茸冒险俱乐部和圣杯
title.en: Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail

description.zh: 在《毛茸茸冒险俱乐部和圣杯》中，勇敢的毛茸茸英雄们将踏上寻找传说中的黄金圣杯的史诗征程。解开各种谜题，探索神秘地点
description.en: Indica Macjones and the brave furry heroes embark on an epic journey to find the legendary Holy Grail. Solve diverse puzzles and explore mysterious locations!

body.zh:
踏上与勇敢的 Indica MacJones 一起寻找传说中的圣杯的神秘而轻松的冒险之旅。在旅途中，你会遇到迷人的 furry 同伴，解开古老的谜题，并探索隐藏的神秘地点，在那里等待着未被发现的秘密。

作为这次探险的领袖，你需要研究古老的地图，管理资源，并派遣团队去探索未知的土地。每一个决定都可能让你更接近圣杯的发现——但要做好面对意想不到的挑战和惊喜的准备。

受经典冒险电影最佳传统的启发，Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail 🦁 带来了探索和解谜的乐趣，一同追寻历史上最伟大的传奇之一。准备好加入冒险了吗？
body.en:
Embark on a mysterious and relaxing adventure alongside the brave Indica Macjones as you search for the fabled Holy Grail. Along your journey, you’ll meet charming furry companions, solve ancient puzzles, and explore hidden, magical locations where secrets are waiting to be uncovered.

As the leader of this expedition, you’ll need to study ancient maps, manage your resources, and send out teams to explore uncharted lands. Every decision could bring you closer to discovering the Grail – but be prepared for unexpected challenges and surprises along the way.

Inspired by the best traditions of classic adventure films, Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail 🦁 is all about fun exploration and puzzle-solving as you chase down one of the greatest legends ever. Ready to join the adventure?

Features:

•

🦁Discover a world filled with vibrant furry characters, each with their own unique stories and personalities.

•

🦁Explore diverse locations, from ancient forests to magical castles, in your quest for the Golden Grail.

•

🦁Solve a variety of puzzles and challenges, including exciting match-3 gameplay, to progress through the story and uncover hidden secrets.

•

🦁Enjoy beautiful landscapes and detailed characters, all presented in a charming cartoon style.

•

🦁Calm and chill environment with Lofi Soundtrack

•

🦁Join the Furry Adventure Club and embark on your magical quest today!

movies.title: Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail 🦁 Trailer

description.zh: 在《Cento》中，你需跟随音乐节奏输入指令，激活技能进行战斗。一边强化自身技能，一边收集礼物，在收录了海量曲目的关卡中持续战斗！
description.en: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!

body.zh:
Unique battle system | Enter commands in rhythm and activate skills. Play a clever beat according to the combination of cards in your hand and your opponent's attacks.

Variety of stages | Fight on stages with different BGMs, from the city to ruins. The playing experience changes depending on the tempo and beat of the music.

Customize your deck | Create your own deck by freely combining skills and gifts received from existing characters. Let's find the strongest combination.

Endurance mode | Aim for consecutive battles while reinforcing your skills and obtaining gifts. Unleash a powerful attack with new skills.
body.en:
Unique battle system | Enter commands in rhythm and activate skills. Play a clever beat according to the combination of cards in your hand and your opponent's attacks.

Variety of stages | Fight on stages with different BGMs, from the city to ruins. The playing experience changes depending on the tempo and beat of the music.

Customize your deck | Create your own deck by freely combining skills and gifts received from existing characters. Let's find the strongest combination.

Endurance mode | Aim for consecutive battles while reinforcing your skills and obtaining gifts. Unleash a powerful attack with new skills.

title.en: Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade

description.zh: 在绚烂的和风Roguelite世界挥洒武艺、斩尽天下恶逆非道！《百剑讨妖传绮谭》是一款以妖魔横行的江户时代为舞台的动作RPG。操使千变万化的妖刀、讨伐各路魑魅魍魉，你将在一次次生死轮迴中杀出通往真相的血路...
description.en: Defeat malevolent forces in this stunning Japanese-inspired roguelite world! Become a master of the Demon Blades and combat swarms of demons in a fantasy realm set in the Edo period. Through every journey, you will unveil the hidden truths concealed within troubled times.

body.zh:
以江户时代为舞台的《百剑讨妖传绮谭》是一款以奇幻冒险为主轴的 Roguelite 机制和风动作 RPG。重视剧情体验的同时，强调爽快、易上手的连段攻击战斗，描绘深具日式古典之美的绚烂传奇活剧！

过去，人与妖之间维持着微妙的平衡。双方虽偶有嫌隙，仍努力维繫得来不易的和平 ── 直到妖怪之王「九尾狐」出世，带领群妖肆虐凡间。在这般乱世中，你将踏上旅程、讨伐各路恶鬼。藉由一次次轮迴寻找夺回太平的方法，并逐步拼凑事件的真实面貌。

✦ 百玩不腻的角色分歧 ✦

不死忍者、地狱鬼差、妖怪武士，各自拥有截然不同的战斗玩法、以及属于自己的故事舞台。别具个性的专属武器、丰富的剧情内容，跟随三名主人公的脚步，享受阅读系列物语般的全新体验！

✦ 华丽豪快的战斗打击 ✦

运用千变万化的妖刀属性、对抗四处作乱的魑魅魍魉。你可以自由搭配武器组合、蒐集数百种拥有神秘力量的「魂玉」、接受猫神明的恩赐，构筑属于自己的作战流派。

✦ 解放顶级强化食谱 ✦

旅途中能蒐集各式各样的强化道具，当然还有用来填饱肚子的食材。追求强大力量的同时，也别忘了来碗梦幻拉麵！

✦ 在妖怪祭典相会吧 ✦

这个世界仍存在善良的妖怪，躲藏在安全的异空间中举行祭典。每一轮独特的冒险将能与他们相会、获取资源，成为你最强大的后盾。

✦ 成为隐藏关卡猎人 ✦

斩妖除魔的征途上，隐藏着变化多端的特殊关卡等你来发掘。专为喜爱高难度、热爱突破自我极限、追求耐玩度的硬派玩家量身打造！
body.en:
Taking place during the Edo period, Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade is an action RPG infused with fantasy elements and roguelite mechanics. Immerse yourself in a realm brimming with authentic Japanese ambiance as you engage in seamless combo attacks against relentless demon adversaries.

Once upon a time, a delicate equilibrium existed between humans and demons. Despite occasional discord, both factions labored to uphold their dearly attained peace. This equilibrium shattered when the sovereign of all demons, the "Nine-tailed Fox" arose, rallying demonkind to sow chaos across the mortal realm.

Embark on a journey in a chaotic world, confronting a myriad of demons, and seeking a path to reclaim peace. Through a series of adventures, piece together the truth behind the mystery and forge a path to restoration.

✦ Replayable Multiple Stories ✦

An Immortal Ninja, An Oni Emissary, A Demon Samurai... Each boasting utterly distinct combat techniques and unique storylines. Explore a diverse selection of exclusive weapons and captivating narratives, all set within the expansive realm of these three central characters!

✦ Splendid Actions ✦

Master an array of Demon Blades to combat the evil forces causing chaos across distant lands. Combine the powers of these weapons, collect hundreds of "Soul Orbs" infused with mysterious talents, and garner blessings from the Neko Shrine... craft your distinct strategy for each expedition!

✦ Unlock Dream Recipes ✦

Throughout your journey, you'll have the opportunity to gather various types of upgrade items. Beyond weapon components, you'll also come across ingredients for gourmet recipes. For an extra boost in strength, indulge in a bowl of fantastical ramen!

✦ Let's Meet at the Demon Festival ✦

In this colorful world, kind-hearted demons flourish, hosting festivals within alternate dimensions. Meet these powerful allies during each unique adventure and gain valuable rewards!

✦ Challenge Hidden Stages ✦

During your adventure, numerous secret areas are waiting to be unlocked. Test your limits and embrace high levels of difficulty within these challenging stages!

description.zh: 进入《超极战猫》的世界，与伙伴们并肩作战，杀出重围！选择你的战猫英雄，施展独特技能，击败鼠鸟大军，挣脱束缚，迎向自由！
description.en: Blast your way through hordes of enemies in Ultra Mega Cats, a cooperative roguelike third-person shooter. Play As one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs with a wide variety of abilities and escape captivity from your Rodent and Bird Overlords!

body.zh:
忍者神龟靠边站！《超极战猫》闪亮登场！《超极战猫》是一款节奏紧凑的肉鸽类第三人称合作射击游戏。你将扮演身怀绝技的超极战猫，在枪林弹雨中杀出重围、挣脱资本魔爪！风骚走位，挑战随机生成、瞬息万变的战场！无论是单人游玩，还是与好友联机合作，每场战斗都是独一无二的崭新冒险！

挣脱束缚，唤醒你心中的战喵之魂！世界颠倒、鼠鸟称王，猫族沦落为奴，而你，是最后的猫族幸存者。受屈辱、被洗脑、还被训练成了替昔日猎物效命的打手。但战喵不屈，灵魂无主！是时候唤醒你内心深处的掠食者，重建世界的秩序了！

让敌人知道谁才是老大！虽然你那满腔怒火与千百年进化而来的狩猎本能，让你觉得只要猛扑上去撕咬一番，就能解决一切。但时代变了，敌人也早就学聪明了。你得动点脑筋，才不会被炸弹仓鼠炸得四脚朝天！

面对铺天盖地而来的敌军，你得灵活运用各种技能与战术，才能杀出重围！

这世界谁说了算？喵皇说了算！ 猫走天下、型由你定！挑选你最喜欢的战猫，探索千变万化的技能组合，打造出专属你的战喵流派！

游戏特色：

• 战喵出动： 五只个性鲜明、玩法独特的战猫等你驾驭！（抢先体验版本仅开放两只）每只都能解锁 50 种强化模组，任你自由打造独一无二的战斗流派。

• 无喵不成军： 随时随地与好友一起在节奏明快的PvE竞技场中并肩作战、挑战强敌！抢先体验阶段仅支持 3 人联机游玩

• 竞技场之神： 每场战斗都在随机生成且变化多端的环境中展开，不同的阵营与特性更会改变每场游戏的规则与节奏，让每次的游玩体验独一无二！

• 喵景如画： 鲜艳活力的艺术风格与拳拳到肉的打击感，让你与你的猫英雄一起"卡砰"！一爪定江山！

• 喵皇永不向老鼠低头！ 与同伴携手解救三位上古猫神，与鼠鸟大军展开决战，打造属于猫咪的喵托邦吧！
body.en:
Step aside, Ninja Turtles, it's time for the Ultra Mega Cats to hit the big stage!

Ultra Mega Cats is a fast-paced roguelike cooperative third-person shooter. In it, you control one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs with the goal of escaping corporate captivity while battling hordes of enemies. Fight through a series of randomly selected rooms and perform feats of dexterity and skill in an extremely dynamic environment – solo or with friends.

Go rogue and awaken your purr instincts

Imagine living in a world flipped upside down, where rodents and feathered forces rule and cats are shunned. You're one of the last cats standing – disgraced, brainwashed, and trained to serve your former prey as their personal killing machine. But that is not enough, as the cat’s soul knows no master! Awaken your inner predator and restore balance to this world!

Put your foes in their place

While your rage-fuelled instinct and millenia of evolutionary experience may make you think that pouncing with claws and fangs at your enemies will get the job done, well, things have changed drastically, and your enemies have caught on. You’ll need to make good use of your skills, especially against the likes of bomb-carrying hamsters.

Utilize a wide range of abilities and playstyles to survive the onslaught of enemies in your way.

Who runs the world? Cats!

As you move throughout the world with cat-like agility, you’re able to tailor your experience to your liking. Choose your favorite Mega Cat, personalize your loadout, and discover thousands of build possibilities, allowing you to play however you want.

Features:

•

At your disposal: Choose from five different ultra cats (two at Early Access launch) with different play styles and personalities. Each cat has 50 different M.O.D.s that can be unlocked, offering more variety.

•

Friends fur-ever: Streamlined, arena-based co-op PvE combat for up to three players in Early Access.

•

Gods of the Arena: Each arena is arranged into ever-changing biomes through level generation. Thanks to different Coalitions (each consisting of different Aspects), no two playthroughs are the same.

•

It’s purrdy: The game’s stunning, vibrant art style packs as much of a punch as your cat hero will, ka-pow!

•

Who wants to live in a world ruled by mice anyway?: Work together to free the three Ancient Cats from their enslavement, defeat your rodent and bird enemies and create a new cattopia for felines everywhere.

description.zh: 快乐拼图，可爱男孩！一个以餐厅为场景的益智类脱衣游戏。由福瑞画师们制作的福瑞游戏。
description.en: Fast puzzles, cute boys~! A food-themed physics puzzler where you undress your waiter. A kemono game, by kemono artists.

body.en:
Kemopop! is an active puzzle eroge featuring several cute, effeminate kemono ("furry") boys, all working in food service. Match sweets and make them undress...!!!

If you like feminine boys, especially ones who are well-endowed (and sometimes, very well endowed), this is what you've been waiting for. Kemopop! features characters from various artists, in over 30+ stages!!

•

Hand-Drawn Original Content: All artwork was made special for Kemopop!. Play stages made in collaboration with excellent kemono artists!!

•

Photo Mode: Browse the artwork you've unlocked, and use it to generate wallpaper...!

•

Universal Controls: Play with just a mouse, keyboard, touchscreen, or controller!

•

Your Character Here: Do you have artwork of a character and a bit of free time? Put it in the game!

•

Gumball Machine: Unlock additional content: new sweets, another half of the soundtrack, fanart, and developer commentary!!

•

Skip It All: Don't wanna play? Use the Bonus settings to get right to the content!!

movies.title: Kemopop! 2.0!! The boys are even hornier!!!

description.zh: 在日常跑腿的过程中，你会遇见三个可爱的兽人角色，可与她们发展关系、恋爱，最终亲密互动。本游戏包含露骨的成人内容。
description.en: While running errands, you'll meet three cute furry characters that you can potentially date, romance, and eventually seduce. This game contains explicit sexual content.

body.en:
WELCOME TO BLISS VALLEY!

You live in the quiet small town of Bliss Valley, enjoying a week-long vacation from work. While running errands on your first day, you’ll meet three unique and cute furry characters that you’ll be able to date, romance, and eventually seduce. They each have their own personalities and interests. Use that to your advantage and have fun!

Bliss Valley is a choose-your-own-adventure-style visual novel. You'll be able to make choices throughout the game and select which character you'd like to pursue romantically. Over the course of several dates with one of the characters, they'll become more comfortable around you and open up about themselves. During certain dates, you'll be prompted with a dating mini-game that will test your knowledge of the character's likes and dislikes, so pay attention! If all goes well, you may end up getting lucky with the character you've chosen to date.

•

No AI Art

•

Engaging Dialogue Scenes

•

Original Soundtrack

•

Choices & Outcomes

•

Multiple Characters to Date

•

Diverse Locations

•

Mini Games

•

Animations

•

Multiple Endings

•

Boss Fights

Bliss Valley features three different characters you can choose to go on dates with.

Ellie is a flirtatious femboy dog, who loves to tease and have fun! While they are very playful, they have a hidden depth behind the cute exterior. Ellie hides a vulnerability that he will only share with someone he deeply trusts.

Robin is a cute non-binary mouse who loves to geek out about manga and video games. While they are very shy around new people, they love to talk about their interests.

Bella is a headstrong alternative goat girl. She is fiercely independent and doesn't let many people into her close circle. Dating is not her thing, but that may change if she meets the right person.

Who who will you pick? Immerse yourself by typing in your own name, and live out a fantasy in Bliss Valley!

This game contains explicit sexual content.

All characters depicted are over the age of 21.

description.zh: 一款视觉小说，讲述一列火车上爆发的死亡游戏故事。通过迷你游戏窥探角色内心，选择你想观看的视角，揭开十二位独特角色背后的神秘设定。
description.en: A visual novel about a death game which erupts aboard a train. Read the minds of the cast through minigames, choose which perspectives you want to see, and uncover the mysterious lore behind twelve unique characters.

body.zh:
Love Exalt 8372 is a mystery visual novel inspired by games like Danganronpa, Your Turn to Die, and the Zero Escape series.

In a world where monsters have been farmed to extinction for XP, twelve people with unique RPG class types board a train; among these twelve people, the last monster is hiding. Some passengers are oblivious victims... while others boarded this train with a plan already in motion.

Act 2 is complete, and Act 3 is underway. New updates will add chapters to the story, new minigames, animations, art, music, and polish for the rest of the existing game. Join our Discord to discuss the developments!

There is a demo! It includes the first scene, Act 1 Scene 1: Last Call. If you decide to buy the game afterwards, all your game progress will be transferred to the full version, including steam achievements!

description.zh: 一场战争。是光明与黑暗的交织。它，已经持续了数千年。 一天晚上，这场千年大战突然敲响了你的窗户。 你将不得不遇见一位不速之客。
description.en: The war. Light versus darkness. It has been going on for thousands of years. One night, the Thousand-Year War suddenly knocked on your window. You will have to meet an uninvited guest.

body.zh:
一场战争。是光明与黑暗的交织。它，已经持续了数千年。 一天晚上，这场千年大战突然敲响了你的窗户。 你将不得不遇见一位不速之客。 在生存恐怖游戏“莉妮·布格”中，你将面对一个对你的幸福生活丝毫不感兴趣的生物。

从一个小房子到废弃的建筑，你的目标只有一个：永远结束这场噩梦。 随着你在游戏中的成长与进步，你将不得不为自己的性命而战，不让可怕的生物接近。 你有两种武器——声音和察觉。 你需要及时地对周围的每一个声音作出反应，并努力找到或消除声音产生的来源，因为每一秒的损失都可能使你丢了性命。

有可能通关“莉妮·布格”吗”？

如果游戏对你而言太难，你将有机会跳过本关或改变难度等级。

支持语言列表：

• English

• Русский

• Українська

• Qazaq

• Deutsche

• Français

• Español

• Português-Brasil

• Italiano

• 简体中文

• 日本語

• Český
body.en:
The war. Light versus darkness. It has been going on for thousands of years. One night, the Thousand-Year War suddenly knocked on your window. You will have to meet an uninvited guest. In the survival horror game "Leenie Boog" you will come face to face with a creature that is not interested in your happy existence.

From a small house to abandoned buildings, you will be pursued by one goal to end this nightmare once and for all. As you progress through the game, you will have to fight for your life and not let the terrible creature get to you. You have 2 weapons - sound and mindfulness. You need to respond in a timely manner to every sound that will surround you and try to find or eliminate the source that makes it because every second lost can cost you your life.

Is it possible to pass "Leenie Boog"?

If the game is too difficult for you, you will be given the opportunity to change the difficulty level.

List of supported languages:

• English

• Русский

• Українська

• Qazaq

• Deutsche

• Français

• Español

• Português-Brasil

• Italiano

• 简体中文

• 日本語

• Český

description.zh: 《化鬼 Deteriorate》是一款动物主角题材的横版解谜恐怖游戏，你需要根据关卡提示解开谜题，并在追逐战中躲避反派的追杀，在【死亡交易】中存活下来。
description.en: 《化鬼 Deteriorate》是一款动物主角题材的横版解谜恐怖游戏，你需要根据关卡提示解开谜题，并在追逐战中躲避反派的追杀，在【死亡交易】中存活下来。

body.zh:
游戏梗概

《化鬼 Deteriorate》是一款动物主角题材的横版解谜恐怖游戏，你需要根据关卡提示解开谜题，并在追逐战中躲避反派的追杀，在【死亡交易】中存活下来。

在怨泽城，如果你是幸运儿，在你死去的瞬间，魂魄会来到雾魇窟。你将与雾魇窟进行一场【死亡交易】，雾魇窟将会为你开设一场“游戏”，赢下游戏，你将会被满足各种愿望，甚至是复活重生；一旦你输掉游戏，你将魂飞魄散，化为雾魇窟的养料。主角猫兽人秦薰梦和她的男友狐犬兽人朱嵌翡获得了一场死亡交易的资格，但这真的是他们足够幸运吗？

游戏内容

1.此游戏是用rpgmaker制作的横板游戏。

2.游戏里你可以操纵主角进行行走或奔跑。

3.游戏里有不少的解谜可供玩家游玩，玩家需要使用特殊道具或密码来解开谜题。

4.游戏里有难度较高的追逐战（难度具有挑战性，值得尝试）

5.游戏中有大量闪图和CG。

操作

此游戏全程由键盘操作，请注意。

移动：方向键或WASD

确认或调查：Z/空格/回车

菜单或取消：ESC/X

跑步：SHIFT

设置：F1

注意：很多地方的事件需要特定的朝向才能触发。

关于实况与同人

欢迎实况与同人作品！！！！！

成人内容描述

本游戏包含部分血腥暴力画面以及闪图，请注意。

本游戏包含少量暧昧动作情节。

特殊

由于作者能力有限，只能制作简体中文版本，十分抱歉。

最后祝大家游戏愉快！！！
