title.zh: Beek: 使魔与毛茸茸 - 重制版

description.zh: 一封奇怪的短信打破了你的宁静。看起来有人迷失在了一个未知的森林里，而你是他唯一能够取得联系的人。
description.en: A call for help within a mysterious messaging app. Someone lost and wandering through a forest in a faraway place. And their destiny in your hands.

body.zh:
一封奇怪的短信打破了你的宁静。看起来有人迷失在了一个未知的森林里，而你是他唯一能够取得联系的人。

由打造《家有大猫》的 Studio Klondike 为您呈现，《Beek: 在异世界被当成使魔以及与那些毛茸茸之间发生的事》是一款精巧的文字类游戏，拥有多结局和精美插画。

主人公 Beek 的命运正等待你的抉择。来帮助他重拾直面黑暗的力量与勇气，带领他找到回家的路。
body.en:
A call for help within a mysterious messaging app. Someone lost and wandering through a forest in a faraway place. And their destiny in your hands.

Beek: How I Became a Familiar Spirit and Everything After That is a text-based narrative experience from the creators of Nekojishi. Featuring dozens of branching paths, multiple endings, and CG's to unlock!

Help Beek seek a way home, and face the darkness of this world with strength and courage.

description.zh: 《龙族至宝：广茂之绿》是一款献给心中有龙的玩家的游戏。狩猎、探索、求生，在太阳与大地真正的子女中成就伟大。
description.en: Golden Treasure is a game for those who carry dragons in their hearts. Hunt, explore, survive, and become Great among the True Children of Sun and Earth.

body.zh:
“美得令人叹为观止，毫无疑问” - Gaming Cypher

“视觉上，这款游戏令人惊艳” -

“我喜欢这个文笔……我完全被迷住了” - English Teacher Plays

太阳是你的父亲。大地是你的母亲。天下众生皆为你的猎物。

《龙族至宝：广茂之绿》由手绘风格呈现，讲述了作为一只非人类生物的选择、生存和生活。玩家将扮演一条龙，在青铜时代的地球这一充满生机却危机四伏的世界中，必将度过幼嫩而脆弱的童年岁月，开辟一条走向成熟的道路。

为了生存，你将需追捕猎物、与其它龙争夺霸权、搜刮地下迷宫的宝藏、并探索荒野和天涯海角。其中最关键的是，你将需成长并了解广茂之绿及其众多的居民的一切，从飞鸟到野兽，再到远古的精灵。如果你变得足够智慧并强大，你或许能够改写我们世界的历史，以及龙族的命运。

游戏特色：

• 超过一百幅手绘场景

• 三个庞大的世界区域任您探索

• 数千个选择及多个各自迥异的结局

• 包含超过70种对手及众多特殊能力的成熟战斗系统

• 四种元素的启悟之道待您掌握

• 独创的三阶段狩猎系统：潜行，追逐，并毁灭猎物

• 第一人称视角迷宫探索，每个迷宫都有其独特的故事和宝藏

• 众多独特宝器和古老的秘密待您发掘

免费试玩版包含序章和第一部分的完整内容，提供数小时的原创游戏体验。永久解锁内容（塔罗牌、动物精通及宝器）将自动转移到完整版游戏中。
body.en:
”Unquestionably breathtaking” - Gaming Cypher

“Visually, the game is stunning” - thegamer

“I love this writing… I’m absolutely enthralled” - English Teacher Plays

The Sun is your Father. The Earth is your Mother. All Beings are your Prey.

Golden Treasure: The Great Green is a hand-painted game about choices, survival, and life as a non-human being. Players take on the role of a dragon and must survive the tender and dangerous years of childhood, forging a path to maturity in the beautiful and deadly world of Earth in the Bronze Age.

To survive, you must hunt prey, fight other dragons for dominance, plunder underground labyrinths for treasures, explore the far corners of the wilderness and, most importantly, grow and learn about the Great Green and its many inhabitants, from birds and beasts to ancient spirits. If you become wise and powerful enough, you may just change the history of our world and the fate of dragonkind.

Features:

•

Over 100 hand-painted scenes

•

Three massive open-world areas to explore

•

Thousands of choices and several completely distinct endings

•

Full combat system with 70+ opponents and dozens of special abilities

•

Four elemental paths of enlightenment to master

•

Original 3-phase hunting system; stalk, pursue, and destroy your prey

•

First-person labyrinths to explore, each with its own unique story and treasures

•

Dozens of unique artifacts and ancient secrets to discover

The free demo version includes the entirety of the Prologue and Part 1 of the game, including hours of original gameplay. Permanent unlockables (Tarot Cards, Animal Mastery and Artifacts) will be carried over into the full game.

description.zh: 《骰子传奇》是一款融合了 RPG 元素的肉鸽卡组构筑游戏。你将化身3位英雄之一，运用独特的骰子激活卡牌，释放致命连击，击败成群敌人。探索广袤世界，收集史诗战利品，揭开“最后的人类”——那位改变世界的法师——背后的终极谜团！
description.en: Dice Legends is a roguelike deckbuilder with RPG elements in which you become one of 3 heroes, use unique dice to activate cards, and unleash lethal combos to defeat hordes of enemies. Explore the world, collect epic loot, and uncover the mystery of the Last Human — the mage who changed the world!

body.zh:
《骰子传奇》是一款由独立团队开发的单人肉鸽游戏，其成员曾参与《巫师之昆特牌》和《赛博朋克：边缘行者》的创意设计。

此外，团队还邀请到《小丑牌》（Balatro）的作曲家操刀原创配乐。在游戏的深度奇幻世界中，你可以选择使用不同骰子（6面骰/8面骰/12面骰）的角色展开冒险。

每击败一个怪物，就能获得增强构筑战术的新卡牌。但组牌只是游戏乐趣的一小部分—还需要利用道具、卡牌组合与强化效果来驾驭骰子的随机性。游戏的精髓在于运用理解、策略配合未知的运气，创造令人大呼过瘾的破局组合！

每回合将投掷一组骰子，并从牌堆中抽取卡牌。接着，运用骰子激活卡牌：构筑防御体系，对敌施加负面状态，或是输出全部伤害。发掘越多的卡牌+骰子组成的协同效应，你的连招就将愈发势不可挡—同时也更具畅快感！

从三位精通不同骰子的英雄中做出你的选择：

•

雄狮圣骑士ARIE—精通6面骰子，既能爆发毁灭性伤害，又能构筑护盾抵御来袭攻击。

•

鸦人召唤师KURO—精通12面骰子，能召唤并驱使强大的魔物协助作战。

•

树蛙刺客XIN—敏捷的暗影术士，精通8面骰子，既能持续积攒伤害，亦可发动致命暴击。

你将进入遭遇灾变的怪异世界，在那里，所有人类都因某种神秘的魔法变成了骇人的怪物。在穿越地图寻找线索、揭开故事真相的旅途中，去往何方与探索何处完全由你决定。每次成功清理一个地点，你都将获得能塑造战斗体系的武器、护甲、饰品等丰厚奖励。一旦打造出终极装备与卡牌组合，你就可以击败最终首领，成为真正的骰子传奇！

•

160张手绘卡牌，提供多样协同与连击

•

50+拥有多重技能的敌人考验你的最强卡组

•

4个视觉风格迥异的世界—每个世界都有专属怪物与挑战

•

3位英雄，拥有各自的独特风格与完全不同的构筑机制

•

75+可供角色装备或战斗中使用的道具

•

世界观和剧情由《巫师之昆特牌》及《赛博朋克：边缘行者》的制作人与《巫师：浪人》与《No\Name》漫画编剧— Rafał Jaki 构思创作

•

游戏原声配乐由《小丑牌》（Balatro）作曲家LouisF操刀制作
body.en:
Dice Legends is a single-player roguelike from an indie team including the creative mind behind GWENT and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, featuring original music by the composer from Balatro.

In the game, you embark on an adventure in a high fantasy world as one of three characters — each representing a distinct class that uses a different type of dice: d6, d8, or d12.

With every defeated monster, you acquire new cards enhancing your build and tactical possibilities. But crafting a deck is only one part of the fun — the unpredictable nature of rolling the dice must be managed and controlled with items, card combinations, and power-ups. Dice Legends is all about using your game knowledge, wits, and a touch of luck to find that game-breaking combo that feels sooo satisfying to play!

Roll a pool of dice each turn and draw cards from your deck. Next, use dice to activate cards and set up your defense, debuff the enemy, or deal as much damage as you can. The more card-dice synergies you discover, the more unstoppable — and satisfying! — your combos become.

Choose from three heroes who specialize in different dice:

•

Lion Paladin ARIE — wields the power of the d6 dice to unleash immense damage or shield himself against incoming attacks.

•

Crow Demon Summoner KURO — manipulates the d12 dice to conjure and command powerful familiars onto the battlefield.

•

Toad Assassin XIN — agile shadow magic user that taps into the power of the d8 dice to accumulate damage over time or deliver massive critical damage.

Enter a world where a magical cataclysm transformed all humans into terrifying beasts. Choose where to go and what to discover, as you travel across the map in search of clues that reveal the story. With each successfully cleared location, you will obtain build-defining weapons, armor, accessories, and more. Once you craft the ultimate gear-card combination, take down the final boss and become a Dice Legend!

•

160 hand-drawn cards offering multiple options for synergies and combos

•

50+ enemies with multiple skills to challenge your best decks

•

4 visually distinct worlds — each with its own set of monsters and challenges

•

3 Heroes with unique play styles and different deck-building mechanics

•

75+ items for your characters to equip or use in combat

•

The world and narrative conceived by GWENT and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners creator and writer of Witcher: Ronin and No\Name manga — Rafał Jaki

•

Original musical score by Balatro composer — LouisF

description.zh: 一款收集英雄与建造的防守游戏，主打即时策略与战斗爽快感。利用你的智慧击退一波又一波敌人的来袭！
description.en: A defensive game that combines hero collection and base building, focusing on real - time strategy and a thrilling sense of combat. Use your wisdom to repel wave after wave of enemy attacks!

body.zh:
黑暗入侵世界，整个大陆的光明都被吞噬。在世界的某一处，一座最后的魔法灯塔闪耀了最后的光芒。守卫它，这世界最后的希望！

喵之塔-末日守卫是一款有着丰富肉鸽元素的游戏。战斗内的即时变化与策略将影响战斗的胜利与否。兼具Roguelite随机元素的策略RPG游戏。你将扮演守护者，从怪物军团的袭击下保卫灯塔。

在准备阶段，你需要仔细考虑如何建造升级灯塔，以及武装和指导各种英雄。而到了防守阶段，你则需要运用你的智慧与各种英雄道具，击退从四面八方涌来的敌人。通过战斗让你的英雄不断变强，及时进行必要的回复，直到打败BOSS成功活到新的一天。

经典策略RPG:

● 经典的RPG要素：数值，技能，天赋，属性克制……以及各种你想要的；

● 丰富的装备和英雄：护甲、武器、饰品、局内道具……除了数值和技能，装备还会附带随机词条。每个英雄都有其独特的技能组和战斗特点。

● 高度自由的成长系统，巧妙搭配天赋和装备，大胆地去组建出只属于你的英雄小队吧；

● 独一无二的局内战斗体验，你需要考虑先给哪个英雄升级配置神器让它优先进阶，1次进阶会觉醒1个新的技能，2次进阶能觉醒超级强大的绝技。每个英雄都有自己的特点，根据不同的怪物波数来决定你的升级策略及其重要。

对抗怪物军团:

● 敌方的数量远远多于我方，身为守护的你需要制定出最优的战术，运用AOE技能造成杀伤，群体控制，单个击破……每一个决策都有可能成为扭转战局的关键。

● 面对组合丰富的怪物们，如何利用好克制关系和英雄特点至关重要，请务必小心应对战场上出现的精英敌人！

● 在每天出现的血月里，都会有一个精心设计且极具挑战的BOSS。请击败他，这样可以获得强大的祝福帮助我们更好的度过今后的每一天

发展与保护灯塔:

● 合理运用资源去重建灯塔，在备战时间、采购装备、招募英雄挑战天赋等方式强化战力；

● 每一天都会获得一次资源，利用这些有限的资源是要全力发展科技，还是壮大经济，还是疯狂打铁，亦或是建造防御都会影响存活的难度。

● 不惜一切代价塔顶上的魔法水晶！一旦破碎，黑暗将至。

● 总计要守护30天，每5天会有血月，能活多久全看守护者的决策。

Roguelite随机元素:

● 游戏的难度颇高，可能经常会遇到水晶破碎的时候。但你的每一次尝试，都会让自己变得更高更快更强；

● 随机生成的英雄、敌人、武器和装备，将会带给你历久弥新的乐趣；

● 天赋系统可以让你在局外进行一些独特的配置加点，以便你更好的挑战。

● 战斗完如果达成条件还会解锁一些新的英雄加入，让你在新的一局游戏里有全新的体验。

● 想要挑战自己的超硬核玩家，通关后还会开放噩梦和地狱难度。
body.en:
Darkness invades the world, and the light of the entire continent is devoured. Somewhere in the world, the last magical lighthouse shines its final light. Guard it, for it is the last hope of this world!

Meow Tower - Doomsguard is a game rich in roguelike elements. The instant changes and strategies during battles will determine whether you win or lose. It is a strategic RPG game that combines the random elements of Roguelite. You will play as a guardian, defending the lighthouse from the attacks of the monster army.

During the preparation phase, you need to carefully consider how to build and upgrade the lighthouse, as well as arm and guide various heroes. When it comes to the defense phase, you need to use your wisdom and a variety of hero items to repel the enemies surging from all directions. Strengthen your heroes through battles, and make timely and necessary recoveries until you defeat the BOSS and successfully survive to a new day.

Classic Strategic RPG:

● Classic RPG elements: stats, skills, talents, attribute weaknesses... and all the other elements you desire.

● Abundant equipment and heroes: armor, weapons, accessories, in-game items... In addition to stats and skills, equipment will also come with random affixes. Each hero has its own unique skill set and combat characteristics.

● A highly free growth system. Skillfully combine talents and equipment, and boldly form your own unique hero team.

● A unique in-game combat experience. You need to consider which hero to upgrade first and equip with artifacts to allow it to advance preferentially. One advancement will unlock a new skill, and two advancements will unlock an extremely powerful ultimate skill. Each hero has its own characteristics, and it is extremely important to determine your upgrade strategy according to different waves of monsters.

Confronting the Monster Army:

● The number of enemies far exceeds that of our side. As a guardian, you need to formulate the best tactics, use AOE skills to cause damage, apply crowd control, and defeat enemies one by one... Every decision may be the key to turning the tide of the battle.

● When facing a wide variety of monster combinations, it is crucial to make good use of the restraint relationships and hero characteristics. Please be extremely careful when dealing with the elite enemies that appear on the battlefield!

● During the blood moon that appears every day, there will be a carefully designed and highly challenging BOSS. Please defeat it, as you can obtain powerful blessings that will help us better survive each day in the future.

Developing and Protecting the Lighthouse:

● Reasonably use resources to rebuild the lighthouse, and strengthen your combat power by means such as preparing for battles, purchasing equipment, recruiting heroes, and challenging talents.

● You will obtain resources once every day. Whether you use these limited resources to fully develop technology, expand the economy, focus on forging items, or build defenses will all affect the difficulty of survival.

● Protect the magical crystal at the top of the tower at all costs! Once it shatters, darkness will descend.

● In total, you need to defend for 30 days. There will be a blood moon every 5 days, and how long you can survive depends entirely on the decisions of the guardian.

Roguelite Random Elements:

● The game is quite challenging, and you may often encounter situations where the crystal shatters. However, every attempt you make will make you stronger, faster, and more powerful.

● Randomly generated heroes, enemies, weapons, and equipment will bring you long-lasting and new fun.

● The talent system allows you to make some unique configuration points outside of battles, so that you can better face challenges.

● After battles, if certain conditions are met, some new heroes will join, giving you a brand-new experience in the next game.

● For super hardcore players who want to challenge themselves, nightmare and hell difficulties will be unlocked after clearing the game.

description.zh: 这是一个以同志为题材的横屏动作角色扮演游戏。故事以中世纪为题材，讲述的是一个围绕着男主Eric展开，发生在贝如塔大陆的奇幻传说。在这片大陆上，你可以和各种各样的角色互动，比如说人类，恶魔，天使，巨人，兽人，熊人，虎人，狼人，精灵等等。开放世界，打怪升级，完成任务，攻略角色，这些动作rpg元素游戏应有尽有，除此之外，你还可以和很多NPC恋爱，和他们开展非比寻常的关系。
description.en: This is an action role-playing game set in a medieval world, where you can complete quests, defeat monsters, discover new lands and romance many handsome male NPCs, including characters such as humans, demons, angels, giants, orcs, bearfolk, tigerfolk, werewolves, elves, and more.

body.zh:
《彩云物语》是一款视觉上令人惊叹的横向卷轴动作角色扮演游戏，酷炫的战斗与深度的角色成长相结合。你将穿越美丽设计的风景，战斗强大的敌人，解开谜题，揭示隐藏在世界各地的古老秘密。故事以中世纪为题材，讲述的是一个围绕着男主Eric展开，发生在诺尔维大陆的奇幻传说。在这片大陆上，你可以和各种各样的角色互动，比如说人类，恶魔，天使，巨人，兽人，熊人，虎人，狼人，精灵等等。开放世界，打怪升级，完成任务，攻略角色，这些动作rpg元素游戏应有尽有，除此之外，你还可以和很多NPC恋爱，和他们开展非比寻常的关系。

相传1000年以前，在遥远的诺尔维大陆，人类的国王Azrael为了保护人类免受巨人的奴役与侵略，以灵魂为代价与恶魔签下协议，从而获得强大的力量击退巨人。1000年以后，Azrael的转世Erick依旧不能摆脱恶魔的控制，随着他的转世，巨人们也逐渐苏醒。在恶魔的操控和天使的干扰下，他会成为这个世界的灭世者还是救世主？故事的结局根据你的决定而定。

主要特点：

动态战斗系统：掌握各种魔法和技能，在实时战斗中击败敌人。执行复杂的连击、闪避、格挡，并施放毁灭性的特殊攻击，以扭转战局。

史诗级Boss战斗：挑战巨大且可怕的Boss，这些战斗需要策略和技巧来克服。每次首领战斗都将考验你的时机、反应能力和利用弱点的能力。

丰富的剧情：发现引人入胜的叙事，带你穿越一个充满古老传说、交战派系和神秘生物的世界。与难以忘怀的角色互动，做出影响故事结局的选择，甚至与他们发展浪漫关系。

探索与解谜：这也是一款开放世界游戏。你可以穿越从魔法森林到黑暗地牢的多样环境，解决环境谜题，发现隐藏的宝藏，解锁秘密区域，探索这个广阔的世界。

精彩的漫画风格CG图像：享受精美制作的漫画风格CG图像，增强故事体验，使你沉浸在《彩云物语》的生动世界中。
body.en:
"Rainbow Cloud: A GAY RPG" is a visually stunning side-scrolling action RPG where fantastic combat meets deep character progression. Journey through beautifully designed landscapes, battle powerful foes, solve puzzles, and uncover ancient secrets hidden throughout the world. The story is set in a medieval backdrop and revolves around the male protagonist, Eric, in the fantastical land of Berutta. In this world, you can interact with a variety of characters, including humans, demons, angels, giants, orcs, bearfolk, tigerfolk, werewolves, elves, and more. The game features open-world elements, allowing you to defeat monsters, level up, complete quests, and pursue characters. Additionally, you can romance many NPCs and develop extraordinary relationships with them.

Legend has it that 1,000 years ago, in the distant land of Berutta, the human king Azrael signed a pact with demons, at the cost of his soul, to gain immense power to protect humanity from the enslavement and invasion of giants. A thousand years later, Azrael's reincarnation, Eric, still cannot escape the control of demons, and as his reincarnation progresses, the giants gradually awaken. Under the manipulation of demons and the interference of angels, will he become the destroyer of this world or its savior? The ending of the story depends on your choices.

Key Features:

Dynamic Combat System: Master a variety of magic and skills to defeat enemies in real-time combat. Perform intricate combos, dodge, parry, and unleash devastating special attacks to turn the tide of battle.

Epic Boss Battles: Challenge gigantic, fearsome bosses that require strategy and skill to overcome. Each boss encounter will test your timing, reflexes, and ability to exploit weaknesses.

Rich Storyline: Discover a gripping narrative that takes you through a world filled with ancient lore, warring factions, and mysterious beings. Engage with memorable characters and make choices that influence the story’s outcome, or even develop a romance relationship with them.

Exploration and Puzzle Solving: This is also an open-world game. you can traverse diverse environments from enchanted forests to dark dungeons, solve environmental puzzles, discover hidden treasures, and unlock secret areas as you explore the vast world.

Stunning Comic-Style CG Images: Enjoy beautifully crafted comic-style CG images that enhance the storytelling experience and immerse you in the vibrant world of Rainbow Cloud.

description.zh: 《Swamp Keeper》是一款受“一击必杀”射击玩法启发的韩国风格弓箭动作竞技射击游戏。你将成为神圣沼泽的守护者，凭借一把弓箭抵御来犯之敌。运用极致的射术击败敌人，并斩杀他们的指挥官。
description.en: Swamp Keeper is a Korean-style bow action arena shooter inspired by one-shot, one-kill gameplay. You are the "Swamp Keeper," defender of the sacred swamp, armed with only a bow to repel invading enemies. Master the art of archery, defeat waves of foes, and take down their commander.

body.zh:
《Swamp Keeper》是一款受“一击必杀”射击玩法启发的韩国风格弓箭动作竞技射击游戏。

你将成为神圣沼泽的守护者，凭借一把弓箭抵御来犯之敌。

运用极致的射术击败敌人，并斩杀他们的指挥官。

虎国的军队入侵了神圣的沼泽地，觊觎其丰富的资源！

携铁与火的敌人已逼近沼泽神殿的核心。

你，作为守护沼泽的使命者，必须击退侵略者。

在盟友的支援下，驰骋战场，平定一切。

拉弓、瞄准、射出—体验一发必中的一击必杀蓄力弓战紧张刺激。

组合属于你的箭矢，选择技能，准备作战。

欣赏那些精心设计的韩风可爱兽人角色与背景。
body.en:
Swamp Keeper is a Korean-style bow action arena shooter inspired by one-shot, one-kill gameplay.

You are the "Swamp Keeper," defender of the sacred swamp, armed with only a bow to repel invading enemies.

Master the art of archery, defeat waves of foes, and take down their commander.

Ho’s forces have invaded the sacred swamp, targeting its precious resources!

Wielding iron and fire, the enemy has already reached the heart of the swamp shrine.

As the sworn guardian of these wetlands, it’s your duty to drive them out.

With support from your allies, traverse the battlefield and restore peace.

Pull, aim, release — experience the high-stakes tension of one-shot, one-kill charging bow action.

Craft arrows that suit your style, select your skills, and prepare for combat.

Enjoy charming Korean-style anthropomorphic characters and beautifully rendered backgrounds.

description.zh: 一家 bakery 遭纵火，整座城市陷入混乱。人与龙之间的和谐纽带濒临破裂，雷门图斯能否在族群面临流放之前，解开蛋糕城之谜？
description.en: A bakery falls to arson and a city falls to chaos. With the harmony between human and dragon crumbling, can Rimentus solve the Mystery of Caketropolis before his kind face exile?

body.zh:
The city of Stalagshire exists as a haven to both humans and dragons alike. To Rimentus, a young dragon hatched within the city, it is the only home he has ever known. Beneath its peaceful facade however, simmering unrest has slowly begun to boil over.

When Stalagshire's Festival of Peace is interrupted by arson and the destruction of Caketropolis - the city's first interspecies cafe - all pretenses are dropped. Amidst rising tensions, the resulting chaos may see the dragons of Stalagshire exiled for good.

Someone's to blame for burning down Caketropolis, and Rimentus is certain his kin are not responsible. But can he solve the Mystery of Caketropolis before time runs out?

Key Features:

• A unique story-driven adventure-mystery experience

• Investigate the Mystery of Caketropolis through the eyes of a dragon

• Discover a world that responds to your choices by examining, licking, smelling, and booping everything in sight

• Custom assets and over 40 hand-drawn cutscenes bring the world to life

• Flavorful and entirely original soundtrack

• Created mostly by one person

description.zh: 探索霓虹璀璨的爱欲之城—— 一座热闹非凡的兽人夜总会，汇聚了各种族、个性与性向的访客。自定义你的角色，邂逅全部 9 位可发展恋爱关系的角色！
description.en: Explore the dazzling neon lights of Amorous. A bustling furry night club that attracts all species, personalities and sexualities. Create your own character and find all 9 datable characters!

body.en:
Thrust yourself to the front of the line of Amorous, a bustling furry night club that invites you to explore it's neon lights and eccentric characters. Immerse yourself with a fleshed out character creator and treat yourself to a varied cast of potential dates to explore!

What makes Amorous special?Amorous is a furry dating simulator which aims to provide a high quality graphic novel experience for free. Shake up the formula with animated NPCs, sandbox environments, real choices and interactive mini-games to keep you engaged. Avoid the normal pitfalls of dating games with an incredibly varied roster. Ranging from foxes to felines, male to female and everything in-between.

So what's in it for me?

• 9 fully datable characters

• Thousands of lines of dialogue with branching trees for replayability

• Several mini-games and novelties

description.en: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey that blends the deckbuilding roguelike, escape-room style puzzles, and psychological horror into a blood-laced smoothie. Darker still are the secrets inscrybed upon the cards...

body.zh:
本游戏可谓《小马岛Pony Island》和《六角疑云The Hex》的原创作者对电子游戏的头脑熔解、自我毁灭般的情书。《邪恶冥刻Inscryption》是一部墨黑色卡片主题的冒险史诗，融合了Roguelike牌组构建、密室逃脱以及心理恐怖元素，为玩家献上一杯血腥的冰沙奶昔。比玩法更黑暗的，是卡牌上冥刻的内容……

在《邪恶冥刻》中，玩家可以……

• 通过抽牌、手术和自残行为获得由林间生物组成的牌组

• 解开隐藏在莱西小屋墙壁之后的秘密

• 踏上意想不到又令人深感不安的冒险史诗
body.en:
From the creator of Pony Island and The Hex comes the latest mind-melting, self-destructing love letter to video games. Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey that blends the deckbuilding roguelike, escape-room style puzzles, and psychological horror into a blood-laced smoothie. Darker still are the secrets inscribed upon the cards...

In Inscryption you will...

•

Acquire a deck of woodland creature cards by draft, surgery, and self mutilation

•

Unlock the secrets lurking behind the walls of Leshy's cabin

•

Embark on an unexpected and deeply disturbing odyssey

description.zh: 一款主机风格 RPG，拥有色彩鲜明的角色阵容、独特的战斗与升级系统、流畅的 2D 平台跳跃玩法，以及一段关于友谊、信仰与寻找人生归宿的原创奇幻故事。
description.en: A console-style RPG featuring a colorful cast of characters, unique battle and level-up systems, quick 2D platforming action, and an original, fantastical story about friendship, faith, and finding your place in the world.

body.zh:
The Tenth Line is the first commercial game project from Sungazer Software. During your adventure, you'll guide the princess of the tiny nation of Easania, far from home and desperate to escape the clutches of a mysterious cult in hot pursuit. Along with her unusual but reliable companions, you'll explore a vibrant world of humans, beasts, and dragons, all struggling to coexist in the tension following the assassination of the king of the nation of Skyweather. Troubled times are ahead, indeed - the long-prophesied end of the world is fast approaching, and with only her wits, her blade, and her royal upbringing to guide her, can she make it home to her family before the end of days?

Gameplay involves adventuring through distinct areas using traditional 2D platforming mechanics, but with a twist: each character is controlled separately, and can move, attack, and interact with the world in unique ways. You'll also visit the occasional village or safe haven, and have an opportunity to take on new quests, play cards, and chat with the locals. Enemies roam the wilds, meanwhile, and can be engaged or ambushed by your heroes, thrusting your party into battle.

Battles are turn-based with an active timing element: you'll decide on commands for each character, then carry those attacks out using careful timing and targeting. Then, it's the enemy's turn to retaliate, giving your party an opportunity to defend. And, with up to twelve enemies on the offense at one time, survival is not always a safe bet. Fortunately, eliminating large numbers of foes at once will leave fewer attackers behind to retaliate, and will also grant your party more momentum, allowing for even more powerful skills to be used during the next attack!

Progression is handled solely by finding and applying items to your characters. Items are plentiful, and have multiple uses, so smart distribution of your treasures is key to survival. Characters can use items for training, powering up their skills and their defensive abilities, or use them to empower their "specialties" and gain a personal, tactical edge in combat. Your party members can also gain "power levels" by winning battles, completing quests, and collecting power fragments in the world. Power levels can be spent on the "Power Flow" board by playing a puzzle-like minigame to increase stats and unlock new skills. It is a challenging, refreshing method of "leveling up" that rewards careful planning and smart decisions.

A standard dual-analog gamepad is highly recommended, though the keyboard is supported.

• A completely original, unique RPG experience that takes inspiration from the 32-bit era of gaming.

• Explore the world through fast-paced 2D platforming by controlling three separate characters, each with unique movement mechanics and ways of interacting with the world.

• Take on dozens of foes at one time through turn-based RPG battles with an active timing element.

• High quality background and sprite artwork, a grand, varied soundtrack, and voice acting for each major character during battles.

• Unique progression and leveling mechanics for your characters.

• Multiple hours of gameplay, plus post-game challenges and a New Game Plus mode.

• Optional story-focused mode available that removes all enemy encounters and simplifies story-based battles.

• Play "Quad Pro Quo" (an in-universe collectible card game) against multiple characters and inhabitants of the world to win unique prizes and complete your collection!

description.zh: 掷出骰子，结果将是祝福，还是惩罚？
description.en: Roll the dice, will the outcome be a blessing or a punishment?

body.zh:
神之骰是一款通过骰子来进行回合制战斗的短篇冒险游戏。

被赐予神之骰的狐狸勇士，即将迎来未知的危险，投掷骰子进行战斗吧。

游戏特色

- 使用骰子进行战斗，无论是攻击还是防御。骰子掷出的点数将是你造成攻击或者防御的数值。

- 选择一件独特的圣物作为战利品，以获得一项特殊的升级。

- 制作属于你自己的骰子。在布满点数的卡片中依据特定的形状裁剪出纸骰子，并成为你的临时武器。
body.en:
Dice of God a short, turn-based adventure game with dice-rolling.

The fox warrior, bestowed with the Dice of God, is about to face unknown dangers. Let the battle begin with a roll of the dice.

Features

- Engage in battle using dice, whether for attacking or defending. The number rolled on the dice will determine your attack or defense values.

- Choose a unique artifact as loot to gain a special upgrade.

- Craft your own dice. Cut out paper dice from cards filled with numbers based on specific shapes, turning them into your makeshift weapons.

description.zh: Cat Bait — 一款具有可爱像素图形的休闲游戏。控制 诱饵猫，躲避敌人并使用猫助手的独特技能。
description.en: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.

body.zh:
准备好在 Cat Bait 的世界中进行令人兴奋的战斗，这是一款具有可爱像素图形的休闲游戏，灵感来自 Vampire Survivors 和 Brotato！控制勇敢的 诱饵猫，躲避成群的老鼠和其他啮齿动物，而你忠诚的猫助手用他们独特的技能消灭敌人。

主要特点：

• 独特的猫助手： 每个助手都有自己的特殊技能和特点。例如，召唤德鲁伊猫用根系减慢敌人并造成持续伤害。谁说你只能召唤一个助手？

• 升级系统： 在每次游戏中升级你的助手。提高伤害，增加弹药数量，并为每只猫解锁其他独特的升级。

• 元进度： 从被击败的敌人那里收集金币，在每次游戏之间升级你的角色和猫助手，使每一次新的游戏变得更强大。

• 皮肤和技能： 解锁诱饵猫的新皮肤，不仅改变外观，还增加新的主动技能。例如，标准皮肤可以击退敌人。

• 史诗级的Boss： 与独特的Boss战斗，例如骑着老鼠的老鼠。每个Boss都有自己的一套动作和攻击，使每场战斗都不可预测。

• 有趣的地点： 从各种地点中选择，每个地点都提供自己的挑战和多样的敌人。以一个空角色开始并选择你的第一个猫助手来开始冒险。

• 会话式游戏： 短时间的游戏会话让你可以轻松进入和退出游戏，从你停下的波次继续。

与一波又一波的敌人战斗，升级你的猫助手，并在 Cat Bait 中征服所有地点。你准备好接受挑战，成为真正的猫英雄吗？
body.en:
Get ready for exciting battles in the world of Cat Bait, a casual game with cute pixel graphics inspired by Vampire Survivors and Brotato! Control the brave Cat Bait, dodge hordes of mice and other rodents while your loyal helper cats destroy enemies with their unique abilities.

Main Features:

• Unique Helper Cats: Each helper has its own special abilities and characteristics. For example, summon the Druid Cat to slow down enemies with roots and deal periodic damage. And who said you can summon only one helper?

• Upgrade System: Upgrade your helpers during each run. Increase damage, add more projectiles, and unlock other unique upgrades for each cat.

• Meta-Progression: Collect coins from defeated enemies to upgrade your character and helper cats between runs, making each new attempt more powerful.

• Skins and Abilities: Unlock new skins for the Cat Bait that not only change the appearance but also add new active abilities. For example, the standard skin allows repelling enemies.

• Epic Bosses: Fight unique bosses, like the mouse rider on a rat. Each boss has its own set of moves and attacks, making each battle unpredictable.

• Interesting Locations: Choose from various locations, each offering its own challenges and variety of enemies. Start with an empty character and choose your first helper cat to begin the adventure.

• Session Gameplay: Short gaming sessions make it easy to jump in and out of the game, continuing from the same wave you stopped at.

Fight waves of enemies, upgrade your helper cats, and conquer all locations in Cat Bait. Are you ready to take on the challenge and become a true hero among cats?

movies.title: Cat Bait - Steampunk & Improving Cat Skills

description.zh: 《啵啵鸡物语》是一款模拟类Roguelite类 RPG游戏，玩家需要挽救一家陷入困境的波霸奶茶店。游戏中，你可以利用波霸奶茶的配料与敌人战斗，建立人际关系，完成城镇任务，玩迷你游戏和钓鱼任务，体验不同寻常的冒险。
description.en: A cozy pixel art adventure about saving a struggling Boba Tea shop. Brew up tasty drinks, battle enemies for inspiration, make friends with customers, and much much more, on your quest to serve up the best tea in town!

body.zh:
🧋一个设定在舒适小镇的放松游戏

当你进入这个游戏时，你将置身于一个充满温馨氛围的小镇。你的任务是帮助一家苦苦挣扎的奶茶店成为镇上最受欢迎的店铺。你将使用各种波霸奶茶原料制作美味的饮品，并通过吸引来自世界各地的顾客来帮助店主。

🧋使用波霸奶茶原料进行战斗

当太阳落山时，你将面对一个神秘而危险的世界，使用你可靠的奶茶武器-珍珠波霸，打败敌人，进而获得新的奶茶创意灵感。

🧋按照自己的节奏玩游戏

不仅如此，游戏还提供了大量的互动内容。你可以与各种NPC建立关系，发展友谊，甚至可能会在游戏中经历一段浪漫的爱情故事。在游戏中你还可以完成各种小镇任务、参加小游戏和令人兴奋的钓鱼任务，这将让你充分体验到小镇的生活乐趣。快来探索这个充满惊喜和创意的小镇吧！

🧋EA反馈

✨ 遇到以下情况请联系我们：

1️⃣ 突然卡顿/闪退/黑屏等异常

2️⃣ 任务指引不明确或剧情断档

3️⃣ 任何操作问题

🐣 反馈建议：

【问题描述】

（附截图/视频更佳！非常感谢）

主创团队会第一时间回复大家，重大BUG将尽快修复更新！
body.en:
🧋A relaxing game set in a cozy town

In this game, players returned to a charming little town where they become the savior of a struggling boba tea shop. With your help, the owner of the shop will be able to make the best boba tea in town and attract customers from all over!

🧋Use boba milk Tea ingredients to fight

But that's not all, as the sun sets in the small town, a mysterious and dangerous world awakens. Using your trusty boba tea weapons, known as Bobas, you will defeat enemies and gain new inspiration for your boba tea creations.

🧋Play at your own pace

As you progress through the game, you will also have the chance to develop relationships with various NPCs, possibly even falling in love with them. The game's storyline is enriched by a variety of town tasks, mini-games, and exciting fishing quests that will keep you engaged and entertained for hours.

description.zh: 冒险前往广阔多样的开放世界，在你成为世界顶级机器人大师的征途中，发现新机器人，收集稀有零件制造机器人，并在实时战术战斗中部署机器人。
description.en: Venture out into a huge open world to discover new bots and collect rare scrap to build them. Deploy your bots in tactical auto-battles on your quest to become the world’s greatest Botmaster.

body.zh:
探索开放世界在机器人世界中恣意探索茂密的森林、干旱的沙漠、热带丛林和北极荒地，同时搜寻稀有零件，发现可建造和收集的新机器人。在这款由剧情推动的单人战役游戏中，你将发现新环境，遇见各种角色，收集稀有宝藏，揭开机器人世界中心隐藏的许多秘密。但请确保自己拥有一支强大的机器人战队，因为你永远不知道接下来可能遇到什么情况。

参与实时战斗在独一无二的实时战术战斗系统中用计谋战胜敌人。你的机器人将凭借先进的人工智能，在竞技场中跳跃、冲锋、击晕敌人或实施爆破，而你则要利用最佳时机来部署冰霜导弹或火焰墙等技能，支持你的机器人战队并彻底击垮敌人。每个机器人都有其独特的技能和强大的终极技能，将这些与强大的玩家技能结合起来是成为经验丰富的机器人大师的关键。每场胜利都会为你的机器人赢得经验点数，用于解锁先进的新人工智能，并进一步增加你的战术选项，你可以将这些选项带入在线PvP竞技场，努力攀登全球排行榜。

自定义机器人战队发现、建造并收集稀有且强大的机器人，组建终极战队。搜寻世界，寻找新的机器人设计图，然后收集稀有零件来建造和升级你最喜欢的机器人。随着机器人的升级和增强，自定义它们的威力和技能。为自己装备强大的增强道具芯片，以调整机器人的优势，改变战斗的走向；在探索过程中部署独特的装置（如连续轰炸或隐身），以便在与机器人世界中的土匪和野生机器人作战时占据上风。

选择你的角色扮演5种动物之一：猫、狗、水牛、老鼠和蜥蜴。选择独特的外观，为角色增添个性，然后完成各项任务，解锁新装饰品，如帽子和服装。在开放世界中找到并击败超级稀有的机器人，收集它们的另类皮肤并自定义你自己机器人的外观。

主要特色

• 探索广阔的开放世界，发现各种稀有独特的机器人

• 收集机器人，组建完美战队，对抗土匪和野生机器人

• 参与实时战术战斗，熟练掌握机器人的人工智能和玩家技能是取胜的关键

• 自定义你的玩家角色和机器人战队，提升他们的等级并学习新技能

• 前往在线PvP竞技场，与世界各地的其他机器人大师对战

• 在这款由剧情推动的单人战役游戏中，踏上成为世界顶级机器人大师的征途，揭开机器人世界的诸多秘密
body.en:
EXPLORE AN OPEN WORLD

Scavenge rare scrap and discover new bots to build and collect as you freely explore the many lush forests, arid deserts, tropical jungles and arctic wastes of Botworld. Over the course of the story-driven single player campaign, you’ll discover new environments, meet a variety of characters, collect rare treasures and uncover the many secrets hidden at the heart of Botworld. But make sure you have a strong team of bots, because you never know what's around the corner.

ENGAGE IN TACTICAL AUTO-BATTLES

Outsmart your foes in a unique tactical battle system. Your bots will automatically leap, charge, stun or blast around the arena with advanced AI. Choose to get your hands dirty and support them by manually deploying abilities like Frost Missile or Firewall at the perfect time - or give the AI complete control and transform the game into a robust auto-battler. Each bot has unique abilities and a powerful Ultimate - combining these with the powerful player abilities is the key to becoming a seasoned Botmaster. Every victory earns your bots experience points to unlock advanced new AI and further increase your tactical options, which you can bring into the online PvP arena and rise up the worldwide leaderboard.

CUSTOMISE YOUR BOT TEAM

Discover, build and collect rare and powerful bots to form the ultimate team. Search the world to discover new bot blueprints, then collect the rare scrap to build and upgrade your favourites. Customise their powers and abilities as they level up and get stronger. Equip yourself with powerful booster chips to adjust your bots’ strengths and change the course of a battle, and deploy unique gadgets while exploring like Bombardment or Invisibility to get the upper hand on the bandits and wild bots that inhabit Botworld.

CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER

Play as one of 5 animals: cats, dogs, buffalo, rats and lizards. Choose a unique look to add your own personality to the character, and complete missions to unlock new cosmetic items like hats and outfits. Find and defeat ultra-rare bots in the open world to collect their alternate skins and customise your own bots’ looks.

KEY FEATURES

•

Explore a vast open world teeming with rare and unique bots to discover

•

Collect bots and form the perfect team to face off against bandits and wild bots

•

Engage in real-time tactical battles where mastery of your bots’ AI and player abilities is key to victory

•

Customise your player character, and your bot team as they level up and learn new abilities

•

Face other Botmasters from around the world in the online PvP arena

•

Discover the secrets of Botworld over the course of the story-driven single player campaign on your quest to become the world’s greatest Botmaster

description.zh: Nutopia正在启动…… 野餐症候群是一个以文件操作为特色的带有轻度恐怖元素的Meta解谜游戏。与棕熊Teddy探索"Nutopia"，并和小狼Vincent一起玩耍吧！
description.en: Nutopia is now booting... Picnic syndrome is a Meta puzzle game with light horror elements featuring file manipulation. Exploring "Nutopia" with Teddy the bear and hanging out with Vincent the wolf pup!

body.zh:
Nutopia正在启动……

故事：Teddy是一个人工智能，他受到嘱托开始测试虚拟世界"Nutopia"，同时顺便测试新的人工智能"Vincent"。

但是，随着Teddy的测试逐渐深入，似乎已经不仅是测试这么简单了。

这变成了一个游戏。

那么，跟随着棕熊Teddy的脚步，让我们一起研究Nutopia的秘密，挖掘它背后的主人的故事，顺便和胆小的Vincent一起玩吧！

特色：

• 游戏内和游戏外的解谜。

• 一个特殊的文件系统。

• 与文件系统联动的道具系统。

• 迷你游戏。

• 富有随机性的微恐怖要素。

• 助帮的你要需她

备注：

• 本游戏存在大量文件读写。
body.en:
Nutopia is now booting...

Story: Teddy is an artificial intelligence commissioned to start testing the virtual world "Nutopia" while also testing another new artificial intelligence, Vincent the wolf pup.

However, as Teddy's testing progresses, it seems to be more than just testing.

It has became a game.

Following in the footsteps of Teddy, let's explore Nutopia's secrets, dive into the story of its owner, and hang out with Vincent along the way!

Features:

• Puzzles both in-game and out-of-game.

• An unique file system.

• Inventory system that linked to the file system.

• Mini-games.

• Randomized micro-horror elements.

• pleh ruoy sdeen ehS

Note:

• This game involves a large amount of file reading and writing.

description.zh: 沉浸在这个设定在阴暗酒吧的多人在线体验中，游戏的危险程度与酒客们一样。加入四人桌，测试你在《骗子骰子》和《骗子牌》中的技巧，在这些游戏中，撒谎和诈唬是胜利的关键。准备好在《骗子酒吧》度过一个夜晚了吗？
description.en: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

body.zh:
欢迎来到骗子酒吧：终极欺诈乐园！

走进骗子酒吧，这是城里最扭曲、最刺激的聚会场所。这不是普通的酒吧——这里充满了谎言、欺骗和心理游戏。坐在四人桌旁，沉浸在终极第一人称多人在线体验中，在这里，狡猾和诡计才是游戏的关键。

抢先体验中的四种游戏模式

•

玩家轮流出牌并声明牌面数值。这个数值必须与桌面上的要求匹配（例如“国王”或“皇后”）。

•

当玩家出牌时，他们可能会对牌的数值撒谎。如果你怀疑他们在撒谎，可以揭穿他们的虚张声势。

•

如果有人被揭穿并且确实撒谎了，他们必须进行一轮俄罗斯轮盘。6发子弹中活下来一发意味着你可以继续游戏，失败则意味着游戏结束。

•

进行完俄罗斯轮盘后，牌局将重置，游戏继续进行。

•

掷出你的骰子。没有人能看到你的点数，但所有人都在盯着你接下来的动作。

•

轮到你时，预测桌上总骰子的数量，并宣布一个具体的点数（例如：“有五个 3”）。下一位玩家必须通过增加骰子数量或提高点数来加注（例如：“有六个 4”），或者质疑上一个人的预测。

•

觉得有人在撒谎？挑战他们的出价！失败者要喝下一瓶毒药。

•

喝下两瓶毒药，你就出局了！最后活下来的人获胜！

•

这是德州扑克 —— 但你下注的不是筹码，而是子弹。

•

轮到你时，可以选择 Call，往池里再加一发子弹； 或者 Fold，用你已经下注的子弹 扣下扳机。 每一轮都会让风险不断升级。 每局游戏仅一次，你可以使用 Coward’s Fold： 在第一回合选择退出，只需用 一发子弹 扣动扳机即可脱身。

•

随着子弹不断加入，公共牌会一张一张揭示，直到最终的 Showdown。

•

每局游戏一次，你可以使用 Switch， 在桌面尚未完全翻开前，替换自己手中的一张牌。

•

你也可以选择 All-In， 迫使所有人要么押上全部子弹，要么 弃牌并直面枪口。

•

玩家轮流旋转老虎机，并宣称自己获得了多少个 Heart （1、2、3，或四个全部一致时为 JACKPOT）。 其中一个老虎机 始终对所有人可见，请谨慎 bluff（虚张声势）。

•

觉得有人在说谎？喊 LIAR。 如果宣称是假的，该玩家将面对 Death Spin。 若未转出任何 Heart，则 立即死亡。 如果幸存，其上一轮宣称所获得的分数将被清除，游戏继续。

•

当一名玩家达到 5 分 时，将解锁 EXECUTE。 只有分数最高且唯一的玩家可以使用它， 立刻处决 分数最低的玩家（若出现平分，则随机选择）。

•

每名玩家在整局游戏中 仅有一次 使用 DOUBLE SPIN 的机会， 可在一个回合内 旋转两次。 在正确的时机使用，足以改变一切。

为什么你会爱上骗子酒吧

•

引人入胜的多人在线游戏体验

•

充满谎言与欺骗的刺激酒吧游戏

•

独特的角色，各具吸引力的背景故事

•

定期更新新游戏和新角色

•

身临其境的酒吧模拟

认识角色阵容

每个夜晚，九位常客在这张桌子上 赌上性命 — 而在下一张桌子旁，他们的过往被低声诉说。

在 Table Stories 中发现这些被悄声讲述的故事，可从主菜单进入。

关注我们

通过社交媒体关注我们，获取最新消息和独家预览。不要错过任何精彩动作！

坐下吧，点上一杯，准备好开始撒谎！
body.en:
Welcome to Liar's Bar: The Ultimate Deception Playground!

Step into Liar's Bar, the most twisted and thrilling hangout in town. This isn't your average pub – it's a den of lies, deception, and mind games. Grab a seat at a table of four and immerse yourself in the ultimate first-person multiplayer online experience where cunning and trickery are the name of the game.

Four Game Modes with Early Access

•

Players take turns playing a card face down and declaring its value. The value should match the table’s value. (e.g., "King" or "Queen").

•

When a player lays down a card, they might be lying about its value. If you suspect a lie, you can call their bluff.

•

If someone’s bluff is called and they were lying, they must play a round of Russian Roulette. Surviving one bullet out of 6 rounds of shells means you stay in the game; failing means game over for you.

•

After Russian Roulette is played, the cards are reset, and the game continues.

•

Roll your dice. No one can see your roll, but everyone’s watching your next move.

•

On your turn, make a bid predicting the total number of dice on the table, showing a specific face (e.g., "There are five 3’s"). The next player must either raise the bid by increasing the number of dice or the face value (e.g., "There are six 4’s") or challenge the previous bid.

•

Think someone’s lying? Challenge their bid! The loser drinks a bottle of poison.

•

Drink two bottles, and you’re out! The last one alive wins!

•

This is Texas Hold’em- but you bet bullets, not chips.

•

On your turn, Call to add a bullet or Fold and pull the trigger with what you’ve already bet. Every round raises the risk. Once per game, Coward’s Fold allows you to escape in your first turn by pulling the trigger with only one bullet.

•

As bullets are added, shared cards are revealed one by one until the final showdown.

•

Once per game, you may Switch, swapping one of your cards before the table is fully revealed.

•

You can also go All-In, forcing everyone to bet everything or fold and face the gun.

•

Players take turns spinning the slots and declaring how many Hearts they’ve got (1, 2, 3, or JACKPOT if all four match). One slot is always visible to everyone, bluff wisely.

•

Think someone’s lying? Call LIAR. If the claim is false, the player faces Death Spin. No Heart means instant death. If they survive, their last claim’s points are removed and the game continues.

•

Reach 5 points to unlock EXECUTE. Only the single highest-scoring player can use it to instantly kill the lowest-scoring player (chosen at random if there is a tie).

•

Each player has a one-time opportunity to use DOUBLE SPIN, allowing them to spin twice in a single turn. Timing it right can change everything.

Why You'll Love Liar's Bar

•

Engaging multiplayer online experience

•

Thrilling bar games focused on lying and deception

•

Unique characters with captivating backstories

•

Regular updates with new games and characters

•

Immersive bar simulation

Meet the Cast

Every night, nine regulars bet their lives at this table — their pasts are murmured at the next.

Discover their whispered stories in Table Stories, available from the main menu.

Follow Us

Stay updated with the latest news and sneak peeks by following us on social media.

Don't miss out on the action!

Grab a seat, order a drink, and get ready to lie!

description.zh: 独居的你即将迎来访客，唯有彻底拖地才能迎接全新改变。扮演一只浣熊，为迎接人生转机，全力清理地板吧。
description.en: You live alone. Someone is coming over. You must mop. Play as a raccoon who has to mop up the floor in anticipation of big changes.

body.zh:
You live alone. Someone is coming over. You must mop.

Play as a raccoon who has to mop up the floor in anticipation of big changes. Using a mouse or a controller, you need to carefully mop between and around corners to avoid soaking your furniture. As you get further into the game, you'll grow your family and accrue more and more furniture, making it increasingly difficult.

You Must Mop is a short arcade style experience about fine motor dexterity and precision, with a lighthearted story to follow.

description.zh: 你将扮演拉米娜（Lamina） 一只害羞的哈士奇女孩，刚搬到大都市「努桑卡」。 但就在她搬来后的第一天，疫情就爆发了——她不得不把自己隔离在公寓里。
description.en: You play as a Husky Girl, Survive the Pandemic, make a story path for her. Move fast or Die fast.

body.zh:
Shyondemic 是一款毛毛城市中的疫情生存游戏！

这是一座被疫情袭击的兽人都市，灵感来源于现实中的新冠病毒（COVID-19）。游戏将隔离与求生的压力，转化成一场轻松又带点疯狂的冒险。

你将扮演拉米娜（Lamina）

一只害羞的哈士奇女孩，刚搬到大都市「努桑卡」。

但就在她搬来后的第一天，疫情就爆发了——她不得不把自己隔离在公寓里。

别太菜，不然就会被奇怪的液体“液化”

这就是你菜出事后的拉米娜：

（图片闪烁警告！如对闪烁画面敏感请注意）

剧情丰富，拥有 6 种不同结局！

•

洗澡（水是救命道具）

•

西米液（别碰这玩意！）

•

电脑（宅到不沾阳光的快乐生活）

•

瓶子翻转挑战（Bottle Flip）

•

可爱的朋友们（就像你一样！）

•

独特的画风与原创歌曲

•

烹饪（让她自由发挥！）

•

几乎由一个人独立完成

•

3 - 6 小时可完成一个结局

其他特性：

拉米娜可以使用她的电脑进行各种操作：

线上购物

自由职业平台

社交媒体

加密货币交易、挖矿

赌博游戏（别沉迷）

每天物价都会飞涨，所以你必须好好管理你的经济！

道具系统丰富：

例如：

水枪

水手雷

水陷阱

水瓶

除臭剂

Floff香皂

升级书

可升级的属性装备

还有更多疯狂内容：

•

梗图（Memes）

•

Boykisser（你懂的）

这些男孩们正在偷偷看着你...

等着你把游戏加入愿望单：

Boy1 正在盯着你……

Boy2 也在看着你……

Boy3 还是在看着你……

快把我们加入愿望单吧！
body.en:
Shyondemic Is a Pandemic Survival game set in a Furry city experiencing a pandemic. Drawing inspiration from real-world events like COVID-19, the game recreates the experience of quarantine and survival during a pandemic but more fun.

You play as Lamina, A shy Husky Girl that move to a big city, Nusanka. Just a day after moving there, she got a taste of Pandemic. Which forcing her to Quarantine herself in her own apartment.

Don't be a skill issue then got caught with those funny looking liquid, u gonna get Liquifed.

This is Lamina after you being a skill issue

( Flickering image warnings! For those who had sensitive flickering imagery )

•

Story Rich with 6 Multiple Endings

•

Water ( Take a shower )

•

Simequids ( No don't touch this things )

•

Computers ( It's time to not touch grass yeaahhhh )

•

Bottle Flip

•

Cute Friends ( Like u )

•

Unique Art and Songs

•

Cooking ( Let Her Cook )

•

Created Mostly by one person

3 - 6 Hours of gameplay to get a single ending

Other Features:

Use her Computer to access things like, Shops, Marketplace, Media Social, Freelancing, Crypto Trading, Crypto Miner and even Gambling, to help you survive the pandemic. The groceries prices are going expensive on each day. So make sure you prepared from the economy sides.

There is many items you can use to deal with them or survive, like Guns, Water Grenade, Water Trap, Water Galons, Water Bottle, Deodorant, FloffSoap and many more.

You can also Upgrade Lamina stats using Upgrade Books or Using Upgradable items.

Memes.

Boykisser.

description.zh: 《Ancient Mind》是一款融合解谜、动作与冒险的游戏，核心在于探寻远古文明的遗迹。探索地牢、击败魔物、解开谜题，揭开古老谜团的真相。
description.en: Ancient Mind is a puzzle-action-adventure game about discovering the remains of an ancient civilization. Explore dungeons, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and discover the truth about ancient mysteries.

body.zh:
Explore a region of mystery and danger in Ancient Mind, a modern take on the classic top-down puzzle-action adventure. Explore dungeons, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and discover the truth about ancient legends.

This game will put your spacial awareness to the test with a sequence of environmental puzzles, levels characterized by a non-linear structure made of keys and locks, dungeons full of monsters, traps, and riddles. Even with a map, you will still need to pay close attention to your surroundings and make a mental map of the area if you want to find your way to the end safe and sound.

Ancient Mind is a modern take on the classic zelda-like top-down adventure. Fight monsters with your sword and use tools such as a grappling hook and torches to overcome obstacles and reach new areas. Items like bows and arrows are not only useful in combat, but also for triggering mechanisms in ancient temples. You will find new items as you progress into the game, unlocking paths even in already explored areas.

Sometimes, secret passages will only reveal themselves after you have acquired the necessary equipment or the necessary knowledge.

Legends tell many stories about these lands, stories about an uncertain past. This region was once inhabited by an ancient civilization that now appears to have vanished into thin air, leaving behind nothing but ruins. Will you find the answers you're looking for? There might be clues behind every corner.

Collect information and ask the right questions as you explore the land, put the pieces together, and find out what happened in the past.

description.zh: 米沙卡是一只平凡的小老鼠，却拥有非凡的勇气。得知奶酪失窃后，他决定亲自拿起武器，夺回这份美味的佳肴。冒险途中，米沙卡将遭遇重重危险与陷阱，还有一众敌人 —— 从狡猾的老鼠到巨型掠食者，无一不令人胆寒。
description.en: Mishaka is an ordinary mouse with extraordinary courage. Upon learning of the cheese theft, he decides to take gun into his own paws and reclaim the lost delicacies. Throughout his adventure, Mishaka will encounter dangers, traps, and a multitude of enemies — from cunning rats to giant predators.

body.zh:
•

In a world where cheese is not just a food but a sacred artifact, one brave mouse decides to fight the rat mafia that has stolen all the supplies! Meet Mike, our hero, ready to defend his rights and get back his lost goodies! Mike is not ironclad, he only has 1 life.

•

Epic Battles: Mike will fight rat bosses, using agility to defeat enemies.

•

Unique Levels: Explore a variety of locations from dark basements to sewers, collecting power-ups along the way.

description.zh: 一款轻量化的放置钓鱼游戏，静静地在你屏幕底部等待着你。捕捉鱼类、购买升级、完成收藏，并将它们展示在你的水族箱中。
description.en: A relaxing idle fishing game that waits for you at the bottom of your screen. CATCH fish, BUY upgrades, COMPLETE your collection, and DISPLAY them in your aquarium.

body.zh:
佛系鱼塘

《佛系鱼塘》是一款轻松的放置钓鱼游戏，在你处理其他事务时，它会静静地等待着你。

你可以在玩游戏的同时专注处理其他任务，因为它会一直停留在屏幕底部。

你可以放大或缩小、更改布局、调整游戏视窗大小、在屏幕上任意移动，或将其完全隐藏。

与其他游戏不同，鱼儿会等你！当你准备好时，点击游戏即可钓鱼。你也可以开启自动钓鱼，让它自行进行。

购买升级以钓取新鱼类。

探索12个生态群系，多达100种鱼类等你收集。

完成任务。

持续钓鱼，收集各种颜色变种，完成你的图鉴，并寻找传说中的鱼类。

寻找宝藏。

将你的鱼展示在水族箱中，并添加装饰品。
body.en:
Idle Waters is a relaxing idle fishing game that waits for you while you do other things.

You can focus on other tasks while playing because it will stay at the bottom of your screen.

You may zoom in or out, change the layout, resize the game view, move it around your screen, or hide it completely.

Unlike other games, the fish waits for you! When you are ready, click on the game to catch the fish. Or let it fish on its own with auto-fishing

Explore 12 biomes, with a total of 100 fish to catch

Keep fishing to complete the collection with their color variants. And find the legendary fish

Buy upgrades to catch new fish

Find treasures

Complete quests

Look at your collection and customize your aquariums.

title.zh: Dino running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM
title.en: Dino running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM

description.zh: 快跑，恐龙，快跑！千万别落入兽人先生的魔爪！
description.en: Run, Dino, run! You can't fall into the clutches of Mr. Furry

body.zh:
Dino Running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM

危险的 Furry 先生已经追踪到你的踪迹了——最好不要去验证如果他追上你会发生什么……

Dino Running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM 是一款明亮多彩的 2.5D 跑酷游戏。你需要逃离巨大而危险的追捕者，收集金币，克服意想不到的障碍，并不断刷新纪录。

每一次尝试都是一次坚持更久、收集更多金币，并证明你的 Dino 是最快的机会！

游戏特色：

•

动感十足的跑酷玩法

•

精美而色彩丰富的画面

•

充满趣味表现力的 2.5D 形式

•

多样且不可预测的障碍

•

金币、纪录，以及让人想再试一次的挑战

•

Dino 自定义装扮

•

超过 10 种角色服装

收集金币，解锁全新造型，努力创造最高纪录。最重要的是——不要停下。Furry 先生已经很近了！
body.en:
Dino Running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM

Dangerous Mr. Furry is already on your trail — and it is better not to find out what happens if he catches you…

Dino Running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM is a bright 2.5D runner where you must escape from a huge and dangerous pursuer, collect coins, overcome unexpected obstacles, and set new records.

Every attempt is a chance to last longer, collect more coins, and prove that your Dino is the fastest!

Game features:

•

Dynamic runner gameplay

•

Pleasant and colorful graphics

•

2.5D format with an engaging presentation

•

Various and unpredictable obstacles

•

Coins, records, and the desire to try again

•

Dino customization

•

More than 10 clothing options for your character

Collect coins, unlock new looks, and try to set the highest record. Most importantly — do not stop. Mr. Furry is already close!

movies.title: Dino running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM

description.zh: 组建一支凶萌的元素生物小队，迎战蜂拥而至的敌潮！晶灵羁绊解锁连携技能，远古圣物助你强力构筑！横扫多个生态地图，拯救你的家园！
description.en: Form a squad of elemental creatures and face hordes of challenging enemies! Choose your Shards according to their synergies to gain new abilities, and equip relics that will make the winds blow in your favor! Survive through different environments and save your lands!

body.zh:
带领你的晶灵小队，在怪物狂潮中杀出一条血路！击败沿途的精英强敌可招募新成员加入你的队伍，它们的连携效果将激发强大战力！团结就是力量，更是全新能力！

认识晶灵

超过20种晶灵可加入你的战斗小队！不断尝试，找出你最喜爱的组合！

组建元素小队

晶灵们拥有不同的元素属性：火系、雷电系、水系、自然系与水晶系！你的小队，由你来定义！打造专属于你的梦幻组合，迎击毁灭美露尼亚世界的危机！

连携机制

每个晶灵都有三种独特的连携属性，当队伍中拥有多个相同连携属性的成员时，小队的整体战力将显著提升！

克服挑战

特殊事件与强力Boss将不断考验你的团队实力，完成挑战可获得生存所需的特殊奖励！
body.en:
Survive an insane army of enemies with a squad of elemental creatures! Recruit new members for your team by defeating the bosses that cross your path, and combine their traits to unlock powerful effects! Unity not only brings strength, it also creates new abilities!

MEET THE SHARDS

Over 20 Shards can join your squad! Experiment and discover which ones will become your favorites!

FORM AN ELEMENTAL SQUAD

Choose Shards of Fire, Electric, Water, Nature, and Crystal! Your squad, your rules! Build the team of your dreams to survive the crisis devastating the world of Mellunia!

COMBINE TRAITS

Each Shard has three distinct traits capable of unlocking powerful abilities and effects! Having more than one creature with the desired trait in your team will increase your squad’s power level!

OVERCOME CHALLENGES

Unique events and powerful bosses will appear to test your squad’s skills! Overcome these challenges to earn special rewards for your survival!

description.zh: 《Toaster Arena》是一款第一人称多人竞技场射击游戏，玩家可在多张地图、多种模式下展开激烈对决。运用高级移动技巧穿越障碍，在战场上抢占制胜先机。
description.en: Toaster Arena is a first person multiplayer arena shooter where players battle it out on different maps and game modes. Use Advanced movement to traverse obstacles and gain the advantage on the battlefield.

body.zh:
Toaster Arena

Toaster Arena is a game that friends can enjoy together, whether they're in the mood for competitive action or just casual fun. It blends old-school, fast-paced gameplay with modern shooter mechanics, creating a unique and thrilling experience. Dive into intense matches that capture the essence of classic games while enjoying the strategic elements of contemporary shooters.

MULTIPLE GAME MODES

Game modes can change the entire experience of the game, offering a variety of play styles to keep things interesting. They range from the chaotic Free For All, where every player is out for themselves, to cooperative team-based modes that require strategy and coordination. For those who love a thrill, there are unique modes like Zombie Infection, where players must survive waves of corrupted attackers. Each mode provides different challenges and dynamics, ensuring that the gameplay remains fresh and engaging no matter how often you play.

VARIED MAPS

The game offers a rich and diverse selection of maps, each uniquely crafted to provide distinct challenges and experiences. From the intense, claustrophobic environments of close-quarters combat maps, where every turn could lead to a surprise encounter.

Custom Loadouts

With more than 10 unique weapons to choose from, players can customize their loadouts to suit their playstyle. The selection ranges from serious, high-powered options like anti-material sniper rifles to quirky, fun choices like cheese slices. Each weapon behaves differently, offering a unique experience and having a significant impact on the battlefield.

CUSTOMIZATION

Choose from a wide selection of parts to build your character, ranging from tails and legs to arms and even hats. Each part can be individually colored, allowing for a multitude of unique combinations. Express your creativity by mixing and matching different elements to design a character that truly represents your unique style and preferences. Whether you want a character with a sleek, cohesive look or a wild, colorful appearance, the customization options are extensive and varied, ensuring that no two characters will ever look the same.

description.zh: 扮演一只好奇的蝙蝠，完成拍摄月亮完美照片的任务。奔跑、攀爬、滑翔并拍照，克服各种障碍，与社区中的淘气角色互动。你能收集所有的月饼吗？
description.en: Play as a curious bat on his mission to take a full fledged photo of the moon. Run, Climb, Glide and Snap your way through an array of obstacles while interacting with the cheeky characters in the neighbourhood. Can you collect all the moon cakes?

body.zh:
扮演一只好奇的蝙蝠，完成拍摄月亮完美照片的任务。

认识小镇居民

探索一个宁静的月光小镇，这里居住着温馨（又有些淘气）的动物居民。奔跑、攀爬、滑翔，帮助他们完成任务。交朋友，并在通往月亮的路上收集月饼！

捕捉回忆

巴托的语言是摄影！通过拍照来解决谜题并与小镇居民交流。赶在时间内完成任务，拍摄满月的照片！

全新Steam功能

Batography 的全新 Steam 版本增加了更多可以发现的月饼以及可以完成的 Steam 成就。你能完成 Batography 的 100% 吗？
body.en:
Play as a curious bat on their mission to take a full fledged photo of the moon.

MEET THE TOWNSFOLK

Explore a sleepy moonlit town, filled with cozy (and sassy) animal inhabitants. Run, climb, and glide your way around to help them with their tasks. Make friends and collect mooncakes on your way to the moon!

SNAP MEMORIES

Bitt's language is photography! Snap photos to solve puzzles and communicate with the townsfolk. Progress to the end in time to take a photo of the full moon!

NEW STEAM FEATURES

The new Steam version of Batography includes more mooncakes to find, and steam achievements to complete. Can you 100% Batography?

description.zh: 《Lyca》是一款小型、轻松的增量游戏，玩家将帮助魔法狼莱卡奔跑在大地上，收集资源，并探索庞大的成长体系，让曾经贫瘠的荒野重焕生机。
description.en: A small, relaxing, incremental game about restoring a barren wasteland into a lush meadow. Help the magical wolf Lyca run through the land, gather resources, and unlock a vast upgrade tree.

body.zh:
《Lyca》是一款轻松治愈的增量游戏，讲述了一只魔法狼在荒芜的土地上奔跑，唤醒沉睡已久的大地，让荒野重现生机。

自由奔跑于广阔的草原，收集资源，探索庞大的成长体系。

解锁超强力的升级、实用技能和珍贵资源。

为荒凉的废土带来生机与雨水。

游戏特色：

•

渐进式成长体验 —— 通过收集资源，逐步推进游戏进程

•

庞大的成长体系 —— 解锁强力升级、实用技能和珍贵资源

•

解锁挂机与无尽模式 —— 随时畅玩，享受自由成长

•

约 3-4 小时的冒险 —— 适合短暂但充实的游戏体验

•

简单轻松的游戏体验 —— 没有复杂操作，纯粹享受治愈之旅

•

多样化操作方式 —— 支持键盘、鼠标单操作模式及手柄

•

轻松Lo-fi 音乐 —— 由 Purrple Cat 制作的舒适免版税音乐，让你放松身心
body.en:
Lyca is a small, relaxing, incremental game about a magical wolf restoring a barren wasteland into a lush meadow.

Run freely through the grass, gather resources, and explore a vast upgrade tree.

Unlock incredibly powerful upgrades, helpful abilities and valuable resources.

Bring life and rain back into a desolate wasteland.

Enjoy:

•

Incremental progression through resource gathering

•

A vast upgrade tree to explore

•

Unlockable "idle" and "endless" modes

•

Approximately 3-4 hours of gameplay to complete the campaign

•

Simple and relaxing experience

•

Accessible controls: Keyboard, Mouse-Only, and Controller support

•

Lofi royalty-free beats to chill to by Purrple Cat

description.zh: 与巫师伙伴组队，一同劫掠魔法塔！在这款肉鸽地牢探险游戏中，打造元素协同效果，击败强大首领，夺取塔中宝藏。
description.en: Team up with your wizard friends to pillage the magic tower! Create elemental synergies, defeat powerful bosses and claim the tower's treasure in this rogue-like dungeon-raider.

body.zh:
Wizards from across the land journey to the Arcane Tower in hopes of claiming its bounty. Do you and your mates have what it takes to reach the top?

Arcane Raiders is a rogue-like dungeon-raider where you blast enemies with spells and maneuver through traps to pillage the Tower of its treasure. Tight dodging controls and powerful elemental synergies will help you in your quest to take down the Tower's fearsome bosses and make it out with as much gold as possible.

Features

•

Fast-paced dodge-and-strike combat

•

Create powerful elemental synergies to decimate foes

•

Face of against dangerous traps, enemies and bosses

•

Randomized rooms and spell drops keeps each run fresh and exciting

•

Local and online multiplayer to team up with friends

description.zh: 一款关于青蛙的 3D 线性收集马拉松平台游戏。收集金苍蝇，解锁新世界，并与各种机制和强化道具互动。最终，揭开大门背后的真相。
description.en: A 3D linear collect-a-thon platformer about a frog. Collect golden flies, unlock new worlds, and interact with a variety of mechanics and powerups. Finally, discover what lies behind the great gate.

body.zh:
Sapo 3D 是一款经典的 3D 收集马拉松平台游戏，拥有线性关卡，旨在提供简短有趣的体验和平缓的学习曲线。探索四个不同的世界，收集金蝇来前进，迎接隐藏在巨大大门后的最终挑战！

帮助小青蛙到达关卡终点，收集大量金蝇。这样，他就可以打开通往下一关的传送门，在那里他会遇到更多挑战和金蝇！

面对会吐种子的植物、会扔爆炸蛋的小鸡、挥舞斧头的巨型瓢虫、汽水炮，甚至太空导弹。每个世界都呈现出独特的挑战！

青蛙的操作方式简单易学，但通过与环境中的强化道具和物品互动，操作会变得更加复杂。从让你三级跳的罐子到太空中的反重力泡泡，应有尽有！

收集到足够多的苍蝇后，打开主区域的大门，揭开它的秘密。准备好迎接最终挑战！

不仅如此！通关后，你还可以享受：

•

速通模式

•

额外关卡

•

给收集到游戏中 100% 苍蝇的玩家的小秘密

用户界面和教程仅使用符号传达信息。因此，无论您使用哪种母语，都能享受游戏的乐趣！
body.en:
Sapo 3D is a classic 3D collect-a-thon platformer with linear levels, designed to be a short and fun experience with a gentle learning curve. Explore four different worlds while collecting golden flies to advance and face the final challenge, which lies behind the gigantic gate!

Help the little frog reach the end of the level and collect lots of golden flies. This way, he can open the portal to the next level, where he'll find more challenges and golden flies to catch!

Face seed-spitting plants, explosive-egg-throwing chickens, giant-axe-wielding ladybugs, soda cannons, and even space missiles. Each world presents unique challenges!

The frog's control scheme is simple and easy to learn, but becomes more complex through interaction with powerups and objects in the environment. Use everything from jars that give you triple jumps to anti-gravity bubbles in space!

Open the giant gate in the main area when you've collected enough flies and discover its secret. Be prepared for the final challenge!

And that's not all! After beating the game, you can also enjoy:

•

Speedrun Mode

•

Extra Stages

•

A little secret for those who collect 100% of the flies in the game

User interface and tutorials uses only symbols to convey information. So you can enjoy the game regardless of your native language!

description.zh: 一款极具挑战性的 3D 平台跳跃游戏，容错率极低。通过跳跃逃离地牢顶端，牺牲收集品换取道具，助你度过这场艰难试炼。
description.en: A challenging 3D platformer with little room for error. Escape a dungeon by jumping to the top, and sacrifice your collectables for items to aid in your ordeal.

body.zh:
jump and don't fall

collect sweet toys

and multiplayer with friends
body.en:
jump and don't fall

collect sweet toys

and multiplayer with friends

description.zh: 在这款多人射击游戏中，所有玩家都会获得“真正的作弊工具”。利用透视和自瞄等作弊手段，战胜其他作弊猎豹。获胜者将有权封禁所有失败者！
description.en: Everyone will be given ACTUAL CHEATS in this multiplayer shooter. Use wallhacks and aimbots to your advantage and dominate the other cheetahs. The winner will get to BAN all losers!

body.zh:
“人人作弊，就等于没人作弊。”

《作弊猎豹》(Cheaters Cheetah) 是一款多人第一人称射击游戏，在这款游戏中，每位玩家都会获得“真正的作弊工具”。其中包括常见的透视、自瞄、陀螺…以及更多作弊功能。

《作弊猎豹》得到了一位前作弊器开发者的帮助（是的，你没看错！），提供了一系列真实存在的作弊手段。在这个独一无二的第一人称射击体验中，用智慧和作弊技巧战胜你的对手！

释放你内心的猎豹

透视、自瞄、陀螺…你能想到的都有！可以在这个竞技场中自由使用所有你熟知的作弊手段。

但请记住，你的对手也可以使用相同的作弊手段。这就形成了一种独特的局面，每个人都知道其他人的位置，从而引发激烈的心理博弈和惊心动魄的战斗。

选择基础作弊还是全功能作弊？

选择你的配置，然后投入乱斗之中：“基础作弊”模式下，所有玩家仅可使用穿墙挂；或者选择“全功能作弊”模式，解锁所有作弊功能！

从经典的死亡竞赛模式，到“突袭首领”模式（在该模式中，多名基础作弊玩家组队对抗一名全功能作弊玩家），《作弊猎豹》还提供了多种独特的游戏模式供你选择。游戏还包含单人模式，你可以作为全功能作弊玩家痛击那些无辜的机器人！

亲手封禁那些可恶的猎豹

游戏设定在一个关押前作弊者的监狱中，他们因在热门在线第一人称射击游戏中使用作弊器而被捕。他们被变成了猎豹，被迫参加一档名为“作弊猎豹”的游戏节目作为惩罚。

获胜者将获得“封禁大锤”，允许他们封禁所有失败者。对那些卑鄙小人，绝不要手下留情！
body.en:
"If everyone is cheating, no one is cheating."

Cheaters Cheetah is a multiplayer FPS game where everyone is given ACTUAL CHEATS for the game. This includes typical wallhacks, aimbot, spinbot... and much more.

Developed with the help of a former cheat developer (yes, you read that right!), Cheaters Cheetah features a wild array of real-existing cheats. Outsmart and out-cheat your opponents in this one-of-a-kind FPS experience!

Unleash your inner cheetah

Wallhacks, aimbot, spinbot... you name it! All the cheats you know are free to be used in this arena.

But remember, your opponents will also have access to the same cheat. This creates a unique dynamic where everyone knows everyone else's position, leading to intense mind games and thrilling battles.

Go legit or rage?

Choose your config and dive into the chaos: "Legit cheat" where everyone only has wallhacks, or the "Rage cheat" where every feature is unlocked!

From the classic deathmatch to a "Raid boss" mode where multiple legit cheaters team up against 1 rage cheater, Cheaters Cheetah also offers a variety of unique game modes to choose from. The game also features a single player mode, where you can demolish innocent bots as a rage cheater!

BAN those filthy cheetahs with your own hand

The game is set in a prison for former cheaters, who were caught using cheats in a popular online FPS. Transformed into cheetahs, they are forced to participate in a game show "Cheaters Cheetah" as a punishment.

Winners will be granted with the "BAN Hammer", allowing them to BAN all of the losers from the game. Show no mercy to those scumbags!

description.zh: 《Willow Guard》是一款单人剧情向奇幻 RPG，将地牢探索式动作玩法与基于选择的互动叙事相结合。 你需要构建自己的能力卡组，猎杀怪物、收集材料、升级装备，与一群拟人化动物角色相遇，并在旅途中做出关键抉择——最终成长为一名真正的 Willow Guard
description.en: Willow Guard is a single player story-driven fantasy RPG that combines dungeon-crawling action gameplay with a choice-based interactive fiction. Build your deck of abilities, kill monsters, gather material, upgrade your equipment, meet a cast of anthropomorphic animals, and become a Willowguard!

body.zh:
Willow Guard is a story-driven dark fantasy RPG combining difficult-but-rewarding action hack-n-slash gameplay enhanced by deck building and layers of deep choice-based story. Play as Ghweros, a Willowguard investigating a series of monster attacks on a remote village close to the northern Hinterlands. Discover a hand-crafted, original fantasy world full of uplifted animals, absent gods, and thousand years of buried secrets to unfold.

Isometric Action Gameplay

Build an action deck of specialized Willow Guard abilities that you activate as you battle through hordes of invading monsters in retro-inspired hack n' slash gameplay through lusciously rendered pixel art levels. Slash, dash and spell cast your way to victory over increasingly difficult foes across the single-player campaign.

Become a Willowguard

When not in combat, control Ghweros in his investigation of the village of Woikos and its secrets, by speaking to a diverse cast of characters. Use an innovative system of clue-and-item gathering to uncover new locations, characters and mysteries, and slowly unravel the story through fully-realized, choice based interactive fiction gameplay.

Build your Character

Willow Guard features non-traditional levelling, where you improve your character by improving your gear, stacking your deck with new abilities, and getting better at the game itself. In the story mode, your choices help shape what kind of Willowguard you are through the Inclination system. Regardless of how you choose to play, your choices will shape the ultimate fate of Woikos - and possibly the whole world!

Craft, Upgrade, Loot

Crafting cards and upgrading equipment requires materials, which are gathered from both killed monsters and found during dungeon runs, or gained as rewards from quests, or traded with the mysterious Merchant. Decide how to use your resources wisely, and build the perfect combination of equipment and deck to take on the evils that plague Tersa!

description.zh: 在这款俯视角单人像素风 RPG中，你将扮演一只身处警察队伍中的猫。 与同伴交谈、参与紧张刺激的枪战、逐步揭开世界观背后的秘密，并在关键时刻做出影响剧情走向的道德抉择。
description.en: In this top-down single-player pixelated RPG, you play as a cat in the police force, talking with your allies, fighting in intense gun fights, unraveling the lore, and making moral decisions.

body.zh: War has broken out between Cat Kingdom and Dogland. In Meowville, a city near the border between the two powers, you are a mere lieutenant in the police force. With tensions between dogs and cats in the city at an all-time high, however, you will be forced to make moral decisions, fight for survival, and save the city.
body.en: War has broken out between Cat Kingdom and Dogland. In Meowville, a city near the border between the two powers, you are a mere lieutenant in the police force. With tensions between dogs and cats in the city at an all-time high, however, you will be forced to make moral decisions, fight for survival, and save the city.

description.zh: 一款快节奏街机风格游戏，灵感来源于现实中生活在莫斯科地铁里的流浪狗。 挑战高难度剧情关卡、冲击在线排行榜，解锁来自你喜爱游戏的客串动物角色！ 接住伏特加、火焰狂吠、烹饪熊肉……手忙脚乱中偷取足够的食物——你能活下来吗？
description.en: A fast-paced arcade game inspired by the real-life stray dogs of the Moscow metro. Compete in online leaderboards and progress through a challenging campaign while unlocking guest critters from your fave games! Juggle vodka, bark fire, cook bears, and more! Can you steal enough food to survive?

body.zh:
Welcome, comrades! Meet Russian Subway Dogs! We have done extensive, totally legal research in order to fine tune this chaotic arcade-simulation for what it's like to scavenge for food from Russian commuters. Surviving isn't easy when you are dodging volatile vodka, rival dogs, and the rare and dangerous Subway Bear!

• A new game from the creators of They Bleed Pixels.

• Inspired by real life stray dogs who’ve learned to navigate Moscow’s subway system!

• Take on Campaign Mode with dozens of levels and over 100 unique challenges from your boss kitty: The Proletaricat.

• Highly replayable Endless Mode with online leaderboards and a score-driven difficulty algorithm that keeps each round fresh!

• Featuring detailed pixel art of Moscow’s world famous, ornately decorated subway stations.

• Play as your favourite animals from other indie games and comics (full list below!)

• From fire and ice to toxic chocolate and cooking wildlife for food, Russian Subway Dogs is full of simulated systems to discover and exploit!

• Original Soundtrack by Peter Chapman aka COINS (Guacamelee!, LittleBigPlanet Karting, Modnation Racers)

Whether you’re a dog person or more of the feline persuasion, Russian Subway Dogs has you covered. Play as a range of unlockable critters with a whole pack of special guests including:

• Question Hound from KC Green's Gunshow

• Fidel from Fidel Dungeon Rescue

• Nacho & Rad Shiba from VA-11 HALL-A

• Ratcoon from Ruin of the Reckless

• Uay Chivo from Guacamelee!

• Nidhogg from Nidhogg 2

• They Bleed Pixels inspired Clawed Kitty!

Simple enough for a puppy to pick up, but still packed with challenge! Run and jump along subway platforms. Bark behind people to scare up food and bounce vodka around the stage. Soon you’ll be discovering high-level strategies, such as cooking and eating rival wildlife with vodka explosions.

Travel the Moscow subway in Campaign Mode! Survive and thrive through dozens of levels and over 100 unique challenges from your feline leader, the Proletaricat and the mischievous Kittens!

Can you finish the level with a vegetarian diet? While protecting a bear? What about preventing the pigeons from cannibalizing each other? Complete enough levels and challenges and you'll discover the secret station at the end of the line!

Feeling competitive? Climb the online leaderboards in Endless Mode. Random Proletaricat mini-challenges and our special score driven difficulty algorithm keep each play through fresh!

From fire and ice, to cooking food and toxic chocolate, Russian Subway Dogs is full of simulated systems, allowing lots of freedom in how you earn points and deal with rival wildlife.

Will you eat the tasty but toxic chocolate for major points, or feed it to that pesky poodle that keeps stealing your shawarma? Drink hot sauce to gain powerful fire barks or feed it to a pigeon for some fire pooping air support?

In Russian Subway Dogs it’s up to you to use your knowledge and abilities to stuff your stomach and inflict as much mayhem as possible!

Musician Peter Chapman (Guacamelee!, LittleBigPlanet Karting, Modnation Racers) has created a banging original soundtrack packed with Slavic sounds and Baltic beats combined with electronic dance music.
body.en:
Welcome, comrades! Meet Russian Subway Dogs! We have done extensive, totally legal research in order to fine tune this chaotic arcade-simulation for what it's like to scavenge for food from Russian commuters. Surviving isn't easy when you are dodging volatile vodka, rival dogs, and the rare and dangerous Subway Bear!

• A new game from the creators of They Bleed Pixels.

• Inspired by real life stray dogs who’ve learned to navigate Moscow’s subway system!

• Take on Campaign Mode with dozens of levels and over 100 unique challenges from your boss kitty: The Proletaricat.

• Highly replayable Endless Mode with online leaderboards and a score-driven difficulty algorithm that keeps each round fresh!

• Featuring detailed pixel art of Moscow’s world famous, ornately decorated subway stations.

• Play as your favourite animals from other indie games and comics (full list below!)

• From fire and ice to toxic chocolate and cooking wildlife for food, Russian Subway Dogs is full of simulated systems to discover and exploit!

• Original Soundtrack by Peter Chapman aka COINS (Guacamelee!, LittleBigPlanet Karting, Modnation Racers)

Whether you’re a dog person or more of the feline persuasion, Russian Subway Dogs has you covered. Play as a range of unlockable critters with a whole pack of special guests including:

• Question Hound from KC Green's Gunshow

• Fidel from Fidel Dungeon Rescue

• Nacho & Rad Shiba from VA-11 HALL-A

• Ratcoon from Ruin of the Reckless

• Uay Chivo from Guacamelee!

• Nidhogg from Nidhogg 2

• They Bleed Pixels inspired Clawed Kitty!

Travel the Moscow subway in Campaign Mode! Survive and thrive through dozens of levels and over 100 unique challenges from your feline leader, the Proletaricat and the mischievous Kittens!

Can you finish the level with a vegetarian diet? While protecting a bear? What about preventing the pigeons from cannibalizing each other? Complete enough levels and challenges and you'll discover the secret station at the end of the line!

Feeling competitive? Climb the online leaderboards in Endless Mode. Random Proletaricat mini-challenges and our special score driven difficulty algorithm keep each play through fresh!
