description.zh: 平凡的大学生浣熊运气爆棚入职了自己最喜欢的游戏公司雄狮科技，作为游戏策划参与新项目《逆转狸猫》并以获得游戏界最高荣誉金猪奖为目标努力工作。他需要使用特殊能力【猜拳】应对背锅、穿小鞋、抱团霸凌等职场PUA，但麻烦远远不止这么简单……浣熊能够在无数次【回溯】中救赎自己和友人、最终获得金猪奖吗？
description.en: Pawffice is a story-driven, strategy roguelike game. Coon, an average college grad. He has to use his unique ability, "Rock-Paper-Scissors" to defeat all sorts of strange enemies. After countless do-overs , can he save himself and his friends, and uncover all the secrets behind Pawffice?

body.zh:
《动物职场》是由国内独立游戏团队开发的剧情策略肉鸽游戏。

普通的应届毕业生浣熊，在面试时被传授了【猜拳】技能而得以进入自己心仪的游戏公司成为一名执行策划，但未知的危机正在未来等待着他……

「用【猜拳】的力量，打败他们吧！」

不负责的同事、甩锅的组员、聒噪的上司、PUA的领导……不是我喜欢的类型，直接拒绝！

「如果能够重来的话，结局是否会被改变？」

裁员、项目解散、公司破产、甚至▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇，是不是能够通过重新来过改变命运？是不是可以逃离做战战兢兢、谁都可以欺负的小策划的命运？

「不管多少次，我都会重新找到你。」

这里好像不是普通的职场……而他们，不只是萍水相逢的同事，而是▇▇▇▇▇▇。平凡的大学生浣熊，能逃出这场名为职场的游戏吗？
body.en:
Pawffice is a story-driven, strategy roguelike game.

Coon, an average recent graduate, was granted the "Rock-Paper-Scissors" skill during a job interview, which landed him a position as an Associate Producer at his dream game company. However, an unknown crisis awaits him in the future...

Unleash the power of Rock-Paper-Scissors and take them down!

Use turn-based "Rock-Paper-Scissors" to defeat your opponents! Unreliable coworkers, teammates who dump their mess on others, annoying supervisors, bosses who gaslight and belittle… None of these sit right with me—I’m shutting them down, no questions asked!

If I could hit restart, would the ending turn out different?

Layoffs, project shutdowns, company collapse, and even ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇—can I rewrite my fate with a second chance? Can I stop being that jittery rookie designer everyone walks all over?

No matter how many tries it takes, I’ll find you again.

This doesn’t feel like a normal workplace… And they aren’t just random colleagues I crossed paths with—they’re ▇▇▇▇▇▇. Can Coon, your average college grad, break free from this “workplace” that’s really just a twisted game?

The Early Access Version includes 1/5 of the full version’s content, with:

• 7 story chapters

• 10+ characters, each with multiple expressive character sprites

• 30+ event illustrations

• 50+ CGs

The full version is slated for release in 2026.

• Early Access players get a discounted price.

• A free update to the full version will be available once it launches.

description.zh: 《Crypt Custodian》是一款以净化冥界为背景、引人入胜的类银河恶魔城游戏。玩家将扮演布鲁托——这只淘气的猫咪已经死去，并被判处担任冥界的清洁工...永远如此！与其他遭受诅咒的幽灵一起玩耍，与猛兽战斗，并探索广袤无垠的世界
description.en: Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania about cleaning up the afterlife. Play as Pluto - a mischievous cat who has died, and is sentenced to be the afterworld's janitor... FOREVER! Hang out with other doomed ghosts, battle beasts, and explore a vastly expansive landscape.

body.zh:
《Crypt Custodian》是一款以净化冥界为背景、引人入胜的类银河恶魔城/塞尔达传说游戏。

你将扮演布鲁托——这只淘气的猫咪刚刚死去，来到了冥界的王宫。在与冥界守护者肯德拉进行简短且灾难性的会面后，你被赶出了王宫，还被判处承担净化任务...永远如此！

探索王宫周边的广阔区域，凭借你信赖的扫帚与猛兽战斗，并掌握新技能，拓展你所处的世界。破解谜题，探索秘密，还有...策划一场伏击，打回王宫去！

众多富有魅力的角色结识徘徊在王宫外的其他各种邪恶幽灵。了解他们如何丧生，以及为何面临永恒的惩罚！还可前往当地幽魂出没之所——罪人酒馆，与你遇到的幽灵交谈，并升级你的装备。

数不胜数的升级破解谜题，击败史诗头目并坚持不懈地清理破败的地下城，以收集全新的升级和技能。通过混搭升级来定制你的游戏风格，并利用收集到的技能拓展你所在的世界。

热热闹闹的互联世界在所到之处都藏有秘密的广袤世界里游荡。构建你自己的路线，按照自己的节奏探索冥界的无数秘密。
body.en:
Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania/zelda-like about cleaning up the afterlife.

You play as Pluto - a mischievous cat who has just died, and landed in the afterlife's palace. After a brief and disastrous meeting with the Afterlife Guardian - Kendra - you are banished from the palace and sentenced to clean... FOREVER!!

Explore the vast grounds that surround the palace, battle beasts with your trusty broom, and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and… organize an ambush to break back into the palace!

A Charming Cast Of CharactersMeet and befriend all the other bad ghosts who live outside the palace. Learn how they died, and what caused them to face eternal banishment! And then head on over to the local haunt- The Sinner’s Inn- to chat with the ghosts you meet, and upgrade your gear.

Tons of UpgradesComplete puzzles, battle epic bosses, and clean your way through ruined dungeons in order to collect new upgrades and abilities. Customize your play style by mix-and-matching your upgrades, and use the abilities you collect to expand your world.

A Lively Interconnected WorldTraverse a vast landscape with secrets hiding at every corner. Form your own path and discover the afterlife’s many secrets at your own pace.

description.zh: 在这个放松的平台里做一只快乐可爱的小鸡。通过跳跃，攀爬以及解谜，去寻找每一只小鸡都会面对的终极问题的答案吧！
description.en: Play as an adorable chicken in this relaxing platformer. Jump, climb and solve puzzles to find the answer to the ULTIMATE question a chicken can ask...

body.zh:
与我们可爱的小鸡主角一起展开探索人生奥秘的大冒险吧！

挑战自己你是否可以在这场冒险中解开 ‘’先有蛋还是先有鸡“ 这个千古难题。

• 你将化身一只小鸡

• 探索你周边的环境以及交到志同道合的朋友

• 用小鸡的嘴‘’啄‘’开谜题

• 没有让你紧张的战斗场面

• 让你放松的背景音乐
body.en:
Embark on an epic adventure with the cutest chicken protagonist in this relaxing 2D puzzle platformer!

See if you can find the answer to the question that dumbfounded sages for millennia: "What came first: the Chicken or the Egg?"

•

You are a chicken

•

Explore curious environments and meet friendly creatures

•

Peck your way through varied puzzles

•

Relaxing game with no combat

•

Wonderful soundtrack that you can chill to all day

description.zh: 与孤儿鸟“小波”展开一次温暖人心的发现之旅，出发去揭开他的身世之谜。跟随这只欢乐蹦跳、喜欢唱歌的小鸟一路前行，引导它完成这趟神奇的旅程，这个世界拥有惊人像素艺术和华丽动画，会根据你的音乐互动而改变！
description.en: Musical Metroidvania, with pixel art to die for. Guide orphaned chick 'Birb', on a platform adventure, as he faces off against the denizens of the forest in rhythm-action boss battles. Acclaimed for its gorgeous animation, and heart-warming storytelling, as Birb strives to discover his true origins.

body.zh:
与孤儿鸟“小波”展开一次温暖人心的发现之旅，出发去揭开他的身世之谜。跟随这只欢乐蹦跳、喜欢唱歌的小鸟一路前行，引导它完成这趟神奇的旅程。这个世界拥有惊人的像素艺术和华丽的动画，会根据你的音乐互动而改变！以清脆鸟鸣激活平台、对森林里的居民歌唱，并学习新的音符，以帮助你在这个广阔迷人的世界中，与其中的生物展开引人入胜的节奏之战。

在这趟自我发现之旅中，小波将在令人愉悦的欢快动画中遇到数十位欢乐的森林居民。飞越美丽像素图形构成的各种区域，了解更多森林中的故事。

帮助森林中的生物寻找散布在各个关卡中的隐藏音符。你的善行会触发额外的节拍层，并与原声和谐地融合在一起，让这个世界的氛围更加生动。

参与演奏动听迷人的音乐片断，挑战你的节奏技巧，并学习新的音符。加入合唱团，跟着音乐，同步按下音符，即可一起跟着唱！

带领小波穿越充满生命力和隐藏区域的相关联关卡。沿路拾取羽毛，并寻找它们的主人，发现这个神奇世界的无数秘密和传说。
body.en:
A heart-warming journey of discovery, as orphaned chick 'Birb' sets off to find his true origins. Follow this cheerful little bouncing bird who revels in singing, and guide him through this magical journey of stunning pixel art and gorgeous animation that shapes itself to your musical interactions! Chirp to activate platforms, and sing to the residents of the forest, learning new notes to aid you in captivating rhythm battles against the creatures of this sprawling, enchanting world.

In this journey of self-discovery, Birb will come across dozens of cheery denizens with joyful and bubbly animations. Fly your way across areas rendered in beautiful pixel graphics as you learn more about the tales of the forest.

Come to the aid of the creatures of the forest to find hidden musical notes scattered across the levels. Your good deeds will release extra layers of beats that will blend harmoniously with the soundtrack, bringing further the atmosphere of the world to life.

Learn new notes as you engage in catchy musical segments that will challenge your rhythmic skills. Join the choir and press notes in synchronization with the music to sing along!

Lead Birb across interconnected levels bursting with life and hidden areas to uncover. Pick up feathers along your way and find their owner to discover myriad of secrets and the lore of this magical world.

description.zh: 在这款吃豆人风格的肉鸽游戏中，小鸭子们被绑架了，而你是一只非常愤怒的鸭妈妈。
description.en: In this PacMan Roguelite, Baby ducklings have been kidnapped, and you are a very ANGRY Mama Duck.

body.zh:
~ Baby ducklings have been kidnapped, and you are a very angry Mama Duck.

This is a QuackMan Roguelite. Battle the evil Lich and his undead minions to rescue your ducklings. Classic PacMan controls but with an added ATTACK button that can destroy walls and vanquish enemies.

Gameplay:

Play as Mama Duck and navigate your way through the evil Lich's dungeon maze. Rescue your lost ducklings and form a giant chain of ducks. You must battle waves of undead minions. In this adorable QuackMan Roguelite, you can customize Mama Duck with hundreds of different gear combinations. Your gear gives unique active and passive abilities. They are also adorable accessories, so you can fashion up your duck.

Features:

•

Destroy walls and make your own path through the maze!

•

Battle massive bosses and fight back a wide variety of undead minions.

•

Make animal friends, like the shop cat at Toe Beans Cafe.

•

Meta upgrades and progression.

•

FASHION DUCKS! Hundreds of gear combinations for Mama Duck

description.zh: Donut County 是一款叙事型物理解谜游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演地上一个不断变大的地洞。让我们一起来认识各种可爱的角色、偷偷拿走他们的垃圾并丢进地洞里。
description.en: Donut County is a story-based physics puzzle game where you play as an ever-growing hole in the ground. Meet cute characters, steal their trash, and throw them in a hole.

body.zh:
Donut County 是一款叙事型物理解谜游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演地上一个不断变大的地洞。让我们一起来认识各种可爱的角色、偷偷拿走他们的垃圾并丢进地洞里。

垃圾也是宝贝

浣熊利用远程控制的垃圾偷取地洞占领了 Donut County。你将扮演操控地洞的浣熊 BK，利用地洞吞掉他的朋友们以及他们的家，以此获得各种看起来傻乎乎的奖励。

有一天，BK 不小心掉进了自己挖出的一个地洞里，并在里面遇到他最好的朋友 Mira 以及 Donut County 的居民们。他们全部被困在距离地面 999 英尺的地底之下，浣熊必须给他们一个解释！

不断变大的地洞

- 探索每个角色的家，注意看每个人的家都有着独特的环境。

- 移动地洞吞掉他们的东西，地洞会随着每次吞噬变得越来越大。

- 在地洞中组合各种物体可获得神奇的效果：熬汤、饲养兔子、发射烟火，等等。

- 将各种东西弹射到地洞外面。你可以通过这种手段来解谜...或单纯地当一个破坏王。

- 吞噬一切。在整个小镇全部消失之前，地洞将一直存在。

Donut County 是由 What Remains of Edith Finch 和 The Unfinished Swan 的设计者 Ben Esposito 创作。经历六年的独力开发，在消耗掉几十个甜甜圈（用于研究）以及与一只浣熊发生一场命中注定的邂逅之后，他终于推出了这款游戏。
body.en:
Donut County is a story-based physics puzzle game where you play as an ever-growing hole in the ground. Meet cute characters, steal their trash, and throw them in a hole.

Where Trash is Treasure

Raccoons have taken over Donut County with remote-controlled trash-stealing holes. You play as BK, a hole-driving raccoon who swallows up his friends and their homes to earn idiotic prizes.

When BK falls into one of his own holes, he’s confronted by his best friend Mira and the residents of Donut County, who are all stuck 999 feet underground… and they demand answers!

The Hole Keeps Growing

• EXPLORE every character’s home, each with their own unique environment.

• MOVE the hole to swallow up their stuff, growing bigger each time.

• COMBINE objects inside for crazy effects: cook soup, breed bunnies, launch fireworks, and more.

• CATAPULT things back out of the hole. You can use it to solve puzzles...or just destroy stuff.

• DEVOUR everything. The hole won’t stop until the whole county is all gone.

Donut County was created by Ben Esposito, designer on What Remains of Edith Finch and The Unfinished Swan. It is the result of six years of solo development, dozens of donuts (for research), and one fateful encounter with a raccoon.

description.zh: 《厄运七人组》将会带您来一场太空漫步，并体验一个爱恨交集，与渴望人肉的故事。
description.en: Unlucky Seven will take you on a space walk and tell you a story about love, hate, and craving for human flesh.

body.zh:
艾伦的朋友们总是喜欢庆祝特别场合，他们错过了匿名戒酒会，跑去参加了一个豪华汽车旅馆的生日派对。不幸的是，派对的主人因为吃了一口美味的人肝香肠而食欲大增。他们的庆生派对即将成为死亡派对...

在这个美丽的像素写实风世界中尽情冒险！你所做的每一个选择都将决定你朋友们的命运。探索参与者们的动机与欲望，并破坏他们的阴谋吧！

《厄运七人组》将会带您来一场太空漫步，并体验一个爱恨交集，与渴望人肉的故事。
body.en:
GameplayThe game is played only using the keyboard. You don't need a mouse - you can throw it away!

In Unlucky Seven you'll have the ability to control different characters to complete the game. The game is played from a side view (observer) and has many interactive elements or items that are necessary to complete the mission.

The key elements during the game are numerous dialogues and answers that the player chooses. Remember to choose wisely!

Elen's friends always remember to celebrate special occasions. Instead of attending Alcoholics Anonymous meeting, they go to a birthday party in a luxury motel. Unfortunately, the owner just ate a delicious human liver sausage. And the appetite comes with eating. The party of their life becomes a party of their death.

Experience the thrill of adventure through the beautiful pixel-realistic world, where you are who you eat, and your choices decide the fate of your friends. Meet the hidden goals and desires of each character and jeer as their plans are ruined.

Unlucky Seven will take you on a spacewalk and tell you a story about love, hate, and craving for human flesh.

description.zh: 《超级猫猫哥》是一款以高位像素艺术风格创作的动作平台游戏，结合了90年代黄金16位平台游戏时代的最佳元素和一些 “超特喵炫酷”的新机制！ 还有别忘了，游戏中有超多关于猫咪的内容！
description.en: Super Catboy is an action-packed platformer created in a high-bit pixel art style, combining the best elements of the golden 16-bit platformer era of the 90s with some ‘‘pawsome’’ new mechanics! And let’s not forget; there’s plenty of CAT CONTENT!

body.zh:
《超级猫猫哥》是一款以高位像素艺术风格创作的动作平台游戏，结合了90年代黄金16位平台游戏时代的最佳元素和一些 “超特喵炫酷”的新机制！ 还有别忘了，游戏中有超多关于猫咪的内容！

来见见超级猫猫哥，他可不是一般的汤姆猫！他和他疯狂的搭档武器女孩一起，在试图挫败邪恶创造者的阴暗计划时，不闻其声空留狼藉。他全副武装，并配备了最时髦的滑板鞋技术。他必须奔跑、跳跃、冲刺、攀爬、射击，并在成群的拟人化狗狗兵团中杀出一条血路。如过你喜欢80年代和90年代、喜欢16位平台游戏、喜欢郎朗上口的曲调、喜欢“强大的”Boss战、喜欢猫咪，讨厌狗狗（开玩笑啦，我们超爱狗勾的）。那么你就会乐在其中。

•

《超级猫猫哥》将我们所喜爱的16位像素平台游戏时代的真实风格和特色相结合，创造了高位像素艺术美学。

•

经典的风格与新时代特色擦出火花!《超级猫猫哥》将传统的平台游戏与令人兴奋的跑酷射击和格斗机制相结合。

•

在磨练你的平台技巧的同时，还要对付邪恶科学家的狗腿子，破坏他占领世界的计划——当然是用“猫咪的态度”。

•

享受各种不同的动作技能和掌握致命的强大武器库以及近战连击

•

一个充满乐趣和动作的故事，每个回合都有可爱的角色和具有挑战的Boss

•

通过详细的像素艺术切场和不同的关卡，如白雪皑皑的山脉、神秘的森林和废弃的工厂，来解开故事的脉络
body.en:
Super Catboy is an action-packed platformer created in a high-bit pixel art style, combining the best elements of the golden 16-bit platformer era of the 90s with some ‘pawsome’ new mechanics! And let’s not forget; there’s plenty of CAT CONTENT!

Meet Super Catboy, your not so average tomcat! Together with his crazy sidekick, Weapongirl, he leaves nothing but chaos in his wake while trying to thwart the shady plans of his evil creator. Armed to the whiskers and equipped with the latest dashing sneaker technology, he must run, jump, dash, climb, shoot and fight his way through hordes of anthropomorphic dog soldiers. If you love the 80s and 90s, 16-bit platforming, catchy tunes, ‘furmidable’ boss fights, cats and hate dogs, (just kidding we love them) then you’re in for a treat.

•

Super Catboy combines the authentic style and features we came to love in the 16-bit pixel platformer era, created with high-bit pixel art aesthetics

•

Old-school style meets new school features! Super Catboy combines old-school platforming with exciting new mechanics of the run’n’gun and beat em-up genres

•

Hone your platforming skills while taking on the hench-dogs of an evil scientist and sabotage his plans to take over the world – with ‘cattitude’ of course

•

Enjoy a huge ‘repawtoire’ of different moves and master a deadly arsenal of weapons and melee combos

•

Challenging motor bike and mine cart chases await

•

A fun and action-packed story with loveable characters and challenging bosses at every turn

•

Unravel the story’s yarn via detailed pixel art cutscenes and diverse levels, such as snow-capped mountain ranges, mystical forests and derelict factories

description.zh: 一款以“毛茸茸的狗狗少女”为主角的探索类动作游戏。掌握狗狗的特殊技能，探索未知的古代遗迹。
description.en: An exploration-type action game in which "Fluffy Girl Doge" is the main character. Get the skills of "Doge" and explore the unknown ancient ruins.

body.zh:
An exploration-type action game in which "Fluffy Girl Doge" is the main character. Get the skills of "Doge" and explore the unknown ancient ruins.

Game Features

• Simple 2D action that can be played easily!

• Explore the intricate ruins to obtain new skills!

• Collect 70 different treasure items!

• Collect crystals to enhance your status!

• There are more than 70 areas to explore and more than 7 types of boss enemies!

• High difficulty challenge mode that opens up after clearing the game!

• Interesting friends to support Doge's adventure!

Operation instructions

[Keyboard & Mouse]

WASD: Move

SPACE: Decision/Jump

Esc: Cancel

E: Interact

Q: Special action/menu switch

Left click: normal attack

Right click: skill attack

Wheel Click: Bomb

Wheel scroll: Skill switching

SHIFT: Map menu

CTRL: Treasure Menu

F5: Reset

[Gamepad] (Xbox)

Left stick: move

A: Confirm/Jump

B: Interact cancellation

X・RT: Normal attack

Y・RB: Skill attack

LT: Special action/menu switch

LB: Skill switching

Push right stick: Bomb

START : Map menu

SELECT: Treasure Menu

START+SELECT : Reset

description.zh: Yu找到了一份新工作：在小镇里担任市长助理。她的任务是认识所有人，帮助毛茸茸的居民们解决日常问题。她很快就会发现，在这座小镇里，人们交朋友的方式非常特别……
description.en: Yu conseguiu um novo emprego: trabalhar como assistente do prefeito em uma cidadezinha. Sua tarefa é conhecer todos e ajudar os habitantes peludos com seus problemas do dia a dia. Ela logo descobre que, nessa cidade, as pessoas têm um jeito muito especial de fazer amigos...

body.en:
Yu's got a new job - working as a mayor's assistant in a small town.

Her task is to meet everyone and help the furry inhabitants with their everyday problems.

She quickly discovers that in this town, people have a very special way of making friends...

This is a short, linear erotic adventure game where you can explore a small town.

It contains a mini-game and you can visit houses and talk to people. Collect, use and combine items in order to

fulfill their needs and unlock new interactions.

There are 6 different lewd scenes (plus a bonus pool scene) and 2 hidden sketches to discover.

NEW FEATURES

-Steam Achievements

-Full voice work for Yu by @DornVa

-New Branding

-Still FREE!

All characters in Yu Crossing Animals are 18+

description.zh: 《毛皮小事》是一部兽人题材的恋爱视觉小说，讲述了兽人们在卡萝之家共度温馨时光的故事。搬进这家小店后，你将与三位魅力十足的兽人角色成为室友，在从春到秋的日常相处中，慢慢与他们建立起更深的羁绊。
description.en: "Trivia About You" is a romance visual novel about furry characters sharing meaningful moments in Carol’s House. After moving into the shop, you become roommates with three charming furry characters. Through daily life, from spring to autumn, you slowly build deeper connections with them.

body.zh:
This game is part of the Bahamut 30th Anniversary Indie Game Promotion Program.

A twist of fate lands you in a charming plant shop called Carol's House, where you are unexpectedly hired by its mysterious owner, Carol.

There, you share a home with three furry roommates—each with strikingly different personalities. Across three changing seasons and countless small happenings, profound bonds are forged among you.

Trivia About You is a heartwarming, slice-of-life romance adventure game that chronicles the everyday happenings of roommates in Carol's House.

Step into the pixel-charmed world of Carol's House, make choices that shape your relationships with furry roommates...

Or will an unexpected choice change everything?

Endless Little Stories

Your unique choices shape the narrative flow, allowing you to discover entirely new scenes and stories. Rich events, charming surprises, and beautifully illustrated CGs make each playthrough fresh and memorable.

Multiple Endings

Build affection with any of the three distinct characters. The crucial decision you make at the turning point will lead the story. Who stays by your side, where your journey is going...will totally be determined by you.

Pixel Objects to Discover

More than just a visual novel! It's an open invitation to wander through Carol's House. Interact with pixel objects in the scene to uncover hidden stories and delicate details. Every seemingly ordinary pixel could be guarding a character's unspoken secrets.

Charming Mini-Games

Step into Carol's House and truly live the life in a plant shop! Engage in light, interactive tasks like watering, pruning, and greeting customers. Find a small sense of accomplishment and calm in the daily, soothing routine.

Via

An easygoing yet sincere gray wolf young man.

Via is gentle, sensitive, and passionate about coffee and photography. He tackles his new job with eager dedication. With his arrival at Carol's House, a brand-new chapter of daily life begins to unfold.

Kyle

A sunshine-bright, straightforward tiger firefighter .

Kyle is an outgoing, warm person who loves to chat and cook. He projects a bold exterior, eager to be the reliable "big brother," but his romantic views are surprisingly traditional. Beneath this straightforward facade, however, Kyle harbors a secret worry and anxiety, ignited the moment he realized a certain someone means more than he expected.

Mick

A quiet, reserved jackal student.

Quiet and often struggling for words, Mick serves as the gentle, unassuming helper in the background of everyday life. He is timid, self-doubting, and lacking confidence, yet he notices everything. However when Mick meets someone he can truly trust and lean on, he finally finds the courage to dream and move forward.

Shin

A rational, cool-headed goat accountant.

Sharp-tongued and aloof, Shin looks stingy and keeps everyone at arm's length. His life is defined by strict boundaries and personal principles. Only in those rare moments when his concern for someone slips out can you glimpse the genuine, gradually warming affection hidden behind the walls he's built.

Carol

A free-spirited and open-minded sheep who runs Carol's House

Carol is the heart and soul of Carol's House. She is the owner of a plant shop and also a notably caring landlady. She enjoys drinking, acts on impulse, and is capable of dropping profound life advice into the most casual conversation.

description.zh: 以丛林战争为主题的电子版桌面游戏。
description.en: Might makes right in the wild wood! The award-winning board game of asymmetrical woodland warfare comes to cross-platform digital play! Combine subtle strategy and bold daring to guide your forest faction to victory!

body.zh:
欢迎游玩广受欢迎的桌面游戏的电子改编版本。《茂林源记》是一个冒险和战争游戏，2-4名玩家在一片广阔荒野中为争夺控制权而作战。

狡诈的猫咪贵族占据了森林之国，想要开发这里的富饶资源。在他们的统治之下，集合了很多森林生物。这个阵营寻求积累资源和扩张猫咪的统治。这个阵营可能会寻求神秘游侠的帮助，后者可以在危险的森林中自由移动。尽管有些人可能会同情这个阵营的理念和梦想，也有一些年长的游侠还曾记得曾经统治森林的飞鹰帝国。

如今沦落到在地图偏远地带的飞鹰帝国，仍然骄傲，但内部争吵不断。他们最近找到了一个新的指挥官，希望能在他的领导下夺回这个种族与生俱来的权力。

这里已经成为了战争的舞台，森林的命运将会因此而被决定。玩家们将会决定最终由哪个种族统治森林。

"森林最新的征服者，猫咪贵族想要通过工业生产和运输来统治这篇荒野。他们通过收集木材来建设工坊、锯木厂和征兵所，从而获取胜利分数。猫咪贵族有茂林法则中最庞大的军队，但数量并不一定能帮你守住天下……

猫咪贵族想要把这里变成一个工业与军事结合的霸权国家。每当贵族们建造一个建筑，包括工坊、锯木厂和征兵所时，他们就能获得分数。但是，为了能持续这项工程，贵族需要大量的木材，并保证供应链不被切断。尽管通过人海战术征服你的对手很具有诱惑力，但这会让你有很大的风险导致供应链铺的太开而导致难以维持生产。

"在猫咪们到来之前，飞鹰王朝曾经统治这片森林。他们必须在陷入内战之前，重新夺回控制权，征服更多的领地和建设更多的鸟巢。飞鹰们十分骄傲，他们严格遵守领袖所颁布的法令。每个领袖会有不同的专长和优势。在合适的时机选择正确的领袖可以让你走向胜利，错误的领袖则会让你征服森林的梦想破灭。

在夜晚之时，飞鹰可以根据建造的鸟巢数量来获得分数。建造的鸟巢越多，得分越高。但是，飞鹰王朝有着严苛的法令，由他们的领袖颁发。每一回合中，他们都会颁布更多的法令，而且如果有法令无法完成，就会造成社会动乱。

无论是新国王还是旧君主，林森联盟都不喜欢。猫咪贵族或者飞鹰王朝，对于他们而言都是一个样。他们相信只有人民才能统治人民！森林联盟是游击战的好手，他们开局的发展可能比较缓慢，但游戏后期会非常强大——当然你要能在其他争夺森林统治权的阵营之间坚持到后期才行。

森林联盟致力于取得居民们的民意。每当联盟放置民意指示物时，就可以获得分数。他们传播越多民意指示物，就能得到更多分数。传播民意需要支持者们的协助，支持者可以帮助他们发动起义，并建立新的基地，这让他们训练更多的长官，增强联盟的军事灵活性。

神秘游侠对于一些人而言是冒险家，对于另一些人而言则是商人、窃贼，或者恶棍。作为游侠，你将会越过领地的限制，探索整片地图，进入茂密的丛林寻找道具和遗迹。你可以与正在交战的阵营做交易来帮助其中一方，这样可以完成你自己的秘密任务。

神秘游侠不属于冲突中的任何一个阵营，他们有自己的任务，在森林中建立自己的名声。游侠可以通过加强与其他阵营的关系，或是攻击敌对阵营来获得分数。你也可以通过任务来获取分数。为了高效的行动，游侠必须充分利用道具，你可以通过探索遗迹或者协助其他阵营来获得更多道具。
body.en:
A game of woodland might and right.

Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

The most recent conquerors of the forest, the Marquise de Cat plays a game of engine building and logistics while policing the vast wilderness. By collecting Wood they are able to build Workshops, Sawmills, and Recruiters to help her score victory points. Marquise de Cat has the largest army in ROOT, but numbers alone won’t be enough to secure the forest...

The Marquise de Cat builds a mighty industrial war machine to subdue the forest. Each time the Marquise builds a Workshop, Sawmill, or Recruiter, you score victory points. The more of the same building she has on the map, the more points scored. However, to fuel ongoing construction, the Marquise must maintain and protect a strong, interconnected economy of Wood. While it may be tempting to overwhelm your opponents with sheer numbers, this leaves you at great risk of spreading yourself too thin and ultimately not being able to keep up.

The Eyrie Dynasties once ruled the wood, before the coming of the Cats. They must retake control by capturing territory and building Roosts before they collapse back into squabbling. The Eyrie are proud and bound to the decrees of their leaders. Each leader brings with them different specialties and advantages. The right leader at the right time could lead you to victory, but the wrong leader could cripple your chances of reclaiming the forest.

During the Evening, the Eyrie score victory points based on the number of roosts on the map. The greater their presence in the Woodlands, the greater their gains. However, the Eyrie are bound by their Decree, an ever-increasing set of mandated actions promised by their leader. Each turn, they must take all of the actions on their Decree, or else fall into turmoil.

The Woodland Alliance doesn’t take kindly to despots - old or new. Marquise, Eyrie, they’re all the same. Only through the will of the people can this wood be ruled! The Woodland Alliance are masters of guerrilla warfare, they begin slowly but can build into a late-game powerhouse - but only if they can manage to subvert the other would-be rulers along the way.

The Woodland Alliance works to gain the sympathy of the various creatures of the forest. Each time the Alliance places a sympathy token, they may score victory points. The more sympathy on the map they have, the more victory points they score. Gaining the sympathy of the people requires supporters. These supporters can also be put toward violent ends, inciting outright rebellion across the forest. When a revolt erupts, the Alliance will establish a base. Bases allow the Alliance to train officers, increasing their military strength and flexibility.

The Vagabond is an adventurer to some, a trader to others, and thief to more, and an all-around scoundrel. As the Vagabond, you will explore all over the map, beyond just it's clearings, into dense woods to find items and ruins. You can trade and lend aid to the warring factions of the forest to help you complete your own secret quests.

The Vagabond plays all sides of the conflict while going on quests to increase his renown throughout the wood. Each time the Vagabond improves their relationship with another faction, or removes a warrior belonging to a faction hostile toward them, the Vagabond scores victory points. You can also complete quests to score victory points. To move and act effectively the Vagabond must manage a pack of items, expand your selection by exploring the forest ruins and providing aid to other factions.

description.zh: 可以同时控制猫咪和吐司的解谜平台游戏，基于名梗的「黄油猫永动机」。游戏共 200+ 关卡，70+ 皮肤，还有 BOSS 战和小游戏！
description.en: Puzzle platformer where you control both the cat and the toast, based on the famous "Buttered Cat Paradox". The game features 200+ levels, 70+ skins, plus boss fights and mini-games!

body.zh:
•

一边控制猫咪左右奔跑、攀爬猫抓板，以及变成液体钻进管道。是的！记住猫咪是液体！

•

一边控制吐司沿抛物线跳跃。蓄力下蹲，吐司会跳得更远！

•

当两者合体时，就可以突破物理法则，带猫咪去往更多无法到达的地方。

《CATO 黄油猫》围绕着「猫咪」和「黄油吐司」这两个主角展开，需要你利用两者的分分合合解开关卡中的各类谜题。游戏包含 140+ 主线关卡和 60+ 支线关卡，有隐藏房间、挑战性的BOSS战和趣味小游戏，还将有换肤玩法，70+ 猫咪吐司皮肤等你收集！

《CATO 黄油猫》是一款可爱猫猫的像素风平台解谜游戏，设计灵感来自于一个网络meme：猫咪落地永远四脚着地，吐司落地永远是涂了黄油的一面着地，将吐司绑在猫背上，就会触发悖论，形成无限翻滚浮空的黄油猫咪永动机！

黄油猫将会经历一场烧脑的冒险，在5个不同主题的世界中漫游，每个世界都有独特好玩的机关装置。

有让吐司联想到不好回忆的吐司机，有猫咪爱玩的黄油跳板、加速猫条。 还会邂逅一些神秘的伙伴，为解开谜题带来意料之外的帮助。

游戏以解谜为主，动作为辅。大多数时候不需要高难度的平台跳跃，只需要专注谜题本身。但冒险途中总会有一些拦路的坏蛋，此时便需要你熟练运用技巧去击败它。

随着冒险进程还将解锁不同小游戏，收集后可以安装到小窝的游戏机中，随时打开再玩一局。

黄油猫的世界里暗藏着不少隐秘房间，需要通过暗道前往。你可以在这里发现异世界的彩蛋和神秘掉落物品。

抱回小窝，换上你最爱的装扮，再次出发吧！

而猫咪和吐司究竟在寻找着什么？这些故事的碎片也散落在冒险途中，等待你的探索。

关于制作组

我们是双人团队Team Woll！主程 Blasin 和 主美 Frank 因Gamejam活动相识，又因好评的Gamejam作品 《CATO 黄油猫》而正式成立工作室。

《CATO 黄油猫》是工作室的第一款作品，经过两年努力、全程远程协作完成的心血之作，希望大家玩得开心！也感谢一路上支持我们的朋友们，我们独立游戏的旅程才刚刚开始！

关于发行商

GCORES PUBLISHING 是由机核组建的独立游戏发行业务，未来也将不断带给大家 BOOOM暴造 创作活动中的优秀独立游戏。欢迎关注我们的发行商页面。

关于BOOOM暴造

机核网旗下的独立游戏品牌。「BOOOMJAM 游戏创作挑战」是每年固定举办2次，限时开发三周、限定开发主题的游戏创作活动。在开发阶段结束后，面向所有玩家举办线上试玩游戏节，以及在机核的大型线下电子游戏嘉年华上对这些游戏进行展示。

欢迎加入我们的社群

了解更多游戏内容资讯，或有任何意见建议，欢迎通过社群联系我们~

•

QQ群【CATO的猫爬架】：813119157

•

微博：@CATO黄油猫

•

B站：CATO黄油猫

•

小红书：CATO黄油猫

•

Twitter(X)：@CATO: Buttered Cat
body.en:
•

Control the cat as it runs left and right, climbs the cat scratching broad, and even slips through pipes. Hey! cats are liquid!

•

Guide the toast meanwhile with the cat, as toast jumps like projectiles. Hold down and power on, and the toast will jump farther!

•

When the two combine, they can trigger the paradox, taking the cat to unreachable places!

CATO: Buttered Cat revolves around the two main characters, "Cat" and "Buttered Toast." You'll need to use the interactions between them to solve various puzzles at each game level. The full game is featuring over 140 main levels and more than 60 side levels. There are also hidden rooms, challenging boss battles, and fun mini-games. The full version will include an outfit system, with 70+ Cat and Toast skins waiting for you to collect!

CATO: Buttered Cat is an adorable puzzle platformer, inspired by the buttered-cat paradox meme: Cats always land on their feet, and toast always lands buttered side down. By strapping a piece of buttered toast to a cat's back, you create a paradox that results in an infinitely spinning, floating butter-cat perpetual motion machine!

CATO will take you to a brain-teasing adventure, exploring five different worlds, each filled with unique contraptions.

Including toaster(Toast: NO!!)to buttered trampolines and speed-boasting space pipes(Cat: Meow!!). Along the way, the two will also encounter some mysterious companions to help them with puzzles.

The game is about puzzles, with a little action elements. You don't need to perform difficult platforming for most of the time; just focus on solving the puzzles. However, some pesky enemies will be standing in your way during the adventure. Your abilities will help you defeat them.

As you progress through the adventure, you'll also unlock various mini-games. Once collected, these can be installed on the gaming console in your little hideout, allowing you to play them anytime.

In the world of CATO: Buttered Cat, there are many hidden rooms that can only be accessed through secret passages. Here, you can find Easter eggs from other worlds and mysterious drop items.

Take them back to your cozy little hideout, put on your favourite outfit, and set off again!

What exactly is the cat and toast searching for? Pieces of these stories are scattered along the adventure, waiting for you to explore.

About Developer

Team Woll is made up of leading programmer Blasin and leading artist Frank, who met during the BOOOM Gamejam 2022 hosted by GCORES. The positive feedback from the Gamejam project, CATO: Buttered Cat, made us officially establish our studio.

CATO: Buttered Cat is Team Woll's first game, a labour of love that took two years to develop entirely through remote collaboration. We hope you enjoy our game! We also want to express our gratitude to all the friends who have supported us along the way. Our indie game journey has just begun!

About Publisher

GCORES PUBLISHING is an indie game publishing business established by GCORES. In the future, we will continue to bring you outstanding indie games from the BOOOM Game jam. Welcome to our publisher site for more information.

About BOOOM

The BOOOM Game jam is a game development event held twice a year, where participants are given three weeks to develop a game based on a specific theme. After the development phase, we host an online game festival where all players can try out the games, and these games are also showcased at the G-FUSION offline video game carnival.

Welcome to Our Community

Feel free to reach out to us through our community channels to learn more about our game, stay updated, or share feedback or suggestions!

•

Twitter (X): @Cato_TeamWoll

•

YouTube: Cato - Buttered cat paradox game

•

Join our Discord!

title.zh: Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville
title.en: Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville

description.zh: 这是一款剧情跌宕起伏的调查冒险类游戏，结合了指向点击和视觉小说的元素。你扮演摩西和柏拉图，这两个懵懵懂懂的侦探在乘坐著名的豪华列车利爪特快时卷入了一桩疯狂的案件。你本应保护的一位和平大使客户遭到谋杀，而你成了主要嫌疑人！
description.en: A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

body.zh:
这是一款剧情跌宕起伏的调查冒险类游戏，结合了指向点击和视觉小说的元素。你扮演摩西和柏拉图，这两个懵懵懂懂的侦探在乘坐著名的豪华列车利爪特快时卷入了一桩疯狂的案件。你本应保护的一位和平大使客户遭到谋杀，而你成了主要嫌疑人！

成为最机敏的狐狸侦探，与时间赛跑，找出凶手。随着时间的推移，你要找到线索、窃听对话、审问乘客。你能在列车到达终点站之前破案吗？荒野世界两大势力之间的战争一触即发！

特色

•

侦探工作（心灵花园） - 考验你的推理能力。利用你的证据板，将所有线索联系起来。

•

利用你的动物感官寻找线索 - 用你的嗅觉、视觉和听觉，当然还有你如狐狸般敏锐的洞察力，揭开乘客们的秘密。

•

审问嫌疑人 - 12 名旅行者等着与你见面。你很清楚，他们个个心怀鬼胎。

•

探索列车，揭开谜团 - 调查充满秘密和谜团的列车。不放过任何未探索的空间。每节车厢都好像隐藏着什么，就像车厢里的乘客一样。

•

争分夺秒 - 时间不等人！做每件事都需要时间，因此列车到达终点站之前，你应该周全计划你所做的事情！

•

完整英文配音 - 由经验丰富的配音演员阵容献声，将《Wilderness》的世界生动呈现。
body.en:
A story-rich, conversation-heavy investigative visual novel with point & click elements where you play as Moses & Plato, two clueless detectives embroiled in a wild case while traveling on the famous luxury train, the Clawville Express. When the client you are supposed to protect, an ambassador on a peace mission, is murdered, you become the main suspect!

Be the slyest fox detective and find a killer in a race against time. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? If not, war can break out between the two biggest powers of the Wilderness!

Features

•

Investigate - Put your detective skills to the test. Utilize your conspiracy board and connect the suspects while collecting all the clues from them.

•

Use your animal senses - Use your senses of smell, sight, and hearing, and of course your fox cunning, to uncover the secrets of the passengers.

•

Interrogate the suspects - 12 travelers are waiting to meet you, and you know very well that they all hold secrets. Can you figure them out?

•

Explore the train and uncover mysteries - Discover a train full of secrets and mysteries. Each cabin hides something, as do their inhabitants.

•

Race against the clock - Time is not on your side! Certain actions can take up valuable time, so it’s worth thinking twice about who you talk to and when.

•

Premium English voice acting - Features a cast of legendary voice actors that brings the world of Wilderness to life.

"Ladies and gentlemen, all aboard!"

movies.title: Moses & Plato - Gameplay Demo Now Available

description.zh: 在神庙和群岛中寻找失落文明！追随壁虎之神明，自由攀爬高耸遗迹与险峻悬崖，踏上跨越群岛的奇幻旅程！没有固定路线，没有唯一解法，每片洞穴、神庙与隐秘小径都等你亲自探索与解谜。驾驶小木船穿越万千岛屿，聆听古老齿轮的晦涩之声，开启充满惊喜与治愈的冒险吧！
description.en: Explore a forgotten land in Gecko Gods, a puzzle-adventure as a tiny gecko. Climb walls, solve ancient puzzles and uncover a lost civilisation in a world full of hidden paths, quiet secrets and natural wonder.

body.zh:
从一只娇小却灵巧的壁虎视角出发，你将漫步在一片被岁月遗忘的群岛中，踏入高耸的遗迹、幽暗的洞穴与古老神庙！灵活攀爬、低空滑行、穿行于光影间，每一次转角都可能通往新的惊喜。探索的乐趣不在终点，而在于旅途中无数次的意外发现！

没有规定的路线，也没有唯一的解法，你可以完全按照自己的节奏决定冒险的方向！攀爬悬崖、跃过山谷、穿越树冠，甚至随心所欲改变解谜的顺序。每一条隐秘山脊与裂缝都可能藏着新的奇遇，让你真正感受到“世界在脚下，由你丈量”的自由震撼！

群岛中遍布着古老的遗迹与神庙，它们守护着巧妙的谜题与机关。你或许需要引导水流、操纵光线、触发开关，或是借助风、重力、反射来寻找答案。每次灵光乍现、成功破解谜题时，都会带来纯粹的满足感，让你的智慧与想象力得到极致释放！

驾着小木船在岛屿之间滑行，每一次启航都通向未知！或是雾气缭绕的沼泽，或是云雾笼罩的高原，又或是点缀着奇异昆虫的森林。不同的生态与地貌为你构筑出千变万化的旅程，每一次抵达都会让人心潮澎湃！

在这里享受最纯粹的探险喜悦。风吹草木的沙沙声、遗迹深处的空旷回响、阳光洒落在石板上的微光，这些细节都让你沉浸在一个充满生命气息的世界中。每一次停下脚步凝望远方，你都会感受到属于探索者的宁静与力量！
body.en:
Set sail in Gecko Gods; a serene puzzle-adventure platformer where you explore a forgotten archipelago through the eyes of a tiny gecko.

Climb across sunlit ruins, weave through lush caves, and uncover the remnants of an ancient civilisation, all at your own pace. Each path holds something new to discover as you glide between islands on your small wooden boat, every stop offering new puzzles to solve, insects to snack on and secrets to uncover.

Experience a world designed for curiosity and gentle adventure, where movement itself is part of the joy.

Drift across tranquil seas to discover unique landscapes, each with its own atmosphere and hidden life.

Scale walls, ceilings and cliffs with the gecko’s effortless agility.

Delve into ruins and temples filled with intuitive, environmental challenges.

With its relaxing atmosphere and intuitive blend of open-ended exploration and fluid platforming, Gecko Gods invites you to experience the world through entirely new eyes, encouraging curiosity and transforming even the smallest details of its environment into moments of discovery and wonder.

description.zh: 《Feeding the Velociraptors》是一款叙事向恐龙悬疑恐怖喜剧游戏。你将在走廊间四处游荡，一边想要摆脱过往行为带来的罪责，一边还要躲避科学写实的迅猛龙 —— 它们不会追究你的过往过错，但依旧会毫不犹豫地将你吃掉。
description.en: Feeding the Velociraptors is a narrative dinosaur mystery horror comedy where you wander corridors, trying to escape both the blame for your past actions—and the scientifically realistic raptors who cast no blame upon you for said past actions, but will still eat you regardless.

body.zh:
Feeding the Velociraptors is a quirky horror comedy game in that retro horror explore-the-corridors fill-out-the-map style - Most players finish in around 5 hours. It's your fault the raptors have escaped. Everyone wants to use you as a meat shield. Find evidence to shift blame onto someone else.

You are Paul! Working as a low level administrator for the finest theme park to ever host realistic dinosaurs, you have found yourself in quite the pickle. Due to a probable accident on your part, the velociraptors are now loose in the park. They’ve eaten the CEO, the head of security, the head of research, the plucky child hacker and the local game hunter specialist, and now they thirst for even more human flesh.

They’re a lot less scarier than what we know of raptors from those movies, but the little ankle biters can still shred your ankles to pieces using their biting ability.

The only thing keeping you alive is the Administrative building’s lock-down system. Unfortunately, due to other factors that were probably an accident on your part, that system is running out of power. There's little food, no communications and little time left before the raptors get in.

Your only hope is the helicopter on the other side of the perfectly safe scenic woods. If the five of you can get to it, you’ll be good, but there’s no way the raptors won’t notice you.

The only option left is a sacrifice. One of you must distract the raptors long enough for the others to get to the helicopter. Lucky for your lack of debating skills, everyone else already talked it over when you were on break, and they’ve decided on your behalf that you should be the one to make this honorable sacrifice.

You have an hour before your noble sacrifice. Take this time to wander the building, reflect on your life, and think about how you got into this situation.

Do not attempt to escape.

A quick note: While this game isn't meant to be horror, it does contain some cartoonish gore and violence. If that’s not your thing, no worries—give it a try, and refund if it’s not for you. I hope you enjoy it.

Includes

•

Explore the stunning complex of Cretaceous Corners, a legally distinct Dinosaur theme park.

•

Around 40 hand-drawn areas to wander through.

•

A colourful cast of characters, not to mention dinosaurs.

•

You were not to blame for the thing that you did. Find evidence to shift the blame to one of your peers, and then present your findings to that same group of peers, who will then judge you.

•

Solve interactive puzzles to progress further into the game. Do not attempt to escape.

•

At least five endings, all different from the other. The phrasing just then implies there are other endings. It turns out there are.

•

There is a bigger mystery here. One no one is willing to explore. It is not up to you to discover the truth. Only survival is important.

•

Do not attempt to escape.

•

Around five hours of gameplay. More if you play for longer. That how time works!

description.zh: 这是一款以猫咪为主角的2D横版剧情解谜游戏。游戏发生在一幢别墅中，你将扮演一只初入家中的猫咪，结识性格各异的动物同伴，与它们互助、同行，解开一个个难题，最终化解家中的危机。
description.en: This is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle game with a cat as the main character. The game takes place in a villa, where you play as a cat that has just entered the house. You meet animals with different personalities, solve one problem after another, and finally resolve the crisis at home.

body.zh:
从昏迷中醒来的那一刻起，猫咪大橘的猫生就被彻底改写了。初入这幢神秘的别墅，便遭遇家主“老大”离奇失踪事件。共处一室性格各异的动物伙伴们竟然还个个能说会道，明显有着超越普通动物的智慧。

“等等，怎么我也变得这么聪明了？”

"老大"失踪后，别墅的生活设施停摆。大橘决定与结识的新伙伴共同努力，让“家”重归平静。你将与其它动物小伙伴协作，获得各种线索，用四只灵活的爪子在房间里上下翻腾，开动猫咪的敏锐头脑解决谜题，探索隐藏在各个角落的秘密和真相。

“老大”在家中设置了一堆独特的解谜挑战——涉及了搜寻、观察、逻辑推理、解读文字和寻找路线多种维度。聪明的大橘只需冷静观察和缜密思考，便可手到擒来。

你的任务是恢复家中生活设施的运行和破解“老大”失踪之谜，顺便揣测一下：“老大”不会是把自己家当成谍战片的拍摄现场了吧？！

是的，拥有十几个房间的大别墅里藏着太多秘密！每个房间都有独特的场景和重重谜题，你永远不知道下一个房间里会有什么惊喜——或是更多时候是麻烦，但这些都不可能阻挡你这只爱探险的小猫咪。

用猫猫的视角沉浸式探索，这个奇妙的世界等待你一探究竟。

这幢别墅并不只是一个谜题游戏场，它更是大家共同的“家”，每个房间都讲述着“家”的不同面貌。

通过解谜与探索，你会逐渐拼凑出老大和动物们的故事：他是如何建立这个家园，又为何离开。而最终的谜底或许不仅仅是“老大在哪”，而是关于你与伙伴们之间的羁绊。

在探索别墅的过程中，你将获知"老大"不辞而别的原因，同时也会发现这个家中的秘密正在慢慢复苏。

最终，你会解开一个个谜团，找到老大。或者……至少找到一些答案。因为你有一种奇怪的预感，“老大”对你来说似乎并不陌生……

你准备好度过一段不平凡的猫生，与动物伙伴们一起奏响冒险与智慧的交响曲了吗？
body.en:
From the moment of waking up from a coma, the life of the cat Orange was completely rewritten. Upon entering this mysterious villa, Orange encounters the bizarre disappearance of the homeowner, "Boss." The animal companions living under the same roof, each with distinct personalities, can all speak and clearly possess wisdom beyond that of ordinary animals.

"Wait, how did I become so smart too?"

After "Boss" goes missing, the villa's living facilities come to a standstill. Orange decides to work with the new companions to restore calm to the "home." You will collaborate with other animal friends, gather clues, use your four nimble paws to climb up and down the rooms, and employ the sharp mind of a cat to solve puzzles and explore the secrets and truths hidden in every corner.

"Boss" set up a series of unique puzzle challenges at home—covering search, observation, logical reasoning, text interpretation, and route finding. The clever Orange just needs to observe calmly and think meticulously to solve them effortlessly.

Your task is to restore the operation of the home's living facilities and unravel the mystery of "Boss's" disappearance, while also speculating: "Boss" didn't turn his own home into a spy movie set, did he?!

Yes, the large villa with more than a dozen rooms hides too many secrets! Each room has a unique scene and a series of puzzles. You never know what surprise—or more often, trouble—lies in the next room, but none of this can stop you, the adventurous little cat.

Immersing yourself in exploration from a cat's perspective, this fantastic world awaits your discovery.

The villa is not just a puzzle game venue; it is also everyone's "home," with each room telling a different aspect of "home."

Through solving puzzles and exploration, you will gradually piece together the stories of "Boss" and the animals: how he built this home and why he left. And the final mystery may not just be "where is Boss," but about the bond between you and your companions.

As you explore the villa, you will learn the reasons for "Boss's" sudden departure and also discover that the secrets of this home are slowly awakening.

Ultimately, you will unravel the mysteries one by one, find "Boss," or at least find some answers. Because you have a strange premonition that "Boss" seems strangely familiar to you...

Are you ready to live an extraordinary cat life, to play the symphony of adventure and wisdom with your animal companions?

description.zh: 🦊 《Astra: Ardent Show》是一款成人向视觉小说。故事围绕一位迷人却叛逆的兽人狐耳公主展开，她逃离王国，踏上追寻自由的旅途。你将揭开过往的秘密，遇见这座岛屿上奇特的居民，并做出抉择，决定这位顽皮公主的最终命运。🦊
description.en: 🦊 Astra: Ardent Show is a adult visual novel about a charming but rebellious furry fox princess who escaped her kingdom in search of freedom. Uncover the secrets of the past, meet the island's unusual inhabitants, and make a choice that will determine the fate of the naughty princess. 🦊

body.en:
Astra: Ardent Show is a NSFW visual novel about a bold and charming furry princess who decides to write her own destiny and completely changed her life.

Astra had it all: a title of heir, a huge, beautiful castle, and a noble husband. But this perfect picture was missing the most important thing: freedom. One day, she abandons everything and escapes to a remote island, where she finds friends and turns her life into a vibrant show by becoming a traveling performer!

But you can't escape the past when the entire kingdom is searching for the missing heir. Marquis Saffron arrives on warships with his loyal soldiers to reclaim his lawful wife, and he won't be stopped by neither persuasion nor weapons. Now Astra must make a choice that will determine not only her own freedom but the fate of two islands!

Game features:

✨ 14 animated and voiced hot sex scenes

✨ Various types of genitals (furry or vanilla)

✨ 14 sweet ERO cards

✨ 24 characters, Furry and Humans, all hand-drawn by brave artists 🥰

✨ 8 amazing comic-style cutscenes

✨ Mini-games of your choice — combat or puzzles, pick what suits your spirit

✨ And of course, the story of our fox heroine 🦊

description.zh: 准备好成为疯狂科学家了吗？在你专属的实验室中合成、进化并指挥独特的怪物大军。管理实验室，掌控遗传精华，在这款深度的怪物收集模拟器中统治战斗竞技场！
description.en: Ready to become a mad scientist? Synthesize, evolve, and command an army of unique creatures in your own lab. Manage your laboratory, master genetic essences, and dominate the battle arena in this deep creature collection simulator!

body.zh:
满足你的科学探知欲

《怪物实验室模拟器》带来了合成与战术战斗的快感。每一次实验都是一个惊喜，每一个配方都是发现传奇的机会。你准备好管理世界上最先进的怪物实验室了吗？

购买神秘精华，合成怪兽蛋，并在孵化器中完成培养，创造出独一无二的 Fulu。

通过组合不同的精华来探索神秘配方。获取惊喜 Fulu 并充实你的终极收藏。

传奇 Fulu 之战即将开启。组建你的战队，在作战室中占据一席之地。

使用宝珠封印你的 Fulu 并将它们加入收藏。这些宝珠将构成你的强大战斗军团。

出售封印的 Fulu 并重新投资购买新设备。扩张实验室，加速生产，获得更强大的 Fulu。

使用融合机器将三个 Fulu 合并。解锁更强的技能、更高的精华产量以及全新的战斗策略。

管教顽皮的 Fulu，在它们捣乱时严加看管，确保你的实验室始终是一个让生物感到快乐和健康的家园。

你的运气如何？转动幸运杠杆，赢取强化 Fulu 的惊喜奖励。

从特殊琥珀中获得稀有怪兽蛋。融化琥珀，寻找隐藏在其中的蛋。

在战斗中疲惫的 Fulu 会在匹配其元素的栖息地中恢复。将它们放置在合适的元素区域以保持它们的心情愉悦。

《怪物实验室模拟器》在属于你自己的实验室中，完美融合了合成与战斗的快感、收集的乐趣以及探索未知的魔力。

其他特色：

•

20 个独特的 Fulu 家族 – 在实验室中探索 20 种不同的 Fulu 血统！

•

技能与元素 – 针对不同家族和元素设计的 80 种独特技能！

•

订单管理 – 关注订单屏幕，通过满足市场需求来强化你的实验室经济。

•

待探索的新区域 – 提升等级以解锁实验室的深处区域。

•

助手清洁机器人 – 终结实验室的混乱；让时尚而勤奋的清洁机器人加入你的团队。

•

每日与每周任务 – 实验室每天都有新的挑战等待着你！

•

最后；一双眼睛…… – 小心实验室里那些一直在注视着你的眼睛。
body.en:
FUEL YOUR SCIENTIFIC CURIOSITY

Monster Lab Simulator delivers the thrill of synthesis and tactical battle. Every experiment is a surprise, and every recipe is a chance to discover something legendary. Are you ready to manage the world's most advanced monster lab?

Purchase mysterious essences, synthesize eggs, and complete their growth in the incubator to bring unique Fulus to life.

Discover hidden recipes by combining various essences. Obtain surprise Fulus and expand your ultimate collection.

Legendary Fulu Battles are about to begin. Prepare your squad and take your place in the war room.

Capture your Fulus with orbs and add them to your collection. These orbs will form your elite battle army.

Sell your orbed Fulus and reinvest to acquire new high-tech products. Expand your lab, accelerate production, and obtain even more powerful Fulus.

Merge three Fulus using the evolution machine. Unlock stronger abilities, higher essence yields, and brand-new tactical combat options.

Keep mischievous Fulus out of trouble, watch over them when they get naughty, and ensure your lab is always a happy, healthy environment for your creatures.

How lucky are you? Spin the lucky lever and win surprises to power up your Fulus.

Obtain special eggs from ancient ambers. Melt the ambers and reveal the eggs hidden within.

Fulus exhausted from battle regenerate in habitats matching their elements. Keep them happy by placing them in the correct elemental zones.

Monster Lab Simulator combines the thrill of synthesis and combat with the joy of collecting and the magic of discovering the unknown—all within your very own monster laboratory.

Other Features:

•

20 Unique Fulu Families – Discover 20 different Fulu lineages in your lab!

•

Abilities & Elements – 80 distinct abilities tailored to specific Fulu families and elements!

•

Order Management – Monitor the order screen and boost your economy by meeting market demands.

•

New Areas to Explore – Level up to unlock deep sections of the laboratory. Upgrade your facility, enhance machinery, and maintain hygiene.

•

Assistant Trash Robot – End the lab clutter; add the stylish and hardworking trash robot to your team.

•

Daily & Weekly Missions – New laboratory tasks await you every single day!

Finally; A Pair of Eyes… – Beware of the eyes that are constantly watching you in the lab.

movies.title: Monster Lab Simulator - Early Access Trailer

description.zh: 《白书传说》是一款有着冒险要素的互动小说游戏，在由犬族统治的战乱的末世中，主角石烬为了生存成为了一个土匪，在一次打劫的行动中，自己遇到了恐怖的正规军，而在自己全军覆没之后，他被要挟去执行一项奇怪的任务，正是这个任务解开了被犬族尘封的过去的历史，也展开了一场紧张的逃命之旅......
description.en: 《The Shu Legend》 is an interactive adventure novel. In an apocalypse ruled by the Dog Clan, bandit Shi Jin is forced by a terrifying army to undertake a mysterious mission after his squad is wiped out. This quest unravels the clan's buried history, sparking a tense fight for survival...

body.zh:
《白书传说》是一款以历史与记忆为主题的视觉小说游戏，故事发生在一个由犬族统治的末世的时代，

经年的战乱导致了时局动荡以及饥荒问题，主角石烬就在这样的时代中随波逐流成为了一个劫匪，

然而在一次抢劫任务中却无意间遇到了一件改变自己命运的事件，而整件事情，揭示了一个被犬族掩埋的历史真相。

游戏由10个小章节构成，总时长约3小时，共46张cg
body.en:
The Shu Legend is a visual novel exploring history and memory. In a Dog Clan-ruled apocalypse plagued by war and famine, the bandit Shi Jin drifts through life. A routine robbery sparks a fateful event, unveiling a dark historical truth long buried by the clan.

The game consists of 10 short chapters with a total playtime of about 3 hours and features 46 CGs.

Parts of the English translation were assisted by AI; player discretion is advised for the best experience.

description.zh: Beastro《欢迎光临》！在这趟奇幻与冒险交织的旅途之中，并不是所有主人公都是手持刀剑……有些手上更爱拿着汤勺。而且，有时候要想拯救世界，需要先美餐一顿。
description.en: Beastro is a cozy culinary adventure where the fate of the world rests on what's for dinner! Farm and gather fresh ingredients, tackle cooking minigames, and create tasty recipes to fuel the Caretakers for deckbuilding battles as they seek to save the world.

body.zh:
帕洛泼里这个地方祥和又美丽，这里住着许多工匠和大厨。村子的围墙之外，黑暗已经开始涌动，凶“饿”的怪物占领了这片土地，虎视眈眈，盯着世间仅存的这一片乐土。

化身年轻的天才厨师潘可，帮忙经营本地的餐馆。潘可的师父失踪之后，村里来了一个神秘客人，警告大家外面已是危机四伏。潘可必须担起责任，接下餐馆，打理食材，招待常来的客人。不仅如此，潘可还要接待勇敢的护界勇士，他们肩负拯救世界的使命。这个冒险游戏中，维护和平的任务从厨房开始！

帕洛泼里的人最在意食材新鲜不新鲜！采集食材和资源，饲养家畜，自己种瓜果蔬菜，打造属于你的温馨小馆。外出采摘野生植物，还能解锁新的种子，丰富店里的菜品。

各种小游戏让人口水不止，体验煎炒烹炸的乐趣，为乡亲做出美味佳肴。美食总是要有人分享才更有味道，所以努力提升厨艺，尝试新的做法，才能吸引客人，令他们满意。

根据乡亲的口味，调整餐馆的经营思路，开发新的菜品，通过技能树提升你的水平，调整内装还能提升店里的吸引力。

你还要为饥肠辘辘的护界勇士供应餐食，这些勇敢的战士来自不同的风味地区，将舍命深入荒野，对付凶饿的怪物，维护帕洛泼里的安宁。护界勇士的风味地区不同，口味和偏好也就不同，有些喜欢吃苦，有些喜欢吃甜，还有些只想填饱肚子！精心搭配菜肴，平衡餐食的风味，以便他们振奋精神，强化技能，解锁新的能力。毕竟，说实话……不论是谁，饿着肚子，都不可能拯救世界！

现在该看看你做的东西怎么样了！护界勇士吃进肚子的不只是食物，也是战斗策略。你供应的餐食会成为他们的牌组，每种食材会解锁一张牌。他们饱餐之后，就会深入荒野对付怪物。他们回来之后，会讲述冒险途中的见闻，还会在有趣的木偶小剧场重现战斗的情景，有时还会带回匪夷所思的食材。战斗采用回合制牌组构筑玩法，参考了传统吃墩牌类游戏的规则。运用相应的风味魔法压制怪物，或用克制的魔法抵消怪物的风味魔法。会有增强牌可以提升招式的威力！你的魔法可以逆转战局！

活用食材的独特效果，比如令敌人入睡，吹飞对手的牌等等等等。不过千万当心，对手也有特殊能力，不小心的话，也有可能被打个措手不及。

走进这场以食物为主题的奇幻冒险，用厨艺“食”现和平！准备好下厨了吗？

解锁食物的神奇魔法吧。
body.en:
Palo Pori is a beautiful and peaceful village of artisans and tastemakers. Beyond the village’s protective wall, darkness has begun to stir. Ravenous monsters have claimed the land and threaten to sink their teeth into this final morsel of hope and happiness.

Play as Panko, a young, talented chef, helping to run the local eatery. When Panko’s teacher goes missing, a mysterious visitor arrives with warnings of the dangers beyond the wall. It's up to Panko to step up and take over the restaurant and tend to the ingredients and patrons. But that’s not all, Panko also finds himself serving the Caretakers, brave adventurers, sent to save the world. In this adventure, preserving peace starts in the kitchen!

In Palo Pori, fresh is best! Gather ingredients and resources, care for animals and grow your own fruit and veg to build up your very own cozy town to table restaurant. Forage for wild herbs and unlock new seeds to grow to expand your meals.

Chop, flip, and sizzle your way through mouthwatering mini-games as you whip up delightful dishes for the townsfolk. Good food is always better with company, so work hard to improve your cooking and experiment with ingredients, to keep your patrons happy.

Tailor your restaurant to the tastes of your community, develop new meals, progress your know how through a skill tree and adjust the decor to increase your restaurant’s appeal.

You’ll also need to feed the hungry Caretakers; these brave denizens of the land will venture out into the wilds to fight the ravenous monsters threatening the peace of Palo Pori. Each Caretaker hails from their own flavour region, affecting their own tastes and preferences: some like it bitter, some like it sweet and some are just looking to fulfil their craving of the day! Craft thoughtful meals and balance the flavour profiles to boost their spirits, sharpen their skills, and unlock new abilities. Because let’s face it… Who can save the world on an empty stomach?

Now it’s time to put your meal to the test! This is where taste meets tactics. The dishes you serve will build your Caretaker’s deck – each ingredient unlocking a card. And once they’ve eaten, they’ll venture into the wilds to fight the monsters. Upon their return, they’ll recount their journey and play out their battles through a charming puppet theatre sequence. They might even bring you back some MONSTEROUS ingredients from their ventures. Fight the monsters in turn-based deck building combat, inspired by traditional trick-taking card games. Outplay the monsters, by matching their flavour magic or neutralising it with a balancing card. Add an enhancing card to power up your moves! Your magic can turn the tables!

Utilize the unique effects of your ingredients to put your enemies to sleep, blow away their cards, and more, but watch out, you’re not the only one with special abilities. If you’re not paying attention, you might get burned.

In this food-based fantasy adventure, it’s time to give peas a chance! - Are you ready to get cooking?

Unlock the magic in food.

description.zh: 《命途》是一款2D风格多结局的日式RPG。游戏中，根据玩家选择的不同，主人公的【执念】乃至性格和想法也会随之发生改变。游戏的结局也会随着你所选择的“命途”而变化。
description.en: The Use of Life is a multi-ending adventure book style JRPG. The main character’s various attachments change in accordance with the choices the player makes, and the ending changes depending on “the use of life” you choose through your journey.

body.zh:
《命途》是一款2D风格多结局的日式RPG。

■结局会因你选择的“命途”而改变游戏中，根据玩家选择的不同，主人公的【执念】乃至性格和想法也会随之发生改变。游戏的结局也会随着你所选择的“命途”而变化。

主人公自己的【生命】是为自己而使用、还是用于帮助他人，都全凭玩家自行决定。最终会根据玩家对于【生命】用法的选择迎来不同的结局，但并不存在传统意义上的【好结局】或是【坏结局】。

■ 以【静&动】为主题的刺激战斗本作的战斗玩法，以“回合制战斗的策略性”与“QTE的动作性”相结合为特征。

敌我双方在1回合内会各自进行3次行动，在【如何应对敌人的强力攻击？】、【如何最有效地使用大招？】等等细节上，玩家的行动战略会直接影响战斗胜负。

这次没能战胜的敌人，在多次挑战后逐渐明白攻略方法最终成功打倒。特别是在BOSS战时，克服生死一线的紧张感，本作的目的便是让玩家在打败强力BOSS后能够获得巨大的成就感。

■独特的事件机制游戏过程中也加入了很多独特的随机事件，包括像TRPG里那样通过掷骰子来判定结果的事件。

哪怕是同一个事件，根绝玩家做出的决策以及判定结果不同，导致的结局也会大不一样。

安全而谨慎地行动、亦或是一路蛮力突破，都全凭玩家的喜好，同时这些行动也会影响到主人公后续的思考方式。

■丰富的角色成长系统主人公通过诅咒获得了超乎寻常的力量，通过一次次死战积累经验来强化自己喜欢的属性。不同的属性提升会为主人公在不同的能力上带来加强，这不仅仅体现在战斗中，对探索时事件也会产生很大影响。

另外，在升级后你可以对各个职业进行强化，进而习得多种多样的技能。

----------------------------------------------------------------

・用纯粹的物理斩击将敌人一刀两断的【战士】

・追求暴击率来进行瞬间超高爆发的【武士】

・咏唱魔法来战斗、追求高风险高回报的【法师】

・用各种附带异常状态的攻击将敌人玩弄于股掌的【巫师】

----------------------------------------------------------------

等等，选择不同的技能升级路线，体验迥异的战斗吧。

■“新感觉”JRPG本作可以算是一款JRPG游戏，但并不是“传统意义上的”JPRG。我们的目标是打造一款能让玩家感到：“原来还有这种进化方式”的“新感觉”JRPG。
body.en:
The Use of Life is a multi-ending adventure book style RPG.

A Story Influenced by Your Use of LifeIn this game, your choices as the player will influence Goshe, the main character, as well as his thoughts and various attachments in life, represented by flames.

Whether Goshe uses his life for his own selfish purposes or sacrifices himself to help others is entirely up to you. The endings of this game are simply the conclusions of the various ways of life, and there are no "Good" or "Bad" endings.

Tense Battles that Balance Stasis and ActionThe Use of Life features unique battles that combine the strategy of a turn-based battle system with the quick reflexes and action of a QTE system.

Each turn, both you and your enemy get to choose 3 actions, which you then take turns to perform. How will you deal with the enemy's upcoming flurry of attacks? How will you time your own attacks to deal the most damage? Your skill and strategy will determine the outcome of battle.

Even if you can't defeat an enemy, the game is designed so that you will gradually figure out how to deal with them and win. Boss battles are especially tense, where you frequently have to toe the line between life and death, and we strive to deliver the highest satisfaction you can possibly get after defeating a strong enemy.

Adventure Book Style EventsEvents in this game are narrated in an adventure book style, and some events come with TRPG-esque dice rolls that determine the event's outcome.

The same event will play out differently depending on your choices and the dice roll results.

You can choose to proceed cautiously and choose the safest options, or bravely throw yourself into every opportunity for battle you come across—it's all up to you, and your actions will affect Goshe's personality.

CustomizationGoshe, the main character, obtains incredible power through a certain Curse. Through encounters with death, he can gain experience which can be used to strengthen his own abilities.

Not only will you gain different advantages in battle depending on what abilities you choose to invest in, but the outcome of events outside of battle can also be heavily influenced by your stats.

On top of that, by leveling up and unlocking new levels for the various classes, you can learn a wide variety of Skills and Spells to use in battle.

----------------------------------------------------------------

・The "Fighter" carves up enemies with pure physical attack power and a high number of moves

・The "Samurai" unleashes unabashed power with Iai and lands fierce critical strikes

・The "Mage" specializes in high-risk, high-reward super-firepower using incantations and Spells

・The "Sorcerer" toys with their opponent by utilizing special attacks, including some that cause status ailments

----------------------------------------------------------------

A myriad of fighting styles can be utilized depending on the class you choose to upgrade.

A “Good-New" Type of JRPGWhile this title is technically a JRPG, we are not aiming for a "good old JRPG" style, but rather a "good 'new' JRPG" style, in hopes of showing that this kind of evolution is absolutely possible.

description.zh: 《King of Bones》是一款快节奏的恐龙格斗游戏，采用基于物理驱动、讲究技巧的战斗系统。你可以通过冲刺、闪避、践踏、头槌与猛击等方式，在多种独特的游戏模式中操控二十多种各具特色的物种展开战斗，努力称霸竞技场。
description.en: King of Bones is a fast-paced dinosaur fighting game with physics-driven skill-based combat. Dash, dodge, stomp, headbutt, and smash your way through multiple unique game modes and over two dozen unique species as you fight to dominate the arena.

body.zh:
Tear into an action packed dinosaur arena brawler where you engage in non-stop life or death fights that will push your abilities to their limits. King of Bones delivers physics-driven skill-based combat that carries the full weight and impact of prehistoric creatures. Dash, dodge, stomp, headbutt, and smash your way through multiple game modes and over two dozen unique species as you battle to become king of the Jurassic world.

PHYSICS DRIVEN COMBAT

Vicious raptors will pounce and cling to your body. A charging triceratops can send you flying. Every part of the fighting system was designed to replicate the look and feel of these deadly titans clashing. Fights will be fast-paced and messy, enemies will struggle till the very end.

MULTIPLE GAME MODES

•

Arcade

•

King of the Hill

•

Onslaught

•

Ascension

•

Spectator

Survive free-for-all deathmatches in King of the Hill. Hatch from an egg and fight every dinosaur in the game while growing into a towering giant in Ascension. Fight non stop waves with ever increasing numbers in Onslaught. Or setup custom fights and sit back and watch the action in the Spectator mode.

MASSIVE SPECIES ROSTER

With 30 unique species to play as the arena will challenge you in different ways as each species has their own fighting style. Get crushed by an Ankylosaur's tail swings. Send dinosaurs flying with the Pachycephalosaur's headbutt. Every dinosaur is dangerous in its own way.

EIGHT UNIQUE ARENAS

Battle it out in gorgeous expansive arenas representing a broad range of biomes. Beware of various dangers and difficulties with some arenas having unique environmental hazards that modify gameplay.

REALTIME PHYSICALLY SIMULATED BODIES

Using the latest Unreal Engine tools the dinosaurs' physical bodies are constantly simulated in the world which means every bite, headbutt, and stomp interact properly with each other.

WEAPONS AND ENVIRONMENTAL DANGERS

Grab a nearby log or bone to wield against your foe. Get blasted through the air by a high powered geyser hidden beneath the foggy waters. Or use your last kill's tail to bash your next kill. King of Bones will let you engage in all sorts of crazy carnage you've only ever imagined.

SPECTATOR AND PHOTOGRAPHY MODE

Dishing out the damage not really your thing? Setup teams with dinosaurs of your choosing and watch AI battle it out while you spectate the action. Take photos, control the speed of time, and get a front row seat on the carnage.

INCREDIBLE ATTENTION TO DETAIL

Subtle breathing of your dinosaur, dynamic stances, real-time body controls, detailed animations and so much more breathe unbelievable life into the dinosaurs. Leaves move beneath your feet and blow to the wind with a mighty roar. The small details are what makes this an experience like no other.

GORE AND DISMEMBERMENT

Rip the flesh of your prey to shreds and consume every last bit of them. Fully dismemberable and simulated bodies mean you can make the most of your meal. The scars and wounds of battle and each bite taken out of you will all be readily visible.

King of Bones is a bold attempt at pushing forward the combat mechanics in the dinosaur simulation genre. Expect non-stop high impact straight up fights for your life. In this prehistoric world... death finds a way.

description.zh: 《Tiny Treats》是一款紧张刺激的第一人称潜行平台游戏，而你只有几英寸高！你需要在多样化的环境中悄悄潜行、攀爬前进，解开谜题，并避免被那些正常体型的人发现！谁知道一旦他们看见你，会发生什么呢……
description.en: Tiny Treats is a tense first-person stealth platformer where you are only a few inches tall! Sneak and climb your way around varied environments, solve puzzles and avoid being seen by the normal-sized people! Who knows what could happen when they see you...

body.en:
OH NO!

Looks like you have had an accident in the lab which has resulted in you being only a few inches tall!

Let's hope nobody will take advantage of your current situation!

Welcome to Tiny Treats!

The vore-themed first-person action stealth game!

Run and duck from cover to cover as you try to find all the parts required to become regular-sized again!

>First-person stealth-focused gameplay

>8 playable levels, including an interactive tutorial

>Many items with many uses

>Metroidvania-style progression system

>Secrets and collectables to find

Many varied levels to explore from your tiny point of view in a non-linear fashion!

Explore laboratories, apartments and ventilation ducts in your search for the pieces of the teleportation device, all while trying your best to not be found by their inhabitants... or else...

Many vore and size-focused scenes ranging from oral vore to unbirth!

Rude preds and friendly ones!

Something to enjoy for everyone!

description.zh: 在黑夜中生存下来。扮演狼人 Frank，在一场以波次推进的笼斗生存战中奋战。撕裂并横扫整间便利店，抵御一整支机械化雇佣兵步兵排的进攻。
description.en: Survive the night. Play as Frank the Werewolf for a wave based cage fight for survival. Tear through a convenience store to fend off a mechanized infantry platoon of mercenaries.

body.zh:
Frank is having a bad night, he's a Werewolf just trying to get by.

He's cornered in a convenience store by a platoon of Hunters, a secretive Mercenary group hell bent on exterminating the Lycan kind.

They've been tracking Frank for weeks and now they have him right where they want him, silver bullets in the chamber, but he's not dead yet.

A short, blood soaked beat'em'up. Survive the night, featuring the music of DEgITx.

FEATURES:

-Progressive destruction: Tear through enemies and helpless inanimate produce as the store gets more and more messed up over the course of your battle.

-A ludicrous amount of physics objects and particle effects, nearly every item in the store can be displaced.

-Move quickly throughout the store, dodging enemy fire and ambushing your attackers.

-Quickly chain attacks together for ultimate carnage, score 50 kills to survive the night.

description.zh: 恋爱 × 喜剧 × 兽人 —— 一款轻松治愈的视觉小说。
description.en: Romance, comedy, and furrys— all wrapped in Diary of Summer Travel.

body.zh:
关于此游戏

《金泉风土记》是一款轻松愉快的男性同性向兽人主题恋爱视觉小说游戏，融合了恋爱浪漫与喜剧元素。

故事

在暑假刚开始的夜晚，男大学生主人公突然来到了一个陌生的、异世界的城市。在这里，他将与形形色色的兽人们相识、相伴，并编织出一段段温馨又欢乐的故事。本该平凡的假期，逐渐演变成一段难以忘怀的旅程。

玩法

•

经典视觉小说模式：通过阅读剧情、享受丰富的对话分支。

•

隐藏式好感度系统：通过选择与互动，逐步提升角色好感度。

•

多条路线与多结局：玩家的选择将决定最终走向。

轻喜剧氛围与浪漫交织，为各位带来一段轻松愉快的体验。

特色

由鲁师傅同时担任美术与编剧，负责立绘CG的设计和剧情的编排。

可攻略角色共3名，单人线全程约3小时。

男性同性兽人向题材，日常与异样感结合的奇妙氛围。

如果你喜欢兽人、恋爱故事以及幽默的日常戏，《金泉风土记》将为你带来一段清新的夏日冒险。
body.en:
About This Game

Diary of Summer Travel is a lighthearted BL-themed visual novel featuring furry characters, romance, and comedy.

Story

On one ordinary summer night, the protagonist (the Player) — a young college student — suddenly finds himself transported into an unfamiliar town inhabited by furries. What was supposed to be a normal summer vacation soon turns into an unforgettable journey filled with laughter, encounters, and unexpected bonds.

Gameplay

•

Classic visual novel structure: read through branching storylines and enjoy rich dialogue.

•

Romance system: build relationships with different characters by raising their affection.

•

Multiple routes and endings depending on your choices.

A mix of lighthearted comedy and romantic moments to balance the story tone.

Features

Character art and CG illustrations created by Luken.

A short yet complete story, perfect for a relaxing play session.

Furry BL theme with a warm, slice-of-life atmosphere.

If you enjoy furry characters, romance, and charming everyday stories, Diary of Summer Travel will bring you a refreshing summer adventure.

description.zh: 《黑神话：悟空》是一款以中国神话为背景的动作角色扮演游戏。你将扮演一位“天命人”，为了探寻昔日传说的真相，踏上一条充满危险与惊奇的西游之路。
description.en: Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.

body.zh:
《黑神话：悟空》是一款以中国神话为背景的动作角色扮演游戏。故事取材于中国古典小说“四大名著”之一的《西游记》。你将扮演一位“天命人”，为了探寻昔日传说的真相，踏上一条充满危险与惊奇的西游之路。

• 雄奇壮丽，光怪陆离别有世间曾未见，一行一步一花新。欢迎来到亦真亦幻的东方魔幻世界！

天命人将前往多个引人入胜又风格迥异的西游故地，再次谱写前所未见的冒险史诗。

• 妖魔鬼怪，卷土重来行者名声大，魔王手段强。《西游记》的一大看点，便是各有所长的厉害妖怪。

西行的旅途并非只有风光旖旎，天命人还将遭遇许多强大的敌人与可敬的对手，与他们豪快战斗，至死方休。

• 山摇地动，各显神通炼就长生多少法，学来变化广无边。五光十色又相生相克的法术、变化与法宝，一直都是中国神话中最为招牌的战斗要素。

天命人除了精通不同棍术，更可自由搭配多样化的法术、变化、天赋、武器与披挂，找到最契合自身战斗风格的制胜之道。

• 千形万象，荡气回肠六般体相六般兵，六样形骸六样情。敌人的凶恶狡猾只是表象，他们的来历、个性与动机，往往更加耐人寻味。

天命人在战斗之外，也会探寻各色人物背后的故事，了解他们的爱与恨，贪与嗔，前世与今生。
body.en:
Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. The story is based on Journey to the West, one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.

• Explore a Land of Vast Wonders

"A world unseen, where wonders gleam,

And with each stride, a new scene streams."

Enter a fascinating realm filled with the wonders and discoveries of ancient Chinese mythology!

As the Destined One, you shall traverse an array of breathtaking and distinctive landscapes from the classic tale, composing an epic of adventure that is seen anew.

• Confront Mighty Foes, Old and New

"Heroic Monkey, might and fame,

Adversaries rise, to test his name."

One of the major highlights of Journey to the West is its diverse cast of adversaries, each with their unique strengths.

As the Destined One, you will encounter powerful foes and worthy rivals throughout your journey. Fearlessly engage them in epic battles where surrender is not an option.

• Temper Your Mastery of Varied Spells

"Spells unbound, talents in play,

Unleashed abilities seize the day."

Spells, transformations, and magic vessels of all manifestations, in which some counteract while others amplify, have long been iconic combat elements of Chinese mythology.

As the Destined One, aside from mastering various staff techniques, you can also freely combine different spells, abilities, weapons, and equipment to find a winning strategy that best suits your combat style.

• Discover Heartfelt Tales Behind Every Facade

"Within all souls, both wild and tame,

There thrives a tale of life's fierce flame."

Beneath the ferocity and craftiness of your foes lies an engaging tapestry of their origins, personalities, and motivations waiting to be revealed.

As the Destined One, you will uncover the stories behind a variety of characters, delving beyond your battles with them to taste the love, hate, greed, and fury they once held and still carry within.

movies.title: 《黑神话：悟空》发售日预告 | The Game Awards 2023
Black Myth: Wukong Gameplay | Gamescom ONL 2023

description.zh: 这是一款点击式冒险游戏，你将带领 Drok'tar 穿越 Gabranth 小镇及其周边地区，寻找自己的悬赏目标。一路上，你会遇到形形色色的角色；如果你做出正确的选择，还将有机会与其中一些角色展开更加暧昧、充满情欲色彩的互动。
description.en: This is a point and click adventure where you lead Drok'tar through the town of Gabranth and its surrounding areas while looking for his bounty. You'll meet a slew of characters along with way, and if you play your cards right, you'll find yourself in more... erotic situations with some of them.

body.en:
Follow an orc mercenary as he tracks down his next target. Drok'tar is no newbie to his work, but the bounty he's looking for can be elusive. He'll have to gather information from the townsfolk and hunt for clues in the surrounding area if he wants to rake in the gold from a job well done. Though, he might find more than just his bounty on his quest...

This is a point and click adventure where you lead Drok'tar through the town of Gabranth and its surrounding areas while looking for his bounty. You'll meet a slew of characters along with way, and if you play your cards right, you'll find yourself in more... erotic situations with some of them.

- Explore a colorful, pixelated environment with only a click of your mouse while on your search.

- Meet a fun cast of characters that populate the small village of Gabranth.

- Search for clues on how to find your target before you lose him.

- Bob around with the wonderfully-charming chiptune soundtrack.

- Maybe find romance in one of the five possible endings.

- 20+ Achievements!

- PET THE DOG!

Can you find your bounty? Will you lose out to someone else? Or will something more happen?

Estimated 2-4 hours of gameplay with good reasons to play through multiple times (you have to get all the endings, right?).

description.zh: 在广阔的世界中收集神奇的生物“帕鲁”，派他们进行战斗、建造、做农活，工业生产等，这是一款支持多人游戏模式的全新开放世界生存制作游戏。
description.en: Fight, farm, build and work alongside mysterious creatures called "Pals" in this completely new multiplayer, open world survival and crafting game!

body.zh:
Q. 这是一款怎样的游戏呢？

A. 在帕鲁的世界，你可以选择与神奇的生物「帕鲁」一同享受悠闲的生活，也可以投身于与偷猎者进行生死搏斗的冒险。

帕鲁可以进行战斗、繁殖、协助你做农活，也可以为你在工厂工作。

你也可以将它们进行售卖，或肢解后食用。

生存

食物短缺、恶劣的环境……非法的偷猎者。这个世界危机四伏。为了生存你只能不择手段。有时候，你甚至要用帕鲁来充饥……

骑乘、探索

你可以骑着帕鲁去陆地、海洋、天空，在各种不同的场所进行探索。

建造

想建造金字塔吗？这时候就让大量的帕鲁为你做建造的工作吧。帕鲁并不受劳动法规的约束，尽请放心。

生活

生火、发电、采掘……。收集各种不同类型的便利帕鲁，来享受舒适的生活吧。

农业

不同的帕鲁擅长播种、浇水、收割等各类不同的工作。和帕鲁一起，打造美好的农园吧。

工业、自动化

为了实现自动化，将手工作业交给帕鲁就尤为重要。建造工厂，并安排帕鲁在其中工作吧。只要有足够的食物，帕鲁就可以不断地工作，直到它们生命的尽头。

地下城探索

有帕鲁在，哪怕危险的区域也大可放心。在危机时刻，你可以让帕鲁做你的替身。它们会不惜一切，哪怕舍弃自己的生命也会保护你。

繁殖、遗传

繁殖后，帕鲁将会继承父母的特性。将稀有的帕鲁组合在一起，繁育出最强的帕鲁吧！

偷猎、犯罪

在禁猎区栖息着濒临灭绝的稀有帕鲁。悄悄潜入那里并捕获它们你就能够大赚一笔！只要不被发现，就不算是犯罪。

多人游戏

支持多人游戏模式。邀请你的朋友一起来冒险吧！当然，你们也可以进行对战以及交易。
body.en:
Q. What kind of game is this?

A. In this game, you can peacefully live alongside mysterious creatures known as Pals or risk your life to drive off a ruthless poaching syndicate.

Pals can be used to fight, or they can be made to work on farms or factories.

You can even sell them or eat them!

Survival

In a harsh environment where food is scarce and vicious poachers roam, danger waits around every corner. To survive, you must tread carefully and make difficult choices...even if that means eating your own Pals when the time comes.

Mounts & Exploration

Pals can be mounted to traverse the land, sea and sky—allowing you to traverse all kinds of environment as you explore the world.

Building Structures

Want to build a pyramid? Put an army of Pals on the job. Don't worry; there are no labor laws for Pals.

Production

Make use of Pals and their skills to make fire, generate electricity, or mine ore so that you can live a life of comfort.

Farming

Some Pals are good at planting seeds, while others are skilled at watering or harvesting crops. Work together with your Pals to create an idyllic farmstead.

Factories & Automation

Letting Pals do the work is the key to automation. Build a factory, place a Pal in it, and they'll keep working as long as they're fed—until they're dead, that is.

Dungeon Exploration

With Pals on your side you can tackle even the most dangerous areas. When the time comes, you might have to sacrifice one to save your skin. They'll protect your life—even if it costs their own.

Breeding & Genetics

Breed a Pal and it will inherit the characteristics of its parents. Combine rare pals to create the strongest Pal of them all!

Poaching & Crime

Endangered Pals live in wildlife sanctuaries. Sneak in and capture rare Pals to get rich quick! It's not a crime if you don't get caught, after all.

Multiplayer

Multiplayer is supported, so invite a friend and go on an adventure together! And of course you can battle your friends and trade Pals, too.

In online co-op play mode, up to 4 players can play together.

Additionally, a dedicated server can allow up to 32 players to play together.
