description.zh: 星辰大学，兽心相伴。扮演大一新生雷欧，在校园中邂逅四位兽人同学，展开属于你们的恋爱故事。包含多线结局、亲密日常、浪漫氛围。
description.en: Stellar University: Furry Hearts -Play as Leo, a first-year student, and meet four furry classmates on campus—unfolding a love story that’s yours to shape. Featuring multiple endings, intimate daily moments, and romantic vibes.

body.zh:
星辰大学，兽心相伴。

《星辰大学：兽心相伴》是一款以大学校园为背景的男同福瑞恋爱视觉小说。你将扮演雷欧，一位初入“星辰大学”的大一新生，在这里结识四位性格迥异的同学，每一段关系都充满不一样的恋爱体验。

【游戏特色】

• 多线恋爱：攻略多位兽人角色，每个角色都有独立的剧情分支与结局。

• 轻松日常与浪漫氛围：体验校园生活、约会事件、以及真诚的情感发展。

• 精美CG：捕捉关键亲密瞬间，包括亲吻、暗示性场景等。

• 不含直接的性行为画面，专注情感与浪漫。

【面向成人玩家】

本游戏包含亲吻、部分裸露及浪漫亲密描写，建议18岁以上玩家体验。

【关于我们】

我们是两人的新人团队，《星辰大学：兽心相伴》是我们的第一部作品。我们历经两年多的时间用心创作故事与美术，希望能为同好带来一段难忘的恋爱体验。将来预计会有能够更加深入每条恋爱故事的更新内容。

© 2026 Lukkabear Studio。本作所有角色立绘、CG及原创剧情内容均归开发团队所有。未经授权，禁止用于商业用途或二次分发。
body.en:
StellarUniversity: FurryHearts

StellarUniversity: FurryHearts is a gay furry dating sim visual novel set on a college campus. You play as Leo, a freshman entering "Stellar University", where you meet four unique classmates. Each relationship offers a distinct romantic experience.[Features]

• Multiple Romance Routes: Pursue different furry characters, each with independent story branches and endings.

• Relaxed Daily Life & Romantic Atmosphere: Experience campus life, dating events, and genuine emotional development.

• Beautiful CGs: Capture key intimate moments, including kissing and suggestive scenes.

• No explicit sexual acts – focus on emotion and romance.

[Adult Content]

This game contains kissing, partial nudity, and romantic intimacy. Recommended for ages 18+.

[About Us]

We are a two-person team making our first game. StellarUniversity: FurryHearts is our debut work, created over two years with heartfelt effort on story and art. We hope to bring an unforgettable dating sim experience to fellow furry fans. Future updates will expand each romance route further.

© 2026 Lukkabear Studio. All character art, CGs, and original story content are the property of the development team. Unauthorized commercial use or redistribution is strictly prohibited.

description.zh: Kiyo曾是一只猫科捕食者，被困在一个霓虹灯闪烁的反乌托邦城市中，这座城市被沉迷于智能手机的兔子们所统治。拿起武器，潜入兔子集团，揭开它们深藏的秘密，并在这场潜行战斗的冒险中，将所有动物从它们的残暴统治下解放出来。
description.en: Control the body of Kiyo, a feline ex-predator trapped in a neon-lit, dystopian city dominated by smartphone-addicted bunnies. Grab your bow, infiltrate the bunnies' facilities, discover their deepest secrets, and free everyone from their tyrannical grip in this stealthy platform adventure.

body.zh:
注意：下方有闪光灯

欢迎来到兔子城，在这座现代化的霓虹灯城市里，所有动物都在大自然之外过着充实的生活——这一切都要归功于最强大的物种：兔子！几年前，它们为我们带来了技术进步以及充满乐趣和愉悦的生活。

而这种生活的代价是什么呢？抛弃你们那些肮脏的自然栖息地以及你们的动物本能。尤其是你们这些食肉动物，要是想被这个光辉的社会所接纳，就应该改变自己的生存方式。

并非每个人都认同兔子们的做法，许多动物在这些贪婪的兔子统治下受苦。

你被一只巨大的猫头鹰招募，它需要你帮忙结束兔子暴政。它让你控制一只虎山猫Kiyo的身体，派遣你执行各种潜行和平台跳跃任务，以揭露兔子们的邪恶计划。为了躲避残忍的兔子警察，你需要巧妙地决定何时保持隐蔽、何时使用暴力，或者两者兼而有之。躲藏在动态阴影中，利用干扰、攻击和忍者绳索杂技，千万别被抓住！

慢慢潜行吧，沉浸在兔子城的氛围中。深入了解这个世界的生活，结识形形色色的人物，探索不同的地点，并发现兔子们到底有多邪恶。

感受霓虹灯下光怪陆离的场景和沉浸式的合成波原声配乐，一定要小心——绝对不能忘记你的使命。
body.en:
CAUTION: FLASHING LIGHTS BELOW

Welcome to Rabbithole City, where all animals live a fulfilling life outside nature in this modern, neon-lit city - and it's all thanks to the mightiest species of all: bunnies! A few years ago, they brought us technological progress and a life of fun and pleasure.

And the small price for such a life? Leaving your filthy natural habitat and your instincts behind. Especially you, carnivores, should change your ways if you want to be accepted in this glorious society.

Not everyone agrees with the bunnies and many species are suffering under this strict rabbit regime.

You are recruited by a giant Owl who needs your help to sabotage the Bunny Tyranny. He gives you control over the body of a tiger-lynx, Kiyo, and sends you on various stealth and platforming missions to uncover the bunnies’ wicked plans. To avoid the merciless rabbit police, you'll need to make clever decisions about when to be stealthy or violent, or both. Hide in the dynamic shadows, use distractions, attacks, and ninja rope acrobatics, and don't get caught!

Take your time and get lost in the atmosphere of Rabbithole City. Learn more about life in this world, meet colorful characters, explore different locations, and discover how evil the bunnies really are.

Feel the seductive pull of the neon lights and immersive synth-wave beats, but be careful - do not lose sight of your mission.

description.zh: 《Laika: Aged Through Blood》是一款以末世废土为背景的西部风格摩托冒险游戏。它讲述了一个饱受占领军压迫的部落的故事，同时也是一位土狼母亲无尽的复仇之旅，作为战士，她要夺回族人失去的一切。
description.en: Laika: Aged Through Blood is an action-adventure Metroidvania set in a post-apocalyptic western world. Play as Laika, a coyote mother and fierce warrior, and carve your motorbike through a land ravaged by betrayal and loss as you uncover dark secrets in the pursuit of vengeance against oppression.

body.zh:
《Laika: Aged Through Blood》是一款以末世废土为背景的西部风格摩托冒险游戏。它讲述了一个饱受占领军压迫的部落的故事，同时也是一位土狼母亲无尽的复仇之旅，作为战士，她要夺回族人失去的一切。

骑上心爱的小摩托，驾驶、跳跃、战斗，穿越广袤的手绘世界。在废土飞驰，完成危险的跳跃，以子弹时间向敌人射击，再来个后空翻子弹上膛！使用基于技能的强化道具，不断挑战强大的头目！

• 驾驶快速灵活的摩托进行战斗。

• 极具风格的手绘末世废土。

• 关于母女关系、复仇与失去的深刻故事。

• 丰富多姿的世界、史诗级头目战以及超多任务。

• 首款摩托大冒险！

[/b][/list]
body.en:
Laika: Aged Through Blood is a thrilling action-adventure Metroidvania set in a dystopian, post-apocalyptic western world.

Take on the role of Laika, a coyote mother and relentless warrior on a quest to avenge her fallen people from the tyrannical Birds, who have claimed superiority and conquered the land.

Fueled by vengeance, Laika rides out on her motorbike on a perilous and emotional journey. Carve and shred through rugged, hand-painted landscapes as you uncover the dark secrets of a fractured world ravaged by power, betrayal, and loss.

Engage in breakneck vehicular combat mechanics that demand precision, strategy, and skill. Utilize a variety of weapons, master close-range tactics, and unlock deadly abilities to defeat your enemies, upgrade your gear, and take back what your people have lost.

• Fast-paced 2D motorbike combat in the first ever “Motorvania”.

• Challenging gameplay that rewards precision and strategic thinking.

• Emotional and thought-provoking narrative about vengeance and loss.

• Striking hand-drawn landscapes teeming with danger and hidden secrets to explore.

• A hauntingly beautiful ambient soundtrack.

description.zh: 作为小村庄最后的希望，你 - Domingo，独自肩负起拯救族人的使命。同时，你也知道自己还要完成另一件重要的事：找到一场浪漫约会。而实现这一切的方法，就是发挥你最擅长的能力——攻略正在袭击你家园的巨龙！在这款充满恶作剧风格的第三人称类魂 Boss 战游戏中，展现你的魅力，接受挑战吧！
description.en: Left alone as your little village’s last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home! Put your charisma to the test in this cheeky third-person soulslike boss battle!

body.zh:
Dragon Kisser is a single-boss arcade experience designed for short, replayable sessions where you'll need both fast reflexes and charm. Play as Domingo, an ordinary village rooster with extraordinary confidence. Help him dodge, woo, and minigame your way to the most legendary victory kiss in history.

You might think convincing a ravenous beast to stop their daily village pillage might be crazy, but it's actually a surprisingly simple three-step process:

Step 1: Dodge!

Swiftly jump and twirl out of the way of the dragon’s attacks to show her what you got. If you do a well enough job she might just give you a second of her time to hear you out.

Step 2: Romance your way to victory!

Once you've impressed the dragon enough, the civilians will start to believe in Domingo and help him to save their town by throwing him various items to aid in winning over the dragon's heart. Once you catch these items, present them to the dragon to turn the stage over to you and have a moment of the dragon’s undivided attention.

Playing these minigames is how you can earn romance points! But be careful, if you fumble in these key moments, you might just be in more trouble than you were before…

Step 3: Kiss that dragon!

Now that you've shown the dragon your bodacious bravery and suave skills, she presents you with your final challenge: The Gauntlet. A challenge in which you show off all of the charismatic skills you've accomplished in the presentation games all at once in a barrage of minigames. If you pass the gauntlet, then you, out of anyone, rightfully earned the right to kiss that dragon. Congratulations!

A BYU Center for Animation Capstone Project

This project was planned, developed, and tested over the course of a little less than a year, completely through student work, for the purpose of learning how to make games, collaborate as a team, and finish something enough for publication. Because of that, support and continual work on this game is limited to individual team members and their schedules as they move towards graduation. Bugs and issues with the game are welcome to be reported on, but please be aware that many of us are moving on to jobs or graduate school, meaning updates post-release are very unlikely. Regardless, we appreciate your time and feedback.

title.zh: Daemon: The Wolf, The Witch, and the Labyrinth
title.en: Daemon: The Wolf, The Witch, and the Labyrinth

description.zh: 《Daemon》是一款第三人称动作RPG游戏,玩家将化身受诅咒的狼探索不断变幻的灵界,并能瞬间变身为狼人,凭借技巧与堕落的守护者展开激烈战斗。
description.en: Daemon is a third-person action RPG where you explore a shifting spirit realm as a cursed wolf—then instantly transform into a werewolf for ferocious, skill-based combat against corrupted guardians.

body.zh:
变身求生

在狼的敏捷与狼人的凶猛之间实时切换。在战斗中改变形态以进行攻击、闪避、压制或逃脱。

激烈的近战战斗

以受魂系列游戏启发的沉重、侵略性战斗,撕裂堕落的野兽和受灵魂束缚的敌人。

什么是DAEMON?

Daemon是一款围绕实时变身战斗打造的第三人称动作角色扮演游戏。 在狼的敏捷与狼人的凶猛之间切换,与堕落的守护者战斗,并夺回散落在变幻灵魂领域中的记忆。

在梦与死之间

一个灵魂苏醒——被困在受诅咒的狼的躯体中。

随着被遗忘的记忆碎片浮现,你将揭开束缚你的诅咒背后的真相——并面对你所变成的存在。

变幻的灵魂领域

穿越被雾气笼罩的岛屿、被风暴撕裂的废墟,以及强大灵魂显现的古老活森林。

在善良与残酷的灵魂引导下,你的道路蜿蜒穿过那些记得失落之物的地方。

主要特色

🐺 双重形态玩法 在敏捷的狼与强大的兽人形态之间切换以:

•

在战斗中适应

•

穿越险恶地形

•

以不同方式与世界互动

🌲 神秘探索 穿越充满活森林、隐藏知识和守护更深奥秘密的古老灵魂的迷宫般岛屿。

💀 首领战 挑战从自然与记忆中诞生的堕落守护者。 夺取他们的力量以唤醒新能力,并深入灵魂领域更深处。

📜 灵魂成长

从被击败的灵魂中收集智慧,进化你的形态、解锁新的战斗技巧,并夺回人性的碎片。

🌀 氛围叙事

体验一个关于失落与变形的动人故事——通过探索、发现,以及世界本身的声音来诉说。
body.en:
SHAPESHIFT TO SURVIVE

Instantly switch between wolf agility and werewolf ferocity in real time.

Adapt your form mid-combat to strike, evade, overwhelm, or escape.

VISCERAL, MELEE-FOCUSED COMBAT

Tear through corrupted beasts and spirit-bound enemies with weighty, aggressive combat inspired by souls-like encounters.

WHAT IS DAEMON?

Daemon is a third-person action RPG built around real-time shapeshifting combat.

Switch between wolf agility and werewolf ferocity to battle corrupted guardians and reclaim memories scattered across a shifting spirit realm.

Between Dream and Death

A soul awakens—trapped in the body of a cursed wolf.

As fragments of forgotten memory resurface, you’ll uncover the truth behind the curse that binds you—and confront what you’ve become.

A SHIFTING SPIRIT REALM

Journey across mist-shrouded islands, storm-torn ruins, and ancient living forests where powerful spirits take form.

Guided by spirits both kind and cruel, your path winds through places that remember what was lost.

Key Features

🐺 Dual-Form Gameplay

Shift between an agile wolf and a powerful were-form to:

•

adapt in combat

•

traverse hostile terrain

•

interact with the world in different ways

🌲 Mystical Exploration

Traverse maze-like islands filled with living forests, hidden lore, and ancient spirits guarding deeper mysteries.

💀 Boss Encounters

Challenge corrupted guardians born from nature and memory.

Claim their power to awaken new abilities and push deeper into the spirit realm.

📜 Spirit Growth

Gather Wisdom from defeated spirits to evolve your forms, unlock new combat techniques, and reclaim fragments of humanity.

🌀 Atmospheric Storytelling

Experience a haunting tale of loss & transformation —told through exploration, discovery, and the voices of the world itself.

description.zh: 《Wires and Whiskers》是一款本地合作的动作解谜游戏，两名玩家将分别操控一只经过实验室改造的沙鼠以及它的磁力外骨骼装甲。玩家需要协作对抗变异敌人，解决各种磁力谜题，并在一个毁灭后的末日战壕世界中努力生存。
description.en: Wires and Whiskers is a local co-op action-puzzle game where two players control a lab-engineered gerbil and its magnetic exosuit. Work together to fight mutated enemies, solve magnetic puzzles, and survive in a ruined, post-apocalyptic trench world.

body.zh:
《Wires and Whiskers》是一款节奏快速的双人本地合作游戏，玩家将操控一只赛博实验室沙鼠与其武装外骨骼，在战术战斗与磁力谜题中前进。

每位玩家将扮演一个独特角色：一位负责敏捷移动与近战冲刺（沙鼠），另一位则控制远程攻击和磁力交互系统（外骨骼）。你们必须精准配合，才能在被辐射污染、变异生物横行的不稳定世界中生存下来。

一起探索！

一起战斗！

使用投射技能！

本游戏是 ISART DIGITAL 学生的毕业项目，体验时长约 20-30 分钟。

如果你有任何反馈或 bug 报告，欢迎加入我们的 Discord！
body.en:
Wires and Whiskers is a fast-paced, two-player local co-op game where you control a cybernetic lab gerbil and its armed exosuit through tactical combat and magnetic puzzles.

Each player takes on a unique role: one handles agile movement and melee dashes (the gerbil), while the other manages long-range attacks and magnetic interaction systems (the exosuit). You must rely on precise coordination to survive an irradiated world overrun by mutated enemies and unstable tech.

Explore Together!

Fight together!

Use Projection!

This game is a 20-30 minute experience developed by students at ISART DIGITAL as part of their final year project!

If you have any feedback or bug reports, please let us know on discord!

description.zh: “据说，当人死去时，先离世的小狗会前来迎接。” - 停留在小狗天堂的柯基犬小柯闻到了刚踏上黄泉路的爸爸气味，于是展开了追寻爸爸的旅程。究竟小柯能不能再次见到爸爸呢？
description.en: "There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you." While spending time in dog heaven, Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi suddenly catches his dad's scent. Now, he embarks on a journey to meet his dad. Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

body.zh:
原本柯基犬小柯是一只流浪狗，从它断尾的样子来看，明显地可以知道它是一只有人照顾的小狗，但不知道为什么，都没有人来找它，而且它已经8岁了，全身上下都是病痛，也不容易遇到新家人。因此，只能关在狭窄的铁笼里过日子的小柯每一天都过得很不开心。结果有一天，它奇迹似地遇到了新家人。虽然新主人是一个邋里邋遢、糊里糊涂的大叔，但小柯很喜欢他身上的气味。小柯待在如此相遇的爸爸身边，和一般的小狗一样，又咬又拉、又跑又跳、又吃又睡，幸福平凡地过完短暂的余生后跨越了彩虹桥。

嗅嗅嗅…这股气味是…待在小狗天堂的某一天，小柯闻到了一股熟悉的气味而从午睡中惊醒。嗅嗅嗅…是…是爸爸！远远传来的这股淡淡的气味，一定是它等待许久的爸爸气味没错，就是它从来没有忘记的那股气味。焦急的小柯不顾危险，离开了小狗天堂并踏上迎接爸爸的旅程。就如爸爸奇迹似地来找小柯，这次也该换小柯去找爸爸了。

究竟小柯能不能再次见到爸爸呢？

在充满小狗与人们故事的美丽世界冒险

小狗天堂外面的世界徘徊在生与死的边缘，令人感到既熟悉又陌生。在沙漠、雪山、海边等数个美丽的地区冒险，体验跨越冒险/动作/竞速类型的多元游戏吧。请别忘记，小柯是一只小狗，在闻气味、吠叫、奔跑、跳跃等行动上有所限制，因此必须与拥有不同故事的小狗及人们相遇并互相帮忙，才能顺利结束迎接爸爸的旅程。小狗和猫咪不一样，独自办得到的事情并不多！

终究是我们大家的故事

在旅程的终点，小柯将再次见到爸爸。尽管过程中充满开心和兴奋，有时艰辛而悲伤，然而结局是注定好的。因为有缘的话，终究会再见。虽然《My Little Puppy》是小狗的故事，但相遇、离别和再会，终究也是我们大家的故事。希望这个故事可以为期盼与曾是独一无二的朋友及家人的小狗再次相遇的人、正在准备迎接未来离别的人带来安慰。总有一天，我们一定会再次相遇的。
body.en:
Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi was once an abandoned dog. Judging by his docked tail, someone had once cared for him, but for some reason, he became unwanted. As an 8-year-old senior dog with various illnesses, it was hard for him to find a new family. Trapped in a cage at an animal shelter, each day passed gloomily for Bong-gu.

Then one day, a miracle happened. Bong-gu met a new family. The man who took Bong-gu had a somewhat scruffy appearance and seemed slightly awkward, but Bong-gu loved his scent. From that day on, Bong-gu lived out his remaining days just like any other dog would: playing tug-of-war, running around, eating, and sleeping. In the end, he crossed the rainbow bridge, having lived out a simple yet joyful life.

Sniff sniff… this scent… One day in dog heaven, Bong-gu wakes from his nap to a very familiar scent. Sniff sniff… it's dad!. Though faint, surely it is dad's scent he has been waiting for. Jubilant, Bong-gu escapes dog heaven and embarks on a journey to meet his dad - a journey that may hold unexpected dangers. Just as his dad once found him by some miracle, it is now Bong-gu’s turn to find his dad.

Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

An adventure in a beautiful world filled with stories of dogs and people

Teetering on the border between life and death, a world outside of dog heaven feels both familiar and strange. Embark on an adventure through beautifully crafted landscapes including deserts, snowy mountains, and beaches. Experience diverse gameplay across adventure, action, racing genres. And remember, Bong-gu is a dog! Actions like sniffing, barking, running, and jumping come with limitations. To overcome his limitations and reunite with his dad, he must meet, give, and receive help from people and other dogs, each with unique stories to share. Unlike cats, there is only so much a dog can do alone!

In the end, this is a story for all of us

At the end of his journey, Bong-gu finally reunites with his dad. The journey is filled with joy and excitement, but also moments of hardship and sadness. Yet, the ending has always been written: those destined to meet again will find their way back together. My Little Puppy may be a story about a dog, but it is also a story of relationships, farewells, and reunions that speaks to us all. For those waiting to see their once-in-a-lifetime friend or family member again, or those preparing for an inevitable parting that may come, we hope this story brings warm comfort. One day, we will meet again.

description.zh: 没有包裹？没问题！破门而入。拆个精光。送货……一款支持最多5名玩家（真想的话15个也行）的混乱在线合作游戏！
description.en: No packages? No problem! Break in. Scrap everything. Deliver... A chaotic online co-op game for up to 5 players (or 15 if you really want to)!

body.zh:
恭喜你，员工！你刚刚加入&Beyond，一家独一无二的敢于将职位描述留白的快递公司。想要福利？有的是。工作细节？无可奉告。现在马上就接单开工吧！

5 张随机生成的地图 + 支持创意工坊模组

道具冲浪（这不是bug，是特色功能）

桥梁？太慢。梯子？胆小鬼才用。有了PhysTech的道具冲浪系统，任何随手可得的破烂都能变成高速载具。文件柜、油桶、办公椅……只要能站上去，就能乘风破浪直冲深渊彼岸。

废料

遇见废料，拆了再说。凡是没钉牢的东西都是原材料：桌子、椅子、电器、破烂…

运送

投入废料，取出货物。货物制造机 3000不要问东问西，我们也不会多废话。完成任务，偿清债务...否则，你就见识见识我们有多关爱失败员工。
body.en:
Congratulations, employeen! You just joined &Beyond, the only delivery company bold enough to leave the job description blank. You wanted benefits? You got 'em. You wanted details? Too bad. Now grab your next delivery contract and get to work!

5 Randomly generated maps + Workshop modding support

PROP SURF (It's not a bug, it's a feature)

Bridges? Too slow. Ladders? For cowards. With PhysTech's Prop Surfing System, every random piece of junk becomes a high-speed launch vehicle. File cabinets, barrels, office chairs... If you can stand on it, you can surf it straight across the abyss.

SCRAP

Scrap first, ask questions later. Anything that isn't nailed down is raw material: Tables, chairs, electronics, junk...

DELIVER

Throw scrap in, pull out a delivery. Delivery Maker 3000 doesn't ask questions... and neither do we. Get it done, pay off your debt... or don't, and find out how much we love failure.

description.zh: 富有创意性的故事和史诗般的冒险题材游戏。 你会选择成为什么样的侦探呢？
description.en: The very first PUNCH & CLICK! Brok is an innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

body.zh:
这是一个剧情向的冒险游戏，完美地混合了动作格斗和案件推理元素。你是会选择通过智力去破案……亦或是暴力呢？

在这个“赛博庞克”背景的未来世界中，动物取代了人类延续了文明的发展。社会顶层的公民都居住在安全的圆顶市区中，而其他的底层人士则居住在环境污染严重的郊区。

布罗格是一名私家侦探和兼职拳击手，他跟其亡妻的独子格拉夫相依为命。虽然布罗格对妻子所遭遇的意外事故已经记忆模糊，但是最近发生的一系列事件逐渐让惨剧的真相付出了水面……甚至影响到了两父子的人生。

他们究竟能否从这个颓废的社会中逆流而上挑战自己的命运呢？

预览版游戏包含了完整版游戏的第一章节（一共有六个章节）

特点

富含深意和情感的剧情故事，角色人设致敬80年代与90年代的漫画角色。

此游戏首开先河混合了经典的“冒险游戏”元素和“砍杀游戏”的RPG元素！

•

完美支持简体中文文本！

•

可以通过智力……或者暴力去解谜！

•

你的每个选择都会影响剧情走向！

•

提供简单模式：适合只注重剧情的玩家（可省略战斗）！

•

升级角色以对抗更强大的敌人和BOSS！

•

合成所搜集到的各个线索以揭开真相！

•

游戏内提供各种提示

•

支持所有操作模式（鼠标、键盘、或游戏手柄）

•

全剧本配音

•

2至4小时的游戏时长！

完整的游戏现在已经推出!

可访问性

BROK是第一个成熟的冒险游戏，可以让盲人或视力受损的玩家完全玩得起！（在1.3版本中增加了）。

- 通过高质量的文字转语音和声音描述（人物、地点和场景）进行完全叙述。

- 适应盲人的谜题。

- 所有的谜题和战斗都可以跳过。

- 调整后的教程。

- 重复上一次语音讲话和指示的按钮。

- 打斗的位置音频。

- 不需要在线连接（下载后）。

- 无特定设备要求：用键盘或控制器玩。

- 额外选项：更大的字体和更大的对比度（背景和敌人。）

- 要进入无障碍菜单，在标题屏幕上按空格（或Xbox控制器上的Y），然后按照音频指示操作。

- 为了获得最佳音频提示，请在选项中选择你的控制器类型。

重要：易用性对话现在仅有英文版。

但是在目前Windows版本的简体中文语言中，已经加入了一个新的选项。

- 在易用性菜单的下方开启“剪贴板解说”选项，所有的文本都会被输出到剪贴板。

- 然后在你的电脑上安装一款有“剪贴板朗读”插件的文本转换语音软件，例如NVDA，就可以。

更多信息和插件下载，请访问我们的网站 “可访问性 ”部分。

致中文用户：

对于听不懂英文语音的用户，这里有一个小小的指南，或许能帮助到你。

进入游戏听到音乐响起后，稍等一会儿能听见一个音效，表示可以按任何按键继续，此时你可以按下键盘上的空格键或是手柄上的Y键，游戏会进入无障碍选项的菜单里，同时能够听到英文的无障碍语音，如果你再次按下空格或手柄Y键，那么所有的辅助功能选项将会被开启，不过是全英文朗读，想使用剪贴板输出的话不建议这么做。

如果你想使用剪贴板输出，那么请把方向键移到菜单底部，正确的话，你应该听到无障碍语音说：

Clipboard narration， off

在这里确认，你会听到一个嘟声，此时，你应当保证你的剪贴板阅读软件能够正常工作，如果一切无误的话，那么你就成功了。

祝游玩愉快。
body.en:
Narrative-driven game that blends action, puzzles and investigation in never-before-seen ways. Will you use your brain... or your brawn?

In a futuristic "light cyberpunk" world where animals have replaced humans, privileged citizens live under a protective dome from the ambient air pollution while others struggle to make a living on the outside.

Brok, private detective and former boxer, lives with Graff, the son of his deceased wife. Although he could never elucidate the nature behind her accident, recent events may shed some light on an even more tragic outcome... one that may be linked to their own existence.

Will they be able to withstand the threats of this corrupted world and face their own destiny?

This prologue contains the first chapter (out of six in the final game)

FEATURES

A deep and emotional narrative-rich experience filled with characters reminiscent of classic 80s/90s cartoons.

The first game to combine a "Classic Adventure" with "Beat'em up" and RPG elements!

•

Solve puzzles with your wits... or muscles!

•

Make choices impacting gameplay and/or story

•

Easy mode for pure "Point & Click" gameplay (fights can be skipped)

•

Level up to beat enemies and bosses

•

Combine clues to uncover the truth!

•

In-game hints

•

All controls supported (mouse, keyboard or controller)

•

Fully voice acted

•

2 to 4 hours of gameplay for this prologue!

Verified compatible with SteamDeck.

The full game is now available!

ACCESSIBILITY

BROK is the first full-fledged adventure game to be fully playable by blind or visually impaired players! (added in version 1.3)

- Fully narrated via quality text-to-speech and audiodescriptions (characters, locations and scenes.)

- Puzzles adapted for blindness.

- All puzzles and fights can be skipped.

- Adapted tutorials.

- Buttons to repeat the last voice speech and instructions.

- Positional audio for fights.

- No online connectivity required (after the download).

- No specific device required: play with keyboard or a controller.

- Additional options: larger fonts and increased contrast (backgrounds and enemies.)

- To enter the accessibility menu, press SPACE (or Y on a Xbox controller) on the title screen, then follow the audio instructions.

- For best audio prompts, choose your type of controller in the options.

IMPORTANT: Accessibility speeches are only available in English.

However, a new option has been added to the Windows version to play speeches in other languages:

- Enable "clipboard narration" at the bottom of the accessibility menu. All the text will be sent to the clipboard.

- Install a text-to-speech software on your computer such as NVDA with a "Clipboard Reader" plugin.

- Languages supported: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French (the other languages are partially supported)

More information and plugin download on our website, section "accessibility".

title.zh: 鳄鱼侦探布罗格 – 尾诞节，新的圣诞
title.en: BROK - Natal Tail, A New Christmas

description.zh: 这是一篇背景设定在《鳄鱼侦探布罗格》世界中的圣诞故事，以独立视觉小说的形式呈现。
description.en: A Christmas tale set in the world of BROK the InvestiGator, presented as a visual novel.

body.zh:
反乌托邦世界中的圣诞故事

学生时期的格拉夫和奥特受到学校通知来准备“尾诞节”——已被扭曲的亚特拉西亚古老传统，他们将会在这次经历中发现，即使在这个衰败的世界中，分享和友谊仍然是生活中最宝贵的财富。

我需要先玩游戏本篇吗？

不需要！这个故事是游戏本篇的前传，用于补充本篇中的角色形象和世界观。虽然先玩《鳄鱼侦探布罗格》可以获得额外的背景信息，但这部视觉小说也是进入布罗格宇宙的有效切入点。

游戏时长是多少？

我在大约三周的时间里编写并制作了这部视觉小说，它大量重复使用了主游戏的素材，玩完大约需要一个小时。

特别版

原版可免费游玩，但经过改进的《Natal Tail》“特别版”，为主机重制，加入了选项、成就和新场景，现在也作为DLC在PC上推出，用于支持开发者！
body.en:
A Christmas Tale in a Dystopia

When students Graff and Ott are called upon to celebrate "Natal Untail," a corrupted version of Atlasia's ancient tradition, they'll discover that even in this decaying world, the values of sharing and friendship endure as life's greatest treasures.

Do I need to play BROK the InvestiGator first?

Nope! This story serves as a prequel to the main game, introducing the characters and explain the game’s terminology. While playing BROK the InvestiGator first provides additional context, this visual novel is a valid entry point into the BROK universe.

What is the length?

I have written and made this visual novel in approximately 3 weeks of work, this re-uses a large majority of assets from the main game, and spans about an hour to get through.

Accessibility

This visual novel has full accessibility for blind players in English.

Special Edition

The original version is free, but the upgraded "Special Edition" of Natal Tail, revisited for consoles, with choices, achievements and new scenes is now also available on PC as a DLC to support the developer!

description.zh: 《摸猫猫》是一款轻松又刺激的弹幕射击游戏——通过“撸猫”来释放攻击！面对一波又一波来袭的敌人，利用食物、道具与武器不断强化你的猫咪，将它培养成横扫战场的强大存在！
description.en: Pet the Cat is a bullet-hell shooter where you unleash powerful attacks by petting an adorable cat! Fight through endless waves of enemies and upgrade your kitty into a formidable force with food, items, and weapons.

body.zh:
1，独特“撸猫”玩法： 使用鼠标抚摸猫咪即可发动攻击，在紧张刺激的战斗中体验前所未有的操作乐趣！

2，可爱手绘风格： 在温暖可爱的手绘世界中，享受闪避、射击与成长的爽快体验！

3，自由构筑流派： 每波结束后，从食物、道具与武器中做出选择，打造属于你的专属Build！

4，武器与天赋成长： 多样化升级路线，让每一局游戏都充满变化与期待！

5，全球排行榜： 挑战来自世界各地的玩家，成为真正的“撸猫大师”！

官方Q群：934031228
body.en:
1,Unique “petting” gameplay: Use your mouse to pet the cat and trigger powerful attacks while surviving waves of enemies.

2,Charming hand-drawn world: Dodge, shoot, and upgrade in a cute and lively art style.

3,Build your own playstyle: Choose from food, items, and weapons between waves to create your unique build.

4,Upgradeable weapons & talent tree: Every run offers new possibilities and exciting progression.

5,Global leaderboard: Compete with players worldwide and become the ultimate cat-petting master!

description.zh: 《这龙带刀》 是一款硬核动作RPG，故事发生在一个被浩劫永久重塑的史前世界。你将化身为年轻的棘龙，手握远古之力铸就的巨型大剑，迎战那些同样持有凶器的恐龙宿敌——血战不休，只为阻挡那步步逼近的灭绝之影。
description.en: Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.

body.zh:
加入《这龙带刀》官方QQ群：779807373

联系我们！分享你对游戏的看法，或反馈意见及BUG！您的反馈对我们十分宝贵！

制作人寄语

大家好，我是 Jean Nguyen，是一家知名主机游戏公司的在职动画师，也是《这龙带刀（Dinoblade）》的创作者。 四年前，我制作了一段病毒式传播的动画短片，内容是一只挥舞着巨剑、施展连招的棘龙。当时制作这段动画，只是为了更新自己的动画作品集，希望借此找到一份新工作，而最终我也成功加入了目前的团队。 后来，许多人在评论区留言，希望我能把这段动画做成一款游戏。但当时我觉得这几乎是不可能完成的事情，因为我从来没有开发过游戏。 直到 2023 年 10 月，我终于决定接受这个挑战。我花了整整一个月时间，在 YouTube 上学习虚幻引擎的教学课程，从零开始踏入游戏开发。 将近三年后的今天，《这龙带刀》终于正式发售了。 这三年来，我一直利用工作之外的闲暇时间开发这款游戏。我已经很少和朋友出去聚会，也几乎不再玩游戏，而是把所有空闲时间都投入到了《这龙带刀》的开发中。 这期间，我也成为了一名父亲，我的儿子现在已经 15 个月大了。在照顾家庭的同时兼顾游戏开发并不容易，但一路以来，我的粉丝始终给予我莫大的动力，而我的妻子也一直全力支持着我。 后来，我还邀请了我的弟弟一起加入这个项目。我一边教他动画制作，一边让他协助开发。他每天都会试玩游戏，到现在应该已经通关超过 100 次了。 开发过程中，我也曾邀请一些外部合作伙伴协助完成音乐、角色设计和模型制作等工作，但绝大部分开发工作仍然是由我独自完成，弟弟则在力所能及的范围内给予帮助。 这一路充满挑战，我也学到了非常多的东西。但我热爱整个开发过程，而最让我感到欣慰的，就是看到玩家们能够真正享受《这龙带刀》带来的乐趣。谢谢大家来玩我做的游戏！

《这龙带刀》是一场硬核动作RPG的狂宴。一场浩劫让史前世界天翻地覆，连恐龙的宿命都被彻底重写。你将化身为年轻的棘龙，紧握由远古之力淬炼而成的巨剑，迎战那些同样手持凶器的宿敌——血战到底，只为挡下那步步逼近的灭绝之影。

跨越龟裂的峡谷，穿行浓雾弥漫的密林，这片大陆的每一寸土地都藏着致命的壮美。而每一片区域，都盘踞着一头暴虐的阿尔法霸主，它们是前方道路的守门人。想继续走下去？那就先击溃它——否则，你只会沦为它的盘中餐。

每一次胜利，都会化作你体内奔涌的力量。新技能在觉醒，杀招在咆哮，你的战斗风格将由自己亲手锻造。连击如狂风，闪避、翻滚、弹反，招招都得卡在生死的间隙；散落于世界各处的传说武器，等着被你发现，被你主宰。

而在蛮荒的最深处，埋藏着一个足以左右整个种族的谜——它能带来救赎，也能将你的族群永远推入深渊。崛起吧，成为传奇；征服这片荒野，亲手决定你们的终局。

化身利刃，在灭绝的阴影将世界吞噬之前，斩断命运的锁链，重铸历史。

•

征服试炼：击败最终首领，解锁终极Boss Rush模式。
body.en:
Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event, one that redefined the very nature of Dinosaurs. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword forged from ancient power. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with brutal weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.

Venture across a sprawling world filled with awe-inspiring biomes, from dry canyons to dense, mist-shrouded jungles. Each region is ruled by a ferocious Alpha, an apex predator who guards the path forward. Defeat them, or be devoured.

Every victory unlocks strength. Master new skills, unleash devastating abilities, and forge your own combat style. Chain together powerful combos, time your dodges, rolls, and parries, and discover legendary weapons hidden across the lands.

At the heart of this savage world lies a mystery — one that could save your species, or doom them forever. Rise as a Legend, conquer the wilds, and decide the fate of your home.

Become the blade and rewrite history before your world is lost to the shadow of extinction.

•

Conquer the Challenge: Defeat the final boss to unlock the ultimate Boss Rush Mode

description.zh: 《喵喵角斗士》是一款硬核的2D类怪猎慢速动作游戏！支持4人联机，有丰富的武器、装备、道具助力角斗场Boss战。 化身萌喵角斗士，与伙伴们一起，挑战困难重重的Boss，享受战胜强敌的成就感吧！
description.en: Cat Gladiator is a hardcore 2D slow-paced Monster Hunter-like action game! 4-player co-op, a wide variety of weapons, equipment, and items to aid in arena Boss battles. Become an adorable gladiator cat, team up with friends, conquer tough Bosses, and savor victory!

body.zh:
欢迎加入官方玩家群：947118887

当赛博监工，享打怪喵生！

游戏玩法：

这是一款2D类怪猎共斗游戏，支持单人挑战或4人联机。

通过观察招式，利用武器特性及活用道具打败强大的敌人。

战斗胜利后用Boss的素材打造装备，挑战下一个更强大的Boss，成为角斗场中最顶尖的角斗士喵！

20260922更新：推出全新武器-重棍！

目前游戏有六种武器：攻守兼备的剑盾；切居登猫的太刀；猛烈轰炸的小炮；势大力沉的大剑；灵活帅气的双刀；蓄力演奏的竖琴。

每种武器都有自己的战斗节奏和特色招式，用它们对抗敌人时，玩家可以得到全然不同的战斗体验。

角斗场的敌人可不是易于之辈！为了战胜他们，玩家需要冷静观察并记住他们的招式，运用自身的武器特点来巧妙应对，当然，装备的加成和道具的灵活运用也是必不可少。

独自面对敌人遇到了困难？叫上你的好友，一起挑战吧！游戏支持最多4位玩家联机共斗，享受把敌人按在地上摩擦的乐趣！

挑战之余，不妨钓钓鱼放松放松，不同的鱼提供不同的属性加成，战斗前别忘了吃口鱼！

陷阱，爆桶，恢复药剂，篮球炸弹，秘制烤鱼等，灵活利用道具可以大大降低战斗的难度！

利用敌人掉落的材料，玩家可以打造不同造型和功能的装备。提高攻击，防御，暴击等基础属性，抑或减少道具的CD，加快道具的释放速度等，各色的装备功能组合待玩家自己去探索。

关于我们

《喵喵角斗士》由三人小团队开发，因为喜欢玩怪猎，所以想做个“2D版的共斗游戏”，在武器操作上做了适当简化，使得“易上手难精通”，同时增强了道具的作用等，让更多玩家轻松上手共斗类游戏！
body.en:
Welcome to join our Discord.

Gameplay:

This is a 2D Monster Hunter-like co-op action game that supports solo play or online co-op for up to 4 players.

Observe boss attack patterns, leverage your weapon's unique traits, and use items wisely to defeat powerful bosses. After a victory, use boss materials to forge new equipment, take on even stronger bosses, and climb your way to become the top gladiator cat in the arena!

20260922 Update: Introducing a brand-new weapon — Heavy Staff!

The balanced Sword & Shield; the elegant Longsword; the sustained-damage Cannon; the devastating charged Greatsword; the cyclone-spinning Dual Blades; and the note-playing Harp.

Each weapon has its own rhythm and unique moves, offering a completely different combat experience when facing enemies.

Arena foes demand respect! Observe their attack patterns, exploit your weapon's unique traits, and strategically counter. Equipment bonuses and tactical item usage are key to victory.

Struggling alone? Team up with up to 3 friends for 4-player online co-op! Enjoy the thrill of dominating your foes together.

Need a break from the challenges? Try your hand at fishing! Different fish grant different stat bonuses—don't forget to grab a bite before battle!

Traps, BoomBuckets, healing potions, basketball bombs, secret recipe grilled fish... Using items wisely can greatly reduce the difficulty of battle!

Forge armor from boss materials to boost stats (attack/defense/crit) or enhance item efficiency (CD/casting speed). Experiment with synergistic builds!

About Us

Cat Gladiators is developed by a small three-person team. We love Monster Hunter, so we wanted to create a "2D co-op hunting game." We simplified the weapon mechanics to make it "easy to learn but hard to master," while also enhancing the role of items—so more players can easily jump into the co-op action!

description.zh: 《九山：狼之城》是一款背景设定于枪火与腐败横行的残酷都市丛林之中的高能硬核俯视角射击游戏。
description.en: Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter where players fight through a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption to save Haru — a girl fitted with a city-grade atomic weapon.

body.zh:
面对残酷而精准的枪战对决，你的每一步都至关重要。在精心设计的竞技场中，你需要用极具观赏性的操作主宰战场，

赢取奖励。

在数个章节共计 54 个高强度关卡中奋战，这里充满了基于技巧的谜题与挑战；完美主义的孤狼玩家和高分挑战者们更可向 S 级评价发起冲击。

直面拥有独特机制与残暴攻击模式的巨型敌人；学习、适应、果断出手，把握极致的时机与策略，

在电影级的对决之中幸存下来。

优化策略、即兴发挥—通过连杀、格挡，行云流水赚取螺栓，以此升级你的战争之手、解锁枪械与刀刃，并根据你的玩法风格来量身打造角色。

在动态漫画分镜式的过场动画中，随烬一同执行任务；感受凌厉的画风和电影般的节奏，逐步沉浸在一个关于暴力、

腐败与忠诚破碎的硬派故事之中。

跟随烬的脚步，前往烟雨迷蒙的像素风格大都市；烬已做好准备，不惜一切代价拯救那个女孩。

欢迎来到《九山：狼之城》，这片霓虹闪烁的都市丛林早已被暴力与腐败所吞噬，你将在此展开一场残酷的俯视角射击对决。

在这款游戏中，你将感受到极致的硬核动作游戏体验。失误一次，即刻毙命。精通枪械玩法，磨炼走位技巧，在暴虐的犯罪团伙头目们所统治的街头与格斗场中杀出一条血路——速度、精准与完美无瑕的执行力是你生存的唯一法则。游戏配乐由韩国嘻哈界重量级音乐人 Loptimist 倾力打造，令人不禁摇摆的循环乐句与深沉的 808 鼓点将毫不留情地推动你不断向前，让每一场激战都堪称血脉偾张。

你将扮演烬，一位老道的前士兵。如今他已沦为一名职业佣兵，在这个捕食者与猎物之间界限早已模糊的城市中心挣扎求存。然而，这次他要面对的却不仅仅只是一单生意：一个拥有不受控制的巨大力量的神秘女孩，被卷入了一场足以颠覆权力格局的暴力阴谋。随着混乱爆发，烬必须拯救女孩，直面自己的过去，以及那个曾得到他无限信任的指挥官的背叛。

在这座城市里，每个人都欲壑难填，无人会按规则出牌。

对于烬而言，前路只有一条：凭借自己的智慧与不屈的生存意志，通过完美无瑕的计划与冷酷无情的执行力，从罪犯手中救出那个女孩。

整座城市的命运危在旦夕，烬深知：犁庭扫穴、重建平衡的时刻已经来临了。

畅玩《九山：狼之城》，沉浸于这座濒临崩溃的城市之中。这不仅仅是一场战斗——你，就是秩序与湮灭之间的最后一道防线。
body.en:
Brutal, precise gunplay where every move counts. Stylish play is rewarded as you dominate tightly designed arenas.

Fight through 54 intense stages across multiple chapters with skill-based puzzles, challenges and S-ranks for perfectionists—for lone wolves and high score chasers.

Face towering foes with distinctive mechanics and high-stakes patterns. Learn, adapt and execute to survive cinematic duels that push timing and tactics to the limit.

Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves, a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

You play as Jin, a skilled ex-soldier turned gun-for-hire, living in the heart of a city where the line between predator and prey has already been crossed. This isn’t just another job though, a mysterious girl with immense but uncontrollable power is linked to a violent conspiracy that threatens to shift the balance of power. As chaos erupts, Jin must save the girl, confront his past and the betrayal of a commander he once trusted without question.

Everyone in Kusan wants something and nobody plays fair.

For Jin, there is only one way forward: flawless planning, ruthless execution and saving the girl from criminals while relying only on his wit and unrelenting will to survive the battlefield.

With the whole city at stake, Jin knows it is time to not only clean-house but restore balance.

Features:

Hardcore top-down combat with style

Brutal, precise gunplay where every move counts. Stylish play is rewarded as you dominate tightly designed arenas.

54 Hand-crafted Stages & Mastery

Fight through 54 intense stages across multiple chapters with skill-based puzzles, challenges and S-ranks for perfectionists—for lone wolves and high score chasers.

Beastly Boss Battles

Face towering foes with distinctive mechanics and high-stakes patterns. Learn, adapt and execute to survive cinematic duels that push timing and tactics to the limit.

War Hand & Arsenal

Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

Adrenaline-fuelled Soundtrack

An adrenaline-fuelled score from Korean hip-hop artist Loptimist serving heavy doses of energy.

Graphic-Novel Storytelling

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

Neo-Noir Atmosphere

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Dive into Kusan: City of Wolves and descend into a city on the edge. It's more than just a fight, you are the last line between order and oblivion.

description.zh: Game Freak 诚意新作：《轮回之兽》是一款融合了即时与回合制战斗的动作角色扮演游戏。在美丽而又严酷的《轮回之兽》世界中，享受创新的“一人一狗协作动作角色扮演”体验。在艾玛和小库的旅程终点会有什么在等待着他们呢？
description.en: Game Freak's brand-new title: Beast of Reincarnation is an action RPG with a fusion of real-time and turn-based combat. Experience the innovative "one-person, one-dog action RPG" in the beautiful yet harsh world of Beast of Reincarnation. What awaits at the end of Emma and Koo's journey?

body.zh:
故事背景设定在末日灾难后的日本，人类仅存的希望寄托在因被孽蚀侵蚀而被人类社会放逐的“孽蚀之人”艾玛，与“孽蚀犬”小库身上。在这款「一人一犬动作角色扮演游戏」中，他们共同踏上一场宏大的冒险。

在这段旅程中，你会经历孤独与失落，也会感受同伴的可靠与温暖。在突然从废土中拔地而起的森林中，感受世界的多变无常。随着艾玛和小库在这美丽而又严酷的世界中穿行，他们之间的羁绊以及能力也在不断成长。

通过独特的技能树、装备和灵秘石来定制自己的游戏风格，在这美丽而严酷的世界中生存下去。根据你喜好的装备，定义你的专属游戏风格：远程攻击、潜行，抑或是激烈的正面战斗？

在这个孽蚀肆虐的世界中……在旅程的终点又有什么在等待着你？

艾玛和小库的协同效应

艾玛和小库共同造就了这款创新的动作角色扮演游戏。操作艾玛使用剑术，同时像回合制角色扮演游戏一样，指挥小库释放各种技能一同作战。

4026 年的后末日世界

穿行于美丽而严酷的后末日世界中。体验“孽蚀之森”中不断变化的场景，遭遇统治此地的头目。在远东相遇的艾玛和小库，必须与世界各地的头目进行战斗并夺取其力量，以完成击败轮回之兽的使命。

扑朔迷离的故事

沉浸于残酷的叙事之中，每个角色的背后都隐藏着危险的真相。在这深刻的故事中，揭示艾玛与小库交织的命运
body.en:
Game Freak's brand-new title: Set in a post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity's only hope lies with Emma, an outcast shunned from society for her affliction, and Koo, the blighted dog. Together, they embark on this expansive adventure in this one-person, one-dog action RPG.

Experience a journey where you feel moments of loneliness, and also the reliability and comfort of your companion. Savor a world of impermanence, where forests suddenly burst forth amidst the wasteland. As Emma and Koo travel through this beautiful yet harsh world, their bond and abilities blossom.

Customize your playstyle with unique skill trees, gear, and spirit stones to survive this beautiful yet brutal world. Define your own playstyle through your preferred loadout, including ranged, stealthy, and aggressive combat.

In this world ravaged by blight...what will you find at the end of your journey?

Emma and Koo’s Synergy

Emma and Koo create a revolutionary action RPG experience. Fight as a unit, using Emma's sword abilities while giving Koo commands to unleash various techniques in a hybrid combat system that combines elements of action and turn-based RPGs.

Japan: Year 4026

Travel through a beautiful yet harsh post-apocalyptic world. Experience the ever-changing scenery, in the blighted forest, and the Bosses that rule this world. Emma and Koo, who met in the far east, are tasked with battling Bosses from all over the world and capturing their powers in order to defeat the Beast of Reincarnation.

A Story Filled With Secrets

Dive into a brutal narrative where every character hides a dangerous truth. Uncover the intertwined fates of Emma and Koo in this profound story.

description.zh: 搭上小火车，前往猫之岛吧！在这款温馨的像素风经营游戏中，您将建造餐馆、扩展并装饰小镇。细心照顾猫咪们的各种需求：吃饭、购物、探索，让小岛逐渐成为它们理想的家园。
description.en: Catch a train to Cat Isle! In this cozy pixel art management game, build restaurants, expand and decorate the town. Figure out your cats needs as they dine, shop, explore and turn the island into their purfect home.

body.zh:
《猫之岛》灵感来自日本著名的“猫岛”。您将从海中央的一座小小火车站岛屿开始，逐步扩建，把它打造成热闹的猫咪小镇。

经营商铺

要管理一座充满好奇猫咪的小镇，可不是件容易的事。有的猫喜欢新鲜的刺身，有的则满足于茶香与日光小憩。作为小岛的管理员，您需要洞察它们的需求，精心平衡商店的供给，满足每只猫的心愿。

通过扭蛋机解锁装饰

转动装饰扭蛋机，为您的小岛解锁可爱的全新装饰。每颗扭蛋都会带来一个小惊喜，从温馨的植物到优美的商铺摆设。收集您喜欢的装饰，让小镇逐渐充满个性与温暖

装饰小镇

每一座建筑，都是展现创意的机会。摆放植物、挂上招牌，添上独特的装饰，让小镇既符合您的想象，也契合猫咪们的个性。每一处细节都能带来温暖，让商店更繁荣。

放松氛围

别忘了慢下来，享受您亲手打造的世界。看着猫咪们探索、嬉戏、悠闲休憩。有时候，单纯的观察，就是最甜美的回报。

游戏特色

•

4 个拥有独特目标和主题的关卡

•

100 多种装饰物（手绘像素艺术）

•

沙盒模式

•

自定义装饰

•

17 种独特建筑

•

2-4 小时的游戏时长
body.en:
Cat Isle is a cozy pixel art management game inspired by Japan’s famous Cat Islands. You’ll build and expand a tiny train platform island in the middle of the sea, turning it into lively town for cats.

Manage shops

Running a town full of curious cats takes careful observation. While some cats seek out fresh sashimi, others are happiest with tea and a nap in the sun. As the island's caretaker, it’s your job to figure out who wants what and create the perfect mix and balance of shop supplies.

Unlock decorations with the Gashapon

Spin the decoration Gashapon machine to unlock cute new decorations for your island. Each capsule gives you a little surprise from cozy plants to charming shop ornaments. Collect your favorites and slowly fill your town with personality and warmth.

Decorate your town

Each building is a chance to get creative. Add plants, lights and decorations to suit both your vision and your cats personalities. Every small detail matters, adding warmth to the town and helping your shops thrive.

Vibe and chill

Also, remember to slow down and enjoy the world you’ve built. Watch the cats explore, play, and relax. Sometimes, just observing is the sweetest reward.

Key features

•

4 levels with unique goals and themes

•

100+ Decorations(hand drawn pixel art)

•

Sandbox mode

•

Custom Decorations

•

17 unique buildings

•

2-4 hours of gameplay

description.zh: 《Moss：遗落圣物》是一款情感充沛、氛围浓厚的冒险游戏，背景设定在一本活灵活现的故事书中，洋溢着神话色彩与古老魔法气息。引领一位身型微小却意志坚定的英雄，踏上一段关于挑战、勇气与羁绊的动人旅程。
description.en: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

body.zh:
在一则鲜活寓言的篇章中展开旅程。

《Moss：遗落圣物》是一款情感充沛、氛围浓厚的冒险游戏，背景设定在一本活灵活现的故事书中，洋溢着神话色彩与古老魔法气息。引领一位身型微小却意志坚定的英雄，踏上一段关于挑战、勇气与羁绊的动人旅程。

探索一座没落王国

在一片充满神话色彩的土地上展开冒险，这座古老王国的遗迹遍布四方，但正逐渐被顽强而原始的大自然重新吞没。

引领出人意表的英雄

与 Quill 建立深厚羁绊——这只勇敢的小小老鼠在旅途的每一步中都将向你寻求引导、庇护与信任。

开启一段跨越时光的传奇

在这部受经典奇幻冒险启发、融合细腻情感与宏大史诗气质的寓言中，发掘尘封的秘密，穿越谜团重重的场景，直面 Arcane 的神秘力量。

可选的本地合作社

两人可以分别扮演奎尔和读者，各自使用一个控制器进行游戏。

附加功能

•

探索一座正在逐渐被大自然吞噬的没落王国

•

引领小小英雄穿越神秘之地，跨越巨大险阻

•

破解精雕细琢、宛如微缩景观般的环境谜题

•

探索常规道路之外的隐藏秘密与惊喜

•

通过可选“跳过战斗”辅助功能，轻松应对秘法奥术威胁

•

揭开一个宏大又温暖的故事——一位英雄需要你的陪伴

•

由充满热爱的小团队倾心设计与打造

•

广获业界好评，荣获超过 160 项奖项及提名

•

交响乐原声由知名作曲家 Jason Graves 倾力打造

全面重制的终极冒险体验

《Moss：遗落圣物》将 Book I 与 Book II 合而为一，呈现完整升级版冒险体验，正式首次登陆 PC。全新特色包括：

•

一次畅玩两段备受喜爱与赞誉的冒险旅程

•

画面与性能全面升级

•

全新精心制作的过场动画与智能追踪镜头

•

收录完整《Twilight Garden》DLC

•

新增辅助功能“跳过战斗”
body.en:
Journey through the pages of a living fable.

Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

Traverse a fallen kingdom, solve environmental puzzles woven into the landscape, and embark on a timeless adventure…

Moss: The Forgotten Relic unites the beloved and critically-acclaimed Moss and Moss: Book II into a definitive singular adventure, beautifully enhanced and reimagined for its debut on PC.

Explore a Fallen Kingdom

Venture through a mythic land marked by the ruins of a ancient realm slowly being reclaimed by an enduring and untamed nature.

Guide an Unlikely Hero

Form a powerful bond with Quill, a small and courageous mouse who looks to you for guidance, protection, and trust at every step of her journey.

Embark on a Timeless Tale

Uncover hidden secrets, navigate puzzling places, and confront arcane forces in an intimate and epic fable inspired by classic fantasy adventures.

Optional Local Co-Op

Play together as Quill and the Reader, each using a separate controller

Additional Features

•

Explore a fallen kingdom slowly reclaimed by nature

•

Guide a tiny hero through mysterious places and towering dangers

•

Solve handcrafted, diorama-like environmental puzzles

•

Discover hidden secrets and surprises off the beaten path

•

Face arcane threats with optional “skip combat” accessibility

•

Uncover the epic and heartfelt tale of a hero who needs you

•

Thoughtfully designed and lovingly crafted by a small team

•

Critically acclaimed with over 160 awards and nominations

•

Orchestral soundtrack by acclaimed composer Jason Graves

Reimagined as the Definitive Adventure

Moss: The Forgotten Relic brings Moss and Moss: Book II together as one complete, enhanced experience debuting on PC first time. New features include:

•

Play 2 beloved and critically acclaimed experiences as one

•

Enhanced Visuals and Performance

•

New Handcrafted Cutscenes and Smart Follow Camera

•

All Twilight Garden DLC included

•

New Accessibility Option “Skip Combat”

description.zh: Shadow Stalk Studios 是一家正在开发《Untamed Kingdom》的独立游戏工作室。我们希望打造一个让所有人都能与朋友一起享受探索乐趣的世界。加入我们，一同踏上穿越荒野的冒险之旅吧！
description.en: Shadow Stalk Studios is an indie company creating Untamed Kingdom. We want to create a space for everyone to enjoy and explore with friends. Come join us as we adventure through the wilderness!

body.zh:
Welcome To The Hunt

Welcome to Untamed Kingdom, a multiplayer animal survival game! Explore immersive maps and Hunt for food or avoid predators to keep yourself alive. Will you be up for the challenge?

Diverse Playable Animals

Choose from a variety of animals, each with its own unique strengths and weaknesses, as you attempt to survive in the wild. Whether you're a cunning wolf, a graceful gazelle, or a powerful bear, your choices will significantly impact your gameplay experience.

Realistic Ecosystem

Immerse yourself in beautifully rendered and highly detailed ecosystem, ranging from lush forests to harsh deserts. Every environment presents distinct challenges and opportunities, and the changing seasons and weather patterns affect your survival strategy. Encounter a dynamic ecosystem filled with a wide range of wildlife, both predators and prey, all with realistic behaviours and interactions.

Fight For Your Survival

Test your instincts and adaptability as you navigate the dangers of the wild. Hunt for food, avoid predators, and manage your energy and health to stay alive. Complete various challenges to unlock new abilities and improve your chances of survival. Establish and defend your territory from rival animals. Engage in territorial disputes, and use your wits and abilities to maintain your claim.

description.zh: 《月影杀》是一款黑暗奇幻ARPG, 融合了极具挑战性的战斗, 流畅的跑酷和深度探索. 掌握六大神圣晶魄的远古魔法, 在这场扣人心弦的剧情冒险中揭开神秘诅咒的根源.
description.en: Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration. Master the ancient magic of the Sacred Six Kristals and uncover the source of a mysterious curse in a thrilling, story-driven adventure.

body.zh:
化身猫族战士, 在黑暗奇幻世界中挥洒奥术之力, 揭开诅咒之源的奥秘! 爽快战斗 × 流畅跑酷 × 深度探索的完美融合.

爽快与挑战并存的战斗

通过格挡, 闪避和弹反攻击来规避伤害. 轻重组合攻击, 运用强大的武器技能, 同时施放多达16个装备法术. 利用近战格斗“窃取”魔法能量——通过弹反攻击施展致命的终结技能.

巧妙地使用技巧来战胜受诅咒的怪物

艾露尔正逐渐被黑暗而神秘的诅咒吞噬. 运用你的武器、法术技能和独特的猫族能力, 用灵活的操作和技巧对抗不死族的士兵, 受尽折磨的幽魂, 以及巨型Boss吧！

以猫族独有的跑酷方式越过重重障碍

施展独特的能力，以多种方式穿越密林、躲避障碍、克服一个个激动人心的挑战吧！通过推进主线剧情，就可以解锁全新的跑酷技能啦！即便是在探索过的地图区域，也能开辟全新的隐藏道路哦！

探索传说故事背后的秘密

运用你的技能探索艾露尔多样化的黑暗奇幻世界，寻找书面日志、富有影响力的NPC互动和独特的晶魄记忆物品，揭开月影杀背后的故事和传说.

创造独特的猫族角色

自定义你想要的毛发样式和长度。你的氏族选择决定了游戏中升级的魔法类型，而你的起始职业决定了初始武器、护甲和属性配置。升级属性、魔法和猫族能力，打造你专属的战斗流派.

《月影杀》的未来

自正式发售以来，社区玩家的反馈在许多方面深刻影响着《月影杀》的未来发展方向。随着我们持续对艾鲁尔（Ailur）的世界进行优化、完善与扩展，我们很高兴与大家分享当前的开发重点以及未来的长期规划。

请注意，随着开发工作的推进，部分功能与开发优先级可能会有所调整。
body.en:
Unleash your arcane power in Kristala—a dark fantasy ARPG with challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration. Step into the role of a feline warrior destined to uncover the source of a deadly curse threatening your world.

Punishing & Satisfying Combat

Avoid damage by blocking, dodging, and deflecting attacks. Combine light and heavy attacks, utilize powerful weapon abilities, and cast up to 16 equipped spells at a time. Regenerate Mana by engaging in melee combat — deflect attacks to land critical takedowns.

Defeat Cursed Monsters with Cunning Skill

Ailur is slowly being overcome by a dark and mysterious curse. Use your arsenal of weapons, spells, and unique feline abilities to battle undead enemies, tortured spirits, and behemoth bosses with cunning agility and skill.

Overcome Obstacles with Feline Parkour

Execute unique abilities that allow you to traverse the environment in many ways, overcoming new + exciting challenges. New traversal abilities are unlocked by progressing Kristala’s main storyline + each new skill opens up new pathways in previously explored areas.

Piece Together the Lore through Exploration

Use your arsenal of skills to explore the diverse, dark-fantasy world of Ailur, seeking out written journal pickups, impactful NPC interactions, and unique Kristal Memory items to unravel Kristala's detailed story and lore.

Create Your Own Unique Feline Character

Choose your desired fur pattern/length. Your clan choice determines the type of magic you'll level throughout the game, and your starting class determines your initial weapon, armor, and stat loadouts. Level stats, magic, and feline abilities to fit your desired play style.

The Future of Kristala

Since launch, community feedback has helped shape the future of Kristala in meaningful ways. As we continue refining, optimizing, and expanding the world of Ailur, we're excited to share a look at some of our current focuses and long-term plans for the journey ahead.

Please note that features and priorities may evolve throughout development.

Kristala – Official Launch Trailer | Available Now

description.zh: 《荒野战纪》是一款结合了战棋与轻度Rogue的策略RPG游戏。在这个充满奇特生物的荒野国度中，你能够探索不同战斗策略、复杂技能组合以及有趣的角色养成。瞬息万变的战斗地图和惊心动魄的游戏事件提供丰厚的奖励和挑战。前方就是未知的荒野，等待着你的勇敢迈步！
description.en: Untamed Tactics is a Tactical RPG set in world of colorful animals. Relive the legend of Greycoat’s escape into the untamed Wilds in a tale of lost honor and finding a new home as you fight, talk, and think your way through this beautifully illustrated adventure!

body.zh:
欢迎游玩《荒野战纪》，这是一款结合战棋与轻度Rogue的策略角色扮演游戏，游戏改编自风靡欧美的同名桌游。在游戏中，你可以感受战略与荒野风情的完美结合，深入活灵活现的动物族群，体验英雄故事与多彩的冒险史诗。

游戏的每个章节都是一段风格各异的冒险之旅。在随机生成的的2D手绘地图世界中，沉浸于引人入胜的故事情节，升级培养你的战术小队，为每个英雄装备独特的符文和能力，激发他们的潜能。探索隐藏的宝藏，解锁更多新角色，获取各种威力强大的符文和升级选项，书写独属于你的荒野战纪。

探索充满活力的世界精美的手绘2D画面为《荒野战纪》的奇妙世界注入了生动的活力。在游戏中，你将与一系列可爱的拟人动物盟友或对手相遇，每个角色都独具魅力。

丰富的战棋策略玩法探索不同战斗策略、复杂技能组合以及有趣的角色养成。巧妙地操控地图环境，引诱你的敌人陷入尖刺陷阱或有毒淤泥的险境。拥抱神秘的神龛之力，善用周遭环境，逆转战局！

引人入胜的故事与灰衣一同踏上这趟非凡之旅，与一班多姿多彩的动物角色相遇，它们将成为你坚定的朋友，亦或是可怕的对手。帮助灰衣夺回失去的荣誉，直面潜伏在荒野中的无数威胁，在这片奇妙新世界中开创自己的天地。

与敌人交涉通过“和谈”功能，在战斗中以特殊方式与对手互动。释放可以改变战局的特殊效果，让你的对手在恐惧中颤抖吧！

高度可重复游玩性随机生成的世界地图和丰富多样的游戏事件为游戏带来了极高的可重复性，简化后的机制则迎合了喜欢挑战不同难度的玩家。
body.en:
Prepare to be swept away by the enchanting realm of Untamed Tactics, a RPG with a narrative focus, that comes from the brilliant minds behind the hit tabletop game, Untamed Feral Factions. Listen to the story of Greycoat, a valiant soldier yearning for redemption whose memory of the events of the past may not be as vivid as it once was. Together with a dynamic ensemble of fierce and diverse animal companions venture forth into the treacherous yet mesmerizing Wilds. Brace yourself for thrilling battles against nefarious adversaries, forge unbreakable bonds of friendship, and make strategic decisions that will shape your destiny!

Each chapter of this awe-inspiring adventure unveils a standalone tactical odyssey set in a magnificent 2D landscape. Marvel at the perfect fusion of a compelling linear story campaign and a procedurally generated world brimming with gorgeous illustrations of captivating creatures. From the perilous shores of Stranglevine Ridge to the towering fortress-factory of New Gizmodan, your band of resilient refugee adventurers will traverse uncharted territories, facing both danger and beauty.

Unleash your creativity as you customize your party, adorning each hero with unique Runes and Abilities that will ignite their inner greatness. Embark on exhilarating journeys into the Wilds, where hidden treasures await, new characters yearn to be unlocked, and permanent upgrades beckon, preparing you for future escapades of epic proportions.

Features

• Engage in tactical combat:

Harness the power of abilities and masterful positioning to secure victory. Manipulate the treacherous environment, cunningly luring your enemies into spike traps or perilous pools of toxic ooze. Embrace the power of mystical shrines, utilizing the surroundings to turn the tide of battle in your favor!

• Parley with foes:

• Unleash the Parley feature, allowing you to interact with enemies in extraordinary ways during combat. Unleash special effects that can tip the scales of the battlefield and watch as your adversaries tremble with fear, or even witness them switch sides in awe! (or it’s just the false memory of the narrator?)

• Explore a vibrant world:

• Immerse yourself in a dazzling tapestry of hand-drawn, vivid 2D graphics, breathing life into the wondrous world of Untamed Tactics. Encounter a delightful array of anthropomorphic animal allies and adversaries, each brimming with their own unique charm and allure.

• Highly replayable:

• Discover an array of diverse strategies, intricate ability combinations, and captivating character builds. With ever-changing battle maps and thrilling events offering bountiful rewards and challenges, coupled with streamlined game mechanics accommodating players of all skill levels, there's endless excitement to be found within this wild fray!

Embark on this extraordinary expedition alongside Greycoat, and be captivated by a captivating cast of colorful animal characters, ready to become your steadfast friends or fearsome foes. Aid Greycoat in reclaiming his lost honor, confront the myriad threats lurking in the untamed Wilds, and carve out your place in this peculiar new world. Adventure awaits — will you seize it with unwavering determination?

description.zh: 本作是一款策略RPG，游戏过程中会将具备不同特色的孩子们设置在战车的各炮台，来击败遭遇的敌方武器并向前迈进。孩子们拥有各自的「情感」与「契合度」。妥善掌控好这两点，并依照状况调整编制即为赢得胜利的秘诀。
description.en: Fuga: Melodies of Steel is an RPG where you place children, each with their own unique characteristics and skills, at different gun turrets in a tank to fight against the enemy.

body.zh:
「没错……我们必须战斗！不然大家都会被带走！」

和平的农村一夜之间在战火中付之一炬，孩子们为了解救被俘虏的父母们，乘坐上巨大战车塔拉尼斯展开进击！

本作是一款策略RPG，游戏过程中会将具备不同特色的孩子们设置在战车的各炮台，来击败遭遇的敌方武器并向前迈进。

孩子们拥有各自的「情感」与「契合度」。

妥善掌控好这两点，并依照状况调整编制即为赢得胜利的秘诀。

【谜之超古代兵器：塔拉尼斯】

孩子们乘坐的巨大战车塔拉尼斯蕴含着许多谜团，有时展现的举动仿佛有着自我意识一般。

若是遇上千钧一发的危机，将会解除禁忌武器「灵魂加农炮」的封印。

【不断迫使玩家「抉择」的RPG】

你愿意付出牺牲来换取胜利吗？还是会寻求其他手段？

本作品将不断要求玩家在受限的条件中「抉择」。

为了达成目的，可不能永远只挑轻松安全的路走。

这时，你视为优先的会是什么呢？
body.en:
"We have to fight! If we don't, everyone we love will be taken away!"

One fateful night, a peaceful village is thrown into the flames of war. Determined to save their families, a group of children boards a giant tank and begins an offensive charge!

Fuga: Melodies of Steel is an RPG where you place children, each with their own unique characteristics and skills, at different gun turrets in a tank to fight against the enemy.

Living inside the tank, the children show emotion and gain affinity amongst each other. Manage these both to change the outcome of their journey!

-A mysterious ancient weapon: The Taranis

Taranis, the giant tank sheltering the children, conceals many mysteries and somehow seems to have its own will. In situations of crisis, it can release a forbidden weapon, the dreadful Soul Cannon.

-Your adventure. Your choices.

Will you make sacrifices for victory? Or will you seek another path?

In this RPG, many choices have to be made in order to progress... but taking the safest road may not always be the best option.

Faced with a desperate situation, what course of action will you choose?

description.zh: 《战场的赋格曲》续作闪亮登场！本作拥有战术性更强的战斗系统、更为惊心动魄的“选择”所造就的行进路线、由各种选择的叠加累积，创造出全新故事的事件系统等，是一款比前作更具战术性、冒险性和故事性的策略RPG！
description.en: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

body.zh:
前作结束后1年……“绝望”不过是途中的一站而已！

为了调查被回收的塔拉尼斯，孩子们被叫去了首都法老。

但不知为何，塔拉尼斯在调查过程中突然失控，载著5个孩子逃走了。

于是，马尔托等被留下的孩子们乘上了昔日的敌方武器——塔拉斯库斯，前去追踪塔拉尼斯。

【战术性更强的战斗系统！】

在听取玩家的意见，改善了操作性的基础上，

新的灵魂加农炮和玛娜嘉尔姆可以让玩家体验到更为极致的战术性！

【更为惊心动魄的“选择”所造就的行进路线！】

选择会产生分歧路线，分歧路线又会使得选择本身变得更为有趣！

飞行船辅助系统则将进一步扩大可供选择的范围！

【由各种选择的叠加累积，创造出全新故事的事件系统！】

在故事中做出的选择将会被累积到判断量表中，并对事件产生影响！

玩家可以体验亲身参与故事、影响故事走向的乐趣！

《战场的赋格曲2》是一款充满选择与判断的角色扮演游戏，

更为强烈的绝望、愤怒、悲伤与感动将在玩家的心中刻下浓重的一笔！
body.en:
A year has passed since the events of Fuga: Melodies of Steel. The war was fought and won. Life went on.

That is, until the children are summoned to Pharaoh to aid with the investigation of the recovered Taranis. During their survey, the Taranis suddenly goes haywire and sets out on a deadly rampage, trapping and absconding with a number of their party. The remaining children and Malt board their erstwhile enemy—the dread tank Tarascus—to chase after the Taranis and save their friends.

Revamped tactical battle system!

New additions to the battle system based on player feedback such as the reworked Soul Cannon and newly implemented Managarm allows for cutting-edge tactical gameplay!

Fight battles how you see fit!

Plot your path forward on the branching routes of the battlefield. The new airship support system allows for even more options!

Make every decision count!

The choices you make affect the Judgment Gauges, ultimately changing how events play out. You are the author of your own story.

The weight of despair, rage, and loss will shake you to your core in Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2—the RPG of hard choices and tough decisions!

*It's not necessary to play Fuga: Melodies of Steel to enjoy Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2.

movies.title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 - Official Trailer

description.zh: 《战场的赋格曲》完结！本作是一款集系列之大成的剧情模拟RPG！
description.en: The dramatic RPG Fuga: Melodies of Steel series is now complete!

body.zh:
所有的“绝望”所包含的意义即将全部揭晓……

马尔托突然失踪了！孩子们被神秘的声音所吸引，前往了禁忌的洞窟，却在那里发现了本应被丢弃在云海中的塔拉尼斯。

为了营救马尔托，孩子们再次乘上塔拉尼斯，潜入了贝尔曼帝国。然而，贝尔曼最强的“魔血骑士团”却阻挡在了他们的面前！

【全新的、兼具爽快感与战术性的战斗系统！】

战斗系统发生了重大的变化！针对弱点属性的连续攻击会被判定为“弱点连击”，可以不断叠加伤害；“辅助攻击”则可以让前作中的敌人和传说中的战士一起加入战斗。

【塔拉尼斯育成要素得到大幅度提升的中场休息任务！】

塔拉尼斯终于可以进化成最终形态了！使用Ω终端，解锁塔拉尼斯的潜在能力，学习丰富多样的“塔拉尼斯技能”，便可助力塔拉尼斯的进化！

【战略要素得到进一步增加的路线行进和事件战斗！】

行进路线中充满了诸如，可以释放塔拉尼斯潜在能力的能量点，以及可以与辅助角色交流的辅助通信等新要素！

此外，利用虚空界面中的事件年表，还可以解锁更多的隐藏事件！

《战场的赋格曲3》是一款充满极限选择与决断的RPG，玩家将在绝望、愤怒与悲伤的尽头迎来系列史上最大的冲击与感动！！

※《战场的赋格曲3》不需要前作的游玩经验。没有游玩过《战场的赋格曲》系列的玩家也可以享受本作。
body.en:
Unveil the Source of the World's Despair!

Malt has vanished without a trace! The children are led by a mysterious voice into the forbidden cave, where they discover the Taranis—the powerful tank thought lost in the sea of clouds. Determined to save Malt, the children reboard the Taranis and set off on a daring mission to infiltrate the heart of the Berman Empire. However, the Crimson Knights stand in their way, strongest of the Berman!

Brand-New Battle System

The battle system has undergone substantial changes. Weakness combos allow you to exploit enemy weaknesses and deal escalating damage with every hit, and assist attacks allow erstwhile enemies and a legendary warrior from past games to join forces and turn the tide of battle!

Upgraded Intermission

Intermission now features an upgraded system to evolve the Taranis to its ultimate form! Unlock its hidden powers with the Omega Terminal and master new Taranis Skills to aid your journey!

Strategic Route Progression and Event Battles

Explore new strategic features like Power Spots to unlock the Taranis's hidden abilities and Assist Transmissions that allow you to interact with supporting characters. Discover secret events through the Akasha Panel, which lets you navigate a timeline to change your fate!

Step beyond despair, anger, and tragedy in Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3, where heart-wrenching decisions lead to the series' most emotional and shocking story yet!

*It's not necessary to play Fuga: Melodies of Steel or Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 to enjoy Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3.

Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3 Teaser PV

description.zh: 体验一段围绕三位雄性巨龙展开的故事。为他们清洗身体、与他们聊天、触碰互动，以及更多亲密体验！这是一场 3D 巨龙清洗互动体验。
description.en: Enjoy a narrative involving 3 male dragons. Wash them, chat with them, touch them, and more! A 3D dragon washing experience.

body.en:
Work at a soap and wash service catering specifically to dragons! Dragon customers have needs you are well equipped to fulfill with your wash tools, your hands, and more to keep spirits high.

Enjoy a casually paced hands on and direct process of pampering dragons, and tend to some spicy requests as customers grow more comfortable with the care you provide. Only contains male dragons, male on male dragons, and male dragon on player content.

Game content is approximately 90 minutes per ending, with three endings.

description.zh: 《Wild Life》是一款面向成年玩家、以剧情驱动的单人开放世界动作角色扮演游戏。你将扮演 Max 和 Maya，探索精心打造的 Kerpal 世界，掌握快节奏、受类魂游戏启发的战斗系统，揭开其中隐藏的秘密，并与旅途中遇到的人建立亲密关系。
description.en: Wild Life is a story-driven, single-player open-world action RPG for adults. Play as Max and Maya, explore the handcrafted world of Kerpal, master fast Souls-inspired combat, uncover its mysteries, and form intimate relationships with the people you meet.

body.en:
OUR PROMISE TO PLAYERS

A quick message from us, the developers

Hi!

We’re the team behind Wild Life, an independent studio from Berlin, Germany. We develop and self-publish Wild Life, but it only exists because our community has supported us for years. That support gave us the rare chance to learn from our mistakes, improve, and keep pushing Wild Life forward. Now that the game is finally heading toward its 1.0 release, the whole team is giving it everything we have, and we’re incredibly excited to reach this milestone with you.

No generative AI has been used in Wild Life, and none will be used in the future. All assets, animations, gameplay systems, Unreal Engine Blueprints and trailers are created entirely in-house without asset store content.

•

Wild Life launches as a complete version 1.0 on February 8, 2027 for $40 USD. No Early Access and no pre-orders.

•

No battle passes, microtransactions, paid DLC, post-release monetization, or DRM.

•

The Sandbox will follow later in 2027 as free DLC for everyone who owns Wild Life after its own dedicated polishing phase.

One purchase gives you Wild Life at launch and the Sandbox later in 2027.

- WL Team

A STORY-DRIVEN OPEN-WORLD ACTION RPG FOR ADULTS

Explore the dangerous yet seductive world of Kerpal through the connected journeys of two playable protagonists, Max and Maya.

You begin as Max, who has left the slums of his homeworld behind and joined the Wildfires, a private military company. His very first mission takes him to Kerpal on an escort assignment for the Federation. What should have been a straightforward deployment, soon pulls him into the planet’s conflicts and the mystery surrounding Maya, a Kerpali with rare abilities and a deep connection to the planet. As their paths converge, Maya becomes the second playable protagonist, revealing Kerpal from an entirely new perspective.

Take on main and side quests, master fast real-time combat, grow through RPG progression, and form intimate relationships in a handcrafted true open world where exploration, story, romance, and adult content come together as one connected adventure.

UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES OF KERPAL

Max and Maya are drawn into a growing conflict involving Kerpali tribes, human settlers, hostile factions, and new off-world forces. Uncover hidden histories, and learn why Maya’s abilities could change the future of the planet and the secrets behind the kerpali curse.

EXPLORE A HANDCRAFTED OPEN WORLD

Travel through dense forests, open grasslands, beaches, canyons, deserts, caves, settlements, and ancient ruins. Each region has its own atmosphere, inhabitants, creatures, quests, and hidden places.

Explore Kerpal freely as the story leads you into new regions, greater dangers, and deeper mysteries.

RELATIONSHIPS, ROMANCE, AND ADULT ENCOUNTERS

Kerpal is home to a varied cast of characters with their own personalities, desires, and stories. Get to know them through conversations and personal quests. Build trust, flirt, pursue romance, and discover adult encounters.

Some relationships develop throughout the story. Others are brief, playful, or hidden off the beaten path. Mature content is integrated into character stories and the world around you rather than separated from the RPG.

All characters involved in sexual content are clearly adults. Every encounter is consensual, and the player remains in control.

MASTER SOULS-INSPIRED COMBAT

Combat rewards movement, timing, positioning, and commitment. Read enemy behavior, dodge, parry, manage your stamina, wear opponents down, and seize openings for powerful finishers.

Fight with daggers, claws, swords, spears, hammers, bows, firearms, plasma weapons, and more. Earn experience, improve your attributes, unlock perks, and equip new weapons and gear to shape the way you fight.

THE SANDBOX: FREE DLC IN 2027

Wild Life and the Sandbox are two distinct experiences.

Wild Life is the complete story-driven open-world action RPG launching on February 8, 2027.

The Sandbox is a separate creative mode developed alongside our community throughout the crowdfunding journey. Build custom maps, customize characters, and create interactive scenes and experiences using the tools developed throughout the project.

The Sandbox is not part of the February 8 launch build. Following its own dedicated polishing phase, it will be released later in 2027 as free DLC for everyone who owns Wild Life.

description.zh: 《Casualties: Unknown》是一款残酷无情的洞穴探险生存游戏。身为俘虏的你被派到异星上找回丢失的货物，你需要探索这颗星球的全部11层洞穴，在各色恶劣环境中奋力求生。而你实际上只是成千上万被派来送死的实验体之一。
description.en: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

body.zh:
在严酷的世界中生存

每一层都会抵达新的深度，带来全新挑战，要求你重新适应。

肢体与心血管模拟系统

受伤在所难免。你需要为自己包扎，应对感染的伤口，控制失血避免失去意识。此外，情绪也会显著影响生存几率，过度悲观会让你的处境更加艰难。

制作以求生存

身为具备理性的生物，制作工具能够帮助你更高效地穿越层层洞穴。万一发生出血，洞穴生物群提供的丰富资源也能够帮助你处理伤口。

风险自负的探索

过往的探险队留下了一些不错的战利品，但即便是有益的物品，也有可能导致你的死亡。

揭开真相

旅途的尽头究竟有什么？如果你成功了，等待你的又将是怎样的命运呢？

游戏特色

•

全面的心血管与肢体损伤模拟系统

•

可以在冒险过程中提升角色属性，包括智力、力量和韧性

•

提升生存几率的完善制作系统

•

3名玩法各异的独特角色

•

总计11层的异星洞穴探险，每一层都充满独特挑战与危险

•

300种可发现物品

•

可在主菜单调整战利品掉率和危险程度
body.en:
Survive a Harsh World

Each layer brings its own challenges, adapt and descend.

Simulated Limb and Cardiovascular Systems

Injuries are unavoidable. You will have to bandage yourself, fight infected wounds, and stabilize blood loss before losing consciousness. Additionally, your mood can greatly affect your chances of survival, too much doom and gloom will make your life harder.

Craft to Survive

As a creature capable of reason, using tools will allow you to travel the cavernous layers more efficiently. In case you start bleeding out, the flora will provide great resources to patch yourself up.

Explore at Your Own Risk

Previous expeditions have left some good loot behind. But even helpful things can prove to be your death.

Uncover the Truth

What actually lies at the end of this journey? And what becomes of you if you are to succeed?

Features

•

An entirely simulated cardiovascular and limb damage system

•

Character traits to increase on your run: Intelligence, Strength, and Resilience

•

Robust crafting mechanics to increase your odds of survival

•

3 characters with their own distinct playstyles

•

11 layers of an alien planet with their own challenges and dangers

•

300 items to find on your runs

•

Adjustable loot and danger values accessible on the main menu

description.zh: wolfworld是一款兽人题材的成人向奇幻回合制 RPG，玩家将在开放地图中探索城镇、森林、矿洞与地下城，通过战斗、采集、炼金、装备打造、生活技能、职业养成和多分支角色互动不断成长，并在高自由度的主线、支线与败北事件中体验危险、欲望与冒险交织的异世界旅程。
description.en: Wolfworld is an adult fantasy turn-based RPG with anthropomorphic characters. Explore towns, forests, mines, and dungeons, fight enemies, gather resources, craft gear, learn skills, and shape your journey through branching quests and character interactions.

body.en:
wolfworld是一款兽人题材的成人向奇幻回合制 RPG。

你将作为一名在异世界苏醒的冒险者，在城镇、森林、矿洞、海岸、教堂与地下城之间自由探索，通过战斗、采集、炼金、装备打造、生活技能与多职业养成不断成长，并在主线、支线、角色事件与多分支败北内容中推进属于自己的旅程。

在这片危险而混乱的大陆上，你不仅要面对怪物、领主与污染事件，也会在与不同角色的接触中逐步卷入欲望、支配、试探与信任交织的关系之中。游戏同时包含开放式成长、较高自由度的地图推进，以及大量角色专属事件与成人向剧情内容。

【游戏特色】

多职业养成与战斗构筑

体验战士、魅魔、牧师、法师等主职业体系，搭配副职业、跨职业技能、专属机制与技能树，组合出不同战斗流派。

回合制战斗与机制博弈

在战斗中管理姿态、元素、心跳心碎、天平平衡等职业资源，围绕伤害、控制、恢复、持续效果与爆发时机进行决策。

开放地图探索

前往不同区域进行采集、遭遇战斗、触发特殊事件与隐藏剧情，逐步解锁更多地点、角色和任务线。

角色支线与多分支互动

和多位兽人角色建立不同关系，体验各自独立的支线剧情、委托任务、战斗互动与专属事件。

丰富的成长系统

通过升级、属性分配、技能学习、装备制作、炼金、生活技能与特殊掉落持续强化角色。

成人向内容与败北事件

游戏包含成人向角色互动、强烈性暗示、支配与败北演出等成熟内容，整体风格偏黑暗奇幻与高危险关系描写。

持续更新内容

游戏将继续扩展主线章节、新角色、新支线、新地图、新职业调整与更多可收集事件内容。

【适合这类玩家】

喜欢兽人题材与奇幻冒险 RPG

喜欢回合制战斗、数值养成与技能构筑

喜欢带有成人向角色互动和多分支事件的剧情游戏

喜欢探索地图、收集资源、逐步解锁内容的成长体验

【内容提示】

本作包含成人向文本、成熟题材、欲望描写、支配关系、败北事件与部分黑暗风格剧情内容，仅推荐成年玩家游玩。

description.zh: 在风暴中迷路后，🦆“弹珠”和🐢“跳棋”需要你的帮助才能找到回家的路。在这个经典风格的横版平台跳跃游戏中，随风飘荡吧：旋转、跳跃、技巧、挑战、隐藏、搜集、海量内容。
description.en: 🦆 Marbles and 🐢 Checkers need your help finding their way home after being swept away in a storm. In this 90s buddy-platformer there's a ton of stuff to do and even more to collect!

body.zh:
乌龟和小鸭很可爱，但可小心了，它们的回家之旅着实有点恼人！

《随风飘荡》是一封献给经典游戏时代的情书！曾几何时，收集马拉松式平台跳跃游戏风靡一时，玩家需要不断尝试才能通关，而他们唯一的帮助就是一本游戏手册。

游戏中有超过 40 个关卡等待玩家的探索和征服，每个关卡都隐藏有独特的可收集物品，以及额外挑战和恼人的跳跳乐，要么征服“它们”，要么向“它们”俯首称臣！

上手很简单，游戏的第一关就将教会你所有能力，但可千万别以为你学会了……

游戏中可随时更换“主角”（乌龟或小鸭），每个主角都有一套全新的动作和技巧需要发现、使用和掌握——保持耐心，反复琢磨—随风而行，守得云开见月明！

主角很可爱，回家路很难！反复尝试-熟能生巧-发现窍门，如果你觉得这些都是小菜一碟，那么请睁大眼睛：沿路好风景—许多许多的隐藏、挑战、搜集或许你都错过了！

随风飘荡，想怎么玩就怎么玩。

🦆“弹珠”与🐢“跳棋”各自拥有独特的能力，但光靠这些还不足以应对所有特殊挑战……

去尝试发现和灵活组合不同的技巧，发挥创造力，去追求尽可能高的上限。

回家的旅途漫长而遥远，珍惜当下的每一刻吧。

因为那些时刻，终将成为美好的回忆！

你能走多远？你的旅程将在哪里结束？

让我们一起-随风-飘荡吧！

对喽，通关了游戏才刚开始哦……
body.en:
Don't be fooled by its cute charm! The journey home won't be an easy one!

Windswept is a love letter to a period of gaming where collectathon platformers reigned supreme, trying again was the norm, and players only had a game manual to guide them.

There are over 40 stages to explore, each with their own set of hidden collectibles, bonus challenges and quirky obstacles to overcome... or fall victim to!

You'll learn every ability in the first stage of the game, after that you're on your own!

Changing your leader gives you an entirely new set of actions to use and master - remember to take your time and things will click eventually...

Making your way home will be tough, and you'll need to keep trying until you get the hang of things - but for those who find it a walk in the park, there's plenty of hidden challenges along the way to test you!

There's no wrong way to play Windswept.

🦆 Marbles and 🐢 Checkers each have unique abilities, but that won't always be enough to overcome specialised challenges... Mix 'n' match different techniques to play your own way.

You may surprise yourself with what you're capable of!

The journey home is a long one - live for the moments as they happen.

After that, they're only a memory!

How far will you go?

Where will your journey end?

Let's get swept away - together!

description.zh: 《九日》是一款结合道教科幻与上古神话的 2D 平台动作冒险游戏。强调格挡机制和节奏明快的战斗、配合独特的道庞克背景，刻画出别具特色的手绘世界。面对统御新昆仑的九位太阳，玩家扮演羿，只身踏上一条复仇血路。
description.en: Nine Sols is a lore rich, hand-drawn 2D action-platformer featuring Sekiro-inspired deflection focused combat. Embark on a journey of eastern fantasy, explore the land once home to an ancient alien race, and follow a vengeful hero’s quest to slay the 9 Sols, formidable rulers of this forsaken realm.

body.zh:
《九日》是一款结合道教科幻与上古神话的 2D 平台动作冒险游戏。强调格挡机制和节奏明快的战斗、配合独特的道庞克背景，刻画出别具特色的手绘世界。

故事

跟随英雄羿的脚步，在新崑崙，羿将踏上一段始于『復仇』，终于『道』的诛王之路。

新崑崙，这座由外星种族太阳人所建造的庇护所数百年间沉静如海。在这片广褒的疆域裡，神祇们为凡人留下一处被称为桃花村的应许之地，亘古以来居住于此的人们持续着古老的祭祀，神圣的仪式会庇佑其子民免于种种灾厄。很快地，又一次的祭典即将举行，村裡的人们正忙着张罗各类祭品。然而就在一切如常之时，一位被遗忘的英雄，羿，从漫长的沉睡中意外甦醒，并在道的洪流掀起巨大涟漪。

跟随羿的脚步，一起在復仇的路上前行并击败统治新崑崙的九王。探索这个道教庞克的世界解开新崑崙神秘的面纱。

特色

• 类隻狼的战斗：

攻击与格档快速的不停交互切换的战斗节奏。利用格挡后所累积的能量，冲向敌人利用灌满『气』的符咒将敌人引爆。结合空中冲刺、二段跳、攀牆等传统2D平台动作游戏的操作交织出节奏明快的平台战斗。

• 紧张刺激的魔王战：

准备好面对危险的古老统治者、凶残的变种外星生物。利用你所有的工具和技能挑战这些令人生却的恐怖敌人。

• 道教庞克的世界设定：

道教结合赛博庞克的世界设定！将科幻元素与东方传说以及道教神话与哲学产生全新的道教庞克！

• 世界探索：

探索新崑崙这个每个区域都有不同特色环境建筑，交通干道互相连通的世界。关卡中藏有秘密和宝藏等待玩家挖掘与探索。但同时路途上也佈满陷阱和敌人，想要拿到报酬必须涉险而入。

• NPC与支线任务：

在旅途中，与不同的NPC互动可获得稀缺物资和进行装备升级。在这个充满威胁的世界，善用一切人脉与资源将会是击败九王的重要关键。另外，完成支线任务，除了优渥的报酬外，对剧情推进也有极大益处。

• 日漫手绘风格：

九日中有着许多精緻手绘背景、动画和漫画，製作时我们借镜了许多日本动画与漫画，希望用大量的逐格绘製以展现这款游戏的视觉特色。在各种细节上，包括过场动画和头目战，团队花费了极大精力企图建构出令人惊艳的画面。

关于赤烛游戏

我们是一家成立于2015年的台湾游戏公司。在过去的六年间，陆续製作过《返校》（2017）以及《还愿》（2019）两款叙事恐怖游戏。截至今日，我们团队拥有 12 名全职创作人，编制虽不大，但每位成员都有着丰富的创作经历与热忱。自创立以来，我们强调集体创作的重要性，给予作品的每位参与者极大的发挥空间，不断彼此沟通并亲力亲为地解决问题是赤烛创作模式的根基。
body.en:
Nine Sols is a lore rich, hand-drawn 2D action-platformer featuring Sekiro-inspired deflection focused combat. Embark on a journey of Asian fantasy, explore the land once home to an ancient alien race, and follow a vengeful hero’s quest to slay the 9 Sols, formidable rulers of this forsaken realm.

Story

In New Kunlun, hero Yi has awakened the 9 rulers of this forsaken realm. To defeat the 9 Sols in the deserted city.

“Becomes one with the way of Tao…”

New Kunlun, the Solarian’s last sanctuary, has remained quiet for centuries. Inside this vast realm, the ancient gods left mortals with a promised land that is forever protected by the sacred rituals, yet the truth of this world remains unknown to most. Everything changes when Yi, a long forgotten hero from the past, is awoken by a human child.

Follow Yi on his vengeful quest against the 9 Sols, formidable rulers of this forsaken realm, and obliterate any obstacles blocking your way in Sekiro-lite style combat. Explore in unique “Taopunk” setting that blends cyberpunk elements with Taoism and far eastern mythology. Unravel the mysteries of an ancient alien race and learn about the fate of mankind.

Features

2D Sekiro-lite Combat: Slash, deflect, charge into enemies and blow them up with the Taoist talisman! Each fight combines fast, brutal action sequences with classic platforming mechanics.

Intriguing Boss Fight: Ready yourself to fight the vicious ancient guardians and gruesome creatures. Be patient and utilize every move in your arsenal, mix up with Yi’s godly bow to defeat these larger than life figures.

Taopunk Setting: When cyberpunk clashes with Taoism, melding sci-fi elements with eastern mythology/fantasy, the experimental genre of Taopunk was born.

Exploration: Traverse in the interconnected regions of New Kunlun. Discover secrets, piece together the story behind Yi’s revenge.

Aids from inhabitants: Meet interesting NPCs of this world and interact with them to receive upgrades, gain new abilities, and discover useful technology.

Hand-drawn Environments/Animations and Manga: Nine Sols is filled with meticulous hand-crafted, anime style landscapes, sprite based hand-drawn animations, blending with Japanese manga inspired cutscenes.

Red Candle Games

From the creators of award-winning psychological horror games Detention and Devotion, comes Red Candle Game’s latest title Nine Sols. The studio aims to deliver a stylized action platformer that’s cohesive and complementary to its lore-rich narrative. It’s an ongoing, most ambitious project from this indie studio.

description.zh: 你准备好迎接第一款悠悠球式银河城了吗？！在这款 2D 俯视角冒险游戏中，你将探索一片广阔的城市景观，通过精通悠悠球技巧来重新诠释周围的环境。穿梭于城市的各个街区，对抗敌对的黑帮头目，重夺皮皮斯特雷洛家族的影响力！
description.en: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Navigate the city's many districts, fight rival crime bosses, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!

body.zh:
Explore a vast urban landscape in this exciting 2D top-down platforming adventure!

Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo combines combat, platforming action, puzzle-solving, and exploration — all enveloped in a delightful character-driven story about corporate shenanigans! Face off against the rival crime entrepreneurs and their underlings using the weapon you know best: your prized yoyo! With Yoko Shimomura contributing as guest composer, you're in for a truly authentic nostalgia blast!

Pay close attention to your surroundings to discover new ways to traverse the terrain! With each newly-learned yoyo trick, you'll come to reinterpret the cityscape, and by chaining these maneuvers together, you'll be able to dexterously reach places you could never have imagined! Many challenges have multiple solutions — so come up with your own novel routes in this mouth-watering adventure!

Features

•

Explore the city's 4 districts with over 1000 screens' worth of challenges and secrets!

•

Infiltrate the businesses of the 4 crime bosses! Navigate their labyrinthine buildings, take on foes, and solve action puzzles!

•

Master over 10 yoyo tricks and Special Moves to create your own yoyo-parkour routes and pulverize your enemies in combat!

•

Collect over 40 equippable Badges that alter the way you play!

•

Unlock over 20 passive Upgrades through a shady loan shark!

•

Find over 80 other collectibles throughout town, from life upgrades to precious treasures!

Corporate shenanigans abound!

Pippit, the self-declared yoyo master, has never meshed well with the rest of his family: the powerful and influential Pipistrellos, headed by his auntie, Madame Pipistrello. The family's had a firm grip on their city for over a decade, owing to the monopoly on electricity that they hold.

It just so happens that, when Pippit finally drops by for his annual visit to the Pipistrello Manor, he gets caught up in the rival companies' nefarious plot to dethrone the Madame and take the source of energy generation for themselves! After the attack, Pippit and the Madame find themselves having to cooperate in a completely new arrangement......

The Big City

Your journey takes place across a huge, bustling city run by rival crime entrepreneurs. From shopping districts to industrial complexes, to a geek culture convention and a sports-addicted neighborhood, you'll track down these dastardly crime bosses that have challenged your own family's dominion over the city!

Get ready for the first Yoyovania!

It never hurts to be on the lookout for secret nooks and crannies! Carefully explore the city's districts with the aid of your map, and carve your own path towards the bosses' places of business! Venture into their dangerous lairs, crack puzzles, and be prepared for epic showdowns!
