description.zh: 《龍焰魔法鎮》是一款支持 1-5 名玩家的策略游戏，充满魔法，轻松惬意。作为守焰人（Flamekeeper），你将帮助可爱的工匠龙找到理想家园。为城镇商店附魔，把龙卡牌放入其中，见证奇幻商业街的活力绽放。
description.en: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

body.zh:
《龍焰魔法鎮》是一款以回合制为核心的策略桌游，风格轻松可爱，可供 1 至 5 人游玩。玩家将化身守焰人，协助工匠龙与店主用精湛技艺为镇民们带来欢乐。收集并管理资源、使用附魔手段强化商店，施展魔法成为最厉害的守焰人。

游戏核心在于巧妙地将工匠龙布置在繁华的商业街。这些小龙能帮助玩家从商店收集各类资源，用于施展附魔法术，触发强力技能组合。结识非凡的“奇幻龙”可获得提升声望的特殊能力。你的最终目标是在游戏结束时获得最高的声望点数，赢取“龙焰大师”（Master of Flamecraft）的称号！

•

成为守焰人，踏入龙族栖居的美妙奇幻世界

《龍焰魔法鎮》构筑了一个龙与魔法共存的幻想世界。你将在此处邂逅一群可爱的工匠龙，它们将运用非凡的火焰技艺协助城中的店主完成看似平凡的日常事务。

“罪恶糖果店”的甜品即将上架，“龙邻邮政”已准备好向全城投递附魔邮件！

•

体验多元游戏模式，单人多人任你玩

无论你偏好独自探索、与好友同乐还是全球联机，《龍焰魔法鎮》都将为你提供独特体验。你可选择挑战不同难度的 AI 对手，也能为家人定制轻松惬意的关卡一同享受休闲乐趣。

随机生成的龙族、店铺与附魔道具相组合，使每局游戏都充满惊喜元素与策略机遇。虽然元素出现的顺序具有随机性，但如何调配资源完全由你掌控，为每次单人或多人游戏带来独特的体验。

•

掌握资源管理的艺术，创造强力组合技提升声望

想要脱颖而出，你需要以精妙策略智胜其他守焰人。通向胜利的途径千变万化，关键在于充分发挥你的技能优势。

在你的回合，你将造访城中任意一间店铺，或收集资源，或使用魔法道具为店铺附魔。你可以从“地精杂货店”获取铁材，到“飞龙蛋糕店”采购刚出炉的面包，或前往“龙涎药剂店”调配神秘饮品。收集足够资源后，即可对店铺施法——此举将唤醒店铺中所有的龙，通过各种能力的组合创造出惊艳连击。搭配具备一次性强力技能或终局计分加成的伙伴卡和华丽龙卡，声望点数将迅速增长，助你赢得胜利。

•

邂逅 70 余只有着精美动画的工匠龙，造访 30 家特色店铺，聆听奇妙的幻想乐章

《龍焰魔法鎮》生动呈现了插画师 Sandara Tang 创造的迷人魔法世界。绘制精美的工匠龙在繁华的 3D 城镇中施展技艺，动画细节丰富的店铺、摊位与实验室构筑出跃动的场景。

曾为《展翅翱翔》《猫与花毯》谱曲的 Paweł Górniak 再度回归，为本作带来美妙的乐章。

您能否在创意无限的工匠龙小伙伴的帮助下，赢得“龙焰大师”的称号？
body.en:
Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enchant the shops using artifacts, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper.

Your main task is to thoughtfully place dragon artisans in the town’s bustling shopping district. They will help you gather various resources from the shops, which you can later use to cast enchantments, triggering powerful ability combos. You’ll also befriend the extraordinary Fancy Dragons, with abilities allowing you to boost your reputation. Your main goal is to earn the most reputation points by the time the game ends. If you manage to do that, you’ll earn the Master of Flamecraft title!

•

Become a Flamekeeper and enter a cozy, vibrant world inhabited by dragons

Flamecraft is set in a fantasy world, in which dragons and magic are part of the ordinary. Here, you’ll meet the adorable artisan dragons, who will use their extraordinary flamecraft to help the town’s shopkeepers with their seemingly mundane tasks.

The sweets are just waiting to be baked in Guilty Treasures, and Scale Mail Post is ready to send enchanted letters all across the town!

•

Play in a variety of gameplay modes, both single and multiplayer

Whether you prefer playing solo, with friends or people from around the world, Flamecraft has something in store for you. Test your skills against AI of varying difficulty or set up a relaxing custom game for your family to enjoy together.

Each game is full of charming surprises and opportunities to strategize with how many dragons, shops, and enchantments there are. The order they appear in is random, but how you decide to play them is entirely up to you, leading to each play - solo or multiplayer - feeling uniquely different.

•

Master the art of resource management and create powerful combos to increase your reputation

You’ll have to strategize and outsmart other Flamekeepers if you want to come out on top. There are countless ways to victory, and it’s up to you to make the most of your skills.

On your turn, you’ll visit one of the various shops in town to either gather resources or enchant the shops using magical artifacts. You could visit Gnome Depot to grab some iron, get freshly baked bread from Drake of Cakes, or brew mysterious potions at Draconic Tonic. You’ll need those, among others, to later enchant the shops - this will let you fire up all of the dragons from a shop and combine their abilities to create amazing combos. This, along with the Companion and Fancy Dragon cards, which offer powerful one-time abilities and additional scoring opportunities, will let you get the reputation points needed to win the game.

•

Meet over 70 beautiful animated dragons and visit 30 unique shops while listening to a whimsical score

In Flamecraft, we’ve brought the enchanting world created by Sandara Tang to life. The beautifully illustrated dragons come to life as they use their craft in the vibrant 3D town, full of animated shops, booths, and laboratories.

Paweł Górniak, the composer behind Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, is also back, with another spellbinding score.

Will you be able to claim the Master of Flamecraft title with the help of your creative little crafter friends?

description.zh: 帮助厨师 Red 实现梦想——辞掉讨厌的工作，开一家全城最棒的餐厅！管理时间与资源，为形形色色的客人烹饪并上菜，无论毛茸茸与否。切、煎、混合，在这个带点幽默的温馨烹饪模拟游戏中熬过艰难的工作班次。
description.en: Help Red the Cook chase his dream - quit his dull job and open the best restaurant in town! Balance time and resources, serve delicious dishes to every kind of customer - fluffy or not. Chop, fry, mix, and hustle your way through busy shifts in this cozy cooking simulator with a pinch of humor.

body.zh:
辞掉让你喘不过气的工作，背上一笔高风险贷款，帮助厨师 Red 实现他的烹饪梦想！

切、煎、混合，忙碌一整天，在这款温馨的烹饪模拟游戏中，体验餐厅经营与食材制作的结合。

主要特色

在客人失去耐心之前做好菜并端上桌。

将新鲜食材与香料结合，解锁所有菜谱。

从毛茸茸的老顾客到奇怪的当地居民——每个人都有自己的胃口。

轻松幽默的氛围，以及一个温暖又有点古怪的世界等待你去探索。

准备好烹饪、上菜，一盘一盘地打造 Red 的梦想餐厅了吗？
body.en:
Quit your soul-sucking job, take a risky loan, and chase your culinary dream with Red the Cook!

Chop, fry, mix, and hustle your way through the day in a cozy cooking simulator that blends restaurant and time management, ingredient crafting.

Key Features

Cook and serve under pressure before your guests lose patience.

Combine fresh produce and spices to unlock all recipes.

From fluffy regulars to strange locals - everyone’s got an appetite.

Lighthearted humor and a warm, slightly odd world to explore.

Are you ready to cook, serve, and build Red’s dream restaurant - one plate at a time?

description.zh: 《龙晶》是一款Furry主题的以探索与叙事为核心的横版冒险游戏。故事发生在龙晶研究所召开第六次龙晶科技峰会之际，你将作为研究所的一名安保队员，在峰会期间执行安保任务，与角色互动，解开谜题，收集隐秘的线索，并逐步揭开平静表象下的暗涌。
description.en: Draconite is a Furry-themed side-scrolling adventure game focused on exploration and storytelling. As a security team member of the Draconite Research Institute, you'll carry out security duties during the summit and gradually uncover the turbulent undercurrents hidden beneath the calm facade.

body.zh:
一百年前，一颗陨石撕裂天幕，坠入大陆。它为这个世界带来了跨时代的能源——龙晶，也由此拉开了这个崭新时代的序幕……

《龙晶》的故事发生在龙晶陨石降临一百周年之际。第六届龙晶科技峰会即将召开，你将作为龙晶研究所联合安保卫队的一员，负责维护大会期间的秩序与安全。然而，在井然有序的表象之下，暗流正悄然涌动。

作为一款注重探索与叙事的横版冒险游戏，你可以在研究所中自由行动、四处探索，与不同角色交谈，并在巡查、调查与任务中推进剧情，逐步揭开研究所潜藏的危机。

随着事件不断发展，你将在这场峰会中经历个人成长，邂逅难忘的情感，并逐步走近龙晶时代背后那段尚未被讲述的故事。

丰富的场景交互：

研究所的每一处空间都值得留意。与环境中的装置、文件、物品和角色互动，了解研究所的日常运作，也从细节中发现被忽略的异常。

部分互动会带来额外信息、触发新的对话，或影响后续事件的发展。保持观察、主动探索，或许就能发现藏在寻常角落里的关键线索。

探索、调查与任务指引：

作为联合安保卫队的一员，你需要在研究所内巡查、与人员沟通、处理委托，并在不同区域之间推进调查。

游戏中的任务系统会记录当前目标与剧情进度，帮助你在探索时掌握行动方向；而真正的答案，仍需要你通过交谈、观察与亲自行动来寻找。

深入的角色支线：

通过与不同角色交谈，你可以接取他们的委托，并在完成任务的过程中逐步了解他们的经历、烦恼与隐藏的心事。 这些相遇不仅让研究所变得更加鲜活，也会让你从不同视角认识他们，以及正在暗处蔓延的危机。

融入剧情的互动玩法：

随着剧情推进，你会在研究所的不同场合亲自处理眼前的任务。在执行安保工作时检查来访者，在关键时刻完成检定，或在突发状况中协助解决问题。

这些互动会随着事件的发展自然出现，成为探索与调查的一部分。通过亲自完成这些环节，你将沉浸于角色所处的情境，也能从中发现新的信息与线索。

沉浸式叙事体验：

探索、调查、角色任务与剧情互动共同构成了研究所中的日常。你会在一次次巡查、交谈与行动中，逐步了解这座研究所的运作方式、其中的人们，以及隐藏在平静表象之下的异常。

随着探索不断深入，零散的线索与人物的故事将彼此交织，引导你一步步接近峰会背后的真相。
body.en:
A hundred years ago, a meteorite tore open the sky and fell upon the continent. It brought this world an energy source generations ahead of its time — draconite — and with it, raised the curtain on a new era...

Draconite takes place on the hundredth anniversary of the meteorite's arrival. The Sixth Draconite Technology Summit is about to convene, and you'll attend as a member of the Draconite Research Institute's Joint Security Force, charged with maintaining order and safety for the duration of the event. Beneath that orderly surface, however, undercurrents are quietly stirring.

A side-scrolling adventure game built around exploration and storytelling, Draconite lets you move freely through the Institute, explore at your own pace, talk with the people who work there, and advance the story through patrols, investigations, and assignments — gradually uncovering the crisis hidden within.

As events unfold, you'll grow over the course of the summit, encounter feelings you won't forget, and step closer to the untold story behind the Draconite Era.

Rich Environmental Interaction

Every corner of the Institute is worth a second look. Interact with devices, documents, objects, and people to learn how the place runs day to day — and to notice the anomalies buried in the details.

Some interactions turn up extra information, open new conversations, or shape how later events play out. Stay observant, explore on your own initiative, and you may find a crucial lead tucked away somewhere perfectly ordinary.

Exploration, Investigation, and Quest Guidance

As a member of the Joint Security Force, you'll patrol the Institute, speak with its personnel, take on requests, and carry your investigation from one area to the next.

The quest system tracks your current objectives and story progress so you always know where to head next — but the real answers still have to be found through conversation, observation, and action of your own.

In-Depth Character Side Stories

Talking with the people around you opens up their personal requests, and working through them reveals their histories, their worries, and the things they keep to themselves.

These encounters make the Institute feel alive, and let you see both its people and the crisis spreading in the shadows from new perspectives.

Interactive Gameplay Woven Into the Story

As the plot advances, you'll handle matters yourself throughout the Institute: screening visitors while on security duty, passing checks at critical moments, or helping resolve problems as they arise.

These sequences surface naturally as events develop, forming part of exploration and investigation alike. Taking them on yourself draws you into your character's situation — and turns up new information and leads along the way.

Immersive Narrative Experience

Exploration, investigation, character quests, and story interactions together make up daily life at the Institute. Patrol by patrol, conversation by conversation, you'll come to understand how this place works, the people inside it, and the abnormality lurking beneath the calm.

The deeper you explore, the more scattered clues and personal stories intertwine, guiding you step by step toward the truth behind the summit.

description.zh: 《伊莫》是一款多人在线大世界捉宠RPG。你将在广袤的艾德尔大陆上邂逅各种神奇生物——伊莫。和他们联结合体，还能以全新的视角和能力感受这个世界的美好。你也可以来到浮空天际的近未来都市，邂逅其他冒险家，交流旅途心得或是感受竞技的魅力。快带上你的伊莫，开启一场超越想象的大世界冒险之旅吧！
description.en: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

body.zh:
《伊莫》是一款多人在线大世界捉宠RPG。你将在广袤的艾德尔大陆上邂逅各种神奇生物——伊莫。和他们联结合体，还能以全新的视角和能力感受这个世界的美好。你也可以来到浮空天际的近未来都市，邂逅其他冒险家，交流旅途心得或是感受竞技的魅力。快带上你的伊莫，开启一场超越想象的大世界冒险之旅吧！

在冒险的旅途中，你将与伊莫联结合体，并利用伊莫的各种能力：完成世界上的谜题，赢得每场战斗的胜利，解决遇到的一切问题！不再局限于人类的速度、视野和能力，亲自体验理性与野性共存的蓬勃。与伊莫“联结”合体，用全新的视角感受世界！

每只伊莫都会因区域、天气、养成方式和成长线的不同，进化出多样分支形态。从沙滩形态到潮湿形态，从晒日光浴的海湾红，到分支进化为女巫草或“家里蹲”埋埋，生态千差万别。丰富的形态图鉴等待你捕捉收集、培养与研究，构筑独属于你的莫百科！

或是蓬松的绒毛，或是坚硬的铠甲……逼真的材质、丰富的动作表现，让你穿透屏幕，抚摸生命的灵动。羞羞獭抱铲猛冲、焚火狼静坐火旁、花芽蟹明明强壮却胆小。不经意间展现的小动作和反差正是他们迷人又可爱的地方！当它们敲敲屏幕，那是向你撒娇的信号！

各种神奇生物——伊莫，在艾德尔大陆上共生共舞，每一个种族都各自延续着独特的种族生态与群落故事。每一个角落，都是自然精妙的构思；每一道声音，都记录着生命的回响。更多新的故事会在挥爪一刻与大家邂逅，让每次冒险都更具世界厚度！

体验真正的即时制自由捉宠战斗的爽快！背袭、连续投掷、出其不意...当捕捉的方式不再单一，每一次丢出谜立方的瞬间都充满了惊喜；全新“抢蛋大作战”加入偷蛋玩法，和朋友一起获得稀有宠物，与其他玩家争夺稀有伊莫蛋，在策略、博弈与运气间享受紧张爽快的对抗！

每位冒险者都有一辆可停驻大世界营地的房车，与其他玩家相遇、交流。当回到家园，可与伊莫一同种植、建造与自由布置空间。旋转木马磨坊、摩天轮纺车等装置将生产与游玩融合，与好友协力和伊莫助力，让家园成为轻松、有趣、充满互动的温暖乐园！
body.en:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.

Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become stronger, here, every challenge is real and instantaneous!

Each Pathfinder now owns a personal RV on the vast continent of Idyll, parked at a campsite in this open world, where they can meet and interact with other players. When you return to Homeland with your RV, you can plant crops, build decorations, and freely arrange your space with Aniimo to transform the entire Homeland into a warm, fun, and interactive immersive paradise.

description.zh: 在《鲜花与众神》中，你将扮演一位有志蜥年，通过向神明献上死斗表演，踏上晋升贵族之路。率领军团浴血奋战，巧妙搭配兵种与祝福，但最重要的，是操控战场上的鲜血——施法、召唤、反败为胜。为了鲜血，牺牲你的追随者在所难免…… 你可以在死斗中走到多远呢？
description.en: Flowers and Deities is a roguelite auto battler where you command a blood-soaked lizardman army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to earn the favor of the Gods.

body.zh:
《鲜花与众神》是一款牌组构筑类 Roguelite，故事发生在一个由嗜血众神统治的雨林世界。率领你的军团踏入竞技场，将敌我洒落的鲜血化作资源，施展法术，召唤巨兽。战斗，死去，然后再次坠入众神的残酷盛宴。

从4种起源与信仰中做出选择，从第一场战斗开始塑造你的战术风格。在多座宏伟竞技场中迎战15+种族与125+独特单位：贵族军团、蛮族部落、冥府战士、天外来客……击败他们，再将他们征召进你的军队。

12种战术流派、300+魔法装备、100+神圣祝福与50+状态效果，构成极其广阔的构筑空间。通过灵活的装备与槽位系统自由实验，针对敌人的弱点调整策略，创造连众神都未曾预料的组合。

鲜血是你最珍贵的资源。每个单位的死亡——无论敌我——都会在地面留下可供利用的血迹。消耗鲜血，施展法术，逆转战局。竞技场已然干涸？那就献祭你的随从，以众神赐予的力量撕开胜利之路！

主要特色

4种起源与信仰 - 从第一战开始塑造你的战术风格

15+种族与125+独特单位 - 击败敌人，将他们征召入伍

广阔构筑空间 - 12种流派、300+装备、100+祝福与50+状态效果

鲜血就是资源 - 每一次死亡都能成为逆转战局的力量

6座宏伟竞技场 - 迎战蛮族、冥府战士、天外来客与传奇巨兽
body.en:
Flowers and Deities is a roguelite auto battler set in a rainforest world ruled by bloodthirsty gods. Build your army, arrange your formation, and fight your way through deadly arenas. Sacrifice your soldiers, spill blood, and use it to cast spells and summon creatures.

Choose from 4 origins and faiths that define your playstyle from the first fight. Battle across multiple grand arenas against 15+ races and 125+ unique unit types. Face noble legions, barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, and alien visitors. Defeat them, and conscript them into your own ranks.

The build space is expansive: 12 tactical archetypes, 300+ magical items, 100+ divine blessings, and 50+ status effects. A flexible equipment and slot system lets you experiment freely, counter enemy weaknesses mid-run, and find combinations the gods never intended.

Blood is your most precious resource. Every unit lost - no matter yours or theirs - fills the pool. Spend it to turn the tide. Combat arena getting dry? Sacrifice your kin and claw out that victory with the power Gods bestow upon you.

Key Features

•

4 origins and faiths - distinct starting builds that shape your entire run

•

125+ unique units across 15+ races - recruit enemies you defeat and grow your legion

•

Vast build space - 12 archetypes, 300+ items, 100+ blessings, 50+ status effects

•

Blood is resource - every death fuels your next move

•

6 grand arenas - escalating enemies including barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, alien visitors, and legendary beasts

description.zh: 在这款温馨的战术解谜游戏中，带领一支小狗足球队，解决 170 多个挑战并射门得分！
description.en: Lead a team of puppy soccer players, solve 170+ challenges and score goals in this cozy tactical puzzle game!

body.zh:
狗狗冠军 (Pup Champs) 是一款由 轨道连结 (Railbound) 和 内饭盒 (inbento) 的制作团队倾力打造的温馨战术解谜游戏。运用你的智慧，成为一名教练，指导一群可爱的狗狗队员，解决超过 170 个精心设计的挑战！

谋定而后动

正确部署你的球员，清理他们的传球路线，避开危险，智胜对手，并带领你的队友们取得胜利。

成为解谜冠军

每个章节都会带来意想不到的挑战 - 球会陷入泥坑，猴子会模仿你的动作，兔子会对传球做出反应，等等！有些球员会把它们视为障碍，而经验丰富的教练却能从中发现机会…

一个关于情谊的故事

在解谜的间隙，通过互动式动态漫画发现一个关于友谊与体育的故事。作为一名退役的足球教练，运用你的经验和智慧，帮助一群笨拙的小狗团结起来，组建一支优秀的球队！

适合解谜新手和专家

狗狗冠军 (Pup Champs) 的设计初衷是让每个人都能轻松上手。一系列精心设计的谜题将引导你在赛场上大放异彩，并射入制胜进球。想要更多挑战？我们还准备了丰富的奖励关卡来满足你的所有需求！
body.en:
Pup Champs is a cozy tactical puzzle game from the makers of Railbound and inbento. Use your wits to become a coach, guide a team of adorable pups and solve over 170 hand-crafted challenges!

PLAN YOUR ACTIONS

Position your players just right, clear their passing lanes, avoid hazards, outsmart the opponents and lead the pups to victory.

BECOME A PUZZLE CHAMPION

Each chapter brings in unexpected challenges - balls get stuck in the mud, monkeys mimic your movements, bunnies react to passes, and more! Where some players see an obstacle, a skilled coach can spot an opportunity...

A STORY ABOUT BONDS

In between solving puzzles discover a tale of friendship and sports told through interactive motion comics. As a retired soccer coach use your experience and wits to help out a bunch of clumsy pups come together and form a great team!

FOR PUZZLE NOVICES AND EXPERTS ALIKE

We designed Pup Champs to be accessible to everyone. A series of carefully crafted puzzles will guide you to shine on the field and score game-winning goals. Want an additional challenge? We've got plenty of bonus levels to satisfy you!

description.zh: 一款修补铁路，环游世界的休闲益智游戏。
description.en: A relaxing puzzle game about fixing train connections and travelling the world - now with a level editor!

body.zh:
轨道连结是一款轻松的铁轨拼接益智游戏，讲述了两只狗狗乘坐火车环游世界的故事。

玩家将在不同的景点连接和切断铁路，帮助所有人回到家乡，并破解超过240道益智谜题，包括平缓坡道和曲折通道。

帮助火车在“嘟嘟”声中抵达目的地摆放、移除或重新安排火车路线，让车厢安全连接到与火车头上。但要小心，不要让它们撞到一起！

超过240道待解谜题轻松通过主线关卡的各个地点。沿途的岔路还有各种刺激的脑筋急转弯等待着你，即使是最苛刻的玩家也会喜欢！

以火车为灵感的游戏机制利用隧道快速到达远方。恰到好处地使用铁路障碍物让火车延误。切换轨道以改变不同方向的火车路线。在路途中接上可爱的朋友，迎接各种不同的挑战！

健康向上的艺术和音乐氛围在游戏世界中享受以漫画为灵感的视觉效果，以及由制作《Golf Peaks》和《inbento》的团队带来的舒缓音乐原声带。
body.en:
Railbound is a comfy track-bending puzzle game about a pair of dogs on a train journey around the world.

Connect and sever railways across the world to help everyone reach their homes and solve over 240 clever puzzles ranging from gentle slopes to twisted passageways.

BEND RAILS TO MAKE THE TRAIN GO ‘CHOO-CHOO’

Place, remove and reroute connections so that carriages safely connect to the locomotive. But, be careful and don’t make them run into each other!

240+ PUZZLES TO COMPLETE

Our main levels will take you through a variety of locations at a relaxed pace. Forks along the road will lead you to spicy brainteasers that’ll please even the most demanding players!

TRAIN-INSPIRED MECHANICS

Use tunnels to cover vast distances in an instant. Delay trains using well-timed railway barriers. Switch tracks to reroute cars in different directions. Pick up cute friends on the way and encounter even more challenges on your journey!

ART AND MUSIC FULL OF WHOLESOME VIBES

Across the game’s world enjoy our comic-book-inspired visuals and a relaxing original soundtrack by the team behind Golf Peaks and inbento.

GO OFF THE RAILS WITH THE LEVEL EDITOR

240+ puzzles are not enough? Try out the level editor mode, create your own challenges, share them with the world via Steam Workshop or check out other people's puzzles!

description.zh: 一款准备美丽便当盒的烹饪益智游戏！在这款厨艺挑战中破解120+种食谱、摆弄食物、仔细思量盒中料理，并享受一个温馨的故事！
description.en: A cooking puzzle game about arranging beautiful bento lunches! Solve 120+ recipes, play with food, think inside the box and enjoy a heartwarming story in this culinary brain-teaser!

body.zh:
《inbento》是一款轻松的图块匹配益智游戏，你可以一边准备日式便当盒（bento），一边享受关于养育儿女和成长的可爱故事。 将超过120种令人费解的食谱制作出来、精通复杂的厨艺，并在将爱倾注到你创造的料理时，了解猫咪家庭的生活。

破解食谱在每个谜题中，你需要从限量的食材和最终成品的图片开始着手——按正确的顺序旋转、移动并放入食物，重新写下原始食谱并制作美味佳肴！

温馨故事完成每一章后，你将获取互动式绘画奖励，并一窥猫咪家庭的生活以及为人父母的酸甜苦辣。

120+种食谱等你挑战在游戏过程中，你会发掘新的游玩方式，让你交换、移除和复制食材，让谜题更加有趣！

无需精通厨艺也能游玩不必是专业大厨也能享受《inbento》——游戏中的无文字教程会以轻松的节奏提供你需要的提示、让你畅快游玩！
body.en:
inbento is a chill pattern-matching puzzle game where you prepare Japanese lunch boxes (bento) while enjoying a cute story about parenthood and growing up. Recreate over 120 puzzling recipes, master tricky mechanics and learn about the life of the kitten family as you pour your love into the food you create.

SOLVE THE RECIPESIn each puzzle you start with a limited number of ingredients and a picture of the final result - rotate, move and insert the food in the right order to rediscover the original recipe and make a delicious dish!

A HEARTWARMING STORYFinishing each chapter will reward you with interactive illustrations offering glimpses into the life of a cat family and the ups & downs of parenthood.

120+ MEALS TO PREPAREOver the course of the game you will encounter new mechanics that allow you to swap, remove and copy ingredients in order to make the puzzles more exciting!

ZERO UNDERSTANDING OF COOKING REQUIREDYou don’t need to be a pro chef to play inbento - the game’s relaxed pace and textless tutorial will offer all the guidance you need to have a great time!

description.zh: 曾是青梅竹马的大学生相约改编儿时的驯龙纸上游戏，不料在一次昏迷中频频陷入清醒梦，而梦境的内容竟然是他们正在开发的游戏……于是，围绕着学院、老师、同学、回忆、梦想和世界各地的龙魂传说的故事，就由重回初中的两人拉开序幕……
description.en: While constantly working on a video game without any rest, a college student who's about to graduate quietly slipped into slumber several times. In those lucid dreams, he found himself in the game he was working on, the fantasy world of Dragon Spirits.

body.zh:
玩家交流群：378509945

曾是青梅竹马的大学生相约改编儿时的驯龙纸上游戏，不料在一次昏迷中频频陷入清醒梦，而梦境的内容竟然是他们正在开发的游戏……

于是，围绕着学院、老师、同学、回忆、梦想和世界各地的龙魂传说的故事，就由重回初中的两人拉开序幕……

- 作者和初中班主任赌气的产物，改编自纸上乱写乱画的游戏，是大学毕业的纪念作。

- 许多画师设计绘制的100多种风格各异的龙魂！

- 由浅入深的即时战斗系统，策略为主、反应为辅。

- 主线是轻松的校园故事，而支线中却潜藏着龙魂历史的秘密……

- 丰富的冒险地图，从龙魂学院，到城市、森林、荒野、洞窟、海滩……
body.en:
While constantly working on a video game without any rest, a college student who's about to graduate quietly slipped into slumber several times.

His workmate, as well as his childhood best friend, advised him to take some decent sleep, but he simply wanted to get the game done before graduation to prove himself.

However, the mystery is that, in those lucid dreams, he found himself in the game he's been working on —— a fantasy world of Dragon Spirits.

His memory of the real world fades in and out among these dreams.

He found himself became as his younger self and met his childhood best friend again. They are all junior school students here, learning how to master the power of Dragon Spirits with the help of their teachers and many other classmates.

Déjà vu, he just cannot understand why everything felt so familiar and miraculous.

•

Adapted from a self-made board game created by one of the developers. She designed it at her very young age. Her teacher laughed and said that it is absolutely worthless and impossible to become a real video game. Many years later, she made this game for celebrating her graduation from college.

•

Catch, Train, Battle! The core of its game mechanic is inspired by the Pokémon series. Rest assured that our unique design will deliver a distinctive experience.

•

Tactical, challenging, and exciting real-time combat system. You need to choose the 4 skills for every Dragon Spirit in your team to create an optimized combination for battles, you must know when would be the best to use them.

•

There are plenty of side quests and challenges to discover and conquer, but be sure to enjoy your colorful school life. You can even reveal the secrets hidden among the history of Dragon Spirits.

•

100+ beautiful and characteristic illustrations of Dragon Spirits from various talented artists.[st]

description.zh: 在这款现代都市为背景的角色扮演游戏中，你可以收集80+种不同的龙魂，研究配招，搭配队伍，制定战术，组建自己的龙魂战队，与它们一起体验异闻故事。在魔都中无处不在的虚拟异空间中冒险，阻止群体认知污染在现实世界中蔓延，揭开黑幕的阴谋。
description.en: In this modern urban-themed RPG, you can collect 80+ different dragon spirits, experiment with skill setups, assemble teams, and devise strategies to build your dragon spirit squad. Adventure through the virtual spaces in Metapolis, and uncover the conspiracy behind it all.

body.zh:
《龙魂：魔都异闻》是一款现代都市背景下的怪物收集RPG，剧本以AVG的形式进行，约20万字。游戏中你可以在充满都市怪谈的魔都中冒险，进入一个个赛博异空间，契约（收服）不同的龙魂，培养它们、配招、搭配队伍战术，成为“龙魂高手”。

◆剧情梗概：认知污染侵蚀魔都◆

主人公谭雅欣是一名生活在魔都的游戏开发者。原本平凡普通的生活被突然出现在现实的巨龙所打破，而这些巨龙竟然就是她所开发游戏里的龙魂！

曾经生活的城市不再只是灯红酒绿的不夜城，人们的意识正在不断被污染，虚构与现实的边界已然模糊！

为了解开这一切背后的谜团，为了让自己生活的城市恢复原本的模样，当然也为了能和更多的龙魂成为伙伴，谭雅欣开始了这场与龙共舞的旅程。

◆80+种龙类伙伴◆

玩家需要组建自己的龙魂队伍，指挥它们战斗。达成自由龙魂们提出的特殊要求，就能与其达成契约，让它们成为新的伙伴。

每一位龙魂伙伴都有自己独特的战斗特性，比如：具有群体复活能力的苍青龙、能将自己身上的强化继承给下一只出场龙魂的霓龙、敏捷差距越大，进攻越为迅猛的霹雳龙。

◆打造你独属的战斗风格◆

每条龙都有其擅长的战斗风格和队伍定位，在培养和战斗时不能一概而论，要逐一分析每条龙的能力，为其制定专属的作战方式。

玩家可以通过配招、装备道具等方式，调整龙魂的面板数值，比如黑月龙擅长回避攻击，灵活使用状态翻弄对手，那么不妨牺牲防守能力，提升它的敏捷。

◆探索虚拟与现实的边界◆

魔都是一座充满了生机的城市，恰逢虚拟世界的侵染事件让整个城市更加“生机盎然”，或者换个说法——混乱不堪。而罪魁祸首就是充斥在魔都各地、打破虚拟与现实边界的特殊地带：拟茧房。

在游戏中，玩家需要深入探索不同的拟茧房。每一个拟茧房都是一个混沌的漩涡，其中流淌着大量无规律的信息，和伺机而动的危险。当然，还有更多的野生龙魂与其他敌人。

◆揭秘魔都暗面阴谋◆

除了拟茧房，魔都当然还有大量的正常空间。玩家虽然需要周旋于城市的各个角落，寻找这场危机背后的主谋与真相。但在路上，你也可以停下来，看看城市的风景和周遭的环境，了解一下平凡中的魔都生活。

◆契约者之间的对战◆

最后，在主线剧情之外，玩家还能在魔都找到其他契约者与他们的龙魂。享受与TA们的对战，破解TA们的战术，加深自己与龙魂的羁绊，共同成长为战无不胜的搭档。
body.en:
Dragon Spirits 2 is a creature-collecting RPG set in a modern urban environment with a storyline about 300,000 words. Players can explore a city filled with urban legends, venture into various otherworldly spaces, and form contracts with different dragon spirits. You can nurture these spirits, customize their abilities, strategize team compositions, and build a formidable dragon spirit squad.

◆Story Overview: Cognitive pollution in Metapolis◆

The protagonist is a game developer living in bustling Metapolis. Her ordinary life is disrupted when dragons from the game she developed appear in reality! Upon forming contracts with these dragon spirits, the protagonist realizes that the real world is being invaded by more dragons of unknown origin. The once vibrant city is no longer just a sleepless town of bright lights; people's minds are being increasingly contaminated, and the line between fiction and reality has blurred!

The protagonist, also known as a pactsealer, embarks on a journey with dragons to uncover the mystery behind these events, restore the city to its former state, and form bonds with more dragon spirits.

◆80+ Dragon Companions◆

Assemble your dragon spirit team and command them in battle. But, before recruiting them as your new companions, you must fulfill their unique needs.

◆Create Your Unique Combat Style◆

Each dragon spirit has its strengths and team roles, requiring careful consideration when training and in battle. Analyze each dragon's abilities, tailor a unique combat strategy, and adjust their stats through skill setups and equipping items.

◆Explore the Boundary Between Virtual and Reality◆

Metapolis is a vibrant place, but the virtual world contamination has made it even more chaotic. Special zones known as Cocoon, scattered throughout the city, are responsible for breaking the boundary between virtual and reality.

In the game, players will explore various Cocoons, each a chaotic vortex of unstructured information and lurking dangers. Of course, there are also wild dragon spirits and other enemies waiting.

◆Uncover the Dark Secrets of Metapolis◆

Apart from the Cocoons, there are plenty of regular areas in Metapolis. Navigate different parts of the city to uncover the mastermind behind this crisis. Along the way, you can also take a moment to enjoy the city's scenery and immerse yourself in Metapolis's everyday life.

◆Battles Between Pactsealers◆

Meet other pactsealers and their dragon spirits in side missions along the city. Enjoy battles against them, decipher their strategies, and deepen your bond with your dragon spirits, growing together into an unbeatable team.

description.zh: 感受动人心弦的故事，了解女子与一只高贵的狼所建立起的毕生羁绊，一起在迅速消逝的世界里展开精彩冒险。
description.en: Experience the moving tale of a young woman and her lifelong bond with a magnificent wolf as they embark on a thrilling adventure through a rapidly dying world.

body.zh:
《Neva》是一款感情丰富的动作冒险游戏，是广受好评的《GRIS》制作团队所推出的最新幻想力作。

《Neva》记述女子Alba的故事，她遭逢黑暗势力的创伤之后，和一只奇特的幼狼建立起连结。一人一狼踏上危险的旅程，穿越昔日美丽但如今逐渐凋零的世界。

Alba和幼狼得学习互相帮忙，合力克服越来越危险的困境，彼此的关系也将在过程中渐渐改变。叛逆的幼狼将蜕变为气宇不凡的成狼，渴望建立属于自己的认同，考验Alba的爱与人和狼之间的承诺。

面对即将摧毁一切的不祥世界，Alba与勇敢的狼同伴会尽一切努力活下去，建立新家园，携手前进。
body.en:
Neva is an emotionally-charged action adventure from the visionary team behind the critically acclaimed GRIS.

Neva chronicles the story of Alba, a young woman bound to a curious wolf cub following a traumatic encounter with dark forces. Together they embark on a perilous journey through a once-beautiful world as it slowly decays around them.

Over time, their relationship will evolve as they learn to work together, helping one another to brave increasingly dangerous situations. The wolf will grow from a rebellious cub to an imposing adult seeking to forge her own identity, testing Alba’s love and their commitment to one another.

As the cursed world threatens to overwhelm them, Alba and her courageous companion will do whatever it takes to survive and make a new home, together.

description.zh: 《灵魂摆渡人》是一款关于死亡的休闲管理游戏。作为逝者的船主，建造一艘船去探索世界，关爱你的幽灵朋友，引导他们穿越神秘的海洋，最终将他们送到来世。内含疗愈心灵的本体游戏和三个主要内容更新包：探索一个更宽广的世界，结交四个全新的灵魂朋友！
description.en: Spiritfarer® is a cozy management game about dying. As ferrymaster to the deceased, build a boat to explore the world, care for your spirit friends, and release them into the afterlife. The Spiritfarer Farewell Edition includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates.

body.zh:
你会如何进行临终道别？

《Spiritfarer®》是一款关于死亡的休闲管理游戏。你扮演逝者的船主斯特拉，也是一名灵魂摆渡者。建造一艘船去探索世界，然后帮助和关爱幽灵，最终将他们送到来世。耕种、采矿、捕鱼、收割、烹饪，并用你自己的方法渡过神秘之海。加入小猫达芙迪尔的冒险之旅，开启双人合作模式。与你的幽灵乘客一起度过悠闲的美好时光，创造永恒的回忆，最终学会如何向你珍爱的朋友道别。

《Spiritfarer®》是一款屡获殊荣的管理类游戏，其内容围绕死亡这一话题而展开，是一款舒心疗愈的游戏。《Spiritfarer®》Farewell版是其终极版，内含受逾一百万名玩家青睐的《Spiritfarer®》游戏本体和迄今为止发布的所有额外内容包。来看看为何各大评论方称《Spiritfarer》为“2020年度最佳游戏之一”吧。

游戏特色：

• 享受美丽的手绘艺术和动画。

• 建造、管理和改进你的渡船。

• 耕种、采矿、捕鱼、收割、烹饪、编织、制作！各种各样的活动在等着你！

• 结识一群令人难忘的角色，带他们上船，关爱他们，与他们建立良好的关系。

• 你可以采用奔跑、跳跃和滑行的方式一路闯过精心设计的平台关卡。

• 探索奇幻和充满想象力的世界。寻找和收集各种资源，以升级你的船只并为乘客制作礼物。

• 体验充满难忘瞬间的感人故事。

• 放松几个小时，进入舒适且令人放松的游戏。花上30个小时即可完成整个游戏，花上几百个小时则能详细感受《Spiritfarer》的所有细节。

• 游戏内针对船只、角色甚至是小猫都有丰富的自定义选项，助你打造独一无二的冒险之旅！

• 在可选的本地合作模式下扮演小猫达芙迪尔。

• 内含疗愈心灵的本体游戏和三个主要内容更新包：探索一个更宽广的世界，结交四个全新的灵魂朋友！

加入讨论组

欢迎加入我们的中文讨论组！《Spiritfarer》官方玩家QQ群：1001220629
body.en:
What will you leave behind?

Spiritfarer® is a cozy management game about dying. You play Stella, ferrymaster to the deceased, a Spiritfarer. Build a boat to explore the world, then befriend and care for spirits before finally releasing them into the afterlife. Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, and craft your way across mystical seas. Join the adventure as Daffodil the cat, in two-player cooperative play. Spend relaxing quality time with your spirit passengers, create lasting memories, and, ultimately, learn how to say goodbye to your cherished friends. What will you leave behind?

The Spiritfarer® Farewell Edition is the definitive edition of the award-winning cozy management game about dying. It brings together the base game beloved by over 1 million players, and all the additional content released to date. See why critics called Spiritfarer one of the Best Games of 2020.

Features:

• Enjoy beautiful hand-drawn art and animation.

• Build, manage, and improve your own ferry.

• Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, weave, craft! An endless variety of activities await you!

• Meet, take on board, care for, and forge relationships with a cast of memorable characters.

• Run, jump, and glide your way through elegantly constructed platforming levels.

• Explore a fantastic and imaginative world. Seek and gather resources to craft upgrades for your ship and gifts for your passengers.

• Experience moving, emotional stories filled with unforgettable moments.

• Unwind for hours into cozy and relaxing gameplay. 30 hours to finish, 50+ to experience everything Spiritfarer has to offer.

• Make the adventure your own with rich customization options for your boat, character, even the cat!

• Play as Daffodil the cat in optional local co-op. Supports Remote Play Together.

• Includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates: explore an expanded world and befriend four new spirit friends!

description.zh: 落魄骑士从战场捡回来的一条野狗，在主人被军团抓走后，被世人视为路边蝼蚁的它，决意含起主人留下的破剑，踏上寻找主人的征程。潜行暗杀/类魂关卡/打铁弹刀/Boss战。
description.en: A stray dog saved by a disgraced knight marches to rescue its captured master. Scorned by all as useless roadside trash, it grips his frayed sword in its jaws and ventures forth. Features: Stealth kills, custom levels, precise parries, brutal boss fights.

body.zh:
我们宣发主阵地在小黑盒，使用小黑盒APP扫码关注我，了解更多制作组资讯。QQ2群：964375397。求愿望单支持！

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

中世纪乱世，列国征伐不休，边陲封地灰棘领惨遭霸权军团入侵。

此地无神明庇佑，无英雄救世，只有战火焚尽村落、铁蹄踏碎平凡。无数平民、随从、牲畜沦为乱世弃子，无人铭记、无人怜悯。

主角是一只自幼被骑士收养的无名猎犬，无名号、无归属，常年随主人守在荒僻领地，苟活于路边尘土，是世人眼中最廉价、最渺小的路边活物。

主人是一名落魄退役骑士，曾为军团征战半生，屡立战功，最终却因知晓军团暗黑秘辛，被上层视作隐患，惨遭弃用、抹黑。

骑士半生孤苦，唯有这只土狗相伴。他从不驯养猎犬搏杀，只教它避世存活，盼它安稳苟活、远离战火。

这只无名狗子，不懂家国大义，不懂恩怨权谋，此生执念唯有一件：忠于唯一收留自己的主人。

世人皆视它为路边废狗、尘埃蝼蚁，可它的世界里，落魄骑士便是唯一的天地。

游戏玩法：

1.弹反，背刺偷袭，处决

2.强大特殊战技，游戏中设计了多种特殊战技可供玩家体验不同的战斗

3.探索，在类魂关卡中发现更多宝物，击杀敌人获得经验和金钱解锁更多技能
body.en:
The medieval age is torn by endless wars between kingdoms. The border fief Greythorn is invaded by a tyrannical legion. No gods shelter this land, no heroes rise to save folk. Villages burn under fire, ordinary lives crushed by iron hooves. Countless villagers, servants and beasts are cast aside, forgotten and pitiless. The protagonist is an unnamed hound raised by a knight since birth. Rootless and nameless, it lingers on dusty roads beside its master, seen as worthless vermin by all. Its owner is a disgraced retired knight. He fought for the legion for decades and earned glory, yet was slandered and discarded for uncovering the legion’s dark secrets. The knight lived a lonely life with only this dog by his side. He never trained it for battle, only taught it to hide and survive far from war. The hound cares nothing for kingdoms or schemes. Its sole devotion belongs to the knight who took it in. The world dismisses it as a stray cur, yet the fallen knight is its entire world.

Gameplay:

•

Parry, backstab, deathblow

•

Powerful special combat arts. Multiple arts are designed for players to experience varied battles

•

Explore: discover treasures in soul‑like levels, gain EXP and gold by defeating enemies to unlock more skills

description.zh: 《BARKOUR》是一款快节奏动作平台游戏，还带着一点潜行味道。化身特工 T.H.U.N.D.E.R.，用跑酷身手、高科技间谍装备，以及总能惹上麻烦的天赋执行任务。跳跃、潜行、战斗，在充满动作、狗狗式混乱和荒诞惊喜的间谍冒险中一路闯关。
description.en: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

body.zh:
特工

好狗狗。顶尖特工。

认识特工 T.H.U.N.D.E.R.：训练有素的精英特工，精通跑酷、高科技装备，以及把自己卷进麻烦的各种方式。

它也许是 M.A.N. 最出色的特工之一，但脱下满身间谍装备，骨子里依然是一只不太普通的狗。它会摇尾巴、跟着鼻子走，也偶尔会让狗狗本能压过专业特工应有的完美纪律。

好在拯救世界，有时候正需要这一套。

任务

你的任务。你的手段。

飞檐走壁、沿栏杆滑行，再用狗狗般的敏捷身手跃过重重关卡。藏身阴影、用间谍装备引开敌人、找到秘密通道……或者干脆把低调忘在脑后，直接冲进战场。

《BARKOUR》融合高速平台动作、潜行、战斗和高科技装备，让你用自己的方式应对每一道难题。

活用超过 30 种装备、发现不同路线，把每场任务都变成 T.H.U.N.D.E.R. 的私人游乐场。

记住：潜行可以省。搞出一团乱可不行。

世界

值得到处闻一闻的世界。

哥特式古堡、杂草丛生的温室、阴森游乐园、秘密设施，还有任何狗狗按理说都不该踏进去的地方。T.H.U.N.D.E.R. 的任务将带你穿梭于风格截然不同的世界。

别只走眼前那条路。嗅出隐藏通道、秘密房间、收藏品、挑战，以及散落在任务各个角落的惊喜。

也别急着赶路。有时候，拯救世界最好玩的部分，就是看看开发团队到底在那面怎么看都很可疑的墙后藏了什么。

简单来说

一场由超级好狗狗领衔主演的间谍冒险。

《BARKOUR》有幽默、有荒诞，也少不了恰到好处的狗狗式混乱。但 T.H.U.N.D.E.R. 的任务可不全是闹着玩的。

在故事中认识 26 位个性鲜明的角色，遇见盟友、反派、意想不到的转折，以及任何特工手册都不会教你的荒唐场面。视觉笑料、丰富表情和搞笑桥段之间，也藏着更有感情的时刻。

用超过 100 种自定义内容打造属于你的 T.H.U.N.D.E.R.，其中一些设计灵感更直接来自玩家社区。

因为再厉害的特工，终究还是一只狗。超过 30 种表情动作取材自真实狗狗的日常，让养狗的人忍不住大喊：“天啊，我家的也会这样！”

超过 15 小时游戏内容。数不清的可疑决定。

一只超级好狗狗。
body.en:
GOOD BOY. TOP AGENT.

Meet Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a highly trained special agent, master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble.

He may be one of M.A.N.'s finest agents, but underneath all that spy gear, he's still a (not so) ordinary dog. He wags his tail, follows his nose and sometimes lets his canine instincts get the better of perfectly professional Agent behaviour.

Fortunately, saving the world sometimes calls for exactly that.

YOUR MISSION. YOUR METHODS.

Run across walls, grind along rails and leap through missions with canine agility. Sneak through the shadows, distract enemies with spy gadgets, find a secret passage... or forget subtlety altogether and jump straight into the action.

BARKOUR blends fast-paced platforming, stealth, combat and high-tech gadgets, giving you the freedom to tackle each challenge your way.

Experiment with an arsenal of over 30 gadgets, discover alternate routes and turn every mission into T.H.U.N.D.E.R.'s personal playground.

AND REMEMBER - STEALTH IS OPTIONAL. MAKING A MESS DEFINITELY ISN'T.

A WORLD WORTH SNIFFING AROUND.

Gothic castles, overgrown greenhouses, creepy amusement parks, secret facilities and places no dog was ever supposed to enter. T.H.U.N.D.E.R.'s missions will take you through wildly different worlds.

Step off the obvious path. Sniff out hidden passages, secret rooms, collectibles, challenges and surprises tucked throughout handcrafted missions.

And take your time. Sometimes the best part of saving the world is finding out what the developers hid behind that suspicious-looking wall.

A SPY ADVENTURE WITH A VERY GOOD BOY AT ITS HEART.

BARKOUR is built on humor, absurdity and carefully controlled canine chaos. But T.H.U.N.D.E.R.'s adventure has another side to it, too.

Meet 26 distinctive characters in a story packed with allies, villains, unexpected twists and situations you definitely will not find in any special agent handbook. Visual comedy, expressive characters and gags are mixed with more emotional moments.

Give T.H.U.N.D.E.R. your own style with over 100 customization items, including ideas inspired by our community.

And because even the best Agent is still a dog, there are over 30 emotes inspired by real canine behaviour. The kind that makes dog owners say: “Oh my God, my dog does exactly that!”

OVER 15 HOURS OF GAMEPLAY. COUNTLESS QUESTIONABLE DECISIONS.

ONE VERY GOOD BOY.

description.zh: 三天。一个注定被彻底毁灭的世界。一名逃离邪教的人隐姓埋名地四处游荡，维系并培育着所剩无几的小小社区。即使历史已被理解，异界恐怖也已被清除，到头来，似乎依然没有什么真正值得争夺或挽回。
description.en: Three days. A doomed world destined to be flattened. A cult escapee wanders in obscurity, cultivating the little community that remains. Despite history comprehended and otherworldly horror culled, there remains nothing at stake.

body.zh:
Nothing At Stake is an open world action-adventure with a roguelike structure styled in the vein of classic n64 games, specifically taking inspiration from the first 3d Legend of Zelda games.

Within is an oblique dark fantasy world packed full of dungeons, ruins of a recently dead civilization, and colorful characters doing their best to survive in a seemingly hopeless world.

Help them make something of the scattered chaos that remains or set down your own path accumulating power as you scope out a land you'd been long isolated from. Whatever your path, tread carefully, as there is no coming back from death.

Story

OVER A DECADE AGO, THE DOMINANT CIVILIZATION FELL.

STRUCK BY AN OTHERWORLDLY FORCE, MANIFESTED IN THE FORM OF A 100 QUADRILLION TON CONGLOMERATION OF ROCK, METAL, AND OTHER INDETERMINATE SUBSTANCES.

A WORLD IN TATTERS, STREWN BY PILES OF RUIN AND UNDYING, UNMANAGED MACHINERY REMAINS.

FORMERLY SUBJUGATED PEOPLES SPREAD OUTWARD FROM THEIR FORMERLY PENNED-IN CORNERS, TRYING TO MAKE SENSE OF THE RUBBLE AND THEIR IMPENDING DOOM.

description.zh: 在阳台、海岸码头、悬崖、热带雨林、荒漠等各种地点，建造属于你自己的观鸟地，静静等待可爱的小鸟们前来造访。 这是一个轻松治愈的桌面放置游戏——像一张张小小的明信片，安静停留在电脑屏幕的一角。让美丽的风景与可爱的小鸟陪伴你的屏幕时光！别忘了拿起相机，拍下那些有趣又温柔的瞬间吧。
description.en: Turn your desktop into your very own birdwatching spot, and await the arrival of new avian friends! Enjoy a cozy idle game — place a tiny postcard on the corner of your screen, keeping you company with pleasant scenes and visiting birds. Oh, and don't forget your camera!

body.zh:
观鸟爱好者大集合！

我们制作了一款桌面放置的观鸟游戏！在屏幕的一角放置属于你的小小的明信片、一扇通向另一个世界的小小窗口。

自由装饰你的观鸟地——如果小鸟正好也喜欢这里，也许就会前来造访。

关注我们：

官方QQ 2号群：330596032

官方QQ 3号群：1079700052

官方#腾讯频道：观鸟笔记 频道号：guanniaobiji

小红书、bilibili、小黑盒同名

多个待解锁地点，码头、海滩、荒漠、雨林……每个地方都有独属的环境和小鸟。

观鸟地可以任意缩放移动，陪伴你的所有屏幕时间！自由装饰你的观鸟地吧~

蓝图系统已上线！可以保存装修、分享装修、快速切换装修！

不只有麻雀~几十种不同的小鸟，会在不同的时候前来造访。也许你还能抓拍到属于你的精彩瞬间。

小鸟造访后提升小鸟好感度，能够解锁更多小鸟生态行为。

拍下那些有趣又温柔的瞬间吧

今天加新了什么鸟？还有观鸟地、建筑、拍照、成就……一切收入图鉴笔记中！

放大小鸟头像，更多小鸟的辨别特征等待解锁

现在可以切换观鸟地的昼夜和晴雨状态——无论何时打开，都有适合此刻环境与心情的观鸟地陪伴……

夜间会有夜行小鸟等待与你邂逅～

大家一起来观鸟！化身小鸟降落在朋友的观鸟地，留下表情、照片雨掉落物作为小小纪念。

还可以申请收藏他人的观鸟地蓝图，把喜欢的布置灵感带回自己的小鸟大陆。

小鸟会带来不同的礼物，收集它们！有各种颜色的羽毛，也许还有……

鸦老板喜欢亮晶晶的一切：亮闪闪的羽毛、瓶盖，还有它会奉还给你的金币~！
body.en:
Birders, assemble!

We've developed a cozy idle game just for you. Now, you can enjoy birdwatching from the comfort of your desktop, too!

Place your postcard — a window to another world — right at the corner of your screen.

Decorate your favourite birding spot to your heart's content. If a bird happens to fancy your humble abode, it just might stop by for a visit!

Join us on Discord!

Unlock a variety of birding spots! The docks, beaches, deserts, even rainforests…

Each place has its own unique scenery, and new bird species to discover!

Your Birding Area can be freely manipulated!

Zoom, move, and arrange your favourite birding spot however you like

— the birds will keep you company while you work.

The Blueprint System is now live!

You can save your builds, share them, and quickly switch between different designs!

Sparrows aren't the only birds that want to hang out.

There are dozens of other bird species, too!

They have their own preferred times to visit — maybe you can capture something wonderful!

The more a bird visits, the more comfortable they'll feel!

You might be able to discover new behaviors over time…

Snap! Immortalize your favourite moments with your camera.

Once you've documented every unique behavior from a bird, you'll earn a statue of them!

Any new lifers today?

Your handbook also keeps a record of Birding Areas, decoration, photographs, achievements, and more!

If you enlarge the main illustration, you'll be able to discover just what traits make that bird special!

You can change the time of day and weather of your Birding Area as you desire.

Regardless of time, or weather, you'll meet a new friend who enjoys it, that's for sure!In the night, nocturnal birds await…

Join your friends for a birdwatching session!

Transform into a little bird and land in your friends’ birdwatching spots, leaving behind emotes, photos, and little gifts as keepsakes.

You can also request and collect blueprints of other players’ birdwatching spots, bringing your favorite layout inspirations back to your own Birdland.

Your bird friends will bring all sorts of trinkets for you to collect!

They'll drop all sorts of colorful feathers, and maybe more…

Boss Crow loves anything that sparkles — whether it be shimmering feathers, or the bright glint of bottle caps!

He'll return the favor in Crow Coins!

More features are under development:

you'll be able to share gorgeous birding spots with your friends, and more…

description.zh: 真正的恐惧，源自本能。踏上一场依赖躲避的生存恐怖之旅，想尽一切办法办法，躲避恐龙这些自然界顶级猎手的追击。深入树木丛生的荒野，探索隐没其间的废弃研究设施。在躲避追猎、制造干扰与挣扎求生的过程中灵活应变，逐步揭开这座岛屿最深处的秘密。
description.en: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

body.zh:
《失落荒野》是一款生存恐怖游戏，电影氛围浓厚，游戏玩法依赖躲避，将为你带来前所未有的游戏体验。狡猾的恐龙对你穷追不舍，在不断升温的紧张氛围下，你需要随机应变，借助环境摸出一条生路。

你将化身萨斯基亚，在史前凶残巨兽无处不在的死亡震慑下，探索神秘岛屿。低调行事，保持警觉，躲避掠食者的追捕。走投无路的时候，就拔腿狂奔吧，或者借助工具替自己争取片刻喘息，上演一场紧张刺激的猫鼠大戏。

游戏特色

智斗恐龙

直面恐龙的威胁。你的对手不是怪兽，而是凶残的荒野猛兽。无论对手是成群出动、组队围猎，还是单独出击、步步紧逼，你要做的，就是仔细观察，从对手的行为中寻找破绽，破解危局。

深入探索

在这片凶险万分的荒野中，探索废弃的研究设施，躲避无处不在的史前巨兽。一路搜寻、收集有用物资，为自己多争取一线生机；但随着探索脚步一步步深入，你面临的危险也将一步步升级。

挣扎求生

谨慎行动，甩开那些穷追不舍的掠食者。制造干扰，让地形和环境为你所用。狭路相逢时，之前收集的各类物品都可能派上用场，想方设法发挥它们的妙用，让自己活下去。迂回周旋，拔腿狂奔，实在走投无路，就先找个地方藏起来吧。

待解之谜

你扮演的萨斯基亚一睁眼，就发现自己来到了一座被远古生物占据的神秘岛屿。面对无处不在、步步紧逼的恐龙，萨斯基亚只能一边竭力求生，一边挖掘深埋的秘密，探寻自己与这座岛屿的联系。
body.en:
The Lost Wild is a cinematic evasion-based survival horror experience unlike any other. Experience the slow burn tension of being hunted by intelligent dinosaurs as you use your wits and the environment to survive.

Play as Saskia as you explore a mysterious island where you’re considered prey by the deadliest creatures of all-time. Keep your head down, stay alert, and evade deadly predators. If all else fails, run or try to buy time using non-lethal tools, resulting in intense cat and mouse style gameplay.

FEATURES

Deadly Dinosaurs

Come face-to-face with dinosaurs that behave like wild animals, not monsters. Whether intelligently hunting as a pack or closing in on you as an apex predator, feel the tension as you carefully observe their behavior to overcome the threat.

Explore

Discover abandoned facilities embedded in an unforgiving wilderness teeming with prehistoric life. Scavenge and acquire useful items to improve your chances of survival, but become subject to ever-increasing dangers the deeper you explore.

Survive

Move carefully and elude predators hunting you down. Create distractions and use your environment to your advantage. Make use of items you’ve discovered to give yourself options in each encounter. Outmaneuver, run, and if all else fails, hide.

A Mystery to Unravel

Play as Saskia who wakes up on a mysterious island teeming with prehistoric creatures. Hunted by dinosaurs, Saskia must find a way to survive while uncovering the mysteries of the island and her place within it.

description.zh: 快来认识Ember吧，你毛茸茸的魔法伙伴！带她回家，悉心照料，与她一同探索非凡的“异境”世界。《Stay: Your Forever Pet!》由VR作品《Stay: Forever Home》的原班团队倾力打造。
description.en: A cozy pet sim where you raise Ember, your magical fox-like companion. Bring her home, care for her, and venture into the Shimmershift together -- deepening your bond one adventure at a time.

body.zh:
这是Ember！你的宠物伙伴与新挚友

在《在我身边：萌友随行!》中，好好照料你的毛茸茸小伙伴吧！这是一款治愈系模拟小游戏，你可以探索奇幻童趣的世界，搜集物资、兑换好物，为你的宠物和小家打造专属装扮。你的Ember会为你的生活增添魔法与淘气，还会带你走进一片奇幻之地，开启一段专属冒险。逼真的行为与动画，让Ember成为有史以来最灵动鲜活、随性自然的虚拟宠物。

轻松休闲·适配碎片时间

可以按照自己的节奏尽情游玩。你和Ember将并肩同行，一起搜集物资、清除棘手的荆棘杂草，并探索神秘的“异境”。

打造专属造型

用每日搜集到的物资，兑换零食、玩具、服饰、装饰品等等。这里有上百种玩具和服饰可供选择，快来为你的Ember挑选贴合它独特模样与性格的装扮吧。从舒适的宠物小床到精致的墙面装饰，你也能兑换上百种饰品，打造一个属于你和Ember的专属小家。

游戏特色

•

独一无二的虚拟宠物，等待你的悉心照料与之建立情感羁绊

•

逼真的行为表现：实时AI与动画系统，对周遭世界做出真实反应

•

一同探索充满奇思妙想的异界

•

与Mosslings互动：它们是一群可爱的小生灵，时而调皮捣蛋，时而暖心相助

•

与Ember漫步时，一同搜集各类物资

•

用搜集到的物资兑换装饰品、饰品、零食、玩具等丰富好物

•

装扮你的伙伴：为她打造属于自己的风格

•

布置你和宠物共同居住的虚拟家园

以上是《Stay: Your Forever Pet!》在先行版包含的内容。随着开发的推进，我们将持续加入更多新内容与玩法。

关于团队

由一支资深开发团队打造，我们曾参与开发《Peridot》、《植物大战僵尸2》、《马拉维拉岛的奇禽异兽》、《Wheel World》以及《幕府将军的头骨》等游戏作品。
body.en:
Meet Ember, Your Pet and New Best Friend

Take care of a furry friend in Stay: Your Forever Pet! In this cozy simulation game, explore a whimsical world, collecting resources and earning goods to accessorize your pet. Your Ember will bring magic and mischief into your space and take you on an adventure in a fantastical land. Believable behaviors and animation make Ember the world’s most spontaneous and vividly alive virtual pet ever made.

A Day with Ember

Every day with Ember follows a rhythm. You start by giving her what she wants to start the day, getting her ready for what's ahead. You can spend your downtime together, then set out on an expedition into the Shimmershift to recover her magic and just maybe, find her pack. Back home, you celebrate the day's finds, care for her, and wind down before it all begins again.

Low-Stress Gameplay

Play at your pace. You and your Ember work as a team to hunt for resources, banish thorny weeds, and explore the mysterious Shimmershift.

Craft Your Look

Use the resources you forage every day to trade for treats, toys, pet clothes, decorations, and more. There are dozens of toys and clothes to choose from -- 70 at launch -- find an outfit that suits your Ember’s unique look and personality.

Expeditions to the Shimmershift

Beyond your home lies hers: the Shimmershift, a strange wilderness where Ember's curiosity can run ahead of her caution. Embark on expeditions together: thorn-walled blockades that her magic can clear, sudden dangers to shelter her from, Mosslings to chase off, and quiet moments of wonder along the way. Ember can't do it alone. You read what she needs, call her back when she strays, steady her nerve, and decide together which path to take, spending her energy wisely so you both reach the end. Expeditions are the heart of Stay's adventure, and the system we'll keep deepening all through Early Access: new lands, new challenges, and new ways to face them, side by side.

Features

Care for and bond with a unique virtual pet

•

Lifelike behaviors and animation respond to the world as it's happening

•

Explore a whimsical Shimmershift together

•

Interact with Mosslings, delightful critters sometimes mischievous, other times helpful

•

Forage for resources while walking with your pet

•

Trade resources to receive decorations, accessories, treats, toys, and more

•

Dress up your companion to express your unique style

•

Customize your shared virtual yard

These are the current features in Stay: Your Forever Pet! as early access. Additional content and new gameplay features will be added as the game further develops.

About the Team

Stay: Your Forever Pet! is made by an indie team who've spent their careers making creatures feel charming and alive on games like Plants vs Zombies 2, Peridot, and Beasts of Maravilla Island. It's Ember's second outing, following her VR debut in Stay: Forever Home.

title.zh: 生肖纪 鸡哥和他的朋友们

description.zh: 这是一款温情满满、故事丰富的休闲解谜游戏，意在用轻松可爱的表达展现生肖文化。在精美的国风手绘世界中，你可以体验到美食烹饪、恋爱模拟、剪纸园艺等等趣味玩法。来随鸡哥一起穿越回古代，粉墨一场关于家庭与爱的人生故事。
description.en: A heartfelt, story-rich casual puzzle adventure celebrating the best of ancient Chinese culture. Explore an exquisitely hand-drawn world with delightful surprises, from cooking, finding hidden objects, paper crafting, and more. Guide Rooster in an emotionally rewarding tale about family and love.

body.zh:
故事背景——生肖联欢闹翻天！

十二生肖在新年夜聚会，傲气的鸡哥实在闹过头了，最终导致其他生肖忍无可忍——他竟然弄哭了兔大厨！忍无可忍的龙决定施展魔法，将鸡哥送回古代，让他好好反省。

在游戏中，你将随酉鸡“鸡哥”一起，与叫“小鸽”的凡人相遇。在小鸽的人生之路上，帮他解决各式各样的问题，其中每件事都潜藏着和生肖伙伴和解的契机。相信只要有你的明智，生肖们还是能欢聚一堂，共庆佳节！

游戏特色——最重要的是把爱融进细节！

我们在美术上采用了可爱版的水墨画风格，同时设计了大量灵动的动画和效果与之搭配，力图为大家带来温馨轻松的游戏体验。

人一生的烟火故事总是有笑有泪，即便平凡，也有值得铭记的种种时刻。虽然是休闲题材，我们还是选择结合生肖文化，用尽可能的用更多的故事和情节来创作这款生肖纪，希望这能抚慰到每一位玩家。

另外，请不要担心会在哪一步卡住，我们鼓励用才智征服鸡哥遇到的种种谜题。但也忘记加入无障碍设计和必要的小提示，确保每位玩家都能愉快的享受游戏。

游戏玩法——人生关，关关难过关关过！

寻找物品、推理、猜谜、烹饪、剪纸、园艺……甚至是塔防和恋爱模拟，生肖纪为大家带来休闲玩法的一大桌年夜饭！

生肖伙伴们都有自己的独到的特质，当然也有不同的象征，鼠的财富，牛的勤劳，兔的善良，蛇的冷静…… 每个关卡都会在此基础上展露创意，并灵活融入生活中的小难题，十余关玩法都各不相同！

鸡哥最后能否顺利和众生肖重归于好，最大的难关又要具备什么才能从容应对。经历一整遭人间烟火，相信大家都能找到自己的答案。
body.en:
About Rooster

It's here!

Rooster is a beautiful and funny adventure celebrating Chinese culture and community with some of its best attributes - traditional folklore, art, music, and of course, food. Made in the best Indie tradition!

Our game opens with the 12 animals of the Chinese Zodiac gathering for their annual Lunar New Year’s Eve party. Rooster’s terrible behaviour is finally too much for the animals to bear – especially when he makes Rabbit cry! Fed up, Dragon conjures a potion and sends Rooster back in time to Ancient China to teach him some lessons.

As Rooster, you’ll meet Little Dove, a human whose life milestones provide reasons to help and make up with your Zodiac animal friends, just in time for a clean start and a happy Lunar New Year.

Make wise choices along the journey, or risk being stuck in the past forever!

Rooster is made possible with the support of the Canada Media Fund and Ontario Creates.

Features

•

Stunning art style inspired by Chinese brush painting with hilarious animation

•

Engaging, Emotional story

•

Gorgeous Original Soundtrack

•

Designed For Accessibility

Huge variety of gameplay with hidden object levels, puzzles, a dating sim, cooking, logic, dialogue choices, paper crafting, garden design, tower defence and the ultimate boss level - how to give a proper apology!

Complete 12 levels – one for each Chinese Zodiac animal

Level 1 - Rat

In this hidden object level, make an apology basket for Rat, who loves to eat and is the sign of wealth and surplus.

Level 2 - Ox

In this hidden object and puzzle assembly level, find objects and solve a mystery with Ox, a hardworking and dependable friend.

Level 3 - Tiger

In this dating sim level, help find a wife for Little Dove. As the guardian of children, Tiger is a creative thinker, confident, and a little unpredictable – like turning an Ancient Chinese matchmaking situation into a game show.

Level 4 - Rabbit

In this hidden object/cooking level, Rabbit is usually quiet, elegant, kind, and friendly. But Rabbit’s hilarious reactions to your ingredient choices may prove otherwise as you help find the perfect ingredient for a special soup.

Level 5 - Dragon

In this cooking level, Dragon is a useful force in the kitchen, with magically-powered fiery and icy breath. As the symbol for luck and success, Dragon’s naturally-ingrained leadership will help get the job done … to a point. Then it’s on you.

Level 6 - Snake

Snake is usually able to calmly think of solutions amidst chaos … but not when it comes to babysitting. Help Snake choose a body shape to keep Baby safe in a gorgeous marketplace FULL of hazards.

Level 7 - Horse

In this transmutation level, energetic and carefree Horse needs help creating items for the human family that will create joy.

Level 8 - Goat

As the symbol of filial piety, purity, and kindness, Goat is on a poignant mission and needs help identifying hidden objects based on clues.

Level 9 -Monkey

Confident and careful, industriously crafty Monkey needs help with some paper crafts during a somber time.

Level 10 - Dog

Honest and smart, loyal Dog needs help cleaning up a decrepit garden and bringing it back to its sparkling glory.

Level 11 – Pig

Gentle, caring, family-loving Pig is busy getting ready for a 100-day feast - and THEN everybody is invited! With a new baby and parents who just need to rest, fending off overbearing relatives trying to come early and offer their unsolicited advice is part of your tower defense mission.

Level 12 - Rooster

It’s the ultimate boss fight … yourself! Self-reflection, correct choices, and awareness are the keys to success!

Experience heartwarming growth with lovable characters as you journey across time, creating beautiful memories spanning multiple generations. Rooster is forged by feathered kindness and love!

As seen in Future of Play Direct, Wholesome Games Direct, and Game Devs of Color Expo.

movies.title: 生肖纪 鸡哥和他的朋友们简体中文版宣传片

description.zh: 扮演一只牧羊犬，守护羊群与唯一信任他的那个人。随着狼群逼近，你必须面对所效忠的世界与野性呼唤之间的裂痕。驱赶羊群，追踪气味，在北方土地守护农场。
description.en: Play as a working shepherd dog protecting his flock and the only human who trusts him. As wolves draw closer, you must face the growing divide between the world you serve and the wild that calls to you. Herd sheep, track scents, and guard the farm across rugged northern lands.

body.zh:
化身为忠诚的牧羊犬休伯特（Hubert），在未知的北方荒野中穿行。在这款极具氛围感的身临其境的第三人称冒险游戏中，你将引导失散的羊群穿过美丽的自然风光，勇敢面对恶劣的天气、险峻的地形和隐藏的危险。休伯特将沉浸式的叙事与独特的放牧玩法体验相结合，一切都从一只尽职尽责的工作犬的视角展开。

一个关于友谊、勇气和对着羊群吠叫的故事。

关于这只狗狗

•

认识一下休伯特，一只毛茸茸且极度自信的小狗，它对麻烦有着敏锐的嗅觉。它通过动作、气味、本能和好奇心来观察世界。

•

你将完全从休伯特的视角体验这段旅程。作为一只尽职的工作犬，它在这个安静的世界里学习如何生存，而这个世界慢慢展现出比预想中更难以捉摸的一面。

关于羁绊

•

休伯特并不孤单。在他身边的是莉莉（Lily），一个机智的孩子，她刚刚说服了山谷里最脾气暴躁的农民给他们一份工作。

•

他们的关系在共同的日常琐事、微小的瞬间和无声的信任中不断成长。

•

随着周围世界的改变，这种羁绊也会受到微妙的考验，塑造着休伯特看待世界的方式，以及他坚持下去的理由。

关于羊群

•

他们的任务是放牧数十只略显混乱的羊穿过牧场。很简单，对吧？

•

好吧，如果这些羊的注意力像金鱼一样短，而农民又毫无耐心，那就没那么简单了。

•

用心放牧（还有毛茸茸的身躯）：休伯特指挥官正带领着一支绵羊纵队。

•

充满吠叫与小插曲的故事：体验农场生活，建立意想不到的友谊，并努力保持在农民心目中的好印象，或者至少远离他愤怒的吼叫声。

关于荒野

•

在围栏线之外，土地变得更加安静和陌生。

•

森林里有什么东西吗？那里有什么东西。这不仅是一个威胁，也是一种休伯特能理解但无法完全解释的呼唤。

•

画作般的魅力：探索在表面上看起来温暖宜人的乡村，但这里隐藏着不安、神秘的时刻，偶尔还会对着月亮嚎叫。

警告：本游戏包含轻微的恶作剧、顽固的绵羊，以及一只认为自己是主角的小狗（也许他是对的）。
body.en:
Step into the paws of Hubert, a loyal shepherd navigating the uncharted northern wilderness. In this atmospheric third-person adventure, guide a scattered flock of sheep across gorgeous nature, braving harsh weather, treacherous terrain, and hidden dangers. Hubert blends immersive storytelling with a unique herding gameplay experience, all from the perspective of a devoted working dog.

A tale of friendship, bravery, and barking at sheep.

THE DOG

•

Meet Hubert, a fluffy and overconfident dog with a nose for trouble. He sees the world through movement, scent, instinct, and curiosity.

•

You experience the journey entirely from Hubert’s perspective, as a devoted working dog learning his place in a quiet world that slowly proves less predictable than it seems.

THE BOND

•

Hubert is not alone. By his side is Lily, a sharp-witted kid who just convinced the grumpiest farmer in the valley to give them a job.

•

Their relationship grows through shared routines, small moments, and quiet trust.

•

As the world around them changes, that bond is tested in subtle ways, shaping how Hubert sees the world and why he keeps going.

THE HERD

•

Their mission is to herd dozens of mildly chaotic sheep across pastures. Easy, right?

•

Well, not when the sheep have the attention span of a goldfish and the farmer has zero patience.

•

Herding With Heart (and Fur): Commander Hubert is leading a battalion of sheep.

•

A Story Full of Barks and Blunders: Navigate farm life, forge unlikely friendships, and try to stay on the farmer’s good side, or at least out of range of his angry voice.

THE WILD

•

Beyond the fence line, the land grows quieter and stranger.

•

There is something in the woods? Something is out there. It is not just a threat, but a call Hubert understands in ways he cannot fully explain.

•

Brush-Painted Charm: Explore a countryside that feels warm and inviting on the surface, yet hides moments of unease, mystery, and the occasional howling at the moon.

Warning: This game contains mild mischief, stubborn sheep, and a dog who thinks he’s the main character (He might be right.)

description.zh: 《这有猫腻》是一款温馨又治愈的游戏。步入精美的黑白手绘世界，体验不同文化的风景，寻找隐藏起来的猫咪，用镜头捕捉它们，继而让猫咪恢复色彩。
description.en: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

body.zh:
Cat Me If You Can 将带你进入一个黑白漫画风格的3D世界，处处藏着毛茸茸的惊喜和待解的谜题，等你来探索并沉醉其中。

快扎进这个温馨又迷人的手工世界吧！寻找藏匿在各处的猫咪，用相机捕捉它们的呆萌瞬间。瞪大双眼——只有最敏锐的观察者，才能发现那些藏得最深的“毛绒团子”！

想找到所有的猫咪？可没那么简单！它们有些藏在谜题里，有些躲在锁住的门扉或各种奇妙的机关后，等着你去破解。

在充满魅力与神秘感的独特氛围中，放松身心，开启一段穿越时空的宁静之旅——当然，还有猫咪相伴。从古埃及的阳光沙滩，到日本的温馨小巷，再到中世纪古堡的幽静角落。每一个目的地都值得你驻足细品，仔细探寻，与每一只隐藏的毛球宝贝不期而遇。

精彩纷呈的游戏内容：

3 个主题迥异的世界，内含 9 个精心打造的关卡。

超过 725 只猫咪等你找到它们、抓拍它们、爱上它们！

50 多个任务与谜题等你探索。

细节满满的关卡：

每个场景的灵感均源自现实世界的人文风情，各个角落都藏着独特的细节，等你来挖掘。

别具一格的猫咪世界：

想看看中世纪打工喵是什么样吗？或者日本民间传说里的妖怪喵感不感兴趣？

快来《这有猫腻》一探究竟！
body.en:
Cat Me If You Can takes you into black-and-white comic style 3D worlds filled with countless feline friends and charming secrets to discover and get lost in.

Immerse yourself in cozy, handcrafted worlds teeming with charm. Seek out hidden cats and capture their adorable moments with your camera.

Stay sharp - only the keenest observers can uncover the most cleverly concealed fluffballs!

Not every cat is easy to spot! Some are hiding behind riddles, locked doors, or curious contraptions just waiting to be figured out.

Solve clever puzzles, decode clues, and uncover hidden pathways to reveal even more elusive feline friends. Every puzzle you crack brings you one paw closer to completing your collection!

Unwind as you take a peaceful journey through atmospheric locations filled with charm and mystery, and, of course, cats. From the sun-soaked sands of Ancient Egypt to the intimate streets of modern Japan, and the quiet corners of majestic medieval castles, each destination invites you to slow down, look closer, and discover every hidden furball.

Packed with content:

9 handcrafted levels spread across 3 uniquely themed worlds.

Over 725 cats to find, photograph and love.

More than 50 quests and puzzles to solve.

Levels full of detail:

Each scene is inspired by real-world cultures, with unique details waiting to be discovered in every corner.

A world of their own:

Ever wanted to see cats working medieval jobs?

Or cats reimagined as creatures from Japanese folklore?

Now you can, in Cat Me If You Can!

description.zh: 在这片虚假先知横行的土地上，你要建立自己的教派，遍历大陆上神秘无比、风格迥异的各个区域，笼络一群笃信森林的忠诚追随者，广散你的真言，最终一统全境，成为唯一的正教。
description.en: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

body.zh:
《咩咩启示录》中，玩家将扮演一只因被阴郁不祥的陌生人拯救从而免于一死的被附体的羊羔。为了报答救命之恩，玩家需要以那人之名组建一支忠诚的追随者队伍。在这片虚假先知横行的土地上，你要建立自己的教派，遍历大陆上神秘无比、风格迥异的各个区域，笼络一群笃信森林的忠诚追随者，广散你的真言，最终一统全境，成为唯一的正教。

吸纳信徒收集利用手边资源，建造新的建筑、举行暗黑仪式来取悦众神，通过布道传教加强信众对你的信仰。

驱逐异端探索一片无限生长、随机生成的世界，与成群的敌人搏斗，击溃敌对领袖并将其力量统统吸纳，维护你的教派的绝对统治。

传播箴言训练你的信众，踏上探索四大神秘区域的揭秘之旅。沿途净化那些不信者的心智，传播大智慧的启蒙，进行神秘的仪式，最终成为无上威力的咩咩之神。
body.en:
Cult of the Lamb casts players in the role of a possessed lamb saved from annihilation by an ominous stranger, and must repay their debt by building a loyal following in his name. Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

BUILD YOUR FLOCKCollect and use resources to build new structures, perform dark rituals to appease the gods, and give sermons to reinforce the faith of your flock.

DESTROY THE NON-BELIEVERSExplore a sprawling, randomly generated world, fight off hordes of enemies and defeat rival cult leaders in order to absorb their power and assert your cult's dominance.

SPREAD YOUR WORD Train your flock and embark on a quest to explore and discover the secrets of four mysterious regions. Cleanse the non-believers, spread enlightenment, and perform mystical rituals on the journey to become the mighty lamb god.

description.zh: 踏上可爱的冒险之旅，结识新的伙伴，并尽情探索岛屿上的各种好玩事物。攀爬、游泳、滑翔、滑行……进行探索的方法多多，途中更能遇到不少个性角色，与大家成为知心好友！
description.en: Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer. Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels!

body.zh:
在岛上尽情撒欢！

在这场注重动作玩法的开放世界冒险里，似乎每个山头上都有个需要帮忙的小伙伴！教训纸片坏蛋，勇闯山丘密林，大胆攀登、征服峭壁，证明什么叫“初生鳄鱼不怕虎”！

体验探索带来的愉悦

探索一座精心打造的岛屿，在各个区域里结交伙伴，享受快乐。岛上每个区域都有独特的任务和角色，从在山巅之间滑翔，降落到剧团的小动物们头上；到与学前班的小伙伴们一起，挥舞木剑勇闯森林；再到深入Creaklands，探寻传说中的“酷小崽们”……还有更多的区域等待你去发现，不知道你会遇到谁呢！

!

结交奇趣伙伴

鳄鱼太小，世界太大……幸好，你在到处都能遇见朋友！结交新的动物伙伴，邀请它们与你一起在岛上撒欢吧。每位小伙伴都能为你的冒险助力，但要赢获对方的青睐并不容易——先从一两个任务开始吧！

巧手打造，彰显个性

在岛上，随处都能收集到手工艺材料！你可以用它们制作各种好宝贝，给小岛增添色彩！你还能制作新的能力，比如能让小鳄鱼一路从山顶滚到山脚的泰迪熊布娃娃，还能用小石块来打水漂，打中躲在远处的纸片坏蛋！

轻松教训坏蛋

本趟冒险，旨在解压！《小鳄鱼探险记》的重点在于探险与玩乐，所以不会用“生命条”这种东西妨碍我们的小勇士冲向目标！
body.en:
There’s a buddy atop every hill in this open-world, movement-focused adventure and they all seem to need help! Bop cardboard baddies, brave serene hills and forests, and scale sheer rocks that only a kid would dare!

Explore a lovingly crafted island full to the brim with areas to discover, friends to make and joy to be had. Each area of the island brings unique quests and characters to meet. Glide through the mountain tops and drop in on the Theatre Troupe kids, swing your stick sword through the forest with the Prep schoolers or find the ‘Cool Kids’ down in the Creaklands. With plenty more areas to discover, there's no knowing who you might run into!

The world is big when you’re a lil gator... Good thing it’s also full of friends! Make new friends and invite them to play in the islands playground. Each new friend you make will add to your adventure, but making new friends isn’t always easy, You might have to complete a quest or two!

Collect arts & crafts supplies all over the island! Use them to make yourself all kinds of goodies and bring the playground to life! Craft new abilities - use your ragdoll teddy to ragdoll lil gator from mountain top to the valleys below! Skim pebbles into hard to reach cardboard baddies!

A no-pressure adventure game! Lil Gator game focuses on adventure and play, don't let a health bar hold you back from reaching your goal!
